descriptions.dos:0001339bf3b0df3d: A Breakout-style game: keep the ball in play and clear every brick from each level. One or two special blocks per level set off an explosion that scores big if hit early.
descriptions.dos:000a8d7165feea19: Take manual control of a moon lander and guide it to a safe touchdown, using the cursor keys to fire thrusters in four directions while watching the fuel supply. Each lander starts with a different bearing and velocity.
descriptions.dos:00181574063532d2: A pirate simulation in the vein of Sid Meier's Pirates!. As young captain Richard Gray, master ship navigation, sword fighting, trading, sea and land warfare and crew recruitment in a story that grows more involved.
descriptions.dos:00189b0f82aa9068: A pre-rendered platform shooter from South Korea, in the style of Donkey Kong Country and a spiritual successor to Rebel Runner. The game is partly translated into English.
descriptions.dos:002275ef159dc27a: Explore the abandoned mansion of toymaker Henry Stauf and solve the puzzles he built into every room, uncovering what happened to the six guests who came before. A pre-rendered, full-motion video adventure.
descriptions.dos:004d9b0c2bf2c99b: A Lemmings-style puzzler. As a wizard who can create and remove blocks, steer the wandering Troddlers to the exit, who can climb walls and make the routing tricky.
descriptions.dos:0054954a7781cf8c: A Shanghai-style tile puzzle: clear the board by removing matching tiles that line up with nothing in between them. Sequel to Turn It.
descriptions.dos:005d9bfd38c97ffb: An isometric puzzle-action game in the vein of Alien 8. Drive an inertia-heavy tank through walled rooms, pushing blocks and shooting others to work out your mission.
descriptions.dos:0061b65d259c021e: Chess combined with Archon: pieces move by the rules of chess, but captures are fought out between living creatures. There is no check; the goal is to defeat the enemy king directly. One or two players.
descriptions.dos:006482a56da72f7b: A shareware version of draughts played against the computer, controlled by keyboard or mouse, in color or monochrome.
descriptions.dos:006dcfe00eaa96c2: A clone of Spy vs. Spy with many missions. Race a human or computer opponent to carry out tasks such as retrieving documents and escaping the building before the other side does.
descriptions.dos:006dd862c8b57d21: A Breakout clone with extras. Steer a racket with the arrow keys or mouse to hit balls into bricks, and fire rockets with a Gigablitz power to clear each level.
descriptions.dos:0071f2b63aadb7b2: Two math games, Beano and Rockets, played against the computer or a second person. Each side rolls dice and builds an arithmetic expression from the numbers, and the result decides the move.
descriptions.dos:00722c3fb7a21620: A puzzle game in which blob-like Freak aliens multiply across the screen, and humanity answers by challenging them to a game.
descriptions.dos:0080514f60e22237: An unofficial DOS version of Tetris: blocks fall one at a time, and the player rotates and moves them to form complete lines that disappear. The longer you last, the faster they fall.
descriptions.dos:00836429ba77227c: The first disk of Eamon, a public-domain role-playing series that began on the Apple II and works as an adventure construction set. The Main Hall is where you create and equip a character before setting out on adventures.
descriptions.dos:00860c27ab69f891: A beta version of a real-time strategy game. Four rival firms in red, green, blue and yellow share a small square map, and you command the yellow one.
descriptions.dos:0094f9d2b4dec530: An adventure and role-playing hybrid set in a post-apocalyptic northeastern United States, where a band of superheroes explores a flooded wasteland of mutants and surviving city-states.
descriptions.dos:009c99bb81cddb06: A strategy game in which you move armies around a map, destroy other armies and rescue hostages. The graphics are sprites from Red Alert.
descriptions.dos:009fafa8dc25829f: A freeware QuickBASIC arcade game by Mark Botta. Ski down a long slope; despite the title, points are scored for avoiding the trees.
descriptions.dos:00be24f92981fd42: An arcade platform action game in which you play Drak, the last Obliterator, a genetically engineered machine sent to save the Federation from an alien spacecraft. Screens are static, with optional scrolling.
descriptions.dos:00c535eb341dcd25: A computer version of the Trivial Pursuit board game with over 3,000 new questions, SVGA graphics, music and sound effects, and an animated quizmaster.
descriptions.dos:00d80aa44c88b9b0: Third in the Game of Robot puzzle series. On the island of Fana, you search for the friend who sent a call for help, with more emphasis on story than in earlier episodes.
descriptions.dos:00ddc513e9f4a800: A top-down American football game. Draft a team of 25 players in Team Draft mode, then design plays in the Chalkboard Editor and test them in the game as coach.
descriptions.dos:00e0268de46e9f04: A shareware two-player Battleships on a 10x10 grid. Hide an aircraft carrier, battleship, cruiser, submarine and patrol boat, all placed horizontally, in a keyboard-controlled game with character graphics.
descriptions.dos:00e33baa84a22b16: A rail shooter on the spaceship Amazon, sent to investigate Saturn and Jupiter for colonization. After contact is lost, you join the team sent to find out what happened to the crew.
descriptions.dos:011e8c941fcaccf0: An educational game teaching English grammar, with chapters on each part of speech, from nouns and pronouns to conjunctions and interjections. Hosted by the critters EG, Blip and the Its.
descriptions.dos:01265d44d09a3e34: A coloring book in the Electric Crayon series with 30 Inspector Gadget illustrations that carry safety messages. Color from 16 on-screen colors, or mix your own.
descriptions.dos:01425b008978887c: As Duncan, save the worlds of Dream and Reality from a dark force. The dream world lets you fly between sky islands or create a clone, and its creatures help or hinder you.
descriptions.dos:014f4a2101e4037e: A submarine adventure in which you command the U.S.S. Helldiver on patrol for German U-boats. A coded message from the Pentagon sends you to a crashed B-17 near the North Pole carrying a VIP and diplomatic documents.
descriptions.dos:01626cb2516ac558: The arcade sequel to Contra. As Scorpion and Mad Dog, fight through five levels to stop the alien Red Falcon, mixing side-scrolling and top-down action with a wide variety of enemies. One or two players.
descriptions.dos:0163651366ac130c: A side-scrolling action game in which you play a barbarian making your way through dangerous dungeons, with platform jumping and joystick-selected moves.
descriptions.dos:0164b746e71e2886: A shooter in which you play a spy in an enemy building made of six towers, each with a lift. Enemies ride the lifts, and you must shoot them before they shoot you.
descriptions.dos:016a2026e798cb56: A detective mystery in the style of 1940s private eye films. As detective Scott Anger, take the case of a mysterious woman looking for her missing brother Dan.
descriptions.dos:017ba4d11dd019da: A Breakout variant in which a baseball-playing bunny smashes bricks with a bat across 30 screens to rescue his girlfriend from an ape.
descriptions.dos:017d7e85daed5c7c: A video adventure with plenty of puzzle solving. As a new CIA operative called to Washington, investigate the assassination of a Russian presidential candidate and uncover a conspiracy reaching the highest levels of government.
descriptions.dos:0182987fd0ccad58: A submarine simulation based on Tom Clancy's novel. As Captain Marko Ramius, take the Red October into the Atlantic, meet the US Navy and fake its destruction while the Soviet fleet hunts you.
descriptions.dos:01a317cc80472eb4: Fourth in the Dangerous Dave series. Blast through levels of zombies with a shotgun to rescue Dave's little brother Delbert from Dr. Nemesis, who has hidden him in a mental hospital.
descriptions.dos:01a6a74ca8aa6d01: A text-based action game: rescue the hostages by shooting the bandits moving around a square area within 15 shots. Three difficulty levels.
descriptions.dos:01a990fa42244ce8: The official game of the 1996 European Championships in England. Pick from all 16 teams in the European Championship, a friendly, practice penalties or a practice match.
descriptions.dos:01b3377dd7db135b: Speedball 2: manage Brutal Deluxe, the worst team in the game, back up the table through a league of two eight-team divisions and two cup tournaments. A brutal futuristic sport.
descriptions.dos:01b3f2accbbca50a: A tennis simulation in which you start ranked 64th in the world and work up through the top tournaments against seeded players. One or two players.
descriptions.dos:01c064b4066a9af5: A paddle game with an added dimension: bounce the ball past your opponent's goal line, but the paddle moves in three-dimensional space instead of along a flat axis.
descriptions.dos:01dfc2842eb69531: A shooter in which you fight through the radioactive mutant army of General Akhboob, dictator of Kookistan, to free hostages from his stronghold. One or two players cooperatively.
descriptions.dos:01ea64f730c67b6c: A first-person horror adventure from Simulmondo starring comic detective Dylan Dog, largely based on Lovecraft's mythos. Investigate the murder of a famous archaeologist in a story that takes in Cthulhu and the Necronomicon.
descriptions.dos:020ca80ab2cc31de: A World War II combat flight simulator from Pie in the Sky, built around the F4U Corsair.
descriptions.dos:02102a98c29da707: A Tetris clone drawn in ASCII text, with gameplay identical to the original.
descriptions.dos:021d9f20745e81b2: An Olympic sports game in which you join the 1988 US team. Eight events, including velodrome sprint cycling, hurdles, pole vault, hammer throw, uneven bars, rings, archery and springboard diving. Practice events or play the whole competition.
descriptions.dos:021e2bd30f258818: A 3D spaceship shooter set in 2238 with untextured polygon graphics. As a pilot in the Ground Defense Games, fight through arenas on different planets in one of four ships with different handling.
descriptions.dos:022834f8c0b4d54a: A text adventure that begins on a train journey in search of the golden idol left by Major Johnston-Smythe. Other treasure hunters have tried before you, and most have never been seen again.
descriptions.dos:022fcb57ad0af118: A futuristic racer set in 2052. Race for one of four teams in the F3600 Anti-Gravity Racing League across six tracks, with hovercraft that differ in speed, acceleration and turning, and weapons to use along the way.
descriptions.dos:02322a514d5fffc4: Recover diamonds from an underground labyrinth while avoiding falling stones and wandering opponents.
descriptions.dos:02477e39c80a4924: A mouse-driven shooter: move the crosshairs and shoot the enemies that approach you.
descriptions.dos:024d3e76fc450121: A Russian first-person shooter that plays more like a technical demo than a full game.
descriptions.dos:024eb445700eccb1: Space Quest V. Roger Wilco is back at Starfleet Academy as both cadet and janitor, cheats his way to the rank of captain, and is handed a garbage scow and a mission to explore strange new worlds.
descriptions.dos:024f1979f673324a: A platform action game based on the British comic character and the 1995 film. A standard run-and-shoot formula with twists, such as wounding enemies until they surrender.
descriptions.dos:02585cbabf574feb: Based on the later chapters of Dragons of Autumn Twilight. The Heroes of the Lance descend into a ruined city to find the disks of Mishakal, fighting horizontally through a maze of rooms and switching between the eight heroes.
descriptions.dos:025c541c0e69d549: An unofficial add-on for Quake that continues the story after the official mission packs. Quake's general, the Dark Reaver Legond, returns from conquering another dimension in her master's name.
descriptions.dos:027c423c69c11ab0: As special agent Robert "Rip" Steel, command a small submarine to destroy the Yellow Shadow's network of undersea mining bases while defending your own.
descriptions.dos:027dddcdf59087ea: A shareware strategy game of global warfare against the computer, playing as the USA or the USSR. Each side starts with twenty numbered cities, and you launch missiles at them by typing Mxx.
descriptions.dos:02811071126d6f01: Pilot a lost spaceship that has stumbled into a nest of space goblins, which eat ships. Steer with the numeric keypad and fire a proton beam to destroy them.
descriptions.dos:028e9ae84280ba5a: A text adventure about Filbur Apse, an obnoxious man who annoys a wizard in disguise and is cursed for it. Find a way to undo the spell.
descriptions.dos:02a0f86c2e707f4a: A World War II naval combat simulation, the first with real-time filled 3D graphics. Command H.M.S. Onslaught, a British O-class destroyer with three cannon turrets, in a style reminiscent of Epyx's Destroyer.
descriptions.dos:02b1c47f3e6575b6: A boxing game with no pictures of boxers and no button mashing. Pick two all-time greats from a list, set the number of rounds, and watch the fight play out.
descriptions.dos:02b4bc0d92df2664: An early DOS version of the card game Crazy Eights.
descriptions.dos:02b6fbedee1682f5: A slot machine and poker machine simulation. The slot machine starts you with $100 at $0.25 per play and pays on cherries, plums, oranges and bars, while lemons lose.
descriptions.dos:02c4c7eab5bf039b: A platformer in which a boy named Mick, on vacation in a village, goes after a girl named Masha who has wandered toward a forest ruled by a heartless witch.
descriptions.dos:02caf6da9bb14047: An artillery game and a close relative of Scorched Earth, designed as a much improved and expanded take on classic tank duels. One or two players.
descriptions.dos:02d02f89968f2747: A naval strategy game late in the Cold War: command a nuclear-powered frigate on a million square miles of open sea, destroy as many Russian ships as you can and try to survive.
descriptions.dos:02d24d399b1c2b6b: A chess game that plays with the style of Mikhail Tal rather than always choosing the safest move. Sequel to Complete Chess System.
descriptions.dos:02e0345d679b9de3: A complex space exploration game in the spirit of Traveller. As a new independent starship captain in the Local Group, you trade, explore and fight, in the same setting as Omnitrend's later Breach games.
descriptions.dos:02e43f0b2e88e9c7: A soccer management sequel with 640x480 graphics and crisper office menus, with new team and individual features. Multiplayer is supported.
descriptions.dos:02f00026cfaa109f: A kart racer, follow-up to SuperKarts, with new tracks, improved graphics and sound and SVGA resolution. Choose from four kart classes, from 50cc to 250cc.
descriptions.dos:02fb8f5ba77675be: A refinery simulation made by Maxis for Chevron and never released to the public. As the plant manager, you learn how supply and demand shape the finances.
descriptions.dos:02fe5cce5b5ae11e: A text adventure in which you play the hungry household cat. Its master, called the Provider, is sick in bed, and you have to find food without annoying him.
descriptions.dos:03097916b2ed22cf: A tournament variation of Tetris pitting two or three players, human or computer, against each other.
descriptions.dos:031595996d0e563f: A first-person point-and-click adventure in a world where dinosaurs never died out and live among humans. The villain Morkus Rex and his Tyranns threaten the long peace between them.
descriptions.dos:0322e750acbda6a4: A text adventure in two halves: first you are at a bar trying to pick up women, then you become a grave robber. Full of jokes.
descriptions.dos:0327fe4c10a442b3: A text adventure written by Gary Bedrosian in 1979 for the Apple II and TRS-80, published by Avalon Hill, and ported to the PC by the author in 1986.
descriptions.dos:032b00384c8a0c93: The third and last part of the Realms of Arkania trilogy. Orcs again overrun the coast around the town of Riva, and the party uncovers a mysterious story on its quest to stop them.
descriptions.dos:0343a959f9516448: A Tetris-type arcade game that fills a cup with falling groups of one, two or three colored balls. Move and flip them so chains of matching balls disappear.
descriptions.dos:034b95cba85c627b: An educational game for children and adults to learn the books of the New Testament. They appear in random order, and you select them in the proper sequence with mouse or keyboard.
descriptions.dos:034fa8455b4fc8de: Interplanetary terrorism threatens the universe, so the Alien World Exploration organization sends bounty hunters to planets suspected of harboring terrorists. You are one of them.
descriptions.dos:03639429c4ba2621: The first of Titus's third-person racing series: the American Cross Country Prestige Cars Race. Start in a Porsche 911 Turbo and upgrade to a Lamborghini and then a Ferrari.
descriptions.dos:036f40bbdb3676de: A text adventure in the Battune series, made of four separate areas. Finishing one takes you to the next, with no return and no items carried over.
descriptions.dos:03777b55cc58a2ae: A fixed-screen shooter based on Namco's Galaga. Move left and right shooting waves of alien ships as they swoop and drop bombs.
descriptions.dos:037b2325b340eb99: A turn-based strategy game for multiple players, combining Heroes of Might and Magic style turns with Master of Orion style research of new units and army improvements.
descriptions.dos:03856c5b64f16eb7: The CD-ROM version of Jones in the Fast Lane, functionally identical to the original. Adds CD audio voice acting, extra animation and actor portraits, and takes little hard drive space.
descriptions.dos:038899c7bc4a8158: A Freescape 3D game from Incentive Software. A pyramid is built to destroy anything that blocks the sun, and an eclipse is coming. Collect ankhs to open doors, shoot mummies, find water and solve the pyramid.
descriptions.dos:039add28bb03593d: Drive a Fisher-Price fire truck as a fireman, rescuing pets from trees and people from houses in the neighborhood.
descriptions.dos:039b344e04ca56ac: A text adventure in which you are a notorious sneak-thief arrived in a new town. Secret war plans are hidden in the Palace, and you need The Fence and some good connections to pull off a caper.
descriptions.dos:03a046df5b326734: A shareware Euchre card game for one to four players, with the computer filling the empty seats. Played with a 24-card deck.
descriptions.dos:03b63e6099a8c3ff: A shooter: pilot a fighter ship and destroy all the enemy fighters, collecting power-ups such as extra lives, tri-shot and machine gun, avoiding missile turrets, and beating a boss.
descriptions.dos:03c32b4e3c3293ff: An action platformer set in an ancient Egyptian pyramid, which a plundering hero, a small mustached head with tiny legs, tries to rob armed with unlimited charges against enemies.
descriptions.dos:03d16b8be35aa66a: A puzzle game of cogs: each level shows a layout and a target layout, and you rotate cogs clockwise or anti-clockwise to turn one into the other. 110 levels on DOS.
descriptions.dos:03de22ae68e6c498: US Gold's game of the 1996 Atlanta Olympic soccer tournament. Pick from 33 teams and play exhibition games or the tournament.
descriptions.dos:03e2fe504d44ba25: A first-person shooter in which space pilot Mash Hardrock is hired by the Jupiter Moon Mining Corporation for a rescue operation, driving a moon buggy armed with a mining laser.
descriptions.dos:03e8ecd0f7b0c524: A SimCity-family simulation: save or develop the rainforest across 40 different isles, hiring people with differing environmental concerns. Includes custom isles.
descriptions.dos:03effd5d0c8143ae: Burst colored bubbles by linking three of the same color, aiming your shots at the right angle. The game ends when bubbles crowd past the bottom line.
descriptions.dos:03ff0a746de38072: A Highlander game originally released only on the Atari Jaguar; this is the unreleased PC version, which leaked online.
descriptions.dos:04030aa5c5450f94: A Boulder Dash-style game. As Joe Kowalski, make your way to the exit of six increasingly difficult caverns, each to be finished within five minutes, while avoiding enemies such as grabbers.
descriptions.dos:040a46b8b01d48c8: A platform action game in which Tal single-handedly clears aliens from a post-nuclear Earth. He must find a sacred suit of armor that shields him from radiation, heals him and lets him float.
descriptions.dos:040dc62ac01f7537: Papyrus's second racing game, four years after Indianapolis 500. Official license with all eight real tracks, sponsors and logos, multiple TV-style replays and a comprehensive garage and setup.
descriptions.dos:0421d8ce8a852311: A two-player shareware strategy game fought with charged tokens. A 16x10 grid is filled with red and blue counters, split between opposite halves of the screen.
descriptions.dos:042833b1f33cc253: An action game in which a Chinese prince fights dark opponents with his sword and spells such as magical arrows and fireballs, finding new magical weapons to defeat dragons and bosses.
descriptions.dos:042c0bd0f3f118b3: A platform game in which the shaman sorcerer Mabin sealed four classic movie monsters (Dracula, Frankenstein's monster, the Mummy and the Wolf Man) into a vessel, and the heroes Duchi and Bbukku deal with the consequences.
descriptions.dos:042d686e3c212131: Shao Kahn has won and Earthrealm is overrun. Using the Outworld Tournament as a diversion, he revives his Queen Sindel on Earth, and the fighters left must stop his extermination squads in one-on-one combat.
descriptions.dos:042e2a314893ad31: A text adventure from Australia, full of irreverent humor in the style of Infocom and Douglas Adams, with built-in pop-up hints.
descriptions.dos:04327f9f3861b0b3: An action game with light puzzle-solving. Travel through eight time periods, from Prehistoric and Roman Empire to Feudal Japan, Wild West and the Future, each with its own enemies and weapons.
descriptions.dos:0434b56f16510e29: A cyberpunk RPG based on When Gravity Fails. As private investigator Marid Audran, solve a murder in the Budayeen district, gather clues, buy cybernetic upgrades and survive turn-based fights.
descriptions.dos:044717f2e071c71f: Based on Buichi Terasawa's space pirate Cobra. After a message from Dominique, held prisoner by Salamandar, Cobra and his cybernetic partner Lady enter isometric arenas to rescue her.
descriptions.dos:045e8bbc3d5cb1dc: A German action game like Crillion, sequel to Bubble Blobb. It is like Breakout, but you control the ball directly: it bounces up and down on its own, and you steer it left and right.
descriptions.dos:0472d68a36d1fc3f: A medieval city adventure in which you play an honest thief who must stop a plot to assassinate the Duke. Arcade sequences such as fighting guards and climbing walls combine with talking to characters and collecting items.
descriptions.dos:04764827b99da6db: Based on the French TV game show. Take on the challenges of the island fortress with daring, strength and speed, facing the Fortress Council overseen by Father Fouras. Multiplayer.
descriptions.dos:04782cfa428ff2eb: A side-scrolling action game across six levels. Play Elliot Ness going after mob boss Al Capone, picking up weapons such as a shotgun and tommy gun, and watch out for Capone's henchmen.
descriptions.dos:047e513b2af72bcd: Part of the NBA Jam series. Choose from over 40 real college teams for head-to-head, tournament and season play, with arcade-style two-on-two basketball and wild dunks.
descriptions.dos:04975f18140d832b: An early fishing simulator in which you enter a bass competition with pro Rich Tauber as your partner. More than 20 lure types and colors, techniques from casting to flipping and jigging, and a working fish finder.
descriptions.dos:0497eee22e48defe: A Korean rail-shooter by Daekyo Computer that nearly filled a CD-ROM with prerendered animation, made openly to imitate and improve on Rebel Assault.
descriptions.dos:049bb29848826682: A text adventure with a random geography and consistently logical puzzles, like Zork or Colossal Cave, giving a complete treasure hunt that can be replayed endlessly.
descriptions.dos:04aa7dc034ace3d8: A top-down role-playing game with 256-color graphics and a mouse interface. As the Guildmaster, you explore a huge world after an invitation to visit. A complete game.
descriptions.dos:04afa7f0a240e7b5: A shareware single-variant solitaire game played entirely with the mouse: click the pack to deal, then move cards around the clock.
descriptions.dos:04bb945c2842cf2a: A first-person shooting gallery set in what could be 1930s Chicago. Shoot the gangsters who pop up in backyards and streets before they shoot you.
descriptions.dos:04be1b27d1f9922e: An SSI-style top-down role-playing game. Create a party of eight characters and travel a scrolling land of towns, mazes and dungeons in search of the Emperor's stolen crown, with tactical combat.
descriptions.dos:04c2819f850f0d41: In the year 691 of the celestial calendar the dimensional control computer Laxis goes rogue and flees to another era. In the power suit Arouza, with a dimensional controller, you hunt it down.
descriptions.dos:04d0773b4cc06a8e: Two-on-two beach volleyball with serves, thumps and spikes. 15 levels and 20 challengers on beaches such as Rio, Hawaii and Sydney, working toward being crowned King of the Beach.
descriptions.dos:04d1b6427d9092d0: Pilot a starglider along a road through space, avoiding obstacles and holes without running out of fuel or oxygen. The full version has 30 roads in 10 areas.
descriptions.dos:04e2252b3cedd351: A text adventure in which you must save your domed city from the Outsiders, under a time limit for the whole game and a shorter one for finding a way to protect the city.
descriptions.dos:04e3e083e8bf4e97: A Sesame Street educational game for one in which children practice counting, adding and subtracting in five activities, such as How Many Zips? and Beam That Number.
descriptions.dos:04e7a2658afd00c2: A real-time strategy game focused on managing units rather than building bases, licensed from AD&D in the Forgotten Realms. Five storylines of increasing difficulty with three missions each.
descriptions.dos:04f06cacbf43cf16: A beat-'em-up with detailed graphics. As a cyborg handyman, you fight your way through the robots of a megacorporation to reach the core and deactivate the evil AI that controls them.
descriptions.dos:04fcfb702759c3d8: A parser-driven adventure in the style of King's Quest, set in Pompeii in 79 A.D. As Avaricius, a wealthy Roman, escape the city before the volcano erupts.
descriptions.dos:05084961d33ca903: A puzzle game about making loops: place random pieces, from lines and corners to S bends and other shapes, on a grid and link them into a closed loop to move on.
descriptions.dos:050f5c9b8dc63a2b: A clone of Taito's Space Invaders modeled closely on the original arcade game. Move left and right at the bottom of the screen shooting rows of aliens, with those at the top worth more.
descriptions.dos:051d9a80bee80e50: Lars the Wanderer's medieval homeland is invaded by tiny yellow smilies in futuristic machines. With Mimi, the mad scientist's daughter, from the future, he sets out to stop them.
descriptions.dos:052c8462b9d86944: A no-frills version of Pong plus a Breakout variant, duplicating the originals almost exactly, without flashy graphics or sound effects.
descriptions.dos:05345bf3f701e58c: Sequel to Dark Designs I: Grelminar's Staff. Adventurers journey to Mount Delkeina, through its tunnels, to defeat an evil warlord and close the dimensional gate he uses to raise an army of monsters.
descriptions.dos:053cad72998f299f: An arcade puzzle platformer in which you control a ghost, with a different task on each level.
descriptions.dos:054894245336e921: A two-player dogfight on split screen or over a null-modem link, against the computer or a person. Takeoffs and landings are automatic, so you can focus on shooting, and crashes get flyby replays.
descriptions.dos:054fbafccaf00371: Control a US attack submarine in a hybrid of turn-based and real-time play: each turn has a timer, so you need to act fast on the large amount of information shown on screen.
descriptions.dos:05558ec9b0a87c16: A side-scrolling action-platform shooter featuring giant mechs, sharp animation and vibrant colors.
descriptions.dos:05736dd117708a97: A futuristic overhead tank shooter set in the year 3871. As the lone survivor of a frontier outpost attacked by alien larvae, pilot a security drone around each sector and repair the communication links to alert the Federation.
descriptions.dos:05748735852cbd42: A strategic and managerial wargame by GDG: command conquistadors in exploration, colonization and battle on land and sea on a fictive planet called Paradise.
descriptions.dos:057feddfc428ec30: An overhead pool game designed to be easy to control, with UK and US 8-ball and 9-ball games, customizable rules, computer opponents of varying skill, two-player play and a Survivor mode.
descriptions.dos:0583cb4e29f78c10: A basic protected-mode Tetris from 1998, with no options or difficulty selection. Later levels bring new backgrounds, music and pre-filled blocks.
descriptions.dos:0586392077da0981: A Gold Box AD&D role-playing game. A magical well brings adventurers to a frozen town under siege; create up to six characters, explore in first person and fight turn-based battles.
descriptions.dos:05873fa7b56f64eb: A shareware strategy game for one or two players on a grid of lines. Players take turns naming coordinates, with the objective of creating triangles.
descriptions.dos:059eb5863ec03dcd: An isometric shoot-'em-up from the arcades. Destroy the Zaxxon defence system in three stages, starting with the aircraft, guns and missiles of Asteroid City.
descriptions.dos:05b12d840232bcce: An educational U.S. geography simulation with 19 scenarios. Drive an 18-wheel truck around the country picking up and delivering commodities, using commands such as turning on the motor and examining the map.
descriptions.dos:05cb0f66eaafaf93: A third-person 3D racing game for one or two players with rudimentary physics and dynamic lighting. Eight cars (three models in different colors) and 15 tracks.
descriptions.dos:05cc07a7f13a69cf: Duke fights an alien invasion across a futuristic Los Angeles in a first-person shooter built around exploration, secrets and interactive scenery, with an unusual arsenal.

descriptions.dos:0669cc0b09f1401e: An educational geography quiz about Europe, teaching facts about the continent's countries, such as which borders which.

descriptions.dos:070f391cc5921c35: A Spanish show jumping game with a side view and simple arcade controls.

descriptions.dos:092442922ab5d2a9: A shareware collection of character-graphics games with a common theme, all based on randomly generated mazes and controlled entirely by keyboard.

descriptions.dos:099b538db3bd21c5: A simple but fascinating arcade shooter from 1989 for one or two players, released only in 2017.
descriptions.dos:09a2c7b9329534ff: Live the life of an old lady who loves to play Bingo. Daily life requires pills, food and sleep, but your one goal is to play bingo.

descriptions.dos:09ca8606c22a149b: A Donkey Kong Country-style platformer in which you play a red gorilla who wants to become a man, through levels representing stages of evolution.
descriptions.dos:09ceb0825320fa26: Thai chess, or Makruk, which looks like regular chess but has different, slower rules.

descriptions.dos:09d7bbe3f8153614.1: A companion to The Print Shop with extra functions such as graphics editors and envelope printing.

descriptions.dos:0a239e388ab532fe: A beat-'em-up highly reminiscent of River City Ransom, in Korean.

descriptions.dos:0a2ae49b1b5e65db: As a space fighter pilot, take your CHZ-250 fighter to defend Earth against an alien invasion that SETI has reported entering the Solar System.
descriptions.dos:0a2bfd88e57ab19e: A forerunner of Minesweeper. As a US Marine private, get an important message across a minefield.

descriptions.dos:0ab2cc2589b85ac0: A puzzle game with a touch of strategy in which you guide a population of a creature through the wilds of biological evolution.

descriptions.dos:0acdc09def26f1c5: As the warrior Armorik, win eternal fame from Thor by single-handedly conquering the eight territories of the North.

descriptions.dos:0adf8a8f6cad3606: An educational game testing your knowledge of US geography with a map of the states. Practice state names and capitals before playing.
descriptions.dos:0ae0dddc3a520b89: A text-based casino with a slot machine, Wheel of Fortune, roulette wheel, keno parlor, craps table and baccarat table, for one or several players.

descriptions.dos:0aeb017c59e16f58: A fixed-screen shooter in which you fire at an enemy orb slowly crossing the screen left and right, and dodge its slightly homing shots.

descriptions.dos:0af81091035450a5: The arcade classic: a yellow dot-muncher clears a maze of dots and fruit while four ghosts chase it. One or two players.

descriptions.dos:0f312381770bab6c: A tribute to Arcade Volleyball by the author of Pizza Worm. Two players with huge heads face each other across a volleyball net and bounce the ball around.
descriptions.dos:0f33b639f50d4216: Part of the Reader Rabbit series for older children. Reader Rabbit volunteers at the Daily Skywriter News Company of World-ville, matching words and sentences across seven word types in four activities.
descriptions.dos:0f3e94b4e2081207: The first of a loose trilogy of treasure-hunt text adventures, with Crobe and Quest for the Sangraal. The elven kingdom of Fyleet has fallen, and orcs and hobgoblins have looted its fortress.
descriptions.dos:0f4100fc16d1c2ed: A conversion of the Atari arcade game based on the second Indiana Jones film. As Indy, play cycles of levels, such as a mine level where you whip through to free captive children.
descriptions.dos:0f55498f103cee2e: A compilation of Earthworm Jim and Earthworm Jim 2.
descriptions.dos:0f71e3ea833d84d4: Command the Los Angeles-class 688i nuclear attack submarine on missions around the world, with the full arsenal of missiles, torpedoes, sonar and radar against mines, ships and subs.
descriptions.dos:0f725ff0e641a829: Fifth in the Might and Magic series: control a party of 6 heroes to save the Darkside of Xeen, completing the quest begun in Clouds of Xeen.
descriptions.dos:0f84e3770cca2e6c: A text adventure: banished to the caverns of Demon's Forge for killing four palace guards, the king's greatest gladiator must find the exit, which no prisoner ever has.
descriptions.dos:0f8e4150cc985f07: An Italian game influenced by the Mani pulite scandal. In one type of level you shoot political leaders carrying small flags while avoiding others.
descriptions.dos:0f939098d507b9af: Lead a team from the Conference, the fifth division of English football, to the Premier League and European glory, signing and selling players and using the phone to reach staff such as coaches.
descriptions.dos:0fa7dcb34033237d: An adventure adapted from Stephen King's novella The Mist. A thick, sinister mist traps you in a supermarket, and you must escape the panic and the bug-ridden town.
descriptions.dos:0fb5d51b7a60f1af: A humorous point-and-click adventure in which garishly dressed Richard Longhurst, with no memories, wakes in an abandoned zoo and is tossed forward and backward in time.
descriptions.dos:0fb5e9c5c36fe3f6: A World War II simulation in the European Theater, billed as an educational game and exceedingly rare.
descriptions.dos:0fb974372c6f9aad: A side-scrolling shooter that uses ASCII characters to make 16-color graphics. The galaxy is in trouble and you save it.
descriptions.dos:0fc4b26b9637037a: A remake of Digger: collect diamonds, stay clear of falling diamonds and rocks, and avoid ghosts. 32 levels with level codes, and three minutes per level.
descriptions.dos:0fca23eac9ca81cc: A first-person shooter in which humanity fights aliens. Your ship boards the alien mothership, where you fly or walk through MadSpace and the laws of physics don't always apply. 25 levels, with Stereo3D cutscenes.
descriptions.dos:0fe5cf1c6ea6d3bd: A weird 3D puzzle-action game in which you are a little guy in a chamber you rotate by pushing around its corners, so objects fall and new parts of the level open up. Two-player competitive mode.
descriptions.dos:0fe7e83feb56b06d: Push rocks around to form ladders to reach the butterflies, then take the exit once you have them all. 15 puzzles with helpful items such as a rope and pick axe.
descriptions.dos:0fef6d83f112ca69: The first campaign disk for Castles. The Picts are rebelling in the north of Albion, and you must build more castles to defend it.
descriptions.dos:0ff2e591f025aa21: A political simulation of world government. You are elected US President and handle crises, avoid wars in conflict zones, send aid and keep a good approval rating.
descriptions.dos:1006975732eaf434: A Donkey Kong clone in two parts on the same layout: climb to the top to rescue your girlfriend while a gorilla throws barrels down the ramps.
descriptions.dos:1006fde165dd3e35: A simplistic backgammon in EGA graphics that lets you play against the computer.
descriptions.dos:10092a6deb5aa3a5: A platform puzzle game in which you control a stick figure drawn by a little girl in her notebook, which her brother has filled with scribbles and monsters.
descriptions.dos:100ee052f97d9602: Mega Phoenix brings the arcade game Phoenix into the 90s, later made into a coin-op by Gaelco. A single-screen shoot-'em-up with several waves and a shield that lasts briefly.
descriptions.dos:101167810ca99cf5: Buy equipment, head beneath the town and mine to get rich and marry the woman of your dreams.
descriptions.dos:10222b501918cba2: A mix of action and puzzle: collect items by jumping among platforms, which change shape and function in later levels as obstacles are added.
descriptions.dos:10227249117d705c: An add-on for Heretic and Hexen with 12 new Heretic episodes and over 250 additional levels, new textures, sounds, weapons and monsters, plus an interface to load levels and create multiplayer games.
descriptions.dos:1022bc75f9e9b7c1: A wargame with three scenarios of the German campaign against Leningrad, starting with the approach from August to December 1941 and the battle of Tikhvin.
descriptions.dos:102721349e7e6bcd: Move left and right shooting birds in the sky and avoiding the blocks they drop.
descriptions.dos:10450984cb06675e: The Wheel of Fortune game show on the computer: take turns spinning the wheel and guessing letters to solve word puzzles.
descriptions.dos:1077f899f7c549e3: A hand-drawn point-and-click adventure. As 1930s US private detective Jack Orlando, you have 48 hours to solve a murder, talking to many people across more than 200 scenes.
descriptions.dos:108b16b93dd81e77: An action fighting game set in feudal Japan, against many enemies in many settings.
descriptions.dos:108f9546fd4f3bf7: Aliens have planted a huge bomb deep in the Earth and challenge the best pilot to reach it in a high-speed ship before the timer runs out, with minimal shields against the tunnel walls.
descriptions.dos:108fd57097325527: A maze action game from IBM that runs on a monochrome display. Select the maze, marker speed, sound options and scoring type, timed or point value.
descriptions.dos:10939410dd206af4: A collection of three arcade-style games by Russian programmer Dima Pavlovsky: Rebel Planets, Ivan and Metal Hearts. In Rebel Planets you shoot upward from a small ship at the bottom of the screen to destroy enemies.
descriptions.dos:109fc9bed78ccd9b: Don Diego Vega is secretly Zorro, a masked swordsman protecting the innocent in Spanish colonial California. Don Cortez hopes to gain more power by finding an ancient treasure, and Zorro sets out to stop him.
descriptions.dos:10a1af9a7c8237a0: A platformer on the Jill of the Jungle engine. As Onesimus, a slave of Philemon, escape to Rome to find the apostle Paul, who will teach you how to become a Christian and find true freedom.
descriptions.dos:10ae43bf0defbc6d: A basic soccer game that skips the managerial side of PC Futbol. Play friendly matches or try to win the European Championship, the World Championship or the Americas tournament.
descriptions.dos:10b27218cc477522: A soccer management simulation set in a fictional European league of eight top clubs, including PSV Eindhoven, Rangers, Liverpool, Arsenal, Real Madrid, Marseille, AC Milan and Bayern Munich.
descriptions.dos:10d371e3ab8c6a0c: A Russian 2.5D sprite first-person shooter from 1998, made in the wake of Duke Nukem 3D.
descriptions.dos:10d6ae82c07fba78: A shareware remake of Pac-Man with a Classic mode and an enhanced Champ mode, closely emulating the arcade original.
descriptions.dos:10d8fcd885cda035: A turn-based strategy game that starts in 275 BC with a young Roman legionnaire. Begin with one province, Rome, and one legion, and conquer every province on the map by force or diplomacy, on land and sea.
descriptions.dos:10d913b63b55cb47: A chess game with a strong opponent, 168 openings, and 2D, 3D and War Room boards. It suggests moves, rates the player, replays 151 classic matches and includes a Mentor tutor.
descriptions.dos:10ec6eb6616192a6: After Jeremy Hartwood's suicide in his Louisiana mansion Derceto, play private investigator Edward Carnby or Jeremy's niece Emily, investigating the death in a house reputed to be haunted.
descriptions.dos:10ed2ebe81f4babf: A Rubik's Cube-style puzzle viewed from the top with all sides displayed, where you choose from 4 to 25 sides. Many starting arrangements are grouped by difficulty.
descriptions.dos:10f08328b7a9a5c2: A children's game based on the novel. Phineas Fogg and his monkey sidekick Sidney bet that they can travel around the world in 80 days, choosing the next destination from a world map.
descriptions.dos:10fed285c63b2464: An asteroids shooter: blast the asteroids in a hostile field while guarding against alien ships, with each wave bringing faster rocks and more aggressive aliens.
descriptions.dos:11095afdce6c8762: A Mario Kart clone in which you race around quasi-3D tracks as a character from the Skunny games. Many tracks around the world, and a battle mode against the computer or a friend.
descriptions.dos:111545688c422835: A classic-style plane shooter: move up a vertically scrolling environment and shoot anything that moves.
descriptions.dos:1117850eb6379d6e: Third in the Ikari Warriors series, a top-down vertically scrolling shooter. The presidential candidate's daughter has been kidnapped, and you must get past enemy lines to rescue her.
descriptions.dos:11178c411af45776: A side-scrolling platformer about a girl named Peach. The Nightmares have taken over DreamLand and captured her true love, so she must collect four keys across dream worlds to enter the castle and defeat them.
descriptions.dos:1122b98d5d4a45ae: A 3D real-time World War II flight combat game based on missions flown by the 357th Fighter Group, the Yoxford Boys, in P-51 Mustangs over France and Germany from England.
descriptions.dos:113816eff29a4b71: A WWII naval simulator. Aboard a Fletcher-class destroyer, defend groups of friendly ships from enemy submarines, locating them on a zoomable map.
descriptions.dos:113fc6303b0ac823: An update of the classic Empire wargame with more terrain, more sighting and movement rules, and land units that can take damage in a skirmish instead of simply being destroyed.
descriptions.dos:1151a7f57488266e: A shareware darts game for one or two players based on the pub game 301. You must finish on a double, and a bust resets your turn's score.
descriptions.dos:117bb4f43d847c2b: A shareware cribbage against the computer, with five-card (to 61 points) and six-card (to 121 points) versions.
descriptions.dos:117eb5ff84a428ba: A shareware patience game with four solitaire games: Betsy Ross, Corner Card, Pyramid and Sir Tommy. Keyboard controlled, with optional sound and a demo mode.
descriptions.dos:118456b2265b09d2: Half a year after Bedlam, the biomechs are back as the Biomex and control important facilities. An isometric shooter in which you pilot Major Kern's combat robot to destroy them.
descriptions.dos:118d609faf51817f: A text adventure: trapped in thick fog on the moors while looking for the house of Dr. Potter, a reporter wonders what strange goings-on he will find.
descriptions.dos:119479fc9cb7a5bb: A first-person shooter in which you pilot a Planet Runner, a huge robot. As a mercenary for corporations, clear planets of rival companies and alien menaces. Single and multiplayer.
descriptions.dos:1196eeb4d99f938f: Dork the Dinosaur is knocked out by a branch during a thunderstorm and dreams he is a character in an eight-level platform game.
descriptions.dos:11a29f3eaac9cba1: A character-graphics platform game in which you keep the plumbing free of pests by jumping to bang the platform beneath them, stunning them so you can collect them for points.
descriptions.dos:11a34d6b8992d43a: Olympic Games in the stone age, with events like clubbing, dino racing, firemaking, mate tossing, saber racing and the dino vault. Up to four players choose from six cavemen with different skills and drawbacks.
descriptions.dos:11a9dd41d6ae11f5: The Sun League fights the oppressive Gar computer. You control a Viper V droid sent into a defense base to reactivate the planet's defenses by finding floppy disks all over the station.
descriptions.dos:11b829b996af9ff8: A realistic flight simulation. As a UN fighter pilot, fly the F-117A, Eurofighter 2000 or F-22 in various scenarios.
descriptions.dos:11be7a4c094f529d: A scrolling shooter in four missions. Kill baddies for the money they carry and spend it in shop rooms to upgrade your craft. One or two players.
descriptions.dos:11beefc288f02b07: Second chapter of the Rob Blanc series. Rob is nearly Defender of the Universe, but the High Ones send him on a holiday on Earth first, where he gets stuck in a lift with an enigmatic teenager.
descriptions.dos:11c5eb91ebf49787: Complete 69 levels riding a pedal-powered helicopter to pick up cavemen who announce where they want to go and carry them to their destinations. Levels are platforms with cave entrances.
descriptions.dos:11c684a3fd4ce78d: A Mahjong (Shanghai) variant with 40 levels of tiles with symbols like butterflies and masks. Pair them within the time limit; a tile can only be moved if nothing is on top of it.
descriptions.dos:11cb85dfa99c42b6: Between Jetfighter 3 and 4, an arcade-action turn with a Wing Commander-like interactive movie feel. A conflict between NATO and Russia erupts over Norwegian oil fields.
descriptions.dos:11edc0f2cc47462c: A Donkey Kong-like game in which you are the batboy and climb the structure by ladders to retrieve the home run ball, avoiding moving items.
descriptions.dos:11f1800adff71386: A 3D shooter. As Kurt, save the world from aliens who sent 8 giant fortresses to destroy Earth. Run and jump through 6 missions of strange worlds and kill the Stream Riders with your machine gun arm.
descriptions.dos:120368e06cd49883: The board game Monopoly: buy streets and railroad stations, build houses and hotels, and charge rent to other players.
descriptions.dos:120f0f167cbcf2ff: A computerized version of the card game Mille Bornes. Race another driver over 1000 miles, dealing with accidents, blown tires and other hazards, where strategy matters more than arcade skill.
descriptions.dos:121bc4d717aea342: Bub and Bob wander into a cave of monsters and are turned into dinosaurs, and must reach the end of the cave to change back. A single-screen platformer: clear each level's enemies to move on.
descriptions.dos:1221c4aaaaad6668: A Qix-style area-claiming puzzle: cut lines across the field to fence off territory, reach the required coverage, and dodge enemies that get nastier as time passes. Food bonuses add time.
descriptions.dos:1228bb4189dc9c1d: IBM's version of Othello/Reversi: two players take turns placing chips, enclosing lines of the opponent's pieces between two of their own to flip them.
descriptions.dos:122a3eba44bd0db6: An adventure set in Mike Callahan's bar on Long Island, a place to share problems with the friendly bartender, whose clientele includes mythological beings.
descriptions.dos:12322530de2bd8ec: Play an exhibition basketball game as the Harlem Globetrotters or their rivals, the Generals, with quarters from one to twelve minutes. The Globetrotters can pull off special moves such as behind-the-back passes.
descriptions.dos:12353b37c2f7a4f3: A math puzzle game: guide an algebraic spirit through a forest to find number cubes and cast a magic spell by solving the roots of a polynomial.
descriptions.dos:123b5b1d82b6b72e: Sequel to DID's space sim Epic, continuing the Raxxon-Terran conflict. You are a Terran pilot ambushed by the Raxxons and surgically transformed into one of their own.
descriptions.dos:125db54f10548063: A shareware game in which a space miner skims a spaceship over a planet's surface, avoiding some obstacles and collecting others, to mine the precious ore Orindum.
descriptions.dos:12639fb0137f1831: A demonstration text adventure whose type-in source code is in COMPUTE!'s Guide to Adventure Games. Venture into a defunct factory tower to retrieve magnetic media holding a copy of Crowther & Woods' original adventure.
descriptions.dos:126447d10b40ad03: A comic sci-fi adventure in which Rex crash-lands on a strange planet while chasing a valuable vase. Explore an odd society, make use of its transformation technology and solve inventory puzzles to get the prize and a way home.
descriptions.dos:126c38f6ddf00f92: A German puzzle game that takes the idea of Oil's Well and expands it with fairly complex gameplay.
descriptions.dos:127f2314a27c401e: Arguably the first text adventure construction program for the IBM PC, released in 1985. Use DOS menus and pop-up windows to create your world and all its objects and characters.
descriptions.dos:12806560f155bcf4: A single-player Backgammon game against the computer.
descriptions.dos:12813df7807f85a8: Billy and Jimmy Lee set out to avenge Marian, killed by the Black Warriors gang in retaliation for their earlier defeat. A beat-'em-up for one or two players.
descriptions.dos:128bbad958820c3f: An unofficial Quake campaign of 21 levels. As in the original, the first stage has no enemies and offers four paths, each a difficulty level, from Easy to Nightmare.
descriptions.dos:128eecc7ef59c0ab: A shareware word-guessing game: try letter combinations and the computer reports how many jots you have, a jot being the right letter in the right place. Words are three, five or seven letters.
descriptions.dos:12983dd10676107f: Zak McKracken, a tabloid writer, teams up with scientist Annie Larris and two Yale students, Melissa and Leslie, to stop the alien Caponians, who have infiltrated the phone company.
descriptions.dos:129d54dc415c5c9e: Sequel to Spirit of Excalibur, set after King Arthur's death. The demonic Shadowmaster has been summoned, and a terrible new force threatens Britain.
descriptions.dos:12a2928d587ac0d7: A sideways Breakout. Rescue Princess Gwen from a castle by bouncing five magic coins into bricks with a magical sword given by the good sorcerer Bruce.
descriptions.dos:12a3fdad15a89e0a: A puzzle game in which two characters must reach set spots in logical levels, helping each other past obstacles with switches, stone blocks, doors and lifts. Originally released for the ZX Spectrum.
descriptions.dos:12a9d2eab85493d0: Control a snake at the bottom of the screen and reach a goal at the top within a time limit. The snake keeps moving in one direction until it meets an obstacle, when it may change direction.
descriptions.dos:12bd10f12eb1fc24: A side-view Spanish action game in which a hero in a spacesuit runs, jumps, floats in the air for a while and fires laser charges at his enemies.
descriptions.dos:12c942a5febd9bad: An adventure for young children. Fatty Bear helps the other toys prepare a surprise party for Kayla, finding cake ingredients, missing letters for the sign and balloons, with bowling and piano mini-games.
descriptions.dos:12d2409aab84132d: A top-down soccer game with exhibition, league and cup modes, many national teams and formation options that you can edit manually.
descriptions.dos:12da3798d9c92479: An exploration puzzle game: each level strands you somewhere on a scrolling overhead map, and you must find the golden keys needed for that level and reach the exit.
descriptions.dos:12df5234a550cb5e: A video poker game that can be used for playing against the computer or for calculating statistical outcomes.
descriptions.dos:12ead4d23130f980: A six-month snowmobile trek through the snowy woods of northeastern Canada. Ten contestants race through 25 cities, surviving in the wilderness and hunting animals.
descriptions.dos:12f303d68cc9354a: A side-scrolling action platformer. As Fox, a member of the CEO special corps, go to the Soviet city of Chernovska to find out what became of an agent who reported on a military project called RAM.
descriptions.dos:12f4ae69962cb578: Laserdisc-style conversion of Don Bluth's cartoon. Cadet Dexter tries to free his love Kimberly from the evil Borf, transforming into Space Ace in critical moments.
descriptions.dos:12f51f2c38d92d99: A simple arcade game: survive a barrage of meteor showers by dodging them with your character anywhere on the screen.
descriptions.dos:12f6e8e8833de091: A racing game based on rally driver René Metge and his Porsche 944 Turbo, viewed from above and behind the car, on four French racetracks including Paul Ricard, Magny-Cours and Dijon-Prenois.
descriptions.dos:12fa46aa081b61fc: A scrolling shooter in which you play an overlynx, a peaceful ancient race of Earth and Atlantis, fighting humans created by aliens on the planet Danedola to exterminate your kind.
descriptions.dos:12fc9c8ce20f3a1a: A snake variant in which hitting your own tail doesn't end the game; you bite that part off and lose length.
descriptions.dos:12fddb0dd2cc096e: An ASCII rogue-like with randomized maps. Explore 20+ dungeon levels to capture the magical Sudbury Sapphire from a group of Imperial Dragons, past vine traps, labyrinth traps and wall torches.
descriptions.dos:12ff7c8669741a2f: The second collection of games for preschoolers and younger students, with drawing and music mini-games.
descriptions.dos:1306ca54ebb21583: A fighting game with characters from the Ravenloft setting of AD&D. Besides winning each battle, you quest for artifacts that decide whether the ranks of Chaos or the Lords of Law triumph.
descriptions.dos:1308ac244030b3f2: A text adventure in which you are on the skeleton crew testing a submarine in emergency conditions. The rest of the crew has disappeared, and you run around the sub fixing everything that doesn't work.
descriptions.dos:13110d0b3464700c: Sequel to Shadowlands. Command a team of four explorers through a deserted space station, solving puzzles, fighting baddies and exploring, in a real-time RPG.
descriptions.dos:1316d5b24e15d1e1: An Arkanoid-style game with a ball, a paddle and blocks at the top of the screen.
descriptions.dos:1323457af5b9b0a3: A timed text adventure: a broken-down car leaves you stranded near an unfriendly farm. Explore the grounds, find useful objects and work around the residents' routines before help arrives.
descriptions.dos:1342620c84b18f6b: An add-on for Descent with over 100 new fan-made levels judged best by Computer Gaming World in a contest, plus a new level from the creators.
descriptions.dos:13698bf0f6b85499: A Battleship-style game with many enhancements: fighter jets, radar jamming and infrared scopes, each tied to a specific ship, adding strategy to the familiar game.
descriptions.dos:136a6ef650d83ac9: A puzzle game in which you choose a picture that is cut into blocks on screen and slide the blocks up, down, left and right to rebuild it.
descriptions.dos:136f5c18eb845169: A side-scrolling space shooter from Korea with 6 stages, each ending in a boss. Shoot everything that moves with CTRL and use the extra weapon with ALT.
descriptions.dos:1374328ca5405e31: A simple educational game for children: guess words of up to six letters while a green airplane flies and each letter choice uses fuel.
descriptions.dos:138950c034f91a66: A horizontal-scrolling platformer in which you play secret agent Top, striking enemies with your head. Items collected during a level can be exchanged for energy and time at the end.
descriptions.dos:13928f1feacea3b5: The arcade classic: ride a flying ostrich (a stork for Player 2) with a lance against evil knights on vultures, flapping to strike from above. One or two players.
descriptions.dos:1392900a8b736fda: A shareware Lode Runner-style arcade puzzle game of ladders and platforms: collect all the gems on a level to move on.
descriptions.dos:13953ed90edac0b6: A fantasy adventure and role-playing game that opens on a dark midnight beside a hut with a vegetable garden, as a howl begins out of the quiet.
descriptions.dos:1398831e5a21c0d3: MicroProse's second edition football simulation, emphasizing management and coaching over arcade action. Fully editable statistics for every NFL team and player of the 1994 season.
descriptions.dos:139e53fecf826d42: A shareware arcade shooter, a cross between Galaxian and Space Invaders: move your ship left and right with the cursor keys and shoot for a high score.
descriptions.dos:139fb1dcddcf2066: A joke program by Doug Oldfield, programmer on Space Quest III and IV, parodying tourist guidebooks with humorous descriptions of locations near Sierra's headquarters.
descriptions.dos:13a1f37c0b43b6eb: A Dinamic scrolling hack 'n' slash game in two parts: find three magic scrolls in the first, then go on to defeat your foes and rescue the other wizards in the second, which requires a password.
descriptions.dos:13a492072a242203: An Olympics-style sports game with five events: hurdles, triple jump, skeet shooting, diving and fencing. Play events individually or as a tournament, choosing your nationality.
descriptions.dos:13a7624018bed066: A division-level strategic wargame covering the entire Russian Front from Berlin to Stalingrad, with over 150 German and over 200 Soviet divisions.
descriptions.dos:13b58c44f292d91f: A collection of mini-games from Spain, a DOS remake of Sega's arcade game Puzzle & Action: Tant-R.
descriptions.dos:13bce0fb052866a7: The wizard Anthrax has summoned a Demon to usurp the kingdom, and a random stranger nearby realizes that only he can beat back the horde of monsters it sends.
descriptions.dos:13bfdfe846e14962: Eight world-renowned weapon fighters are invited to a mysterious tournament. A one-on-one fighter that lets you sidestep a full 360 degrees around your opponent.
descriptions.dos:13ea711c418cfe65: A live-actor arcade shooter from American Laser Games set in the 1920s gangster era. Find out who shot singer Johnny Rock, or who hired the shooters, and put them behind bars.
descriptions.dos:13ee880b79e04f05: Fight creatures of myth and folklore with swords and wands in search of a golden ring with magical powers, collecting mushrooms along the way to restore your health.
descriptions.dos:13fc5fdaa945f30c: A text adventure in which you are a government agent held in a secret base in the United States, where you learn of a Soviet plan to fire nuclear missiles from inside the country and blame it on an inside job. You must stop it.
descriptions.dos:14064c506c11ffb1: Make a fortune by acquiring companies in each of 12 industries to build monopolies, raising funds through bank loans, venture capital or junk bonds.
descriptions.dos:14077c9a35c05b94: Edmark's first game for very young children, entirely point-and-click with spoken instructions. Millie perches on a desk on the main page in front of a row of activities.
descriptions.dos:140c9c1892bc6de5: Downhill racing from an isometric, Marble Madness-style view. Reach the bottom within the time limit, stay on the track and avoid hazards such as water, logs and parked cars. Faster finishes earn more prize money.
descriptions.dos:1411d1ab7771d4b7: A role-playing adventure on the land of Faland, full of demons, monsters, wild animals and renegades, with farmlands, forests, mountains and deserts to explore.
descriptions.dos:1413944a4960b70c: A game based on programming in Pascal, inspired by C-ROBOTS: design and program a robot to win real-time battles against robots written by others.
descriptions.dos:141c107563fce6cf: Robots rule Earth and the last humans are kept in a zoo with American artifacts. A wave of killings is under way, and you have 12 hours to find out who is responsible and why.
descriptions.dos:141d503a4f991a0e: A flight sim set in a near future after the Soviet collapse, where Alaska declares independence and oil is scarce. You fly as a mercenary pilot in the Strike Commander squadron.
descriptions.dos:1429278ae4816d82: A murder mystery on a ship in which you piece together clues and evidence to find the culprit, relying on logical deduction and precise timing.
descriptions.dos:1429b7a7c21beaa0: The official game of the Major Indoor Soccer League. Create an expansion team and build it into a championship franchise: trade and create players, modify rosters and train for the season. Coach, GM, play, or all three.
descriptions.dos:143df1940244a706: A grand strategic game of World War II in the west, 1944-1945. The Western and Italian fronts are covered in detail, and the Eastern front reflects the effect of a two-front war.
descriptions.dos:14480d2be18b94ae: A simple arcade platformer starring a bunny with a passion for sweets. Climb ladders, jump traps and hop platforms to grab every food item; each level brings a new kind of treat.
descriptions.dos:144d7d5df4ae4ab5: An Asteroids-style game where instead of asteroids there is one large BattleStar on the field that you must destroy while avoiding its fire.
descriptions.dos:1453ef70c6a2a73e: A pinball game with four SVGA tables, multiplayer modes and a realistic physics model. Tables don't scroll; you see the whole table at 800x600. A leaked prototype that was never released.
descriptions.dos:145ce6c9508dcf88: A shareware program that makes predictions about the future in two modes. In the first, pick from a list of questions, such as political elections, science, health and education.
descriptions.dos:1466dabf49ea4696: An IQ-test-style brain trainer with questions in five categories: odd one out, shapes, building blocks, dominoes and number sequences. You have fifteen minutes, or you can practice one category.
descriptions.dos:146830a6511f8dac: Play Joshua, leader of the Israelites after Moses, leading them to Canaan past puzzles and obstacles such as falling rocks and hostile soldiers, using his horn and special weapons. One or two players.
descriptions.dos:1475ba89a514842b: A Spanish-language fantasy RPG: find a way out of Castle Ragor using spells, healing potions, poisons, weapons and keys.

descriptions.dos:19b27f5e042a481a: A freeware clone of Taito's Space Invaders: control a cannon at the bottom of the screen and destroy waves of advancing aliens, with three lives.

descriptions.dos:19d7aaa7729848ca: Fourth in the Police Quest series, with a new setting and new protagonist, LAPD homicide detective John Carey, who finds his best friend and ex-partner Bob Hickman murdered.
descriptions.dos:19e51ee9f7d902ac: Includes all four games of the Dragon's Domain series, which was inspired by the old Atari game Adventure.
descriptions.dos:19ee3dc762e50a61: A keyboard-controlled adventure and exploration game. As captain of a space ship, rescue a Drosi ship trapped in a decaying orbit, in a story with more to it.
descriptions.dos:19ef2c14cd9186f5: A 3D falling-block puzzle that supports up to four players.

descriptions.dos:1a27d19925e9cd7f: A program that lets you design and distribute your own adventure games, an adventure engine for describing locations, rooms, objects, words and events, with sound and music.

descriptions.dos:1a2bee17fb31bef6: A Tetris-like game written in Pascal by an employee of a research institute in Tula in 1991, differing from Tetris in how the screen is cleared.
descriptions.dos:1a31e0ea158b7d3b: A platformer in which Leo the Lion searches the islands of the Archipelago Lion for a stolen crown, through jungle, swamps, a magic castle dungeon and a pyramid, solving many puzzles.
descriptions.dos:1a33cc2f94ec4577: A shareware Space Invaders clone: move your gun along the bottom of the screen blasting a formation of aliens that drop bombs as they descend, with four shield structures between.

descriptions.dos:1a3f3933cbf6b49c: A German dragon-themed vertical shoot-'em-up with decent graphics and the common gameplay elements of the genre.
descriptions.dos:1a41b25487432d69: A freeware Christmas edition of Jetpack with new levels from the original developers. Play Santa Claus, exploring levels full of treasures and peril to collect all the gifts.
descriptions.dos:1a46e433a087e5d3: Sequel to Last Half of Darkness. You wake alone in a strange room near a dungeon, the girl you saved is missing, and she is about to be sacrificed to an ancient volcanic force.
descriptions.dos:1a4d82194a4db0c1: A sports game in which you play a cat running a series of obstacle courses, each harder than the last, from the city park to the underground sewer and a bowling pub.

descriptions.dos:1a860dae2d9f5e95: A sci-fi text adventure in which you wake six months before schedule from cryogenic sleep to the computer alarm and must find out why small gelatinous creatures have breached the ship.

descriptions.dos:1abd158bebb974aa: A computer version of Conway's Game of Life, the cellular automaton simulation in which patterns evolve over generations.

descriptions.dos:1b5ca549a57ca594: A Gauntlet-like game from 1989 with EGA graphics and a level editor for making your own levels.
descriptions.dos:1b60204588660923: A real-time strategy game in the vein of Warcraft or Command & Conquer: colonize newly discovered planets, control their resources and defend your colony.

descriptions.dos:1b90fb6e9ec1f74f: Stranded on an alien planet after your spaceship explodes, find pieces of it to rebuild it, jumping across platforms and shooting droids and aliens in a side-scroller.

descriptions.dos:1b95e2c0ac0694de: A first-person action adventure aboard DS9. As an alien envoy, you become involved in a murder plot that leads to war with an evil alien race.

descriptions.dos:1bd86741f982a19f: Guide a floppy disk from the bottom of the screen to the top by crossing a series of floors, climbing to the next floor when you reach the end of one.
descriptions.dos:1bd89f1c30b163b0: A shareware Breakout variant: move a paddle along the bottom of the screen to keep a ball, or several balls, from touching the bottom, hitting bricks at the top.
descriptions.dos:1bdce2a21d530291: A soccer game with practically every international team of 1994 and modes including exhibitions for one or two players and the World Cup, seen from behind and above the player.

descriptions.dos:1bf2e7b8b0d163ef: A classic Snake written in Borland Turbo Pascal 6.0 for DOS in 320x200 with 256 colors: eat food, grow your tail, and avoid walls and yourself.

descriptions.dos:1bfdba7cad62c7d1: An educational game for young viewers starring Joe the bunny, who travels with a backpack and wants to learn in a magical town, which he must first enter by solving a puzzle.
descriptions.dos:1c0193854db53b2d: A vertical shooter in which you pilot a slow, large aircraft that must fight its way back to its home base.

descriptions.dos:1cc629a0bacc0483: An off-road racing game with no AI opponents, only obstacles, in a race against the clock. Compete against your own high scores.
descriptions.dos:1cc653d386e38e4d: An early realistic Harrier flight simulation by Rod Hyde with 3 skill levels and two practice modes, one for flight basics and one for combat.
descriptions.dos:1cd14b69d980feae: A soccer penalty simulator with large sprites and CGA graphics, for one player against the computer or for two players.

descriptions.dos:1d11a7630799caf8: A DOS version of Laser Chess, which plays like chess except some pieces are deflectors and a laser cannon. Place your deflectors strategically to aim your laser.

descriptions.dos:1d18672431c92eb2: A puzzle in which you move blocks with a cross-hair so that blocks of the same design touch and clear, until all are cleared.
descriptions.dos:1d1e7e89bb9f3a45: At a carnival you stop at Troggle Shoot, where owner Dr. Quandary invites you to shoot at targets to win one of three dolls.
descriptions.dos:1d29af46be382753: A large Colossal Cave-style adventure in which you set out to free the land of Hezarin from the evil tyrant Anjith.
descriptions.dos:1d33cdce1214e5f9: Dizzy must rescue four of his Yolkfolk friends from Cuckoo Land, Ice Land, Cloud Land and Zak's Castle in a single-screen action game resembling Pengo.
descriptions.dos:1d36753687adfdbd: Third in Donald Daley's Socrates series of chess programs, more a training program for good and experienced players.
descriptions.dos:1d3c7abadf32c53d: Destroy your enemy's ultimate weapon by flying a high-tech hovercraft through perilous tunnels full of enemy vehicles, choppers and sentry guns.

descriptions.dos:1d41b6de93472de8: A shareware remake of Namco's 1980 Galaga with a Classic mode and an enhanced Champ mode.
descriptions.dos:1d5fa9adb35eaf5c: Chris Crawford's macroeconomics simulation after Balance of Power: balance a country's military and social spending to survive among competing fictitious nations.
descriptions.dos:1d6ffd83b8152956: An Arkanoid-inspired brick-breaker: deflect an always-moving ball with a paddle, catch power-ups from some bricks, and lose when you run out of balls.
descriptions.dos:1d71250492534b6a: As a cadet fresh out of Starfleet Academy, command your first U.G.A.S. starship in a Federation war with the Krellans and Zaldrons.
descriptions.dos:1d7383420a40b20a: Command giant HERCs in head-to-head combat over network or modem, or against the computer. Its two-player mode was ahead of its time.
descriptions.dos:1d7cbb298d17f135: Sequel to Pinball Dreams with four new tables: Neptune (undersea), Safari, Revenge of the Robot Warriors (sci-fi) and Stall Turn (aviation).
descriptions.dos:1d7ff5cc575bdb3c: A scenery add-on for Microsoft Flight Simulator covering England, Scotland and Wales, with many small airfields.
descriptions.dos:1d83ad4a5b2d9226: A shareware educational game of word problems for grades 2 to 7, for one or two players. The land of Greecia has lived in darkness under the god Apathy, and Zeus plans his downfall by teaching.
descriptions.dos:1d88a8aeae78cf02: A text adventure on a mostly predetermined course in which each object you pick up kills exactly one creature, and the goal is to kill them all.

descriptions.dos:1d9a3e758ee10d03: A side-scrolling arcade game in which you fly an attack aircraft with eight lives against enemy aircraft and naval forces from a neighboring country coming in from the right.
descriptions.dos:1d9c96b1701c3c73: Infocom's sci-fi text adventure. In the year 2186 you are destined to rendezvous with a gargantuan starship from the edge of the galaxy and must gain entry to its mysteries.
descriptions.dos:1daba8e241e5362d: A top-down cartoon racer for 1 to 4 players, similar to Micro Machines 2, with practice, Knockout Races, tournaments, Beat the Clock and Team Knockout. Choose from 12 characters.
descriptions.dos:1db11e1253f422d5: A freeware side-scrolling shooter inspired by the arcade P-47 Thunderbolt: fly the P-47 against waves of planes and ground installations.

descriptions.dos:1dbdf256f2b1b8cc: A simulation of modern naval combat in real time, tracking surface ships, subs, missiles and aircraft, with an adjustable clock ratio and pause.
descriptions.dos:1dbe41cb96a2a734: A LucasArts-style adventure on the island of Santa Lanchia, where a fisherman's boat is destroyed by lightning and he and the wreckage drift ashore.
descriptions.dos:1dc3415a28f817e3: A space simulation in which you are a Galactic Command officer commanding and controlling every aspect of a giant Battlecruiser.
descriptions.dos:1dc90d9401819c7d: An Infocom mystery in which, as a young American detective, you answer a letter from old friend Tamara Lynd and travel to Tresyllian Castle in England.
descriptions.dos:1dd7a16f1a20c19b: A Risk clone using the same rules: place armies on the map and conquer the majority of the lands, attacking adjacent territories in turns.
descriptions.dos:1de556b1820026f4: A first-person role-playing game like Dungeon Hack or Eye of the Beholder, with simple, intuitive gameplay and no long story. Attack monsters by timing presses of the Spacebar.

descriptions.dos:1e477adc52b8ef16: A shareware collection of 7 little mouse-controlled shooting games that test your quick reactions, with points and a high score list.
descriptions.dos:1e489b2ab7545ccc: In his second adventure James Pond must retrieve the toys Dr Maybe has stolen, using a stretch device to reach high areas or slide across ceilings, across worlds themed on toy types.

descriptions.dos:1e5e142032302548: An educational game for all ages in which you become animals in four groups: Forest Animals, Ocean Animals, Jungle Animals and Young Lion, on a grid with randomly placed obstacles.
descriptions.dos:1e7909fd1d21cad4: Fly a scout ship to rescue survivors from a space station caught in a meteor shower. The ship moves forward continuously and loops from top to bottom of the screen.
