descriptions.dos:1ea41b6167289641: A Korean cartoony platformer starring Shakii the wolf, ruler of the kingdom of Shake, which was plunged into chaos by the almost invincible Lion Warrior Midnight Sword.
descriptions.dos:1eab1bfdc0633ee4: A Tetris clone in which you play eight games at once and blocks float upward, with some new shapes. When a playing field fills, keep going with the others.
descriptions.dos:1eaccbd567c56a95: A suite of tools to compile simple Choose-Your-Own-Adventure style games, including Gnomic, a demonstration game distributed only with it.
descriptions.dos:1ebfa544921777eb: A tile-based RPG in the vein of the early Ultima games. On the planet Lysandia, eliminate the chaotic presence threatening it, with character creation, weapons, spells and skills such as swimming.
descriptions.dos:1ec24bfb0d1276f4: A freeware keyboard-controlled Pac-Man variant: negotiate a maze chased by ghosts, eating fruit and pills, with power pills making ghosts vulnerable.
descriptions.dos:1ec3093304bc299d: A very early implementation of Eliza, the program that mimics a human's responses to what you type.
descriptions.dos:1ecda9c9504b7174: You play Heimdall, a demigod of Norse mythology charged with guarding the entrance to Asgard from all evil, including Ragnarok, which is on its way.
descriptions.dos:1ed4c981203cd627: A basketball game with real NBA teams and an offensive, action-oriented style. Play an exhibition or try to win the NBA title in playoff mode, substituting tired players.
descriptions.dos:1ed722f66bad7881: A side-scrolling platformer in which you control a super monkey, collecting weapons and power-ups such as spitting green balls and bags of money, avoiding hostile animals and monsters.
descriptions.dos:1efeca409491899f: A BASIC story game by three high school students, a hypertext-like tree story with many choices leading to immediate death and characters borrowed from Spaceballs.
descriptions.dos:1f09b9e0a0ae6066: After Dal'X, Bomb'X and Castle'X, a classic 2D platformer with the usual enemies, secret zones and end-level bosses. You are Nestor Burnos, whose fiancee Maëva has disappeared.
descriptions.dos:1f1c1d26b90e37f9: A single-player RPG set in the world of Magic Candle using a modified engine, aimed at novices: clear the monsters from the cellars, dungeons and dark corners of Maramon.
descriptions.dos:1f1eb3a14bf086a3: A turn-based tactical squad combat game that introduced team-oriented missions, RPG-style squad leader development and a scenario builder, with ten missions in the retail version.
descriptions.dos:1f20557abf1c0428: A puzzle adventure about Bureau 13, an ultra-secret organization investigating the paranormal, which sends two agents after a member who has drawn unwanted attention. Many characters to choose from.
descriptions.dos:1f325ff0ace33795: Barbie has a big day tomorrow and dreams about her planned activities. Traverse five levels of thirteen stages through the mall, the beach and the soda shop to make it through the night.
descriptions.dos:1f366c34161291f4: A 16-color shareware clone of the classic mainframe Star Trek game. Each sector of the universe is an 8x8 grid containing planets, starbases and enemies.
descriptions.dos:1f3892c1ec48a766: An early computer translation of a classic board and paper hockey simulation.
descriptions.dos:1f511ec6c4951664: A Pac-Man variant: control Wilf, dumped by circumstances into a maze inhabited by sinister creatures, and complete it while avoiding the monsters.
descriptions.dos:1f55eaddb65ab058: A 3D snooker simulation, the snooker version of Virtual Pool and the most realistic available at the time.
descriptions.dos:1f5fa9ff1c737358: An educational adventure: as a treasure hunter exploring a castle, find the exit while earning points by picking locks and finding treasures, solving math riddles with the four basic operations.
descriptions.dos:1f62c7f635e44709: An adaptation of Lewis Carroll's story: Alice escapes her math homework into a wonderland of bizarre characters including the Cheshire Cat and the Jabberwock.
descriptions.dos:1f6d1c4525d2db15: After a failed scheme, Plucky Duck and Buster Bunny have one pouch of magic beans left, which grows a huge beanstalk. Control Plucky through eight areas in a platform adventure.
descriptions.dos:1f77c9e894270a0b: A timed puzzle game: fill out levels with bricks to build as tall a tower as possible, with limited time per level and each level becoming the base for the next.
descriptions.dos:1f7bab04b67ed35b: A shareware miniature golf game controlled with keyboard and mouse. A shot is made by choosing the tee position, setting the direction, then the power.
descriptions.dos:1f7e42f0777c7a02: A soccer game released for the 1994 World Cup with an overhead view like Sensible Soccer. Club and national teams, with players that vary in speed and skills such as heading and overhead kicks.
descriptions.dos:1fb5bdadd0d46951: A golf game with two 18-hole courses and Leader Board-style hitting mechanics. Account for wind and pick from 14 clubs, in a 3D third-person view with an overhead map.
descriptions.dos:1fba440cfe37ca80: In 1984 two undercover cops lose a criminal who flees the bar by motorcycle, and the chase begins. A police adventure.
descriptions.dos:1fcb65a88a311c14: Create a party of adventurers from several races and explore the world, earning fame, glory and gold by completing quests, with turn-based combat and a well-designed inventory.
descriptions.dos:1fd8a32214c8acf3: A wacky mix of track and field and retro arcade games played as an alien. Choose from 8 alien characters with different strengths, such as the many-legged caterpillar-like Mr. Mune.
descriptions.dos:1fd9ea7eb90ed1ea: A one or two-player platform game with fruit, worms, penguins and fireball-throwing monsters, installable in English and Swedish. The Evil One has captured Bublina, and you are armed with a magic rod.
descriptions.dos:1fe61df840279b98: Play a dozen well-known courses, including Augusta and Pebble Beach, with a split screen showing an overhead view of the hole and a 3-D view. Includes a driving range to practice.
descriptions.dos:1fe7bb92b4c8977a: An early mouse-controlled character simulation from Erosoft: select a scene and use mouse movements to control its animation. Interaction is limited compared with a conventional adventure game.
descriptions.dos:1fe84a216a5a2fa5: A third-person point-and-click adventure. As sports journalist Richard Kendall in summer 1997, you follow an expedition of four explorers into the Atlantic searching for traces of Atlantis.
descriptions.dos:2005974e6242478f: Liberate "The Boss" and bring him back safely. Dropped from a chopper with your panther and a .357 Magnum, travel through parts of the city to find him.
descriptions.dos:200fa00a21e29704: A CD-ROM from model maker Revell showcasing six fast European cars. Look under the hood at their parts or watch promotional videos with commentary and statistics, plus a racing game.
descriptions.dos:2015f168251830e1: A Gomoku (Five in a Row) variant on an extended go board of 28x18 squares: you, as blue, take turns placing pieces against the computer, as red.
descriptions.dos:2019bb45361af888: An interactive behind-the-scenes CD-ROM about the Star Wars Trilogy Special Edition. Browse production material explaining changes made for the revised films.
descriptions.dos:20304b4e3419a625: In 2050, enemies known as alterants control the city by distributing mind-controlling drugs. In a 3D view from a hovercraft, destroy all the alterants and stop their drug runs.
descriptions.dos:203a8454c8578ef8: Manage a virtual farm: buy and sell livestock, plant and maintain crops, in a changing weather system with realistic seasons.
descriptions.dos:203b77ef7d242280: An unofficial single-player Star Trek adventure built with Domark's Virtual Reality Studio. A timed game on an Enterprise whose self-destruct sequence has started, played like a maze exploration through similar corridors.
descriptions.dos:205d17777a904b77: Years ago the Zybonians installed a control center in the middle of the Earth so they could pull the planet from its orbit to their home system. Sequel to Deep.
descriptions.dos:205d895c45c87182: A simple two-player game on one computer in which each player flies a red or green helicopter and tries to destroy the enemy helicopter.
descriptions.dos:20649712cec5bb5f: An aerial racing simulation: complete a lap around the course as quickly as possible, steering with a detailed set of flight controls. Scenery and your opponent are 3D shaded polygons, and the cockpit view can be turned and zoomed.
descriptions.dos:20922b3295b9970a: A graphical adventure in Larry Niven's Known Space universe, centered on the Ringworld, an immense artificial band orbiting a distant star.
descriptions.dos:2093fcd1d5da2ec5: Martin Bourdages's first game, a fast, small VGA Tetris-based game. This is the registered version, with two players enabled and an additional game.
descriptions.dos:2097de1fa6196af4: An enhanced Pac-Man clone in which you gobble up gumdrops and other foodstuffs while avoiding getting eaten yourself.
descriptions.dos:20a027ff0feab05d: Recreates three key battles of the American War of Independence, including Bunker Hill. British and American sides can be human or computer controlled at 3 skill levels, with adjustable reinforcements and ammunition.
descriptions.dos:20a6b807f90fcd6a: A remake of the 1981 RPG Ultima. Travel to another world and save the land of Sosaria from the evil wizard Mondain, with top-down overworld tiles and first-person pseudo-3D dungeons.
descriptions.dos:20c10a43500f5690: A text adventure of exploring a mine: visit all the rooms and return the treasures to the entrance in as few moves as possible. Choosing a different mine number at the start gives you a different mine.
descriptions.dos:20c43307044bc37c: A computerized Battleship for two human players or one against the computer, published by Acorn Software Products.
descriptions.dos:20c487934879e608: A hack-and-slash platformer set in the Crimean War. As a British cavalryman on horseback with a sword, kill Russian soldiers before their muskets, mortars and handguns kill you.
descriptions.dos:20e0545bb0ba0514: A shooting-gallery game in the style of Operation Wolf. As the detective Mike Gunner, you are hired to end the criminals of Robbland city, the most dangerous city on Earth.
descriptions.dos:20ebf2fe8cc54e32: A shooting gallery demo program bundled with IBM's first BASIC compiler: move a ground-based gun left and right and line up shots at targets crossing the screen.
descriptions.dos:20f13e1e70a50906: A very basic Breakout with just a paddle, a ball and bricks, without power-ups or enemies. A short game of 9 stages that is without end.
descriptions.dos:20f296ef04141ad7: The classic puzzle game, basis of countless clones: in a warehouse, push crates one at a time onto marked spots to complete each level.
descriptions.dos:20f64d1ce40a138d: On the planet Twinsun, four races lived in peace until Dr. Funfrock used cloning and teleporting to create an army of soldiers and monsters. Play Twinsen in an action adventure.
descriptions.dos:2104d23ab03f2795: A word game and sliding tile puzzle from Softdisk disk subscriptions: rearrange letters within a constrained area to spell out words. Each appearance contained different puzzles.
descriptions.dos:2105e43914fa9c99: An F/A-18 flight simulator focused on air shows, replicating the tight maneuvers and precision flying of the US Navy's Blue Angels through formation flying.
descriptions.dos:2111428f4f8da28e: A tactical WWII simulation of the whole Eastern front from 1939 to 1945, with over 700 weapon types and hundreds of unit types and formations.
descriptions.dos:211664c42916831c: A text adventure. As millionaire Steven Scott, you find your racehorse's trainer and rider has been stealing from you and face deceit and danger finding out why.
descriptions.dos:2117f45145f3187d: A golf simulator that uses photographs taken from many angles to simulate the Harbour Town Golf Links, played from a first-person perspective.
descriptions.dos:211eaa9ea8e8fefe: An educational Disney game for pre-schoolers learning the alphabet. Choose Mickey's home or the fair, where Mickey can perform 26 actions.
descriptions.dos:21303423e17a6bfa: As Hen House Harry, collect 12 eggs from each single-screen level of platforms, ladders and lifts, avoiding ducklings, in a game similar to Donkey Kong.
descriptions.dos:2133e4d7110288c3: An updated version of the educational game Math Blaster!, no longer written in BASIC.
descriptions.dos:214728bd86b24f35: Mankind's last defender is pitted against waves of alien ships bent on destroying Earth with powerful explosives. Hunt down each ship within a strict, shrinking time limit.
descriptions.dos:21583866e5070216: A simple shooter in which you fly a ship forward and shoot enemies, while asteroids line the sides of the screen and limit your movement.
descriptions.dos:21639c09c430c2df: A free racing simulator from a German programmer. Single races only: choose one of four tracks, one of four rivals (three cars and the clock) and one of three cars.
descriptions.dos:21642fd997105922: An arcade action game in the style of Moon Patrol. Drive a four-wheel-drive truck across a desert, accelerating, firing missiles and jumping, with 8 levels.
descriptions.dos:216d941618b8f1c8: A Tic Tac Toe-style game in which the goal is to get 5 in a row on a massive board.
descriptions.dos:2174d1c7eff943b5: Third and final game in Ezra Sidran's Universal Military Simulator series, with real-time unit movement on accurately recreated topographical maps of historical battlefields.
descriptions.dos:2189acac2a591d06: An ASCII graphic adventure with 11 new levels and custom level support. As the fearless adventurer Eduin, find your village in the Dark Woods while evil creatures try to stop you.
descriptions.dos:218d89b160138672: A Korean sci-fi side-scrolling shooter in which you control a giant mecha sent into a hostile area of deep space to fight mechanized aliens, moving in eight directions.
descriptions.dos:2199d1077aedceee: It is 1908 and you are president of an upstart car company: design cutting-edge automobiles, manage finances and run marketing campaigns, with many classic car designs you can modify.
descriptions.dos:219a09fe23408bce: A shooting gallery game with digitized actors. Escaped prisoners, helped by outsiders and armed, pop up from cover on different screens, and as a Sheriff's deputy you must take them out.
descriptions.dos:21b68e045406bd22: An action game with puzzle elements: control the space probe Sky Cat on a mission to find and rescue hostages in an alien base, shooting enemies with a laser like Thexder and solving puzzles to overcome obstacles.
descriptions.dos:21cb22c3a6c77b04: A toolkit to design and play turn-based strategic battles in any era, from ancient times to the future, with complete control over units' firepower, movement and strength. One or two players.
descriptions.dos:21d21ac3d6d4efe8: Bar scene games on your PC: compete in a tournament or practice up to 5 events, including Liar's Dice, Wet 'n' Wild, Last Call and Air Hockey.
descriptions.dos:21d9817259ca9009: A computerized spirit board: use a mouse as the planchette to spell out messages from any spirits nearby, letter by letter.
descriptions.dos:21e3dfafae4c5d7e: A Space Invaders-like arcade shooter: defend your ship at the bottom of the screen from waves of attackers. Each cleared round brings a harder one, with a time limit.
descriptions.dos:21f0ecea4fa7b728: A shareware vertical scrolling helicopter game in character graphics: fly over enemy territory destroying SAM tanks, dodging homing missiles by constantly changing course and speed.
descriptions.dos:21f4b5b05bb0b82e: The first baseball game of Dynamix's Front Page Sports brand, balancing team management and statistical accuracy based on the 1994 Major League season, with a career mode where players age and improve.
descriptions.dos:21f9d6b14d8b2777: A word game in which you fill in the missing letters of an incomplete word that slowly moves down the screen, for one or more players.
descriptions.dos:21fd3ebba82be6aa: A shareware horizontal scrolling shoot-'em-up: destroy defense bases set up by an alien race through the levels and rescue captive humans.
descriptions.dos:220a2d987686e5f2: A basic action game in which you control a bouncing ball. In each one-screen level, backgrounds progressing from the big bang to the future, bounce between platforms collecting points and the exit key.
descriptions.dos:220ed12bbdb5d304: A small shareware strategy and action game for two players, with 30 rounds on random terrain. Each gets a team of small humanoid Clonks, and the goal of each round is to kill the enemy's captain.
descriptions.dos:221b558fb1176766: In the far future, gladiator-style blood sports have been revived. To solve a mystery, the hero must become a player in the cruel battles where only the most ruthless survive. A first-person shooter.
descriptions.dos:221dcbbe5c1ffacc: A solitaire laid out like mahjong with cards face down, 25 left in a draw deck. Collect the maximum number of cards totaling 13 and clear the layout.
descriptions.dos:2227e3c7454c0d3a: A text adventure: Inter-Planetary Human Simulations has built IP-39, the ultimate human-match android, and it has gone missing. Find out whether it was stolen or escaped, and where it is.
descriptions.dos:22325b9a932a885b: An educational typing game. MasterType is a wizard defending the command ship at the center of the screen from missiles launched from each corner, as you type the words that destroy them.
descriptions.dos:22363a1276996624: A Korean colorful platformer. Choose either of two little kobolds, Cobi with a club or Comi with a hammer, who both control the same and can perform special combo moves.
descriptions.dos:2239275917e22f6b: A cross between Breakout and Space Invaders: control a robot that walks along the top of a brick wall and jumps, as a line of bugs rises from the bottom and a bomb flies across.
descriptions.dos:2249b443fa6ff9a9: Interactive fiction based on Roger Zelazny's novels. As Prince Corwin, compete against your eight scheming brothers and sisters for the throne of Amber, center of the one true world.
descriptions.dos:22691d6070d058f2: Pumpkins have stolen Earth's candles to their home planet. As an axe-wielding maniac, destroy them and collect the candles in a simple 2D action game of mazes. Its fame comes from a newsgroup joke.
descriptions.dos:2270bb7ec76e75c6: A top-down Gauntlet-style game: move through the maze collecting keys and using potions to heal and defend yourself.
descriptions.dos:22716f94a191af24: A toolkit to design and play turn-based strategic battles set between 1846 and 1905, with full control over units, one or two players, and pre-made scenarios and campaigns.
descriptions.dos:22723c2cc4568c13: A variant of the Atari 2600 Adventure: return the golden chalice to the yellow castle, past locked gates, a bat and several dragons.
descriptions.dos:22730068adee48bf: A WWII strategy game of the Eastern Front from 1941 to 1945 at corps level. Play either the Russians or the Germans, with full control including production of war material.
descriptions.dos:22754a671b59cadd: An RPG in which the kingdom of Celystra's new king Lythare loses his newborn child, and blames the Champion Knight-Paladin. First volume of the Aethra Chronicles.
descriptions.dos:22758807a1f3dfb3: A Pipe Dream-style game: lay track for marathon runners through a forest using pieces at the bottom of the screen, and place the finish line before the runners reach it.
descriptions.dos:2279d192b708713d: Ants are after your sugar cubes. Armed with a fly swatter, squash each ant before it drags a cube off the screen, keeping a target minimum of cubes on each level.
descriptions.dos:228e79b59cea5a69: A freeware keyboard-controlled Pong for one or two players, with five difficulty levels, a high score table and a soundtrack.
descriptions.dos:229b11ba8de70816: A graphical roguelike RPG with an easy interface and a detailed near-real-time combat system. You are the hero who wants to explore the Valley to slay monsters and find treasure.
descriptions.dos:229b6ca2f7964f56: A model railroad simulation: sketch and design your own track plan, add terrain, buildings and rivers, then place customizable trains and change switches.
descriptions.dos:229f5e1af220e363: Guide Dave through ten levels to reclaim his trophies from a deserted pirate's hideout. A run-and-jump platformer meant to be harder than usual, originally for the Apple II.
descriptions.dos:22a85e805a68595d: Another adventure for the snowball hero, who must stay solid despite fireballs and lava pools. Essentially the first game with new graphics and levels.
descriptions.dos:22a89724869932b5: Manhattan, 2019, after a nuclear war. Jonathan "Jungle" Rogers must reach the airdrop platform XV-238 in the base of the schizophrenic assassin professor McJerin and escape to outer colonies.
descriptions.dos:22c585562452cbf5: A small text adventure by Swedish programmer Magnus Olsson, in version 4.3, with teleporting, dragons and locked doors.
descriptions.dos:22c9b59472afefde: The sequel to Bomb Jack, adding side scrolling and moving closer to a platformer. As the bomb-hungry caped superhero, collect bombs for points and avoid monsters.
descriptions.dos:22d0b8979f7b5d42: Follow-up to Puyo Puyo, a falling block game: combine four or more same-colored Puyos to make them disappear, and chain combos to send Nuisance Puyos to the opponent.
descriptions.dos:22d27c664a7e13ec: A puzzle in which you empty the field of molecules by sending each into its own gate, though each moves in four directions from obstacle to obstacle.
descriptions.dos:22e02b71fc93077c: An updated Pong and Quadrapong in which two or four players bounce a ball around a square court, each moving a paddle along one edge. The goal is to score the fewest misses.
descriptions.dos:22e525790b7232cf: A minimalist one-room interactive fiction game: the room is the middle of a town square in a nondescript New England town, containing only a single object, a phone booth.
descriptions.dos:22e552f67bdd1b4a: A Boulder Dash clone starring a funny green monster. Collect all the diamonds in each level while avoiding falling cobblestones, traps and creatures underground.
descriptions.dos:22e895f6eecf67ae: An Angband variant in ASCII graphics that adds new races, modified classes, an Adventurer's Guild for quests and over 120 new monsters.
descriptions.dos:22e9bfeb2746ad22: A Simon Says-style game where up to 2 players compete to memorize a color sequence.
descriptions.dos:22ece43afe33328f: A shareware puzzle game described as a cross between Othello and Life. Anti Chaos: make squares of different colors all the same color on a grid where each square is linked to its neighbors.
descriptions.dos:22ee14072c929917: A compilation of 15 games and activities for kids 3 to 8 from the Putt-Putt and Fatty Bear Funpacks plus new ones, mostly played against Putt-Putt or Fatty Bear.
descriptions.dos:2311157e737e1949: Version 2.0 of a wildland fire simulation. On a top-down map of 180,000 acres of forested coastland in the Northwest, set up the situation and fight the fire.
descriptions.dos:231818b7597f848e: Based on the Belgian comic Les Tuniques Bleues, replay the American Civil War as the North or South. Move troops on a map of the US, and battles between armies in the same state play out as action sequences.
descriptions.dos:2331df2ad55bec10: An adventure and arcade game set 100,000 years ago. As a young hunter of the Light-Foot tribe, explore your territory, keep friendly contacts with other tribes and trade objects.
descriptions.dos:233b08a209c4460c: A text adventure in which you are Amsel of Fandora, a scientist and visionary who has lived as a hermit and can no longer afford the peace of solitude, with your friend Hawkwind at your side.
descriptions.dos:233bcc30ada0391c: A keyboard-controlled game in which you fly a 3D landscape firing rockets at enemy craft, with single-player, player-versus-player and two-player cooperative modes.
descriptions.dos:233d20230441370a: Three side-scrolling platform games with Bible themes. In Noah's Ark, find a male and female of each species and bring them to the ark before the flood. Another is Save Baby Moses.
descriptions.dos:2342ad7c44066cca: An interactive comic book from ICE Inc, one of the earliest of its kind before CD-ROMs, in which you follow the story of a return to planet Earth.
descriptions.dos:236c5eadb333fcc0: A shooting game made for the Spanish Gunstick light gun, similar to Crossbow. William Tell walks on automatically to rescue his beloved while you act as bodyguard, shooting threats.
descriptions.dos:236d9289143fdeb9: A Falcon 3.0 expansion pack that lets you fly the Mikoyan-Gurevich MiG-29, the agile Soviet fighter, and fight for the other side, with the graphics and realism of Falcon 3.0.
descriptions.dos:2380f2864b6d4640: Buck Rogers awakens in the 25th century, an ancient military hero, and joins the New Earth Organization to fight for Earth. A Gold Box role-playing game.
descriptions.dos:23887da41e1ac37a: A rare Spanish side-view space shoot-'em-up whose pictures and names of characters have nothing to do with the gameplay.
descriptions.dos:238a5a4542128efd: A puzzle follow-up to King's Valley: collect all treasures by drilling and cutting through pyramids haunted by mummies, with a limited supply of equipment you must use in the right order.
descriptions.dos:238f4f91b8646ea5: A one-on-one fighting game modeled closely on Street Fighter, for one or two players.
descriptions.dos:23974317553dbe4d: An advergame for the German TV magazine WISO. A Breakout variant in which bricks with a question mark trigger a multiple-choice question about the economy.
descriptions.dos:2397bfe37f47a51b: Dinamic Multimedia's first international competition game, in which you are the Spanish national coach for Euro '96, choosing from the Primera Division players and designing the team's formation.
descriptions.dos:239ef9d44b7659ed: A text adventure in which a nightmare comes true: find your way out of a wax works factory where all the exhibits come to life.
descriptions.dos:23a5ed58f17eb8f1: Tie-in of the board game. Up to four players land on a planet with their motherships and try to gather as much ore as possible within 24 rounds, while tanks and destroyers fight over it.
descriptions.dos:23baa95e1eb294b3: A fishing game for one to two players, effectively a two-player version of Richard Olsen's Bass Class, supporting up to fifty lakes, including those made for BassTour.
descriptions.dos:23bfc71d7cc624c3: A tennis simulation with all the rules from tie-breaks to break points, viewed from behind a player with a split-screen option. Singles and doubles over 1, 3 or 5 sets on grass, quick, hard or clay courts.
descriptions.dos:23c2b8ad94b65f6c: A Tetris clone for up to two players with 7 block shapes: fill a line of the pit to make it disappear.
descriptions.dos:23cb77afec8c3f2d: The REEL Magic edition of Return to Zork, a full-motion video adventure starting behind the white house, where a video message from a wizard begins your quest.
descriptions.dos:23d46ad27ec82c91: As a highly respected warrior, conquer as many regions as possible in three stages: fight through hordes of fighters to reach the castle, climb its sections, then battle its inhabitant.
descriptions.dos:23e52e47f1f2ce8c: Command a squadron of rebel pilots to outfly and outsmart the invasion force of the Terran Overlord Government.
descriptions.dos:23ed491e21122c2d: A shareware dungeon crawl. Two hundred years ago you served Lord Trentarus, whose mages built a sarcophagus of pure wizidrium to ensure his reign continued.
descriptions.dos:23f7897d095b0586: An action game of cat-themed mini-games tied together: as a little black cat, work your way from an alley to a lady cat in an apartment complex, scoring as many points as you can.
descriptions.dos:23fce87b143db63e: A Pac-Man clone written in compiled BASIC, with the maze rotated 90 degrees: munch the dots, collect prize items for bonus points and dodge four ghosts.
descriptions.dos:24036d0500656570: Hugo the troll goes on an adventure to rescue his wife Hugoline and three children from the evil witch Scylla. Includes mini-games such as Hugo on a snowboard.
descriptions.dos:242a30536956550a: Be a TV network executive who picks the shows and cancels low-rated ones in favor of popular tripe and identical sitcoms, in a highly unusual simulation from First Row Software.
descriptions.dos:242c63d5a79ec229: An interactive fiction adventure written with the AGS toolkit in which you play Bertrand, a resident of a small mountain village who ducks into a mansion during a storm.
descriptions.dos:242c6e1e582a16ec: Second in the DRED trilogy: as a DRED agent, defend the DRED headquarters under attack. The puzzles are tougher than in the first.
descriptions.dos:24316dab5ca56353: A puzzle game in which you guide a robot through many levels with hazards such as lasers and enemies, blowing up bombs and pushing crates, with smooth scrolling playfields.
descriptions.dos:2460d02ac3ed5685: A fixed-screen shoot-'em-up: move left and right at the bottom of the screen and shoot the aliens at the top, Drones, Emissaries, Hornets and Commanders, with higher ones worth more.
descriptions.dos:24705ff935adcba1: An epic fantasy RPG in the land of Trazere, where armies of mutants are marauding. Heroes scour cities, dungeons and wilderness for clues to the source of the evil, moving on a strategic map.
descriptions.dos:2470dbeaacc29101: On a trip to Disney World, Cosmo is stranded on a planet with his parents vanished. Run and jump through lands such as alien tropics, haunted forest, ice cave and future world to find them.
descriptions.dos:24840aae2a4f6721: An inventive Tetris take: the field is a large circular fortress with a small ring of balls at the center, and new colored balls arrive from outside to complete circles.
descriptions.dos:2488b16920b65d75: A first-person shooter distributed by Coca-Cola through McDonald's. On your first day at school, a mad scientist has turned your schoolmates into zombies, and you cure them.
descriptions.dos:24a652171b3d63a0: A graphical multiplayer space strategy war game of galactic empires. Colonize and develop planets that determine what kind of starships you can build.
descriptions.dos:24c116c7dbdfef2c: The alien hero of Galactix returns at the request of the King of Galaxia, whose three magical orbs have been stolen by bandits, to retrieve them.
descriptions.dos:24e1a3060bd91dee: A free first-person shooter by Pie in the Sky made as a demo of their Game Creation System, with 3D graphics and sound effects.
descriptions.dos:24e35e75a2728246: A strategy game on an 8x8 board against the computer, Max. You control the blue pieces around the center and it commands the red ones in the corners, each side moving once per turn.
descriptions.dos:24e3c6474b5cc96b: A 3D real-time submarine simulation: command a US submarine in the Pacific during World War II, navigating to track and intercept Japanese warships.
descriptions.dos:25059b1758e8ed53: A fishing simulator: travel to a river, buy equipment at the docks and take tips from Bill Saiff, whose house walls hold the angler's trophies and greatest misses.
descriptions.dos:2507bc553c7c2d5d: One of the first games made in Russia after the Soviet collapse: a beat-'em-up of Russian peasants in hand-to-hand combat to defeat Evil Forces and protect ancient scrolls describing the Sobor combat system.
descriptions.dos:2508b7cc47e57b5f: A shareware platform game for one or two players: guide the small red Aro through sixty levels (eighteen in the shareware release) at four difficulty levels.
descriptions.dos:25191d3644684161: A puzzle game in which you rebuild a structure, such as a big A, from eight differently shaped blocks (some like Tetris pieces) that you rotate and place in limited numbers.
descriptions.dos:2528919d2f5fbd7f: An educational geography game for ages 7 and up, in the style of Carmen Sandiego. Help professional photographer Nigel take pictures around the world.
descriptions.dos:253285b22cdb8729: Play Charlie Chaplin starring in films in the style of black-and-white classics. After filming each scene, you get to edit it.
descriptions.dos:253584831f133f25: Travel to Tokyo to rescue Eva from a scientist who plans to turn her into a machine, in a mouse-driven adventure with several smaller challenges.
descriptions.dos:2544a782b4edee0d: An educational English game helping children identify letters and sound combinations, numbers and number sequences, and everyday vocabulary.
descriptions.dos:254510256665960a: After its creator is killed, you are left holding a sample of a mysterious invention. Deliver it, investigate the intrigue around it and avoid being blamed for the murder.
descriptions.dos:254afef1b5cb04e2: A program for children from pre-school through third grade that teaches telling time in a variety of ways, converting digital to analog and back, at selectable difficulty levels.
descriptions.dos:254d052437ee13c6: A wargame of the Battle of Waterloo, fought on June 18, 1815 between Napoleon's French forces and Wellington's English and allied forces and Blücher's Prussians.
descriptions.dos:255f8857bb05df21: A drag racing simulation: fine-tune your car with a dizzying array of customization options, then send it down short, linear tracks at high speed.
descriptions.dos:2566ffde47c2b6c2: An early squad-level tactical combat game like X-Com and Laser Squad: isometric turn-based combat in the far future, where surviving squad leaders gain experience.
descriptions.dos:2576295d953cb4b4: A total conversion of Duke Nukem 3D developed for WizardWorks as a paid add-on; after a year of production the project was finished and released free on the Internet.
descriptions.dos:258324849de72c12: A shareware sci-fi shooter. Scientists have genetically modified insects that now live in an underground tunnel network, whose leader Phylox rules from a fortress with a breeding chamber.
descriptions.dos:259e82c59cc9a4be: Race as Spanish rally driver Carlos Sainz in a Toyota Celica in the World Championship at circuits such as Monte Carlo, Sweden, UK, Argentina and Spain, on clay, asphalt and snow, tuning the car for each.
descriptions.dos:25ad50d3b4bbbddb: An arcade racer of high-speed dune buggies. 5 tracks of 5 stages each, from cities to deserts to tracks over water, and 12 drivers to pick from.
descriptions.dos:25b4a1e5e5a8f772: A fairly detailed chess tutorial, apparently originally part of Grand Master Chess: Tutor & Challenge, with the challenge portion missing.
descriptions.dos:25b66662d3bc8676: A puzzle arcade game probably inspired by Tetris and Columns. Blocks slowly appear at the top of columns, and you use a cursor at the bottom to pull blocks down from a column, since the game ends if a column reaches the bottom.
descriptions.dos:25dc8050f36313bc: A word game for one or more players. The word-giver sees the real definition and paraphrases it, others make up their own, and everyone votes for the definition they think is correct.
descriptions.dos:25df384a01d6fad6: A text adventure made with the Computer Novel Construction Set: the dog has done a poop in the middle of the Town Square, and your task is to clean it up.
descriptions.dos:25e6a58ee3701022: A puzzle game: collect all the treasures by drilling and cutting through pyramids haunted by mummies, with a limited supply of tools that you must use in the right order or get stuck.
descriptions.dos:25f7462b15a6189c: Krisalis's fourth licensed Manchester United game, named for the club's 1993-94 Premier League and FA Cup double. Overhead view like Kick Off with loose control and a range of moves.
descriptions.dos:25f9ae6f92d39aad: A very simple shareware arcade game against a friend or the AI. Each player has 7 of the 14 cannons along the bottom, and shots ricochet off the walls.
descriptions.dos:25f9f80215698328: A manager simulator for a team in the top three German leagues, with the real players and teams of the time. Handle economics and sport, trade players and more.
descriptions.dos:2603e3c52acb10eb: In 2880, alien races pillage the planet Soran, forcing its inhabitants to flee to Earth and live in a floating Sky-City. A first-person shooter.
descriptions.dos:26079d54e16f7844: Mirinae Software's final game, a casual arena fighter for two players.
descriptions.dos:262889186922639d: A Boulder Dash clone in which a smiling red ball collects all the coins and goes to the exit, avoiding falling rocks and other dangers.
descriptions.dos:262a07eba2dc09b7: An old-fashioned jump'n'run. Jasper's cat Orlando is nabbed by a witch who wants him for a potion, so make your way through a world of magic and monsters to her castle.
descriptions.dos:262a780661fa6909: A Formula 1 racing game in arcade or simulation mode, with manual or automatic transmission, training, single races or a full season, and a two-player option on separate computers.
descriptions.dos:2634d794354d16a9: Jumpman is a bomb disposal expert who saves the Jupiter headquarters after the Alienators booby-trap its 30 levels. Find your way around each screen using platforms, ladders and a jet booster, collecting every bomb.
descriptions.dos:263a46b87ef24d06: A Tetris clone with slower falling blocks. Cleared blocks add to a rising bar chart at the right of the main area, and blocks can be rotated, moved and dropped.
descriptions.dos:263c2ffbcee5c0c5: An arcade game from Maddox Games, later known for IL-2 Sturmovik. Two mice have fun: one runs along a table on which five saucers sit, trying to keep the dishes dropped by his brother from falling.
descriptions.dos:2655a8890e0bcb92: A strategy game of the Vietnam War. As both President and commander-in-chief, keep South Vietnam from falling to the Vietcong while managing military resources and public opinion.
descriptions.dos:265b06459da3d480: A first-person shooter built with the same 3D creation software as Castaway. As a ninja working for Santa, rescue his reindeer from Abominable Snowpeople.
descriptions.dos:26626e19f366cca6: A Core Wars game: you get a tank, a programming language and a board with obstacles like rocks, trees and rivers, and write a program that wins in the most trials.
descriptions.dos:26649f3c6b516c67: A hand-drawn point-and-click adventure set in Russia after Perestroika. A mystery spanning a continent is split into three parts, each with a different character.
descriptions.dos:2668e9e77349e067: An early 3D soccer game with four leagues (England, France, Germany, Italy) and basic management options such as trading players, finances and stadium expansion, with camera options and seasonal weather.
descriptions.dos:2676860d8f3eab4c: A photographic adventure starring Jo Guest: a routine milk delivery turns into an unexpected visit. Use the mouse to explore the house and choose how the encounter develops.
descriptions.dos:267757f5bd8d3969: A Thai kick boxing game endorsed by André Panza, with over 35 moves. Build your fighter in the training gym and customize attacks before taking on opponents in the ring.
descriptions.dos:2678b2ef5c3de20f: A basketball simulator with many difficulty levels, redefinable keys, play against the computer or a friend, selectable match length and a demo mode.
descriptions.dos:268a3edf05cd3a87: An educational game for up to four players testing knowledge of the fifty US states, with quizzes such as State Comparison, where you compare area and population of two random states.
descriptions.dos:268bde2e605d7b16: Interactive fiction that is a single conversation with a single character. You play an art critic speaking to Galatea, an animate sculpture with artificial intelligence, with dozens of possible outcomes.
descriptions.dos:2692aeee1ce0e35a: Use your helicopter gunship to land and save civilians while destroying enemy hostiles, with quick maneuvers and a chain-gun.
descriptions.dos:2694be5361d5bfe8: A Taiwanese fighting game matching fighters from different martial arts backgrounds, with simple fighting using two kinds of attacks.
descriptions.dos:26950da930a509ad: A Finnish English-language two-dimensional shooter, originally shareware and made free in 2000. In a post-apocalyptic world after the Third World War, soldiers fight to amuse a morally feral population.
descriptions.dos:269c3f5184b70126: An arcade racing game with simple controls and no realistic physics, with power-ups and cars that can jump. Pick one of eight characters with different traits before racing.
descriptions.dos:269f521e4f0f429b: A role-playing adventure set in the future as imagined by Victorian science fiction writers, based on GDW's tabletop RPG. Explore Earth's far corners and travel between planets on ships of Martian liftwood.
descriptions.dos:26a0f31d55a6ec9b: An isometric tactical war game like Cannon Fodder, but more advanced. Command squads through missions on terrains from grasslands and desert to the Moon, with pistols and machine guns.
descriptions.dos:26a40ee4a36621ab: A text adventure in the land of Kerovnia: inducted into the Guild of Thieves as a beginner, steal your way to the top, helped and hindered by the Guildmaster.
descriptions.dos:26a43d25c5fb1378: A fast arcade shooter for two players, against the computer or a human via split screen, flying ships in caves and destroying opponents with weapons and bonus add-ons.
descriptions.dos:26af9dcc2a0b67b0: A real-time strategy game very similar to Warcraft II, set in Semirechye, a medieval fantasy world loosely based on Slavic folk tales, where you lead a tribe.
descriptions.dos:26b260e4fb5123f2: A pseudo-3D flying game in which you control a lightly-engined plane over planets and in space. In 2354 humanity has colonized space and collides with the Kartanian Empire.
descriptions.dos:26b5b84b158ae60a: A role-playing game set after a devastating atomic war, with the Earth a radioactive wasteland, where the courageous live on the surface and many people live in huge underground Vaults.
descriptions.dos:26bbdc9c23985c13: Follow-up to Halloween Harry in a side-scrolling platform shooter: aliens are invading Earth and turning humans into zombies to enslave them.
descriptions.dos:26cb8fb08bfc8172: A plotless side-scrolling futuristic shooter: a space fighter flies left to right destroying hostile objects, while dodging harmless ones such as asteroids and bubbles.
descriptions.dos:26ce89786448592d: Puts nearly every team and player from 1871 to 1981 against each other, using the engine of Tony La Russa 3 with aged courts and players, in exhibition or series play.
descriptions.dos:26e1036512d85814: A top-down driving game in which you are a cab driver picking up customers and dropping them off, avoiding crashes and refueling in time.
descriptions.dos:26e6137499e10fa0: Another Crosscountry geography game, now of Canada. Drive an 18-wheel truck around the country picking up and delivering commodities with typed commands like TURN ON MOTOR.
descriptions.dos:26eba2e042b7132a: A Finnish freeware game about demolishing buildings: run a demolition company and bring down buildings with as little explosives and collateral damage as possible.
descriptions.dos:26f7632a5b10071d: In 1938 Indiana Jones and his father race to keep Hitler from capturing the Holy Grail, dealing with Nazi guards, the Luftwaffe and enemy spies. A SCUMM point-and-click adventure.
descriptions.dos:26fa837d8502e488: Private investigator Tex Murphy is hired to investigate the murder of a university professor, one of eight scientists on Project Overlord, which sought to control people remotely, and finds other related deaths.
descriptions.dos:26fc802599649b36: An evil wizard at the top of a sinister tower has imprisoned the souls of four great gods in four talismans and hidden them. A role-playing game.
descriptions.dos:270f6962e2c9958d: A 2D top-down space shooter: enter a solar system where pirates have overrun the freighter lanes, clear them and protect the freighters, with a radar in the corner of the screen.
descriptions.dos:2710b31e12256477: A real-time 3D simulation of flight from lunar orbit to moon landing. Master gravity and inertia in a Lunar Landing Vehicle over hazardous terrain, with keyboard or joystick.
descriptions.dos:271bd416667cc7e0: A single-screen shoot-'em-up: protect humans from predatory buzzards that hatch from eggs laid by pairs in their nests each round.
descriptions.dos:2726a70b052b0a17: A shareware program that generates mazes from parameters like size, colors and path width, which can be printed and used as puzzles.
descriptions.dos:2730b099270e8b5d: A platform action game with light adventure elements. Cornelius the Elf must rescue his sweetheart Elisa from the evil Necrilous the Not-Very-Nice.
descriptions.dos:2738257d4d940ca4: A Civil War strategy simulation in which you play the Confederacy, allocating funds for food, salaries and weapons and choosing offensive or defensive strategies to win as many battles as you can.
descriptions.dos:2738d9bbe5c39558: Play Jerry, chased by Tom, and use various tricks to pay him back. Choose from two difficulty levels and set the time to play.
descriptions.dos:276153aaf5afca96: A platform game with 60 levels, essentially a remake of the SNES game Super Troll Islands, featuring the TV character Mr. Blobby.
descriptions.dos:276da53a5bbdadff: A Space Invaders-style shooter in which destroyed alien ships drop gold and silver coins, which you collect to buy power-ups.
descriptions.dos:27701be3dac35bbb: A beat-'em-up in which you play former punk rocker and martial artist Duke Dunnegan, wrestler Gorgeous George or a pushed-too-far teacher, cleaning the mean streets of thugs.
descriptions.dos:277b8cfcb78a1f7e: An add-on program of 9 slot machines, including 3-wheel, 5-wheel and progressives, for Capstone casino games such as Trump Castle and Casinos of the World.
descriptions.dos:2785d7b5cdf64412: A small tabletop-style soccer game from Sweden: each team has three players and the ball can only leave the field through the goal.
descriptions.dos:2789e6e32995d350: Aquatania has become a land of misfortune thanks to plotting witches. Find five charms and a magic bracelet to put things right, surviving events like being hit by a car and falling a great distance.
descriptions.dos:2792db5cc009cb74: The first of the PC Basket series of budget games, combining a database of Spanish basketball teams with a basketball simulator. It includes 8 teams.
descriptions.dos:279e9770c9fe25a8: Loosely inspired by Dutch Schultz's buried millions, go down into the Lost Dutchman's Gold Mine to blast out a lost treasure in a random maze, infested with rats and spiders.
descriptions.dos:27aa10592e8fb5d7: After humans' victory over the neurocomputer MESIA in the 23rd century, the corporation Conex rebuilds cities and makes new robots, and slowly it becomes clear the company is not what it seems.
descriptions.dos:27cd6063542a64f7: A realistic 3D baseball game in full-screen SVGA with fully animated players, various camera angles and enhanced physics, with real and fantasy ballparks and four skill levels.
descriptions.dos:27da0aa260d20914: Fly as an American or Japanese pilot in one of 4 operations in the Pacific during WWII. Twelve aircraft and about 20 ship types, with a manual full of historical information.
descriptions.dos:27f0b77b8460853c: A single-player keyboard-controlled Asteroids-style shooter in which enemy ships travel in vertical or horizontal lines. Destroy them all and find the exit.
descriptions.dos:27f2bb2acd4878f1: Build molecules out of the atoms provided, watching for double, triple and four-way atoms that stop you from completing your task.
descriptions.dos:27f6d06bd33d9c9d: A game for children where you are the bus driver for the town's children, with some logic and memory elements.
descriptions.dos:27fa46312e266bf5: A text adventure in which you play a GI stationed at Osan Air Base, trying to piece together what happened the night before after a night out at the clubs of Songtan.
descriptions.dos:2800e03d12d4767d: The registered version of Brix, adding 112 levels and a level editor, a near exact clone of Taito's Puzznic: move pieces so identical ones touch and disappear.
descriptions.dos:28028d8f639ada70: Third chapter in a series of text adventures after Two Days to the Race and The Queen's Footsteps. It is April 19, 1907 and you, Emilia Vittorini, are hosted at a villa in Varenna on Lake Como.
descriptions.dos:28059beadc2674b5: It's 1989 and a meteor shower is bringing a deadly, virulent disease to Earth. Contain the infection and keep mankind from catastrophe.
descriptions.dos:280a43fdcf03686f: A shareware side-scrolling platformer closely resembling Super Mario Bros., set in a fantasy land under terror, based on an unofficial DOS Super Mario Bros. by the same author.
descriptions.dos:2815e63b69bca1e4: Mika Huy is assigned by her boss at the Reality-on-the-Norm newspaper to take three photographs, including the alley bum Sinny Binds, Davy Jones's grave and zombie Mayor Michael Gower.
descriptions.dos:281a9ab3f098ce60: The sequel to the ZZT series, with 5 very large game boards with different puzzles and storylines.
descriptions.dos:282dd02576a017ea: A puzzle game: on each time-limited level, push color boxes of the same color together to unite them, then push the resulting box into the exit tile.
descriptions.dos:282df99dc51a2614: A computerized Klondike Solitaire: arrange cards in 7 tableau stacks, build piles of alternating color and descending value, and move aces to the four foundation cells.
descriptions.dos:2839f3a6689c696a: A computer coloring book in the Electric Crayon series with 29 pictures of Super Mario Bros. characters in different occupations, colored from a 16-color palette with a mix button for 256 colors.
descriptions.dos:2843317eb68e3a6e: In medieval Korea, peasant boy Dusu must save his love from an arrogant noble's son who wants to marry her. A 2D side-scrolling platform game with a stick, sickles and magic spells.
descriptions.dos:28480dbcd8b90bfe: A puzzle game in which you, a white ball, must escape from red balls, evil robots, on a field of colored cells with a flashing exit.
descriptions.dos:28629bd7d972c7eb: An arcade-style soccer game with an Indoor and an Outdoor part. Play single matches, league or tournament, with weather effects, replays, customizable game length and funny moves.
descriptions.dos:286bf50e56d27fb4: A maze-like arena where laser tanks fight. Destroy all the opponents that spawn to finish each level, shooting through thin walls.
descriptions.dos:286dc21b439b0822: A Bomberman clone made in 1997 by Kurt W. Dekker (PLBM Games). Destroy the other player or enemies and the blocks in the way, collecting helpful items.
descriptions.dos:28758ee829338ba1: A mouse-only Klondike Solitaire. Click cards to move them onto each other in alternate suits to clear the tableau. Cheating is allowed, but the program will yell at you.
descriptions.dos:287de469313495cc: An adventure with optional graphics and a verb-noun interface. Princess Sabrina has vanished and King John the Good asks travellers to find her, so you begin in the dark forests of Transylvania.
descriptions.dos:287f7f7c50146a3d: Pirate Fry needs a pirating license and must pass three tests: kill someone, steal something valuable and redeem himself. He is sent to Volcano Island to fulfill his triple objective.
descriptions.dos:288329889b5b8cf8: An interactive board game in which Asterix and friends travel the Roman Empire on a challenge from Caesar, learning about countries' history and culture. Play as Asterix, Obelix, Impedimenta and others.
descriptions.dos:28a6514083e25150: Two games in one for children: a platformer for 1 or 2 players and a pair-matching game, starring Sooty and Sweep.
descriptions.dos:28a9bfb0a891bfa1: A nonlinear police investigation in 2D graphics, sequel to Mortville Manor. A cyclone puts detective Jerome Lange's ship in at Maupiti Island, where more trouble starts.
descriptions.dos:28c0b287da48f4fa: A strategy game in the distant solar system Dominium, settled from Earth, where wars ended with a Galactic Charter and military forces were reduced.
descriptions.dos:28c13b7d174a5984: A rugby league game with set tackles instead of rucks and mauls, viewed from an isometric perspective.
descriptions.dos:28c181aaba33a645: The second Redcat game, in which Princess Dana has been kidnapped and Redcat must fight through seven levels, killing a lot of mice, to rescue her.
descriptions.dos:28eb2986b223f419: Sequel to Dangerous Dave: a side-scrolling action game in which you run through a huge mansion of many levels, battling monsters and collecting items, with extra lives at score milestones.
descriptions.dos:28ebdf13555b68b7: Eight-year-old genius Billy Blaze, Commander Keen, flies to Mars in a rocket built from household objects, until the alien Vorticons steal vital parts and hide them in the Martian cities.
descriptions.dos:28eed1bb0c557274: A Psygnosis puzzle game like Lemmings but with a smaller number of caterpillar-like creepers to guide to their goal, in a Christmas edition.
descriptions.dos:28f293af97d0f9eb: As Grand Vizier Iznogoud, whose only aim is to depose the Caliph of Baghdad and take his place, face many challenges and enemies in a colorful platform environment.
descriptions.dos:28fe256c05577bed: People are vanishing in the city of Waterdeep, so descend into Undermountain, a Forgotten Realms labyrinth built on the Descent engine, to find eight pieces of an amulet.
descriptions.dos:28ff1bcbc66ec6bc: Drive a bike up a ramp and jump over a series of yellow school buses. Keep your speed matched to the number of buses to land on the down-ramp without crashing; you have three lives.
descriptions.dos:2908ff48dd866522: A re-release of the 1996 World War I air combat sim Flying Corps with the Fokker D-VII, a new campaign, a mission editor, Direct3D and 3DFX support and multiplayer.
descriptions.dos:291301920a472743: A fighting game with a variety of characters from China's Three Kingdoms era, 220 to 280 AD.
descriptions.dos:2913f8402ff195b5: The classic sliding puzzle: 15 numbered tiles in a 4x4 square with one missing, which you arrange in order by sliding tiles into the empty spot while the game counts your moves.
descriptions.dos:291e5f566af04e5c: In 2197 the Voyager 2 probe reappears in Earth orbit with a passenger with dark intentions, and retired starfighter pilot James Egg is the key to stopping the attack. A plot-driven public domain game.
descriptions.dos:291f03d9e72899f8: A bridge game with a built-in tutorial mode in which Omar Sharif guides novices through the rules, with sample hands showing the best bids and plays, while experienced players can start right away.
descriptions.dos:291fde4af80fbed9: The original space strategy game: name your civilization and those of up to three AI opponents and set out to dominate the galaxy by mining, building and conquest.
descriptions.dos:2928c811b19f6fbc: You are due to take your girlfriend to the Live Aid concert, but thieves have dismantled your motorcycle. Find and reassemble all the parts by 7:30 pm or she will go with the loathsome John.
descriptions.dos:2929ebde762e0ad9: A puzzle in which the screen is divided into two fields of cells: the right side shows an image that you must lay out from tiles in the left.
descriptions.dos:292c09e4bf74877d: A Gals Panic spinoff in the Qix style: claim sections of the playfield to reveal photographic images.
descriptions.dos:2932ae28f0a83845: An unofficial VGA remake of the arcade Mario Bros.: flip the turtles that come out of the two pipes by hitting them from beneath, not jumping on them. Two players cooperatively.
descriptions.dos:29462b3cad7dc7d3: An early learning collection of 6 games for ages 3-8: Draw, Scribble, Names, Sequence, Letters and Match, building reading and counting skills and keyboard familiarity.
descriptions.dos:294a94cb5c0ae188: A German Formula 1 team management simulation by Ascaron, with the 1995 teams and drivers licensed. Run an existing team like Ferrari or Williams or build your own.
descriptions.dos:2953143102f43bf5: A series of Sokoban-style puzzles in which you push crates onto their target squares, with a photographic gallery gradually unlocked as stages are completed.
descriptions.dos:295445241c17c3eb: Based on the Tom Clancy movie. As CIA officer Jack Ryan, find out whether the Red October, Russia's top-secret nuclear missile submarine heading west, is trying to defect, and prevent a deadly war.
descriptions.dos:2954cb6daa0ec97b: A baseball game of strategy and statistics. Manage pinch hitters, infield positions, relief pitchers and base runners, with 28 major league teams and the ability to enter data for new ones.
descriptions.dos:2954d2e07c247203: Your colony is under attack by a marauding cross-shaped alien vessel that wants the colony's food stores. Defend them with a single ship.
descriptions.dos:29808ab150989e27: A naval simulation in which you command the Ocean Ranger, a frigate-sized foilborne missile ship, tracking and destroying targets on the surface, beneath the sea and in the air in four locations.
descriptions.dos:2996858058866c50: A top-down arcade game in which you play a pursued spy driving a vehicle, such as a boat or car, armed with a revolver, in locations like a river or city street.
descriptions.dos:299a0b63a15e5556: A one-on-one fighting game whose five fighters are objects: Ace High the playing card, Slammer the door, Ringo the phone, Jumpy the spring and Tock the clock, each with a special attack.
descriptions.dos:299c4814cdb9dd24: A Towers of Hanoi variant: help a stack of monkeys retrieve two apples from a tree, moving one at a time and never placing a larger monkey on a smaller one.
descriptions.dos:29a285da0c0002e6: A coin-op conversion: you are a hero raised from the dead by Zeus to rescue his daughter Athena, fighting undead and demons through Ancient Greek scenery to the god Neff. The title refers to your shapeshifting.
descriptions.dos:29a33ed9f6f4cab8: A pinball game with four different tables.
descriptions.dos:29acab8dbb21d3f5: A chess game that adds an animated battle between pieces for each capture, in a futuristic science-fiction setting, with pieces animated from clay models.
descriptions.dos:29af44566c709bd3: Fly the RAF Harrier GR7 or US Marine Corps AV-8B, with vertical take-off, hovering and reversing, in three imagined flash-point areas of future conflict.
descriptions.dos:29c50547ca7509fd: A 3D space combat simulator with many missions and smooth polygon-fill graphics.
descriptions.dos:29c6512ecd95ce31: Fly a Sopwith biplane, shooting down enemy planes and destroying enemy buildings, alone or against the computer. The only officially released version adds a novice mode, damaged but flyable planes and screen damage.
descriptions.dos:29d09c62997822d8: You are attacked by arrows from four directions: aim your sword at the attacking arrows and shoot them before they hit you.
descriptions.dos:29d21e7f4387d3ac: A puzzle strategy game set in ancient Egypt, in which you are a high priest saving unfortunate people from evil forces in a pyramid.
descriptions.dos:29d50a73a6c72b98: A puzzle game of creating wacky machines. Each level has a machine designed for a task but with parts missing, and you place the parts so it works, using cats, mice and other machine parts.
descriptions.dos:29d56b8a95d214a6: A game of obscure words for one or more players: type FICT at the DOS prompt, enter the number of players and names, then guess definitions.
descriptions.dos:29d6cffbfaec6b48: A simple economy game about building factories and maintaining product quality. You lose if you run out of money or your product quality falls to 0.
descriptions.dos:29d8a7d7542f60b1: A turn-based wargame with eight airborne operations at the tactical level, from the scattered landings at Crete to the bridges of Arnhem. The only game in a proposed series.
descriptions.dos:29e172da2098d7b7: A baseball management application full of stats: manage your own team through the season, make trades and add players through the yearly draft, aiming for the World Championship.
descriptions.dos:29ebfde2e49c6fa8: A 16-line BASIC program from PC Magazine: move a paddle along the bottom to deflect a ball off the walls, and the game ends when you lose all ten balls.
descriptions.dos:29fa9bea9c850977: A Snake variation in which the python devours rabbits hopping around the field, and a mongoose hunts you from time to time. You can hide in a hole.

descriptions.dos:2b3c98c9000d5bb0: An educational game to teach graphing skills to children 4-10, in which the creature Bumble guides you through six games.

descriptions.dos:2b57697280affe6d: A political simulation in which you are the US President, in your first term, meeting the challenges of politics and economy and aiming to be re-elected.
descriptions.dos:2b611a3841ece097: A winter-themed edition of the Around the World platform game, with snow replacing the original scenery.

descriptions.dos:2b9b2064b43369a1: Space Invaders in ASCII characters, written in Pascal, with a few added features.
descriptions.dos:2b9ec0ec6d16e48e: A desktop planetary program from Broderbund, more of an application than an edutainment game, for exploring space.
descriptions.dos:2bacb8fe62875f19: A cricket game using Ian Botham's name and one-day cricket rules of 1991, with two teams of eleven players.
descriptions.dos:2baf33ef06b42184: A one-on-one fighting game in which ten contestants compete in a tournament for the title of Universe Hero, at the end of the 21st century as the galaxy settles after interstellar wars.

descriptions.dos:2bb6a52b63cd80e5: Lucasfilm's graphic adventure in which teenager Dave Miller ventures into a mansion to rescue his girlfriend from an evil mad scientist.

descriptions.dos:2bc2eb9708e1ec41: A Breakout clone for monochrome displays: dismantle a wall of bricks with a ball deflected by your paddle, starting with five balls.

descriptions.dos:2bfeedb41f62469e: An educational tool for children ages 4 to 14 with multi-level modules for Math, Music, English, Alphabet, Art and Time, and an exam generator.

descriptions.dos:2c104ea6902b7e08: A slightly isometric top-down tennis game for two players, computer or human, on grass, dirt or clay at three difficulty settings. Create a character and save its stats.
descriptions.dos:2c2458c769132359: A top-down space shooter that scrolls at different speeds in any direction, as you wish, over the surface of a ruined, devastated planet.

descriptions.dos:2c38649feb83802b: An educational title in which you explore the inner body of a frog, either dissecting it to remove organs or reconstructing it.

descriptions.dos:2c3fa2c7f698538b: A near-carbon copy of Frogger with updated graphics and sound.

descriptions.dos:2c61a1d035621603: An Asteroids clone seen from behind your ship, in which you are surrounded by dangerous space rocks.

descriptions.dos:2c6fea8154331d57: A counting game with the Berenstain Bears.

descriptions.dos:2c9559d638b17f7b: A text-based adventure for DOS based on the James Bond film A View to a Kill, developed by Angelsoft and published by Mindscape.

descriptions.dos:2ceaddf8d75908df: A simple shooter in which a city faces never-ending alien saucers, and with a single gun you must lead each target based on its altitude and velocity.
descriptions.dos:2ceb214ffd638b5f: A strategy game set after Earth's biosphere collapsed, leaving only androids built for the last war, which collect resources and build and send robots to fight.

descriptions.dos:2cfa87dacba77079: A murder mystery: personalize your character and enter a party where everyone is a suspect. You have about two hours to solve the case and make an arrest.
descriptions.dos:2cfd3866800b7c4c: A shareware blackjack for one to four players with a tutor mode in which you pick one of four preset strategies and watch the game play automatically, or customize your own.
descriptions.dos:2cfe2d52df704d4b: A very basic chess game: play against the AI, another person, or have the computer play itself.
descriptions.dos:2d01064a0aa19940: A magical typing tutor for kids: learn letters with words, play musical notes with the keyboard and learn proper finger placement.
descriptions.dos:2d0272344b41b2c2: A real-time puzzle game in which you steer a friendly spotted ball with the cursor keys through a labyrinth, gaining speed as it goes and losing energy when it collides.

descriptions.dos:2d3761cdd56ac8d9: Play an ancient Roman gladiator in an almost fighting game, in an amphitheater against people and lions.

descriptions.dos:2d7358713526a8ef: A horror adventure from Horrosoft. After a strange letter from your father, the village pastor, you return home to find him missing and everyone hostile, as evil forces have taken over the villagers.
descriptions.dos:2d8622b33281dabb: The first part of the Doppy & Pru text adventure trilogy.
descriptions.dos:2d92c51bcdf8360b: A multiplayer Snake-like game similar to Cervii: control a continuously growing snake and stay alive as long as possible while the other players do the same.
descriptions.dos:2d9958117debf92c: An early spaceship simulator like EGA Trek but simpler: fly a long voyage, fight Imperial ships, repair and refill at starports, and trade commodities for profit.
descriptions.dos:2da6adfd55374f6f: Sequel to Fantasy with eight short interactive scenarios, in which you fill in details that personalize how each story unfolds.
descriptions.dos:2dafc7c11b0e50b0: An unofficial Formula 1 racing game across a 16-circuit season, with practice, single race and full season modes, and options for tires, transmission, laps and difficulty.

descriptions.dos:2dba922f60448c2b: A simple shooter in the tradition of American Laser Games's Mad Dog McCree, with video backgrounds. As one of the last bounty hunters, shoot foes with a mouse or light gun and protect the innocent.
descriptions.dos:2dbdaced27091bb7: An atmospheric puzzle adventure aboard a giant cylindrical spaceship that has entered the solar system. You replace an astronaut who died on the way to investigate it.
descriptions.dos:2dcdc0a9c4840c0a: Fly an F14-LBC Rapier on missions over Colombia, from destroying drug labs, refineries and convoys to carrier missions against enemy ships and oil supplies.
descriptions.dos:2dd94f5de16d93d9: A freeware IPX network-only tank game: shoot the other tanks without being killed, hiding behind random objects and picking up weapons beyond your wimpy laser.
descriptions.dos:2de0df6b1796aafb: An international ice hockey game: control a leading national team in practice, exhibition or tournament modes, training your team and swapping players.
descriptions.dos:2de346558afaea14: A text adventure in which you search for the legendary lost Dutchman's gold, starting in a miner's shack with a map and heading through deserts, mountains and ghost towns.
descriptions.dos:2dedb6bc1fdb1e72: A shareware homage to Galaxian: move your ship side to side with the cursor keys and fire with the Space bar for a high score.
descriptions.dos:2df3e775fdff2d14: An educational history game about the Spanish exploration of America. As a conquistador exploring southeastern North America, pick regions on a map and collect gold and knowledge.
descriptions.dos:2df7ae15738f750e: A Breakout clone from Bulgaria with power-ups and variable speeds.
descriptions.dos:2dfecfeea36019f3: As Prof. George Jumpalot, explore a large cave of red platforms to find a sacred statue left by the Ginkians, an ancient tribe of headhunters.
descriptions.dos:2e05d77b31d4da67: A puzzle of two overlapping rectangles of colored squares in the form of a cross, with four points of contact, to be rearranged.
descriptions.dos:2e0a988925312380: A scientific outpost on a far off planet has been attacked, and a team of marines is sent to investigate and destroy the invaders. A shooter for one or two players.

descriptions.dos:2e1c13fc8875b983: In 2112, as captain of a colonization starship in the Neublinn Galaxy, you are on a mission to colonize nine solar systems when a powerful alien race called the Mancer enters the galaxy.

descriptions.dos:2e3cae881508b818: A two-player cue sports simulator with five game modes: pool, 8 ball, 9 ball, Bumper Pool and Snooker, with an editor for Bumper Pool.

descriptions.dos:2eb687d362d752ba: Mine for gems while avoiding the malfunctioning mine robots.
descriptions.dos:2eba2c43edc805a1: A revised poker edition supporting up to three opponents at once, with new SVGA photographs. Play five-card draw and add opponents with compatible data disks.

descriptions.dos:2ed121b3cf8d5393: A re-release of Wheel of Fortune with an extra one thousand new puzzles.

descriptions.dos:2f097ede5377e4d7: A game based on the film about the furlings, forest creatures who go into the forest one day.
descriptions.dos:2f1485635aaefd7a: A children's bowling game made for Fisher-Price as a promotion, in which you help the Little People win an exciting competition.
descriptions.dos:2f28169b03c6e12d: The first of MicroProse's Command Series tactical wargames, designed by Sid Meier and Ed Bever, descended from NATO Commander, about the Allied campaign in Europe.
descriptions.dos:2f41bd344b708b62: The USA edition of A320 Airbus, a realistic flight simulation covering the US between the West and Northeast coasts with about 240 airports and improved flight physics.

descriptions.dos:2fb3f45a1490c1a9: A computer knowledge quiz in which you build a dream computer.

descriptions.dos:2fc73900b5988ea5: Follow-up based on the classic Korean tale of Hong Gildong, a boy persecuted by his family who becomes a noble-hearted bandit. An interactive cartoon movie like Dragon's Lair.
descriptions.dos:2fc74955a0adaee9: A flight simulator and action game in which you fly an F-14 in single battles or a career, with 256-color graphics.
descriptions.dos:2fc83855de68e19a: A keyboard-controlled Pac-Man style game, released as a freeware beta with thirty-two boards and a board editor.

descriptions.dos:2fd98c5f80c2a47a: A flight simulator with three planes, over 100 airports and maps of major US cities, formation flying and a NAV system.
descriptions.dos:2ff0bdf4a8c75a5b: An evil scientist has turned you into a ball. Roll your way through mazes of monsters, keys, doors, trampolines and wall-dissolving acid to survive.

descriptions.dos:301787b77d73be81: An interactive showcase of exotic cars, letting the viewer look over the interior and exterior of each model along with its price and specifications.

descriptions.dos:3030230d5aee3c9b: An illustrated interactive fiction adaptation of Arthur Conan Doyle's The Lost World, played by typing commands to explore and solve the story.

descriptions.dos:30a64f4e1c8e2cd1: A science fiction adventure written by Roger Zelazny and Jane Lindskold, set in a future where universes can be created as Pocket Universes.

descriptions.dos:30ab3b40a0915560: An updated Sensible World of Soccer with current teams and fewer bugs. A top-down football game with quick matches or a 20-year career as player-manager.

descriptions.dos:30bfc9718abee089: An unofficial Deep Space Nine story played through a small set of text commands, where interactions with the show's characters drive the scenario.

descriptions.dos:31271792d14e766e: A simple amusement-park shooting gallery with six events, such as shooting moving ducks or balloons. When you run out of time or bullets you receive a prize.
descriptions.dos:3131a455bd017882: A text adventure written with the authors' own system, similar to TADS.
descriptions.dos:3136c3805ab3264c: A two-player game in which each player flies a rocket around a battlefield, trying to shoot the other. The loser is whoever's health runs out first.

descriptions.dos:31c647f9a4ca5803: A Euchre card game with drop-down menu options for AI difficulty and alternate rule sets.

descriptions.dos:31cf309a35094a22: A 1995 PC port of a well-known Soviet arcade platformer, written in 1990 for the Vektor-06Ts computer.
descriptions.dos:31d0604b8cc4a723: A strategy simulation with detailed graphics, where almost every significant event is accompanied by a small animation.

descriptions.dos:31dcbe748900842b: An Ataxx variant played with angry little balls, for one or two players.

descriptions.dos:32309c6e88ca6049: A backgammon game in CGA graphics, played against the computer.
descriptions.dos:3237101bcd32948f: A party board game for two to eight players. Roll dice, follow the prompt on each space, and gain or lose money while working toward a chosen winning total.
descriptions.dos:323b52bed2da9543: A Scrabble-like word game for one or more players: choose letters from your tray and place them on the board to make valid words, using the mouse or arrow keys.
descriptions.dos:3249ec2060b6fd98: A mix of Berzerk and Adventure. Explore over 120 rooms to find the evil enemy.

descriptions.dos:32514d37e93f4cd0: An arcade game inspired by Lode Runner. Dig holes to trap enemies, collect power-ups, and choose between two characters with the same abilities.

descriptions.dos:3278a194dd8e3fa8: A freeware word game against the computer. Make as many words as you can from adjacent letters on a 5x5 grid of random letters.

descriptions.dos:329b23fe9d7eb6e0: A platformer in which a race of rational bees defends its civilization against an invasion of alien mosquitoes, dragonflies and ants.

descriptions.dos:32ee964e6969c485: A business simulation in which you are the CEO making decisions to stay ahead of competitors and raise shareholder value, with comic-style graphics.

descriptions.dos:3315066c2fca1123: An adventure set in the small southeast Asian kingdom of Opalia in the 1950s, where USSR and US agents have destabilized the country and local rebels plan to act.
descriptions.dos:33274f9bb838839e: Based on the 1989 Batman movie, the game has five parts, each resembling a different game type, starting with a platform stage in the chemical plant where you hunt Jack Napier.
descriptions.dos:333726639d5cc4bd: A Yahtzee-style dice poker game for one or more players.
descriptions.dos:333a15e6bcaf4133: A first-person shooter in which you play Werner Mueller, a sysop at GIC Headquarters in Futura City, woken at night by explosions and caught in a deadly fight.
descriptions.dos:333bdf187c845c93: A keyboard-controlled shareware pinball game for one player. It is not a real-table simulation: everything is shown on one screen, with a VGA table in the lower left.
descriptions.dos:333beff762882d89: A role-playing strategy game in which you control up to seven students who enter a high school to take on the evil teachers and stop the demonic Principal's plan for world domination.
descriptions.dos:333d425a61fbf304: A version of ELIZA, the 1966 chatterbot by Joseph Weizenbaum of MIT that mimics a Rogerian psychotherapist by prompting you to elaborate on what you type.
descriptions.dos:3359eaaa46a4d5a5: Four children's card games in one program: Memory Match for solitaire, and Old Maid, Go Fish and Slapjack against the computer.
descriptions.dos:335b8ae1d41dedd8: An English-language text adventure inspired by Wagner's opera. You are a modern person who has fallen asleep at the opera, and the game takes place in their dreams.
descriptions.dos:33633d34836ce46a: A shareware electronic version of dominoes, created by Barry Sargent.
descriptions.dos:3363661a2c0715dc: An arcade flight game in which you fly the ATF (Advanced Tactical Fighter) on missions around the world, destroying enemy submarines, radars, aircraft and bases, seen from behind your plane.
descriptions.dos:3363b3369d734eee: A shoot 'em up set in New York in 1930. Gangsters pop up in a row of buildings and you must shoot each one before the on-screen timer runs out.
descriptions.dos:336d5f291eddc9e7: A traffic control simulation in which you manage the flow of vehicles through a busy city block during the 7:00 to 9:00 AM rush hour, as traffic grows and streets jam.
descriptions.dos:3373b587ba1044ff: The last game of the Doom text adventure trilogy, in which you are again the space explorer who survived Doomawangara, the most dangerous planet in the universe.
descriptions.dos:337b77c6f79869b1: A shooter set in Victorian England, where Baron Fortesque used a time traveler's knowledge to build an immense artificial intelligence, the Chaos Engine. For one or two players.
descriptions.dos:3386dd8c4d89459c: The fourth Wizardry game, in which you play not a party but Werdna, the evil Archmage from the end of the first game, fighting through the dungeon.
descriptions.dos:338b4b627841315c: A Prince of Persia-style platformer in which you fight a voodoo curse and its henchmen while avoiding deadly traps.
descriptions.dos:338dd9fe5d43bb4f: A first-person shooter in which you are a mage out to destroy the evil Nemesis, throwing fireballs at foes or at certain walls, and finding bolts and nukes.
descriptions.dos:339ae3add20f6ec2: A maze puzzle from William Soleau and Soleau Software, a successor to Blind Maze, MadMaze and Mission Maze that replaces ASCII graphics with images.
