descriptions.dos:33bc442f7bc5f264: A puzzle game of logic and deduction: work out which spy on your team is really a mole leaking secrets to your enemies, without being fooled by their disguise.
descriptions.dos:33c057016f5eb224: A boxing game that aims to recreate the sport in detail instead of acting as a pure arcade game, with multiple camera angles and viewpoints.
descriptions.dos:33c8eaff83b54609: A first-person 3D shooter set in feudal Korea, known as Legend of the Seven Paladins, and the first commercially released game using the Build engine.
descriptions.dos:33d382beda0f9eaf: A DOS conversion by John Nelson of Eamon, the game creation system and text-adventure role-playing series created by Donald Brown for the Apple II in 1980.
descriptions.dos:33d649f05591ef12: A computer version of the card-matching game Go-Stop.
descriptions.dos:33f10693f3486992: An archery game inspired by the archery event in the arcade game Track and Field, written by an author who found that event hard to master.
descriptions.dos:34128822743e648c: An arcade shooter in which you pilot a Sioux AH-23 attack helicopter and a T1 assault tank against alien forces secretly operating on Earth.
descriptions.dos:3425dcb86d482c5d: The arcade racing game in which you drive a Ferrari with a female passenger across varied terrain on short tracks, seen from just above and behind the car, with sharp bends and hazards.
descriptions.dos:34289bb261c44c01: A role-playing adventure created with the Bard's Tale Construction Set. Starting in the city of Lorraine, assemble a team of adventurers to complete the king's quest, with the same mechanics as the original Bard's Tale.
descriptions.dos:342d7e764204f703: The sequel to Accolade's baseball game HardBall, with better graphics and animation and authentic major league ballparks.
descriptions.dos:342ebc094c20a702: A Spanish action-arcade game in which you guide an armored knight with a sword through several screens, fighting creatures before meeting the dragon.
descriptions.dos:34303de1d6d67af8: A version of Monopoly designed specifically for the city of San Diego.
descriptions.dos:34399b7d924e15dc: Command a submarine in hostile waters and sink as many enemy ships as you can. With a limited supply of torpedoes, time each launch against ships zig-zagging across the periscope view.
descriptions.dos:345a23238c209b8b: Play a NASA Administrator who must design and build a space station over 15 years, planning shuttle launches, recruiting personnel and managing the budget.
descriptions.dos:34601d20d2034416: Test drive ten of the best cars on ten tracks, from Monterey Raceway to a mall parking lot, in the format of Car & Driver magazine. Race solo or against computer-controlled cars, or by modem, with replays.
descriptions.dos:34623742c65f723a: A text-mode DOS platformer made for a DOS game creation competition at high-voltage.cz.
descriptions.dos:34656f1d2e96924c: A breakout game from the makers of Fuzzy's World, designed to close the book on Arkanoid-style programs, with enemy fighters and menacers that launch colored balls to hinder you.
descriptions.dos:3467ed4d7d2e18fa: A puzzle game that its authors call a four-sided colored domino.
descriptions.dos:3472c01f5f8b233a: A word puzzle in which dots randomly appear on screen to form the letters of a hidden message. A clue is shown first and points are awarded by how few dots you need to guess it.
descriptions.dos:347667480bf44296: A kingdom-building game in the mythical land of Genesia, seen in isometric view. Watch your people work, play and suffer in real time while you build infrastructure, grow food, mine minerals and produce building materials.
descriptions.dos:347db59e2b8ffb41: An Olympic sports game with eight events, any selection of which can be played at a time, including rowing, cycling and the triple jump.
descriptions.dos:348129a7bbe40450: An arcade game about road marking: you drive a truck through city streets painting the road lines.
descriptions.dos:348265c21f01512d: A puzzle game in a simple design. A figure made of blue, yellow and red squares sits on the playing field, and you must make it match a target figure shown in the top right corner.

descriptions.dos:3487d0f4955a95dd: A platformer in which Santa loses all his presents from his sleigh, scattered across the country, and must cross scrolling levels to collect them.
descriptions.dos:34937729b234854c: A Spanish action game starring Mortadelo and Filemon. Dr. Bacterio's experiment to grow hens to horse size has failed, and a gang of uncontrolled giant hens is roaming the streets.
descriptions.dos:34a83b8fd081c935: A chess program written by Richard Lang, who has written programs that won the World Computer Chess Championship ten times, and a continuation of the Mephisto series.
descriptions.dos:34afa376279f543e: An educational game for ages 5 to 7 with four games that build math skills, including Clowns' Counting Games, a number counting game with three levels of difficulty.
descriptions.dos:34b10cbbefcabf47: A simple fighting game on an urban rooftop. The fighters Ken and Roc, nearly identical, fight three rounds across a seemingly endless series of levels.
descriptions.dos:34b9c9b8515b1154: A platformer in which Moktar, an Arab man lost in the big city, must be brought back home. It is essentially Titus the Fox with a different main character.
descriptions.dos:34bab04c3e2a3c87: A second short unofficial text adventure set in the Deep Space Nine universe, guided by a limited command vocabulary and encounters with its characters.
descriptions.dos:34c5559f65efc047: A Spanish fighting game, in the style of Mortal Kombat, whose odd cast includes a hot dog, a robot, a woman and other characters.
descriptions.dos:34cbcefeea07eaa9: A hockey game that lets you control Wayne Gretzky and other stars such as Mario Lemieux, Eric Lindros and Mark Messier, 600 players in all, with the 26 NHL teams of the time and international teams.
descriptions.dos:34ccb493d4c0dd4f: A Swedish take on Snake. Use the arrow keys to steer a green snake that is always moving through a scrolling labyrinth, with limited strength that decreases as it moves.
descriptions.dos:34d332b181e10dda: A first-person adventure about exploration and puzzle solving. In 2134, fifty years into a brutal civil war between the Alliance and the anti-technology UN, the desperate Alliance sends you on a mission.
descriptions.dos:34d4cc2eb6c395cf: An adventure based on the French comic character Iznogoud. As the Grand Vizier, whose only thought is to depose the Caliph of Baghdad and become Caliph instead of the Caliph, you wander around and scheme.
descriptions.dos:34e27faf2189af11: A board and adventure game based on Bram Stoker's Dracula. Dracula has come to London seeking fresh blood, and has already turned Lucy Westerna into a vampiress.
descriptions.dos:34ead909aa99219f: A Korean platformer based on a popular Korean animated series, with animated cut scenes from the show.
descriptions.dos:34ed21760a2f5018: A Star Trek style game of protecting the Federation by ridding it of Klingons. The galaxy is 8x8 quadrants of 8x8 sectors, each empty or holding a star, a starbase or a Klingon warship.
descriptions.dos:34f0a7032d447275: A vertical scrolling shooter in which you, the Supreme Magician, travel from the Marsh of Eternal Stench to the Garden of Eden, surviving a deluge of monsters. For one or two players.
descriptions.dos:34f514ea25ed9b54: A clone of Dr. Mario. On a Tetris-like board with three kinds of viruses, drop red, blue, yellow and green pills to clear the viruses by matching four or more of one color.
descriptions.dos:34f55e8b8d136759: A strategy wargame of Second World War campaigns with six scenarios, beginning with Breakthrough 1940, the German invasion of France.
descriptions.dos:34fa3245c49aec95: A baseball game licensed from Pete Rose in which you can play every position on the field, with different batting and pitching styles, digitized voice, one or two players and season play.
descriptions.dos:35061a28a9814bcc: A falling-block puzzle game in the style of Puyo Puyo, with a full story mode. Wander an overhead map of a village and challenge its characters to matches.
descriptions.dos:35087d5686848263: A text-mode dungeon romp for fans of Kroz and ZZT. As a wizard in the caverns, gather gold, gems and orbs while facing seven types of enemies.
descriptions.dos:350dbd2e996d73a7: Two games on one disk, built to show off an early 3D system: Voyageur IV, an asteroid shooter, and 3D Ping Pong, a table-tennis game, launched from a common menu.
descriptions.dos:350dd0d9ea24ace8: A side-view platformer starring a bearded, big-eyed caveman abducted by aliens. To get home he crosses several worlds, each with its own style, enemies and levels, with no weapons.
descriptions.dos:352b624ebe6fa2b3: The Jeopardy! quiz show with over 1000 answers on sports, from Olympic events like gymnastics and swimming to football, golf and baseball, with one-on-one play against the computer.
descriptions.dos:353956f7be2284ee: The first of Moraff's dungeon crawls. Choose to be a fighter or a wizard and explore four-color dungeons, climbing back up ropes to shops and inns, with a map that fills in as you go.
descriptions.dos:3542fa81eb18bdc5: A Spanish action game. After bringing peace to Cocovillage, Mad Mix faces a new threat at Cococastle, the haunted castle of his cousin Ope's town.
descriptions.dos:3549e9d1abe4d3f0: A space game in which you navigate obstacles using indirect thrust.
descriptions.dos:354ec4db8c71c450: A shareware falling-block puzzle played with the keyboard. Colored tiles slide down a ramp to a grey catcher, which you then position over the play area and drop them into.
descriptions.dos:3550bb2f958bbe1f: An odd soccer game whose teams are made up of characters such as construction workers, cowboys, grannies, insects and scientists.
descriptions.dos:35608fbbafdce895: The episodic first-person shooter and follow-up to the top-down Castle Wolfenstein. Play B.J. Blazkowicz, an Allied spy, across six episodes, the first distributed as shareware.
descriptions.dos:35736cc5bdf35189: An arcade adventure with four distinct stages that repeat with greater difficulty once you survive them all. Fail, and the lovely Penelope, captured by cannibals, is lost along with you.
descriptions.dos:3574f822aa26a7a6: The first game in the Strike series. A year after the Gulf War, a self-styled general takes over an Arab Emirate and threatens world war, and you fly a helicopter gunship to stop him.
descriptions.dos:3576e959928ba756: A platform shooter starring Van Slug, a futuristic detective who rids the city and countryside of monsters, through fairly large levels full of ground and flying enemies.
descriptions.dos:357b5837d328b8a7: A platformer based on the Disney movie in which you control Mowgli, raised by animals in the jungle, and try to reach the human village. He can jump, run and climb.
descriptions.dos:3584369ec6ec82c8: A five-level platformer in which the Blues Brothers flee the law. Play bulky Jake or nippy Elwood, cross a prison, a river and the city, and collect your missing records. For one or two players.
descriptions.dos:3595bddb960114e3: A shareware first-person shooter with the engine and play mechanics of Wolfenstein 3D, plus an optional high-resolution mode. The registered version has three episodes.
descriptions.dos:35b34fff78815612: A text adventure set in 2285, when Earth is dying from a plague and a now-extinct plant could cure it. Time travel is the only hope, taking you to places like the Old West and the American Revolution.
descriptions.dos:35b49e9ce3396bff: A sequel to Mike Singleton's Lords of Midnight III, based on Wagner's Der Ring des Nibelungen. Play Siegmund, son of Volsung, on a quest to find nine magical objects.
descriptions.dos:35b86c1eddf713f0: A superhero text adventure featuring the Gamma Force: a humanoid made of flame, an elf princess with a bow and a musclebound waterbeast.
descriptions.dos:35b887cc273d2ca8: Guide a ball through 50 levels of walls and barriers. You control a bat that serves the ball and then follows it through the level, deflecting it before it falls behind you and costs one of your four lives.
descriptions.dos:35bfcae4d438b43b: A compilation of the voxel-based RAH-66 helicopter simulations: Comanche: Maximum Overkill, the Global Challenge and Over the Edge add-ons, plus ten bonus missions.
descriptions.dos:35f2db36db5d82c3: A computer adaptation of Games Workshop's board game, a violent fictional sport. Teams such as the Champions of Death and the Elfheim Eagles play single matches or a full league, and you give the orders.
descriptions.dos:35f7b0d35f277a73: A single-player shareware version of the Chinese tile-matching game, played with the mouse. It was first released around 1989, and version 3.1 came in September 1991.
descriptions.dos:35fb5179e0c5bddf: A construction-site game for kids in which you try out an excavator, bulldozer, steamroller or wrecking ball with just three buttons to press.
descriptions.dos:360d8773417b2bb7: A very simple scrolling arcade shooter from Taiwan, likely ported from a console, which is difficult from the start. A joystick is recommended.
descriptions.dos:361314c70a748217: A single-player Pac-Man clone. Pako, a friendly yellow blob, must eat the eggs of space pests and pass 100 levels to be cloned and released into the world.
descriptions.dos:361d9a92ee454de1: A text adventure from the book Creating Adventure Games On Your Computer, one of four sample adventures typed in and compiled in BASIC to teach interactive fiction design.
descriptions.dos:362ee12ac7ceb536: A Minesweeper-style logic game in which you clear the cargo bays of Altair-217 station of irradium explosive devices planted by a criminal group, with the colonists' lives depending on you.
descriptions.dos:3637716906f4c1f4: A side-scroller like Paperboy, on a skateboard. Navigate streets and sidewalks collecting flags before time runs out, dodging pedestrians, cars and obstacles through 10 levels.
descriptions.dos:364f5ce4c5c3e202: A Lode Runner clone with 25 levels of ladders, ropes, enemies and diamonds. As a commando sent into an underground warehouse, you pick up all the stolen diamonds.
descriptions.dos:36500e15da629c06: A space flight simulation in which a computer has taken control of an intergalactic empire and locked it in limbo. You must reach it through hostile territory and destroy it.
descriptions.dos:3658f812b6242b04: The sequel to Deja Vu. You wake in Las Vegas with a headache as Ace Harding, and must find $112,000 belonging to a murdered Chicago racketeer for the mobster Tony Malone.
descriptions.dos:365e1c28cdfd29f8: A Wolfenstein-style 3D shooter made with the Pie 3D Game Creation System, in which you rescue Santa's frozen elf from the evil polar bear king. It uses heavy weapons but is not gory.
descriptions.dos:366403f291d3553b: A compilation of the whole Wing Commander II saga on one CD: Vengeance of the Kilrathi and its Special Operations expansions.
descriptions.dos:366cf92c0750d15f: Lead a covered wagon party of pioneers west from Independence to Oregon's Willamette Valley. Stock up on provisions, then decide when to rest and how much to eat as you travel.
descriptions.dos:36983d77f804c911: A shooter similar to Galaxian War: no plot, black space, and waves of resilient enemy ships that die only after several precise hits.
descriptions.dos:36a6dcc31443876e: Avalon Hill's strategic board game Diplomacy in its first commercial computer adaptation. Choose a country and attempt world domination.
descriptions.dos:36a6dd001a9e5f57: A text adventure in which you explore the Miser's House. It has little text and simple puzzles, and no goal beyond exploring, with points awarded for treasures.
descriptions.dos:36a7f6b405490070: An educational game for toddlers set in a children's treehouse, teaching numbers, shapes, letters and animals through activities with items found around the treehouse.
descriptions.dos:36b1d0e2912da4da: A Spanish clone of Pang. As part of Ball Breaker Corp. you destroy balls that have invaded Earth, which split into smaller balls each time they are hit until they disappear.
descriptions.dos:36b820885b25889c: The successor to Championship Manager, with the same text interface and new features such as reserve squads, transfers of international players and injury time.
descriptions.dos:36bdf41c51a2793d: A role-playing game in which a prophecy says dragons will rule the world. The emperor sends four heroes, warriors and magicians, to an island to confront their lords.
descriptions.dos:36ca28cca41e9390: A shooter in which you are a spaceship pilot defending Mars against ten hordes of space snakes, each stronger than the last. You have five ships.
descriptions.dos:36cefcb2137ddbd3: A flight simulation of US Naval aviators over Vietnam, with MiGs, AAA and SAMs, and carrier landings. Configure each plane's loadout, plan your mission package and fly.
descriptions.dos:36d558d98a2b22cf: An action platformer with gameplay like Flashback. A fanatic group called Apocalypse attacks a nuclear convoy to start a global nuclear conflict, and the president sends his best agent to stop them.
descriptions.dos:36ddf09319b08816: A cross between Arkanoid and Tetris.
descriptions.dos:36ec714faf02b243: The second Star Saga game, combining science fiction role-playing with a strategy board game. Up to six players take pre-created characters, in a merging of computerized and non-computerized RPG.
descriptions.dos:36ed17c64f7420fb: A racing game based on the classic Italian road race. Drive a rickety 1920s car across Italy in stages, staying within the time limits at each checkpoint to remain in the race.
descriptions.dos:36ed8d247658e9fc: A real-time mecha strategy game set in futuristic Japan. Command a group of armed soldiers through missions, from infiltrating a drug lord's mansion to assassinating a coup leader, pausing to give orders.
descriptions.dos:36ef120bb3d04ed4: A chess program with several AI levels for beginners and advanced players, up to an ELO rating of 2150, and an optional advice feature that tries to teach you chess.
descriptions.dos:36ef29da7a1388e2: A text adventure in which Richard sets out to find his father, the archaeologist Edward Lynton, who has mysteriously disappeared, while the evil god Darsuggotha tries to ascend into our world.
descriptions.dos:3708a9621d27057c: A platformer based on the 1960s TV series The Munsters. The family has been transported to a mysterious castle, and you play its members in turn, collecting items in each room to rescue the rest.
descriptions.dos:372dc3b767214f28: An action game based on the film Platoon, in which you control a squad of five US soldiers in Vietnam in turn, switching between them as each can take only three hits.
descriptions.dos:372e1b4634b1f53d: A creative kids' title from EA Kids in which you make your own music videos using songs and characters from the time, including ones from other EA Kids titles.
descriptions.dos:374253abbffe9856: A standard side-view platformer: run, jump and collect bonuses through a series of short, sometimes difficult levels, moving between them through locked doors.
descriptions.dos:3746845bea659a6c: A cyberpunk adventure set in the near future, when hell has been found to exist. The Hand of God governs the ways to hell, demons can reach our dimension, and criminals are sent to hell instead of jail.
descriptions.dos:3748fc026895c6c9: A football management game featuring English teams. Start with any Division 3 side and try to climb to the Premiership, handling training, scouting and other duties.
descriptions.dos:374cf232239c1137: A Bust-A-Move variant without the cute mascots. Aim and launch a colored sphere up a narrow tunnel, ricocheting it into place, with an automatic launch after ten seconds.
descriptions.dos:3770b8378f79a39b: A squash game licensed from Jonah Barrington, with one- and two-player modes. Barrington calls the score and claimed the program could improve a player's real squash.
descriptions.dos:377cad0e9c728979: The sequel to Elite. You have a ship and limited funds and nowhere to go but out into space: trade, fight, hunt criminals or work for the various governments, with few limits.
descriptions.dos:378b7da30ad4465c: An educational adventure like Law and Order for kids, with over 50 mysteries to solve, from missing items and dug-up skeletons to sea monster sightings.
descriptions.dos:378b9efe9ac443fa: A tactical starship combat game. Command the United Alliance of Planets, Klargon Empire, Reman Star Empire, Imperial Pirates or Freemen planets, fighting ships, starbases and outposts with phasers and torpedoes.
descriptions.dos:378e7bae3eb243eb: An educational action game. The lazy Gruzzles have stolen all the letters from every book, and Benny the Bookworm sets out to get the words back.
descriptions.dos:378e7d4824078d88: A combination of first-person helicopter simulation and isometric espionage action. As ace pilot and neurosurgeon Johnny McGibbitts, fly behind enemy lines on a mission against the Mad Leader.
descriptions.dos:378ef203a2d96f1f: Perhaps the earliest official Scrabble for the PC, for up to four players with computer opponents at 8 skill levels and an amendable 20,000-word dictionary.
descriptions.dos:3792915df1c3fbb2: A shareware, single-player two-dimensional platformer. Diana, sitting in class, finds herself in the lost temple of the Aztecs.
descriptions.dos:379a79e568fc62c3: A Russian remake of Sokoban with EGA graphics. It is intentionally austere, with no menu, screensaver or plot.
descriptions.dos:37a69f23ed9bba2b: A chess game based on Terminator 2, with sounds and characters from the movie as pieces. Captures are animated like Battle Chess but fought off the board in futuristic wastelands, with several difficulties and play styles.
descriptions.dos:37b1fc4169abca8b: Build a series of castles to gain dominion over the land. Your decisions affect your standing with the Church, nobles and peasants, while you keep a strong military and workforce and watch your treasury.
descriptions.dos:37b29bee97d5a7b2: A four-way scrolling shooter inspired by Sopwith. Fly an early 20th century fighter plane with the objective of blowing things up, using moves such as climbing, diving, flipping and 360-degree loops.
descriptions.dos:37b670977f0ccac9: A text adventure in which you must save your people from living without the Ruby of Rashmik, the magic object that makes crops grow and the birds fly.
descriptions.dos:37b987a9bd7dd226: A three-in-a-row logic puzzle in which you transfer rings onto pins to line up three of the same color vertically or horizontally.
descriptions.dos:37be25ee8a63f160: Pilot the Gunship Gladiator helicopter to stop a coup. Twelve levels in three styles, starting with flying low over a city to shoot tanks.
descriptions.dos:37c1179f71e0194d: Five-card draw poker against up to three photographed opponents at once, with VGA graphics and an introductory voice sequence. More opponents were available on data disks.
descriptions.dos:37cae7b97dd28abf: An American football game with single games against the computer or a friend and full seasons with playoffs and Super Bowls. A Construction Set lets you create your own team down to its playbook.
descriptions.dos:37e59fb0ebf16276: Santa has lost his sled and his delivery notes. Walk around town, pick up the presents and work out by trial and error which house each belongs to, while a rogue Easter Bunny gets in the way.
descriptions.dos:37f8001d72ab8f1a: An arcade game in which you are a bartender serving beer to demanding customers in four lanes of increasing length. If a customer reaches the end of the lane without a beer, you lose.
descriptions.dos:37fe2331da99e08a: The first Leisure Suit Larry adventure, in which Larry Laffer goes on a disastrous search for romance. Explore illustrated locations, type commands and solve inventory puzzles for comedy and points.
descriptions.dos:38025a6ef55c6d57: A junior edition of Wheel of Fortune with word puzzles aimed at a younger audience.
descriptions.dos:380bb00ce0bcdfbd: A direct computer conversion of Steve Jackson's board game, in which a giant supertank fights superinfantry and howitzers. It plays like the board game.
descriptions.dos:381bde0b24ecf54e: A role-playing game based on novels by Lord Steven and heavily inspired by the early Ultima games. An evil wizard threatens the kingdom of Syree, and none of its heroes has returned.
descriptions.dos:381ee1e90236b2d3: A shareware underwater arcade game in which you play a marine biologist diving for rare sea creatures. Lead the diver to the creatures and bring them back to your cage for points.
descriptions.dos:382acaa7f60c8891: An isometric 3D platformer, with controls rotated to match the viewpoint. Each level is played against a time limit.
descriptions.dos:38301ea1b71ebb39: A 2D naval simulation with action elements, set in 1995 as tensions boil in the Persian Gulf between Iranian, Iraqi and US forces. You are captain of the destroyer U.S.S. John Young.
descriptions.dos:383277aae666a2c1: You wake in prison with no memory and find a briefcase computer that controls four droids. Use them to find out who you are and escape, in a role-playing game.
descriptions.dos:38384430fc77bcc0: A stock market game for up to four players, who invest in oil companies, car companies and airlines and use performance graphs and economic trends to make their fortune. You can take out a loan.
descriptions.dos:383f5cedcb2c4526: A platformer in which thugs from the evil Thindicate corporation kidnap Roy Fat's wife and he must trade for her with the Duplicator. There are seven stages.
descriptions.dos:384783ff93463ae8: An ASCII space strategy game in which you are the supreme leader of a galactic empire, with the common 4X elements of planet management, exploration and conquest.
descriptions.dos:38509aa69d2e8078: A reading game for 3 to 7 year olds, with talking characters and digitized music and sound to help build reading skills.
descriptions.dos:385b0e1d7f2b636e: Dan Bunten's M.U.L.E. revamped with VGA graphics and set underwater. Four players compete for economic dominance in a round-based colony.
descriptions.dos:386776f13171f209: The second GeoTutor geography quiz, on South America. It teaches where each country is and adds a paragraph or two about each.
descriptions.dos:386f4a1eb1bad421: A side-scrolling platformer in which Mylo Steamwitz, a space trader, enters the mines of the Altairian system to collect crystals and start a twibble farm. Finish all 16 levels, collecting every crystal.
descriptions.dos:387cb39e44c3c489: An adventure in which you single-handedly save the world from alien intruders, among strange characters, aliens and heroes in detailed settings.
descriptions.dos:387e6ccff949e77b: A scrolling shooter in which you, found guilty though innocent, choose to become a front-line warrior for the empire instead of a colonist. Pilot one of two ships and shoot everything on screen.
descriptions.dos:388b4fc2f9f07324: An action-sports game with a threefold mission: sail three legs around the Bermuda Triangle as fast as you can, rescue lost swimmers and rafters, and avoid sharks, mist and whirlpools.
descriptions.dos:389e5a0124f99db3: The first Tetris sequel, designed by Alexey Pajitnov with Andrei Sgenov. Falling pieces are rotated and positioned to form complete rows, here looking down into a well.
descriptions.dos:38a0ac87805d2534: A parody of Zork, full of goofy situations and commentary on the inadequacy of adventure games of the late 1970s and early 1980s, played as a nonlinear treasure hunt.
descriptions.dos:38a5581a34b4178f: The fifth Ultima, built on the Ultima IV engine, with an overhead view of Britannia and its towns, and 3D dungeons. It adds much more world interactivity and deeper characters.
descriptions.dos:38ab0c59bba156b2: A rugby simulation for one or two players without an official license.
descriptions.dos:38bec611e8ea979f: A first-person RPG in which you are abducted from Earth by aliens and dumped in a strange, familiar city in an alternate dimension. Explore it and find the clues that lead you onward.
descriptions.dos:38c204015abb24e2: An Apogee platformer starring Baron Baldric, later reused in the isometric game Mystic Towers. The registered version was sold only in Australia.
descriptions.dos:38c656d6aee900a3: A turn-based strategy game of the South Pacific campaigns of the Second World War. Command either the Japanese or US forces, with hundreds of specific units.
descriptions.dos:38ca5609b55a779b: A mecha combat game heavily inspired by the Amiga's MechForce, itself a computer adaptation of the BattleTech board game.
descriptions.dos:38ccf28c1b1e8807: A beat 'em up set in a post-apocalyptic New York, starring the twin brothers Billy and Jimmy Lee, trained in the Sou-Setsu-Ken fighting style. Play alone or with a friend.
descriptions.dos:38d3356eadbac6e5: A side-scrolling fighter like Double Dragon. As the fallen angel, you search for the leader of a drug distribution network, beginning in the London underground, with two tasks to complete on each level.
descriptions.dos:38d846af5e7b13c1: A Street Fighter II clone with stick-figure fighters, for one or two players.
descriptions.dos:38dcf859aba9861e: A bomber game in which you fly zig-zagging across the sky, losing altitude with each turnaround, and drop bombs on the cities below.
descriptions.dos:38e2dd0b5b5af015: An old-school overhead RPG much like the first Ultima games, controlled with simple keyboard commands, on a quest involving the Sword of Rhin.
descriptions.dos:38e4fea938296719: Play Willy and shoot spitwads at bouncing balls. Each large ball you hit splits into two smaller ones, and each split drops a power-up.
descriptions.dos:38f0bdf4b56f38df: The building is on fire and the babies are trapped. You are the rescuer holding the safety net, and must catch each baby that jumps.
descriptions.dos:38fe5d9b47da0bac: An educational game for children aged two to six, in which Barney Bear visits the farm.
descriptions.dos:390b0238ec8bbe8c: A platformer in which you play Aldo, who looks a lot like Mario in Donkey Kong, climbing to the upper levels to reach a treasure chest while avoiding falling barrels.
descriptions.dos:390c141ea48216c7: A chess opponent with detailed graphics and a large book of opening moves.
descriptions.dos:391efacece3d91ad: A shareware ski jumping simulation with full 3D graphics and realistic physics. It has 32 hills, from the small K50 in England to the huge K250 in Slovenia, and up to 16 players.
descriptions.dos:39227b23d9ab88d3: A simulation of commanding a Type VII U-Boat, an exact recreation of submarine warfare circa 1941, with internal and external views in full 3D.
descriptions.dos:3928930499e954eb: Unlike the first two games, which were role-playing and resource management, Universe 3 poses true logic-based puzzles, with characters moving much as in Omnitrend's tactical game Breach.
descriptions.dos:392cee57d388acb7: An Asteroids-style game in which you fly a spaceship and shoot all the asteroids and aliens you meet. Large asteroids split into smaller ones, and a map shows where they are.
descriptions.dos:392f7d257bca349f: A platform shooter in which you play a soldier in red armor, reminiscent of Crusader, with no clear plot.
descriptions.dos:393612e5aeed2e84: A clone of the arcade game Pengo. Control Pango, a penguin, in a maze of ice blocks that can be moved or destroyed, and clear it of the bees chasing you.
descriptions.dos:393a725de99926d5: A puzzle game in which Bloxinies, a little character with a smiling face, enters an odd gate into a puzzle world and can escape only by collecting all the diamonds that open the door.
descriptions.dos:3954a0f1a8c9c6a2: A lesser-known Coktel Vision adventure that introduced the interface used in many of the company's later games, and one of its first to use FMV cut scenes.
descriptions.dos:395b9dbc14736847: An Infocom text adventure in which you are teleported into the body of the main character in the world of Sorcerer, following the story from there.
descriptions.dos:395bf03421965170: A simulation of the air war over Iraq a few years after the Gulf War, in which you fly an F-16 in a series of one-off missions, with a detailed cockpit and systems.
descriptions.dos:3989a463d42e8679: A puzzle game inspired by Pipe Dream. Balls of three colors constantly appear at the left of the play field, and you route them into matching storage cups at the right.
descriptions.dos:3991d07ca8542f70: A World War II flight simulation and strategy game in which you fly a dive bomber armed with torpedoes and a machine gun and try to sink the battleship Bismarck.
descriptions.dos:399f4a25abece61a: In the year 2127, after the great interstellar war, the galaxy is full of unclaimed planets. As a starship captain, you explore and take advantage of them.
descriptions.dos:39a68aa5e3d177dd: A text adventure in which you are stranded in deep space without fuel and find an abandoned space station where strange things have been happening, then try to reach the planet below.
descriptions.dos:39b31f1f77eb2635: A puzzle game in which each level gives you atoms to arrange into a specific molecule shape in a top-down view. A small picture of the target is shown at the lower left.
descriptions.dos:39b5eb28e57a090a: Destroy the enemy cities by entering the angles at which to fire your missiles. UFOs fly over and try to destroy a city or your base. The game ends when you have fired all twelve missiles.
descriptions.dos:39cb2a051dc90a25: An educational game for ages 2 to 5 starring Donald Duck. His alphabet letters have escaped and are hiding around the house, and you help him find all 26 and put them back.
descriptions.dos:39d06fc09e54acae: Based on the AD&D Spelljammer rules, you pilot a ship that travels into space and to distant planets for exploration and piracy.
descriptions.dos:39db2b9718194f0d: Develop the careers of aspiring heavyweight boxers as their manager, choosing options through an icon-based manager's office, including training the boxers.
descriptions.dos:39db776b79b06bcf: Two basketball games in one package, with 3 skill levels. One recreates the real game, with a full league for one or two players that can be saved, and the other is faster paced.
descriptions.dos:39f9c7513d313efa: A tool for running NBA fantasy basketball leagues: name the league and commissioner, set the number of teams, import new stats and draft players.
descriptions.dos:3a048aa64fbf4f31: A text-based simulation of darts for up to 20 players. Each player picks fast overarm, controlled overarm or underarm throws, which affects accuracy.
descriptions.dos:3a0afcf2d9eb8852: A sports edition of Jeopardy! with 700 categories and 3,500 questions on sports like baseball, football and hockey.
descriptions.dos:3a16b223d8400e19: A collection of six arcade mini-games. Miss Piggy has been pignapped by the sinister Dr. Grump, and Kermit, Gonzo, Fozzie and other Muppets come to the rescue.
descriptions.dos:3a23692416b99337: An early Gettysburg simulation with simple top-down map graphics and keyboard controls.

descriptions.dos:603228a3a7e67775: A first-person shooter set in the Terminator universe, originally an expansion for Terminator: Future Shock. It runs on an updated Xngine with sharper 640x480 play and was released as a standalone game.
descriptions.dos:603c36a507e1c313: A real-time strategy game set in the year 699. Slav prince Mirko, whose settlement has been burned, leads his warriors to conquer the surrounding territories and take revenge on his treacherous neighbors.
descriptions.dos:6041950953cb4652: A 3D shooter in the style of Zarch. You fly a spaceship in any direction through closed environments, shooting enemies while a mini-map in the corner shows where they are.
descriptions.dos:6041ef4ef7b7b0ab: A first-person shooter made with Pie in the Sky Software's 3D Game Creation System. You infiltrate the military compound of an unnamed Middle Eastern dictatorship that is secretly manufacturing chemical weapons.
descriptions.dos:604e85ea4caf2632: Interactive fiction with graphics. Your aim is to escape the land of Kerovnia, where strange events are routine and the banished Roobikyoub dwarves, makers of fine whisky, have upset the king's subjects.
descriptions.dos:60541ea09e8b6414: A side-scrolling beat 'em up in which Freddy Hardest fights through the streets of a decayed future New York, taking on thugs armed with baseball bats and knives. The difficulty is set high.
descriptions.dos:6058b69b4bf91365: A Tic Tac Toe variant played on a 3x3x3 cube. Score by lining up three of your marks in a row, win more games than your opponent to take the match.
descriptions.dos:605ad1c88a7f5687: A fantasy strategy game in which you play a wizard competing against up to four computer wizards on two planes of existence. Win by destroying your rivals or by casting the Spell of Mastery.
descriptions.dos:605cc41d60bf9bd5: A creativity program for making animations and pictures with Bugs Bunny and the cast of his cartoon world. Set your frame, place backgrounds and characters, and build your own cartoon.
descriptions.dos:605cf64673c4702d: A Bible-based adventure following the apostle Paul's first missionary journey from Acts 13 and 14. It spans ten cities and over 160 locations.
descriptions.dos:605dfda8ac46c80b: A soccer management game, an updated Championship Manager 93/94 in which you take charge of an Italian club from Serie A or B, with rules adjusted to Italian football.
descriptions.dos:606631de5f64886b: A snake game in which a beer-themed worm from Finland slithers around the screen. Arcade play in the classic snake mold.
descriptions.dos:60708d04aab8c479: A stealth fighter flight simulator and sequel to F-19 Stealth Fighter. Fly air-to-air and ground missions over the Persian Gulf, Cuba and Vietnam in both cold war and full-scale war scenarios.
descriptions.dos:607261b51e03b0d9: A basketball management game, the sequel to PC Basket. Lead one of the 16 teams of the 1993/94 Spanish league, choosing your five and team tactics and controlling the players.
descriptions.dos:6076caccb4e918c5: A cyberpunk interactive movie viewed in first-person slideshow style, similar to Myst. As Sam Frost, fresh out of prison, you are hired by Metacorp to find out why guests of its Alexandria resort are being killed.
descriptions.dos:607c17258c85c641: A platformer and successor to Charlie the Duck. Guide Charlie through 18 levels across different worlds, find secret exits to hidden levels, and face a boss after every six levels.
descriptions.dos:60820c527f7e4cfb: A naval hydrofoil missile boat game mixing simulation and action. Missions include destroying every enemy vessel in an area, surveillance of ships you must identify without sinking them, and escort duty.
descriptions.dos:6085abd8dce882bc: An auto-scrolling game in which you move your submarine up and down to dodge obstacles.
descriptions.dos:608a9a53d9093337: A business simulation in which you head a petrochemical conglomerate for 1 to 10 years, buying domestic and foreign oil and releasing it to refineries to build your fortune. Each turn is half a financial year.
descriptions.dos:608b52816abb15f7: A vertically scrolling action game ported from the arcades. One or two players fight through jungles, rivers and ruins, picking up machine guns, grenades and rocket launchers along the way.
descriptions.dos:60974be03860df93: An adventure in which a witch has put a princess and her castle under a spell. After 100 years the castle is full of deadly creatures, and you must clear them out and rescue Sleeping Beauty.
descriptions.dos:60a031368ca0fc55: Fly an F-14 Tomcat mission after mission, shooting planes out of the sky with a vulcan cannon and a limited supply of missiles in this port of the arcade shooter.
descriptions.dos:60b2501289ad7e33: A shooter built on a spell that turns the strong Bully into a fish and the fearless Monica into a hawk on alternate full moons, keeping them apart. Only an extraordinary event can break it.
descriptions.dos:60b8178dd516d0e2: A wrestling game with arcade elements, licensed from the World Wrestling Federation. Pick Hulk Hogan, the Ultimate Warrior or the British Bulldog and fight in practice matches and championship bouts.
descriptions.dos:60bfd74f9677e739: Assemble a team of 5 X-Men from 15 and battle evil mutants in a top-down RPG. Fights can be resolved as side-scrolling action or turn-based RPG combat.
descriptions.dos:60c0ea7022c323bb: A turn-based railroad empire-building game based on Avalon Hill's board game, keeping its hexagonal map and track tokens. Invest, build routes and out-trade your rivals.
descriptions.dos:60c3bea1e3f9c206: A turn-based, hex-based wargame on the Battlefront engine about Allied and Axis forces in North Africa in World War II. Eight scenarios from Syria in 1941 onward can be played from either side.
descriptions.dos:60cda01e752a02d0: A top-down exploration shoot 'em up in which you collect four crystals from a hostile alien craft and carry them to your scout ship to destroy it. Keys open the way, and roaming androids must be cleared from each room.
descriptions.dos:60ce42180e41d20c: A falling-block puzzle game in which three-ball jelly beans drop from the top of the screen. Position them to make rows of three or more of the same color.
descriptions.dos:60cfc6893680c6ef: A Cinemaware action-strategy game in which you sail the high seas as Sinbad, helping the Princess defeat the Black Prince and his minions from hell. You fight pirates and genies along the way.
descriptions.dos:60e558a82757e3c1: A combination of Syndicate and its American Revolt expansion. In a future ruled by corporate syndicates, you direct a squad of agents to take control away from competing companies.
descriptions.dos:60e9925032659195: A platformer in which you play a robotic insect in a robotic jungle whose cousins are chewing through the citadel and threatening the reactor core. Capture the renegade insects and use them later to perform tasks.
descriptions.dos:60f89119e5919780: A full-screen 3D role-playing game with puzzle and combat elements. You are Drake, an adventurer out to stop the evil Khull-Khumm and restore Stonekeep to its former glory.
descriptions.dos:60f9fcd7acd19cd6: A crossword program with an archive of 365 Los Angeles Times puzzles. Load a puzzle, move around the grid to pick Across and Down clues and type in answers while a clock times you.
descriptions.dos:61008c02b4599d1e: A platformer in which treasure hunter Panama Joe searches a maze of Aztec catacombs for ancient treasure, avoiding bouncing and rolling skulls, spiders, chains and fire.
descriptions.dos:61053eff0351131d: A mountain climbing action simulation. Reach the peak by one of several trails of varying difficulty, with alternating joystick movements in the manner of the Epyx games, while managing the gear in your backpack.
descriptions.dos:6106eef5412aedb8: A card game of preference in which you join a private card club and choose two opponents, who range from fools to card-sharpers.
descriptions.dos:6107ae2ec1740f6b: A faithful take on the Pac-Man arcade classic in CGA graphics. Move through a maze collecting dots, avoid the ghosts and use power pills to turn the tables on them.
descriptions.dos:61080d4834343781: A shareware space flight and combat simulator played from the bridge of a starship. Accept missions from Space Force HQ and complete as many as you can; the game ends when you die or fail three missions.
descriptions.dos:61126a8faa451b13: A fan-made graphical adventure built on Sierra's AGI interpreter in the style of Police Quest 1 and King's Quest III. You play Hank, a geeky, lanky teenager.
descriptions.dos:61135738ec5a68d7: A track-and-field sports game in which you enter athletes for a chosen country and train them before competing in a varied set of events.
descriptions.dos:61197bd0484e33b0: The Prince, turned into a beggar by a lookalike who has taken his place, fights to restore himself and his bride in this cinematic platform sequel to Prince of Persia.
descriptions.dos:6119fc5640e769ed: A top-down kart racing game with 8 circuits against 2 opponents, one of which can be human, in the style of Super Sprint. Races can be wet, dry or on ice, so pick your tires to suit.
descriptions.dos:611d167432ce6b71: Two dino-mites, Spike and Bloop, race to gather eggs before one-eyed cavemen called Trogs can eat them. One or two players.
descriptions.dos:611e58338a6de8ff: A shareware dungeon game and sequel to The Dungeons of Grimlor, mixing action with puzzles as you explore the dungeons beneath the town.
descriptions.dos:6122f5c4b5f23b73: A bridge card game played against the computer or other players by hot seat or local network. Includes the full rules, a tutorial, and commentary and tips from champion Omar Sharif.
descriptions.dos:61244d6919909842: Max Montezuma, a soldier descended from a legendary Aztec emperor, crashes on an uncharted island and explores ancient ruins, linking the mystery of the past to the present. Combines first-person shooting, platforming and puzzles.
descriptions.dos:61279b92c6146679: A scholar of 14th-century France is sent by the king and the pope to investigate the Abbey of Montglane. After a fire destroyed old manuscripts, you must recover ten treasures that went unaccounted for.
descriptions.dos:6139dee5067f865f: An unofficial commercial add-on for DOOM II that replaces all 32 original levels with a new set and a new plot, in which the demons are an alien race from the planet Hell. Gameplay is unchanged.
descriptions.dos:6139fdc720e8d0d9: A four-player RISK-style conquest game in which you cannot see your opponents' armies and they cannot see yours, making every battle unpredictable.
descriptions.dos:613d9acdaf2bd6eb: A minesweeper-style puzzle game. Reveal cells showing how many mines lie adjacent and mark the mines; clicking a mine reveals them all and ends the game.
descriptions.dos:613e9f6f96779313: Karnov, the fire-breathing Russian, seeks the Lost Treasure of Babylon. He runs, swims, jumps, climbs and flies through nine levels.
descriptions.dos:6141bfafb5b048c9: A space strategy game set in the 27th century. After the interstellar warp drive is developed, two research ships are sent to find colony planets, but only Explorer-2 returns to Earth.
descriptions.dos:614a019507aa6fcb: Race off-road trucks around compact dirt circuits full of jumps and tight turns. Earn prize money, upgrade your truck and compete against other drivers.
descriptions.dos:615e9a6f8907822c: A meandering text adventure in choose-your-own-adventure style, in which you guide a 16-year-old Vietnam-era draft dodger-in-training through the confusing times, with no clear long-term goals.
descriptions.dos:615f04fbe314f7aa: Your pet dog Rover has been dog-napped by evil robots. Explore 30 levels of puzzles and destroy deadly robots to rescue him.
descriptions.dos:616ab1ab95c1f20b: A BBS door game in which, as a caller dialing in remotely, you see how much you can bug the SysOp, the system operator, before he wakes up.
descriptions.dos:616cac974b5026fa: An educational program full of scientific facts about the planets, asteroids and satellites of the Solar System. You can calculate things like a planet's position on a given date, and there is a small quiz and a puzzle.
descriptions.dos:6178f586696d44fb: A strategy game set in the Dragon Isles, a once-peaceful archipelago devastated by a vast invading fleet. You lead the scattered survivors in rebuilding and fighting back.
descriptions.dos:617a752596f766aa: A tile puzzle in three variations of 120 timed stages each. Rebuild set arrangements or clear pieces by changing their colors and values; passwords let you resume every fifth level.
descriptions.dos:6182a9feda402af2: A Space Invaders-style shooter. Control a laser cannon at the bottom of the screen and destroy wave after wave of brightly colored demons that bounce around and attack with bombs and lasers.
descriptions.dos:618d00a436341d2d: A compilation of the V for Victory wargame series, including Utah Beach, Velikiye Luki, Market-Garden and Gold-Juno-Sword. You command forces as a military strategist in World War II.
descriptions.dos:6190a6ee37727615: An interactive fiction engine for playing or writing your own interactive stories.
descriptions.dos:61918f32ff3f6df4: A platformer in the vein of Donkey Kong Country and Chinese bootleg games, starring a basketball-playing monkey who crosses pre-rendered levels fighting dog-like creatures.
descriptions.dos:619b40ba3d461e0e: A 2D golf game from the makers of Sensible Soccer. It is an action take on the sport rather than an accurate simulation, built on the idea of no fuss, just fun.
descriptions.dos:61a6c927b78821ca: The FMV version of The Lord of the Rings for the REEL Magic MPEG card, a role-playing game set in Middle-earth where the dark lord Sauron forged the One Ring to control the races.
descriptions.dos:61a7979285a79107: An Arthurian adventure in search of the Grail. A mouse-driven interface lets you investigate locations and complete smaller quests along the way.
descriptions.dos:61bdcad95c6bd518: A strategy game in which you play a DOD operative using the Ballistic Missile Defense System, with ground, land-launched and space-based components, to destroy incoming ballistic missiles and protect the United States.
descriptions.dos:61c801882b4be169: Set in 1963, you start with a little money to buy your first hot rod, tune it for performance and race rivals at the diner for money and pink slips.
descriptions.dos:61d12aea4015625e: A four-player ecology simulation in which players bid with ecopoints for animals, then see how each fares in different biomes and whether its value rises or falls.
descriptions.dos:61d8e9683718d8fc: A curling simulator played with a swing meter, similar to golf games, in which you deliver stones toward the target as in real curling.
descriptions.dos:61dc191ae46e0977: The Bungeling Empire has stolen a cache of gold and you must infiltrate its treasury and take it back, crossing 150 screens of platforms, ladders and ropes while avoiding robotic guards.
descriptions.dos:61f13eee52f60aca: A shoot 'em up with scrolling in all directions. The zoomed-in view makes it hard to shoot enemies before they appear.
descriptions.dos:620a5c5eb8cb95e1: An open-world 8-bit-style action game inspired by Grand Theft Auto, combining driving, fighting and shooting. It began as a homebrew NES demake of Grand Theft Auto III and is set in the eighties.
descriptions.dos:620ecdffaa1a5c18: Microsoft's version of the classic snake game. Steer your snake to eat the numbers that appear on screen; it grows longer with each one and dies if it hits a wall or its own tail.
descriptions.dos:621bc20af4984d18: You are John Parker, a Rastafarian soldier defending your ganja field against landing American soldiers. Standing on your Volkswagen bus, fire at the soldiers and also destroy bombers, helicopters and UFOs.
descriptions.dos:621c5a412089a70b: A 1995 remake of the 1992 Dismal Passages. The story and location names are changed, and the gameplay is now an action-oriented adventure rather than a turn-based RPG.
descriptions.dos:621e530108d3eb90: You are Rockford, digging through monster-infested caves for diamonds. Collect enough in each level to open the portal to the next, and watch for falling boulders, which can squash enemies.
descriptions.dos:62207ada4985d176: The D-Day invasion recreated with Impressions' Micro Miniatures wargaming system. Direct units as overall commander, or play out individual battles yourself.
descriptions.dos:6221ba283b59ace4: The Gold release bundles the flight simulator U.S. Navy Fighters with its Marine Fighters add-on. Fly US naval aircraft over Ukraine in a war against Russia, in a campaign, single missions or missions you create.
descriptions.dos:6223af71dde3f64d: A rally game with 28 tracks taken from the real RAC Rally, driven in six real rally cars. The weather changes from rain to sun to snow, and surfaces vary from tarmac to mud.
descriptions.dos:622e46e99b217389: Control a four-colored disc with your mouse. Colored balls zoom around the playfield, and four wall-mounted hands of matching colors grab for them.
descriptions.dos:623412f07cc8bfa4: A shareware puzzle game in which you steer an energy field ship with the / and \ keys. Each key press leaves behind a mirror that deflects your craft if it strikes it.
descriptions.dos:623442282c5bf145: Hopy-ONE, a bio-droid created in a lab researching the deadly Fast Line Virus, must collect samples of the virus to help produce a vaccine, in this platformer.
descriptions.dos:623ecca46d648071: A shareware interactive fiction from 1987. A flat tire on a holiday drive leaves you lost, and the driveway you remember leads you to Castle Ralf.
descriptions.dos:624654d766778d75: An adventure RPG from the early 90s that was popular among shareware boards, in which you quest for the Eternal Grimoire.
descriptions.dos:6269a5b2463c82d5: A stock market simulation, Release 2, which adds margin and short sales. You start with a net worth of $10,000 on a market where three companies each from several industries have changing share prices.
descriptions.dos:62753de834e346d6: A simple action RPG in which a young warrior (a barbarian, knight or valkyrie) helps a weakened kingdom and recovers Artifacts that once made it strong. You move in real time through forests and other terrain.
descriptions.dos:62837a7b33c0d9dc: An educational game for pre-schoolers with Disney characters, teaching counting from 1 to 9. Mickey plans a surprise party for a randomly chosen Disney character.
descriptions.dos:6288094332d5e9e0: As an MI7 agent you must unmask a mole. The plans for the new Sonic Macrothrodule are believed leaked, and you have one hour to solve the puzzle.
descriptions.dos:628a6cde7b0effe8: A head-to-head air combat flight sim set in modern times with a strong arcade feel. You fly a generic hypothetical modern fighter on sorties; a follow-up to ACE.
descriptions.dos:628e44793502de02: A kart racing game similar to Super Mario Kart. Up to four players race in split-screen, or you can face seven computer opponents in three leagues, using eight different vehicles.
descriptions.dos:6295be0f1a090f35: A flight combat game set in a fantasy world with one big continent, so there has never been naval warfare and all fighting is in the air. With the king dead and no heir, four factions go to war.
descriptions.dos:629d20cfeefa95ca: A 3D tank simulation. Control up to 16 tanks, command the company, platoon or individual tank parts, play head to head, and fight 15 missions across three theatres of war, with a thermal-imaging night mode.
descriptions.dos:62a3dfc662223de2: A comical, unrealistic top-down football game with a small square pitch and huge players. Master overhead kicks, trapping the ball and quick one-twos.
descriptions.dos:62b3a57c4bc7f478: An improved version of 4D Tennis with better player animation and digitized photos of tennis stadiums around the world where the matches are played.
descriptions.dos:62be2891f121a8eb: A platformer starring a caveman who clubs ghosts and other creatures on his way to the end of each level, picking up throwable weapons along the way.
descriptions.dos:62c89d2f60273b6b: A Spanish isometric puzzle game in which you guide a disembodied glove through a checkerboard labyrinth, pushing chess pieces out of the way, each moving by its own chess pattern, to reach the exit.
descriptions.dos:62db1ab7c7f57ef4: A Zork-like text adventure with crude graphics. Stay alive and find the treasures while your strength drains every turn, so finding ways to restore it is essential.
descriptions.dos:62e760cd5a120664: Epyx's basketball played the way kids play it, on four courts: the schoolyard, the alleyway, the parking lot and the backyard, each with its own hazards.
descriptions.dos:62f50cee792660f7: The first of SSI's gold box AD&D games. Create a party, help the city of Phlan defeat the evils that threaten it, then search for the legendary Pool of Radiance in first-person dungeons and overhead turn-based combat.
descriptions.dos:62f590c83b7dbc3a: As a new employee of TetraCorp, you colonize asteroids and turn them into successful mining colonies, then sell your ore to the Federal Ore Trading Commission while spreading into the unknown.
descriptions.dos:62f7218942a5dcac: A freeware puzzle game whose board is three overlapping circles made of squares, named for the triskelion, a motif of three symbols around a common center.
descriptions.dos:62f73f432698b047: A series of mini-games based on the 1950s TV series. Ralph Kramden wants to hold the Raccoon Lodge's annual meeting at Miami Beach, and the Kramdens and Nortons must work to raise the money.
descriptions.dos:632e57b2af320d46: The shareware first episode of a trilogy, unrelated to the Jules Verne novel, mixing platform action with puzzles.
descriptions.dos:633f9df569df27c7: A rugby game with the official Super League license. Pick one of its teams and play a match, passing, running or kicking for points under unchanged rugby rules.
descriptions.dos:634448fab02fe90e: All the fairy godmothers are captured except you. Free them by collecting every token on a screen, grabbing the key and reaching the exit, using a magic wand to transform objects against the monsters.
descriptions.dos:634787c69932dc49: A children's matching game in which you use the mouse to match words to pictures; clearing the board triggers an animation.
descriptions.dos:6347a57649236d55: A horror adventure, whose title means Howls, in which you play Kane, a small-time thief, or his girlfriend Lorry, searching for a stash of gold after your car breaks down and you must repair it to leave.
descriptions.dos:634dd8fc40d1085a: On the coast of darkest Africa, you gather the right supplies for a dangerous safari from the village's many items, explore Africa, and then return to civilization.
descriptions.dos:634f9c00a84f1714: A text-based Othello game from Finland, played against a simple computer opponent.
descriptions.dos:6351f8aefe74dab4: A freeware clone of Ultimate's Atic Atac with improved graphics, sounds and new level design. Pick one of three characters trapped in a haunted castle, each with its own weapons and routes through the maze.
descriptions.dos:63624da393a35e36: A Risk-style war game against the computer, another person or over the internet, with humans, dragons, wizards and other creatures. Pick a map or have one generated at random.
descriptions.dos:6365e3730f01fc33: A graphical adventure with a real-time element in which you wake in a padded cell, one of thousands of rooms in a labyrinthine asylum, at 9:30 PM and must find a way out.
descriptions.dos:636709bd5eb6a64c: Guide your frog to safety in three different locations, starting underwater and reaching the surface, then hopping across logs, birds and even a whale to the life preserver behind a tugboat.
descriptions.dos:636e67f48651bb00: A Pac-Man clone in which a smiling face collects all the dots on a one-screen level while escaping ghosts shaped like playing-card symbols. Green power dots let you eat them for a while.
descriptions.dos:6371730aca4f940b: An action game based on the British comic magazine Viz, with its crude humor. Play Johnny Fartpants, Buster Gonad or Biffa Bacon and run through scrolling environments.
descriptions.dos:6375c0d014695f20: A CD of 1500 levels for Duke Nukem 3D, including one hundred multiplayer levels and a level loader to keep track of where you are.
descriptions.dos:6377126594e77dc7: A helicopter simulation in which you fly the experimental UH-1XA in several modes: a flight school that guides you through takeoff, flight and landing, and a reality mode with missions to fly.
descriptions.dos:63839660a47d043b: The shareware prequel to Heroes: The Sanguine Seven. Control a superhero team to defeat the henchmen of the villainous Wild Hare, who is rampaging the city; three of the seven heroes are available.
descriptions.dos:63860e403d5903e2: A French Qix clone in which you claim 70 percent of the screen to advance while avoiding or trapping the enemies, which come in three types: Rollers, Kicks and Suiveurs.
descriptions.dos:6397d6a0640ce898: An adventure set in the summer of 1937. Industrialist Bronson Bernard invites guests to the maiden launch of his flying boat Condor, and the party hides something darker.
descriptions.dos:639f2d2c1f6f761e: Take the role of Christopher Columbus and later Spanish conquistadors, exploring the New World or a randomly generated map. Establish forts and missions and bring gold back to Spain to earn promotions from the Queen.
descriptions.dos:63a657d14ce30de0: A shoot 'em up of Spanish origin with an unusual craft, a World War I flying bookcase in place of a space fighter.
descriptions.dos:63ba0cbedaa95f90: A fast stunt racing game: choose from eight cars and race on over sixteen tracks with loops and corkscrews. Drivers are organized in teams of two cars each.
descriptions.dos:63c2b980f8eedd60: A top-down stock car race from coast to coast across the southern US, from Florida to California via freeways, bridges, side routes and country roads, and you can even cut through houses and water.
descriptions.dos:63ca664f11dbc6f9: Compete with up to three other traders on the interplanetary market, raising and lowering prices for goods. Produce goods like perfume by planting flower fields and buy raw materials such as water.
descriptions.dos:63de31946b640c51: A color-based Tetris variant. The screen is split into two squares, and on the left you control a platform to catch the blocks falling from above.
descriptions.dos:63e941fd31a37fd6: It's 1926, and Edward Carnby, nicknamed the Supernatural Private Eye, investigates the disappearance of a film crew at Slaughter Gulch, a ghost town in the Mojave Desert.
descriptions.dos:63f13d0801d92162: Build a racing career with Mario Andretti. Start with $20,000, buy a Sprint Car, win a season to earn money and progress through six racing series.
descriptions.dos:640625f82bb03215: A turn-based ASCII spacecraft simulator set in a Star Trek-like universe. As a young Star Fleet lieutenant you command a light scout, and as you rise in rank, you face the Kazzim empire.
descriptions.dos:6411c8ad05f6044b: A point-and-click adventure developed by Flair Software and released for PC DOS in Europe in 1996.
descriptions.dos:641a42ef050d5848: A story painting adventure in which you play Peter Pan. You stole Captain Hook's treasure map, and he took the children from your village, so you trade the map to rescue your friends.
descriptions.dos:641d87dead30cacf: An RPG in the land of Darkmoore, ruled by the evil Lexnor. Choose from five classes and travel Darkmoore conquering dungeons to build your fame; the screen is split into two parts.
descriptions.dos:641f13f06e3887ba: A sailing simulation with eight courses. Race against computer opponents, steering the boat and setting sail trim and centerboard position, with wireframe 3D boats and a switchable overhead map.
descriptions.dos:64244a8ec57db2dc: A rogue-like RPG with randomly generated dungeons, in which you descend to fight monsters and find treasure. The DOS version has tile-based graphics.
descriptions.dos:643159e594d40e4c: A pipe-style puzzle game by William Soleau with modest CGA graphics.
descriptions.dos:6436ebdf3ffdbd7f: A Korean platform shooter similar to early Duke Nukem. A boy miraculously turned into a super-cop traverses hostile areas to defeat monsters and evil mechanical creatures in colorful scenery.
descriptions.dos:643b21851733dfca: A well-written interactive fiction set in the Twilight universe by Paragon Software. Your girlfriend is kidnapped, and you must deal with the kidnappers, rescue her and save the world.
descriptions.dos:643dbcfcd055d215: An arcade go-kart racing game with 16 tracks, the predecessor of Manic Karts. Just drive and steer, picking up power-ups and upgrades such as Turbo, Oil and Grip.
descriptions.dos:643e2e09671e2149: A Psygnosis arcade game in which you control an arrow that sets a direction and fire balls from it, aiming at the right angles to score a goal against your opponent.
descriptions.dos:6445f67ae84cfa11: The classic text adventure. Starting near a white house in a forest, you enter the Great Underground Empire to collect the Nineteen Treasures of Zork.
descriptions.dos:644e82d2714c5394: A turn-based strategy game about two warring kingdoms with no computer opponent, so you need a friend or play yourself. After setting up your area, players take turns moving tanks, rotating turrets and firing.
descriptions.dos:645c25c6bc7a4a1d: AGD Interactive's remake of the second King's Quest chapter. King Graham travels to the land of Kolyma to find his bride and must find three mystical stones to open the way to her.
descriptions.dos:6478bb8e168c7cda: A text-only financial game like Lemonade Stand, but with drug sales, robberies and shootouts with the police. You start with $500 in one of eight US cities.
descriptions.dos:64a9697a4777eae0: A stick figure fighting game with 256 fighters, one for each color, for two players.
descriptions.dos:64adbaf397a6d060: A parser-based graphic adventure in the style of early Polarware and Scott Adams titles, one of six such games from Mark Data Products that first appeared on the Tandy CoCo.
descriptions.dos:64bdfef9c5895ef0: An isometric action adventure set in medieval Japan. The last survivor of a slaughtered ninja clan walks, jumps and fights his way to take revenge on the evil shogun responsible.
descriptions.dos:64c09c3c1a176d4c: A shareware version of Hanafuda, the Japanese Flower Card game also known as Koi-koi, played alone against the computer. Collect families of cards by matching their pictures.
descriptions.dos:64c5f532246de91f: An RPG adventure in which the Evil Wizard Marbodaei has scattered stolen jewels across the Twelve Worlds of Tamrak. Travel from the home world to the other worlds to find each hidden jewel.
descriptions.dos:64cc1b5ade8514f1: A shareware RPG with intricate tactical combat and extensive world exploration. Control a team of eight characters on a quest to find and destroy the demons of Omalin, with 100 spells and 300 monsters.
descriptions.dos:64d473699a0cbb7b: The first game of the Super Kroz trilogy: more puzzles, more monsters to kill or avoid, and more levels.
descriptions.dos:64e786472d4a98d9: An educational game for children under five in the Fun School series. Spend the day with Teddy in six activities, each with varying skill levels.
descriptions.dos:64e8713c7e7eddfb: A freeware episode of the Game of Robot series, made to introduce new players. Explore screens, solve puzzles and find all the keys scattered across 12 levels.
descriptions.dos:64e8956190b5b9b9: The second volume of the series lets you reenact five crucial battles of the American Civil War: Gaines Mill, Stones River, Gettysburg, Chickamauga and Chattanooga, in a turn-based, hex-based wargame.
descriptions.dos:651bb72d1fa5d276: A LORD-style BBS door RPG set in a near-future town where a mysterious force is possessing residents and driving them to violence with brutal hand weapons.
descriptions.dos:6523287779984ac9: A top-down shooter similar to Commando and Ikari Warriors. Terrorists have seized the control complex of a nuclear missile site, and you must infiltrate it and eliminate their leader before they launch.
descriptions.dos:6523f935102ebad3: An interactive fiction game about a young elf's adventures in a kingdom of ogres.
descriptions.dos:652ee548647a2442: A baseball game for one or two players, played in parks, vacant lots and backyards with makeshift bases. Beyond normal rules, you cope with mud puddles, tree stumps and other hazards, in split-screen view.
descriptions.dos:653dcd36a53e99d2: An educational platform game for practicing spelling. Control Boppie, a bouncing ball, and collect letters in the correct order to form words, one letter at a time.
descriptions.dos:65431e87ed2431c3: An action puzzler similar to Lode Runner and Lemmings. Help prehistoric humans evolve by guiding a group of characters to discover tools, the wheel, weapons and fire.
descriptions.dos:654719527cd39cf4: A classic RPG about survivors after an apocalyptic event. Your characters must gather vehicle components to build a car and reach a haven, with character generation and skill modification.
descriptions.dos:65487a74f09ec167: A simple text-mode game in which you play a miner hunting for gold. A spot may hold a nugget or sand, stone, a cave, or an underground river that floods the mines beneath it.
descriptions.dos:6548c62c0b314cae: A 3D first-person shooter and flight game in which you fly through mines. The Post-Terran Minerals Corporation's mining robots have been hacked and have taken the human workers hostage.
descriptions.dos:654b9169d1a41f7f: A fighting game in which you choose one of 10 characters and pilot one of 10 huge robots in the year 2097, when one company called W.A.R. controls humanity.
descriptions.dos:6554315222d75ad5: The Jurassic Levels, an add-on with 80 more levels for the Lemmings-style puzzler The Humans (Evolution: Dino Dudes), with the objects collected in the first game available from the start.
descriptions.dos:655ad61e4882d9ad: A shooter in which you play a death star that automatically fires anti-particles up, down, left and right. Move it so the particles hit and destroy other stars for points.
descriptions.dos:6565635a14d766a3: An Italian first-person shooter in the style of Doom, available as a playable demo version 0.99 from 1998.
descriptions.dos:656a782ab7f9a511: A space combat game like Wing Commander in which you pilot a ship as the lone hope of humanity against two alien races. Multiplayer modes like Race and Tag are available over IPX networks.
descriptions.dos:656de3fd337b60a7: King Graham collapses and can be saved only by retrieving a magical item, so his daughter Rosella journeys to fetch it in this entry of the King's Quest adventure series.
descriptions.dos:656e3073061880d0: Drive your tank, shoot the bad guys and avoid getting shot.
descriptions.dos:656f086b15c45d76: A quiz game based on a CBS game show, with 1,000 questions. Play a friend or a computer opponent, earning money across two matches to rob the Vault.
descriptions.dos:6576d7e3410398e2: An arcade racing game set in the hardest racing series in the known galaxy, where you race against the best pilots of the universe in a fight of life and death.
descriptions.dos:6576fdb119ac95ca: A Finnish taxi simulation in which Pentti-Antero Sillankoykas, a lifelong disabled man cured by prophetic dreams, starts a taxi service for disabled people.
descriptions.dos:657775f2aa4e3223: A Dinamic soccer game carried out by ex-Real Madrid player Michel. It has two loads: Super Skills, test events that introduce you to the controls, and the main game.
descriptions.dos:659109523ff65e0f: A naval strategy game, the spiritual successor to The Lost Admiral, with VGA graphics, more resources, research to unlock more powerful ships and an extra-powerful flagship with cruise missiles.
descriptions.dos:6598ca42b662974b: A strategic puzzle action game in which you clear the playfield of colored tiles before time runs out. Each playfield depicts a period of human history, such as Prehistory, Crusades, Prohibition or the Berlin Wall.
descriptions.dos:659f6a70eb673e70: An adventure about a little monkey who finds life in a zoo too boring and dreams of a far-off monkey island full of fun and bananas. He needs your help to escape.
descriptions.dos:65a47f7503247ae3: Shredder will take over New York City in 48 hours. The Ninja Turtles, each with a different weapon, fight crime in a side-scroller that leads to him.
descriptions.dos:65a76f7357d771db: A shooter released under the name Police Academy II on other platforms, in which you play a lawman training as a policeman.
descriptions.dos:65a875d5bdb4271b: Electronic Arts' chess game, based on a competition-winning chess engine with a database of 500 games, an SVGA isometric chessboard and the license of world champion Garry Kasparov.
descriptions.dos:65a9f78ddbb42d38: A variant of American checkers for one or two players, where the pieces are individuals with arms and armor bought at the outset, and RPG-style traits decide the outcome of moves.
descriptions.dos:65aba50f7de47018: A pool simulation in which you can pick various jungle monkeys as your player.
descriptions.dos:65d26450ccf072c3: A mix of space shooter, jump-and-run and beat 'em up starring Hulk Hogan as the Hulkster in a suburban setting.
descriptions.dos:65d48b3abb4691f8: A trilogy of Level 9 text adventures, Snowball, Return to Eden and Worm in Paradise, playable separately; for the maximum score, complete them in order.
descriptions.dos:65e267b4e1ff4043: A keyboard-controlled edutainment title for teaching math through simple sums. The shareware version practices addition and subtraction.
descriptions.dos:65e432d7fb75de6f: In the 22nd century, you are a gem prospector in the asteroid belt harvesting precious stones, while Commie Claim Jumpers, a group of space pirates, contest your mining rights.
descriptions.dos:65e51830e5004085: A scrolling shooter based on The Neverending Story, following Bastian's flight on Falcor.
descriptions.dos:65ed5cfce250ea91: A Paperboy-style game in which Pat drives his van to deliver telephone directories for Delivery Man Dan, who broke his leg, avoiding obstacles and fuel running out over five days.
descriptions.dos:65fdc9063bd88f88: The third volume of the series lets you reenact six battles of the American Civil War: Wilderness, Spotsylvania, Cold Harbor, Atlanta, Franklin and Nashville, in a turn-based, hex-based wargame.
descriptions.dos:6600de1889b88e02: A maze game in which theologian Vince M. Louis enters the Labyrinth of Zeux in search of the magical Silver Staff, collecting keys and treasures along the way.
descriptions.dos:6600e5da117aa963: A freeware puzzle game in which barrels roll out of a factory toward a destination on an incomplete track. Arrange the available pieces of track to route them there.
descriptions.dos:6611dc3825d1b3c7: A shareware code-breaking game. The computer picks a secret five-letter word and you have twenty attempts to deduce it from feedback on which letters your guesses contain.
descriptions.dos:6614ffd0b188cd7e: An interactive movie set in December 2042, as the world recovers from World War III and radioactivity has turned many humans into mutants.
descriptions.dos:661ac56ba0f55a27: A CD-ROM re-release of Lone Wolf: The Mirror of Death, renamed Tower of Fear after the Lone Wolf license was lost.
descriptions.dos:66388da0a153d127: An implementation of the Monopoly board game for up to eight players, with the computer as an opponent in single-player, a short game mode, a super short game mode and a time limit.
descriptions.dos:66623b82c4cab65d: A character-graphics arcade game in which an ASCII smiley face erases solid blocks and trails left by streaking meteors while avoiding getting splattered by them.
descriptions.dos:66737beae623adeb: A text adventure made with the Computer Novel Construction Set. You are Bradford Scotts, a famous musician who comes to a town seeking refuge from his fans and wants to find peace and quiet by buying a house.
descriptions.dos:668054e5f79ed73d: A version of LockerGnome Quest, Brian Provinciano's original SCI Studio demo game, with the sciAudio application added for digital speech.
descriptions.dos:668b84fa66c4fcc3: A game of four distinct sub-games based on the Eddie Murphy film. Axel Foley first visits a warehouse to shoot out bad guys in a sequence influenced by Green Beret, then goes on to other challenges.
descriptions.dos:669738ae93521fcb: A shareware package of eight educational mini-games for children that gives audio feedback and encouragement. It is a companion to 123-Talk.
descriptions.dos:66984f0387c2bf2a: An early 3D RPG set in the AD&D Ravenloft setting and sequel to Strahd's Possession, an advance over the step-by-step adventuring of games like Bard's Tale.
descriptions.dos:669f0012f154d77c: A five-card draw poker game against photographed opponents. Manage your bets to win successive rounds, with optional data disks adding more opponents to the original two.
descriptions.dos:66a439169813a8da: An enhanced remake of Paraplane in which you learn and practice paragliding: taking off, landing and riding air currents, with several skill stages from practicing to free flying.
descriptions.dos:66a60c5fa98bf69b: A PC implementation of the Rubik's Cube puzzle.
descriptions.dos:66b1577c1a41dc67: A Korean action platformer about a man arrested for crossing on a red light who must escape from prison. It has platforming reminiscent of Prince of Persia and fighting modes.
descriptions.dos:66d4125e1459ff79: A Korean fighting game for one or two players, with a short intro story and detailed but demanding graphics.
descriptions.dos:66d460296e57227c: You play Rick Dangerous, an Indiana Jones type searching for the lost Goolu tribe in the Amazon. After his plane crashes among crazed natives, he must escape and later face the traps of an Egyptian pyramid.
descriptions.dos:66db32488e0fb70d: A Test Drive entry about racing on rough surfaces rather than tarmac. Choose from four monster trucks, a Hummer, Land Rover Defender 90, Jeep Wrangler or Chevrolet K-1500 Z71, each with its own handling.
descriptions.dos:66e82ed26eb87b57: An early math program from the IBM Personal Computer Education Series, devoted entirely to mathematics despite its abstract title.
descriptions.dos:67136c745f24435a: An action game in which you steer an urthwurm, a worm that follows existing tunnels and stops dead when it hits an obstacle head-on.
descriptions.dos:671f0ae2ffcdf64b: A 3D arcade racing game with two vehicle types, F-1 cars and Stock Cars, each with different handling. Compete in a championship that covers circuits of increasing difficulty.
descriptions.dos:6724a86a346890c1: A Tetris-style falling-block puzzle game made with the AGI engine.
descriptions.dos:67264a7a52e0c222: You play Abraham Lincoln or Jefferson Davis during the American Civil War, making the strategic, political and economic decisions: leading the government, mobilizing armies and picking generals.
descriptions.dos:6727040ec6efc9c1: An adventure RPG from Magnetic Scrolls and MicroProse. It is 1993, and your ancestors the Winthrops dealt with black magic and perhaps pacts with demons.
descriptions.dos:67277b41b44eaf38: A collection of 75 levels, including 15 multiplayer maps, selected from a contest for Redneck Rampage.
descriptions.dos:673d889075129ae8: Pilot the F-16 on dogfights, bombing raids and reconnaissance. Plan your route by setting waypoints on the tactical map before takeoff and optionally choose your armament.
descriptions.dos:6743d3ef2761bd2c: The sequel to Zool. Play the Ninja of the Nth Dimension, or his girlfriend Zooz, through 15 platform levels against the villains Mental Block and Krool, collecting treats along the way.
descriptions.dos:6746b65399c27ecf: A chess game with a cyber, Tron-like theme. The board has pieces resting on intersections instead of squares, but play is identical to chess.
descriptions.dos:6750b97ad8146a27: A historical simulation of Magellan's voyage to circumnavigate the world. Deal with rough seas, unreliable maps, rebellious crews and unfriendly natives, with persons and situations based on real history.
descriptions.dos:67556d02f0b1bc69: A shooter in the vein of Missile Command. Control a single American SDI satellite and protect the USA from waves of Soviet attacks by zapping incoming missiles before the warheads strike.
