descriptions.dos:676af99d7bab5c0c: A puzzle game in which you arrange colored balls, green, purple, blue or yellow, into quartets at several locations on the board. The locations are balls you can spin to send others through connecting paths.
descriptions.dos:676b4a42a8a7b664: A football simulation from the head coach of the Chicago Bears. Modify plays or design your own for 28 pro teams, with four passing methods and instant replay from 4 angles.
descriptions.dos:677ee3dfb68dc976: A tile-matching game in which you remove matched tiles in pairs, and a tile can be removed only if it is open on its left or right side. Play in solitary or tournament mode.
descriptions.dos:67886dbfd116a9de: Slater the Petrosaur and his friend Charlie visit various locations and take on tasks to enjoy a camping trip in the great outdoors, in an educational game.
descriptions.dos:678a3e6ade78d6dc: A top-down shooter in which you save the world by going from arena to arena shooting at the other guy.
descriptions.dos:678b30600f44a786: You wake from reconstructive surgery with the face of Angel Devoid, the master criminal you were hunting, and now you are the hunted.
descriptions.dos:678ef6c2447855c8: A 3D Rubik's Cube controlled by mouse or keyboard. Rotate the cube around the axes and turn its faces with the number keys to restore each face to a solid color.
descriptions.dos:67a6359c623ef1cf: A port of the Colossal Cave Adventure text game, based on Bob Supnik's DECUS implementation of Don Woods' 350-point version. Explore a cave and solve puzzles to find treasure.
descriptions.dos:67b5c02c2b4b8105: An eight-player game of conquest. Assemble vast armies, conquer and loot cities, undertake quests, make and break alliances and wield magical artifacts on different worlds.
descriptions.dos:67b6ac1f19c51967: A simple target-shooting game with a swiveling ground gun pointed in five angles at birds streaking across the sky in ASCII.
descriptions.dos:67c7be2977980315: A proof-of-concept side-scrolling platformer. A little man moves with the arrow keys and hops to dodge slowly falling bombs and collect the level's 39 gold coins.
descriptions.dos:67c98905c1ee249d: A tank-based action game. As a new tank pilot for the Nataka Corporation's Imperial Armored Cavalry, you are drawn into a full-scale war when a Nataka installation is attacked by forces from Network 53.
descriptions.dos:67cf7670efbf20bc: A collection of a dozen low-bandwidth mini-games for two players, some turn-based and some simultaneous, played by direct computer connection through a modem, with ANSI textmode graphics.
descriptions.dos:67d1207c61107bc5: A flight simulator and follow-up to EA's earlier flight trainer. It offers many planes and flight modes such as formations, races and obstacle courses, plus a comprehensive flight training option.
descriptions.dos:67d182653f94f8a2: A word puzzle in which you turn one word into another by changing one letter at a time, with every step a valid English word. Rounds get harder, and an optional Expert Mode adds more difficulty.
descriptions.dos:67de87f5e11ef634: A strategy game set in medieval England, much like Defender of the Crown. Start as a young knight with a small fiefdom, develop your economy, raise an army and expand your territory.
descriptions.dos:67e694ebc5262480: The first game in the Redcat series. Redcat sets out to retrieve stolen treasure from the mice across 10 levels, killing different kinds of mice with his sword and bombs.
descriptions.dos:67fcbe43162985ae: The sequel to Universal Military Simulator, giving total control over nearly every aspect of a battle. Scenarios include the Normandy invasion of 1944 and the battles of Alexander the Great.
descriptions.dos:682e83a7c3d7e71f: An educational game set in a child's bedroom, the first of a trilogy with The Treehouse and The Backyard. Almost everything on screen can be clicked, rewarding the child with games, activities or an animation.
descriptions.dos:683de842e3f4658d: A political strategy simulator inspired by a prediction of events in the Middle East. In 1997 the Israeli prime minister dies and you are appointed the new prime minister, making and following political policies.
descriptions.dos:6848e76852e16062: A music composition tool: drag notes, sharps and other nomenclature onto a staff with a pointer, play your score, cut, copy and paste sections, and print it.
descriptions.dos:68502cb4de69de5e: A graphics war game of strategy and tactical troop deployment. You are the commanding general facing one of eight opposing generals.
descriptions.dos:6854abcaea654227: An isometric 3D arcade adventure released by Ocean, originally for the Sinclair Spectrum 128K, MS-DOS and Atari ST.
descriptions.dos:68567a85ef343d34: A standard backgammon game in the short variation where opponent stones can be taken. Play against the computer, with moves made by letter keys.
descriptions.dos:6857169124f5c4b7: A sci-fi air-combat simulation set in an alternate history where World War II never happened and aliens invade instead. You fly the Corsair nicknamed Corncob against the invaders.
descriptions.dos:68600eec56e519e9: A side-scrolling Scramble variant in which you fly your spaceship across six zones, starting with zone 5, avoiding or destroying missiles while avoiding walls and watching your fuel.
descriptions.dos:68618c494191ce1b: A Gauntlet-style game in which you travel through 99 mazes before meeting the final demon. It has a two-player cooperative mode and a built-in level editor with pull-down menus.
descriptions.dos:6861a88ec8d40ee7: A World War II flight simulator using a slightly modified RealSpace engine from Strike Commander. Fly US or Japanese planes in historic missions such as dogfights, bombing runs and missile attacks.
descriptions.dos:6864d325d65edcb7: Based on a children's board game, guide a metal ball through a maze without touching it, controlling it with two knobs. Koolah is an English spelling of the Finnish word kuula, a metal ball.
descriptions.dos:686a833e067d810c: The classic sliding block puzzle, written in BASIC. A 4x4 board holds tiles 1 to 15 and one empty space; slide them into numerical order.
descriptions.dos:68765eea4c196ad8: A casino game in which you choose your wager, pick five numbers and try to win money.
descriptions.dos:687f872c984ea315: A text-based golf game with tees of different lengths and pars. You pick a club for each swing from four woods, eight irons and a wedge.
descriptions.dos:6883ad798748f0a2: A robot catches multicolored figures falling from above and avoids the colorless ones, to energetic music. It can also be made to jump.
descriptions.dos:68886950dc4ea2cb: A shareware Pac-Man clone in which you run around a maze eating power-ups and avoiding green gremlins, unless they have eaten a big power-up and go monster hunting. A small twist comes when you lose a life.
descriptions.dos:689493e26dbb5971: Harald Hardtooth, a tooth with a face, arms, legs and a bowtie, shoots bacteria with a tube of toothpaste across levels made of platforms.
descriptions.dos:68a036efc724d326: Four number games for pre-school ages. In Munch you steer a Pac-Man-like figure to eat the correct answer, and in Tiny Bomb you type answers to math problems before the bomb goes off.
descriptions.dos:68cce7cd88533103: A two-player phrase-guessing game. A player keeps their turn as long as they guess correct letters; 500 phrases in ten categories.
descriptions.dos:68d22ae05e9b6d04: Guide Moses through 100 levels to reach the promised land. The action half plays like Boulder Dash, collecting question marks and Manna to open the exit, and a question half tests Bible knowledge.
descriptions.dos:68e34a73ccdb92bb: A single-player mouse-driven collection of solitaire card games, including Auld Lang Syne, Calculation, Canfield, Four Seasons, Golf, Klondike and Little Spider, with undo and scores for multiple players.
descriptions.dos:68e6e3f2cffa076c: A short text adventure in which you enter commands to find out what happens the day after a night out.
descriptions.dos:68e83f06dfd631a6: A poker game against the computer in which you win money by completing hands rather than by beating other hands.
descriptions.dos:68f71a53c30dad46: Run a railroad company and build your own railroad empire, with a mass transit system that helps your chosen city develop. There are a number of places to set up business.
descriptions.dos:68fa0d8e3988a213: A conversion of the coin-op arcade game. Dirk the Daring, a clumsy knight, sets out to rescue Princess Daphne from the dragon Singe. Only the first half of the game is included.
descriptions.dos:68fcc068b52d96f4: An add-on to Cadaver that needs the original disc. It continues the story with four more isometric levels of puzzles, plus new spells, potions and baddies, and redesigned maps.
descriptions.dos:69031f1e70498091: A CGA Jam entry set in space. Use your graviton engine to attract or repel asteroids and fuel cells, which you need to keep going.
descriptions.dos:69070cbe4ef932fd: An undersea adventure in search of hidden treasure in the fabled pirate cove of Silver Eye on the sea bottom, fighting through the inhabitants of the dark underworld.
descriptions.dos:690de03c8663dad5: A shareware clone of Eugene Jarvis's Defender with the same gameplay. Control a spaceship to stop aliens abducting people, playable by keyboard, mouse or joystick, with a high score table.
descriptions.dos:691b7dcaac17835a: A tactical wargame of the near future, set in 2020 or 2044 depending on whether you play the US or German version. Single-player, two-player or head-to-head by modem, with modern forces and heavy lasers.
descriptions.dos:6920336c31548399: Guide Mutt, the bad-luck Litil Divil, through the Labyrinth of Chaos to retrieve the Mystical Pizza of Plenty, across five levels with over 50 rooms of killer spiders and other hazards.
descriptions.dos:69335b791acbd064: A Sierra-style adventure for kids based on nursery rhymes like Humpty Dumpty. All the rhymes have gotten mixed up, and the child must find the missing pieces and give them back.
descriptions.dos:69450469aebc15a9: A Tetris-like game in which the pieces fly all over the place and you must attract disks of the same color together, completing sets of four or more.
descriptions.dos:6945705b0872d12c: A Boulder Dash-like game in which each tile has terrain worth points. Levels hold earth, boulders, teleporters, balloons and monsters; collect all the treasures and kill all the monsters, then exit.
descriptions.dos:695454fee73d9b64: A dragon flight simulator set in the AD&D world of Dragonlance, flying dragons through the War of the Lance. Complete 20 missions to rank up, gain magic items and hit points or get a better dragon.
descriptions.dos:6982775960e7a9f6: A simple text-graphics bowling game for one to four players, with a selectable difficulty. The ball oscillates at the end of the lane and you press space to throw it.
descriptions.dos:69b1fe84763ff9a3: The Block Man continues his quest to win Princess Pentagwin's hand by collecting all the jewels, solving puzzles with teleports, elevators, boats and blocks. It has strong Sound Blaster support.
descriptions.dos:69b5ad2bde75e0af: A Vietnam War flight simulation in which you pilot the Republic F-105 Thunderchief, known as the Thud, on strike missions over North Vietnam's target zones.
descriptions.dos:69b8f1a1112c7aed: An interactive fiction in which daredevil autoist Troy and singer Miss Melody Sweet, with help from mechanical genius Aloysius Pratt, thwart a madman's evil plan.
descriptions.dos:69cb627600314ea4: Two Might and Magic games in one, Clouds of Xeen and Darkside of Xeen, set in the land of Xeen, ruled by two villainous overlords. Solve quests and puzzles to unravel its secrets.
descriptions.dos:69cb9fec1fdfee27: A two-player DOS version of a Commodore 64 game from Compute!'s Gazette. The objective is to hit your opponent with a boomerang.
descriptions.dos:69d3b8b3b6c9eba8: A simulation that lets you open safes. First identify the safe's manufacturer, model and class and its lock, with three attempts per item.
descriptions.dos:69d9797e0b19aa13: An action adventure in the Dome, heavily influenced by the original Legend of Zelda: you begin by getting a sword from an old man in a cave. Unlike part 2, it is not a platformer.
descriptions.dos:69de0212c22169f5: A homebrew platformer from a Korean high school, influenced by Super Mario World with a distinctly Korean flavor.
descriptions.dos:69e5b3be75c20c80: A brawler in which Suhee searches the shadier districts of the city for her father, a dentist who has vanished, using her fighting and negotiating skills.
descriptions.dos:69e6db19a102f97b: A simple arcade shooter with a space-aliens theme. A circular red and green avatar shoots in its direction of movement down grid corridors as alien ships come one by one to hunt it.
descriptions.dos:69eaa12cb29ecc1e: A clean-looking backgammon game with several game types, traditional, acey deucey, gioul, plakoto and dutch, and several skill levels.
descriptions.dos:69f827f6a21b640e: A craps and casino gambling game with primitive ASCII graphics.
descriptions.dos:69fb8e2be5e28fe8: A space conquest game for up to six players around one computer. Moves are entered by keyboard and hidden from other players, and ships are not visible in flight, in 80x25 text mode.
descriptions.dos:69ff0aaad38fcbe0: A fantasy RPG from SSI. A long-foretold prophecy is about to be fulfilled as the Shadow Lords prepare to enter our world, and you must find a way to break the chain of events it foretells.
descriptions.dos:6a0651c5d7567cf5: A detailed spaceflight simulator from the makers of Microsoft Flight Simulator, taking you on a journey through the Milky Way and beyond.
descriptions.dos:6a0a66e51d340ef3: You crash your spaceship on an alien world and must collect diamonds across ten levels to power it up and get home. A very difficult platform puzzler where the slightest mistake sends you back to the start.
descriptions.dos:6a1455d682bc5f88: Drive a tank on a special mission to destroy a new type of torpedo, launched from a torpedo-house instead of from your submarine.
descriptions.dos:6a1ef63bcf3fe44d: A futuristic shooter that combines two styles of gameplay across multiple levels. A state-of-the-art space cruiser with an android pilot, the Star Breaker, is sent to purge the Rrampon invaders from the colony planets of New Chicago.
descriptions.dos:6a4f85acd1859c8f: A soccer management game, successor to the 8-bit Trener. Choose the Polish, English, German, Italian, Spanish or French league, a European league or League of Nations, or create your own league from 288 teams.
descriptions.dos:6a55cacc919b1eb3: A strategy game by Chris Crawford, designed as a study of artificial personality and a language of interaction, set on Kira, a moon.
descriptions.dos:6a6c067369beb435: An overhead-view action RPG in which an apprentice wizard with four minor spells aims to defeat 7 master wizards, returning six treasures to their owners and finding more powerful spells.
descriptions.dos:6a6e41c59bf44d99: A baseball-themed catching game: control a catcher running along the bottom of the screen to catch falling balls. Difficulty rises every five waves.
descriptions.dos:6a8de92789a68f41: A four-color ASCII Reversi-style board game against the computer, always playing the black pieces, with five levels from easiest to hardest.
descriptions.dos:6a94c85a3a0b0798: A god simulation played on bulletin boards as a BBS door, where many gods battle to decide who should rule the heavens.
descriptions.dos:6ab4d31fb62a9d35: An arcade game of racing the clock to pick up and drop off passengers, keeping your taxi moving by rotating road sections with the mouse.
descriptions.dos:6abb81667112e084: A golf game based on the 1993 Ryder Cup at the Belfry course. Icons show or hide information like the current hole and wind, with two control methods for each shot.
descriptions.dos:6ac82957ee345abe: An unofficial port of the vertical shoot 'em up Sky Jaguar released on MSX and ColecoVision.
descriptions.dos:6ac86087defcaf82: A turn-based strategy game on the planet Chromos, where the Drullian people fight the out-of-control AI Skynet-Titan. The screen is split in two, one half for each player.
descriptions.dos:6ad8b60b6b5471c1: A shoot 'em up in which you control a gun on a tower and shoot down airplanes and parachutists. It has four levels and weapons including a regular gun, homing missiles and a flame thrower.
descriptions.dos:6ae28a59d9cbdc4d: An Olympiad game of winter events: Downhill, Giant Slalom, Luge, 2-man Bobsled, Ski Jump, Cross Country, Biathlon and Speed Skating, using a basic 3D engine to simulate slopes.
descriptions.dos:6ae6591eca227e0b: A demo of a beat 'em up from a company specialized in arcade machines. Fight through single-screen levels, defeating all enemies on screen to advance, alone or with a second player.
descriptions.dos:6aed426dc6a08731: A simple dart game in which you set the height on the y-axis, then stop a moving x-axis to land on the board. You count your own points, with three darts per round.
descriptions.dos:6aeeb85b9cc47edf: A platformer in which each level is set in and around a building. Collect specific items and demolish a percentage of the building using several types of bombs.
descriptions.dos:6af0a0d47c69d5f9: In peaceful Khantun, the former leader Kaimen has turned his powers to evil, the Holy Ones are kidnapped and monks rule. You must vanquish Kaimen and restore the path of righteousness in this action RPG.
descriptions.dos:6af7787356c81b8b: You're stranded on a desert island and must escape with as many treasures as possible before the tsunami strikes, within a 500-move limit. A small, old two-word parser game.
descriptions.dos:6afca8ef213db40e: A poker game from Artworx's series, a second volume of card challenges in which you beat photographed opponents hand by hand.
descriptions.dos:6aff933ebd2027b8: A space trading and flying game that predates Elite, with more adventure elements.
descriptions.dos:6b05a6a9d832f79b: A small French fighting game in which two gnomes, one red and one blue, fight each other with a punch and a kick for each player.
descriptions.dos:6b117df22cf62cf1: A strategy game of the American Civil War from 1861 to 1865. Play the North or South and take over a number of the opposing side's cities before the war ends.
descriptions.dos:6b16ea66a5547f49: A strategy game in which you manage a city's police department. Decide how many cars to send to a call and how many to keep on patrol, and build new police stations.
descriptions.dos:6b17de3e0d9f2fb8: A Star Trek adventure in which evidence of an unknown civilization has been found. Avoid Klingon suspicion and carry diplomats to the planet Gothica to make a good first impression for the Federation.
descriptions.dos:6b28525c5e69d85f: A sci-fi adventure in which you try to save Earth from a collision with a mechanically controlled asteroid, involving space travel and exploring a deserted mining colony.
descriptions.dos:6b2bb0315552d3b4: A peg-solitaire board puzzle on a board of thirty-seven round cells, all but one filled with balls. Jump a ball over another into an empty cell, removing the one you jumped.
descriptions.dos:6b331da6a07d34ee: An ASCII recreation of the 1976 Midway coin-op Sea Wolf. As a submarine captain you have one minute to torpedo as many PT boats, submarines and oil tankers as you can.
descriptions.dos:6b34a1e360a95818: In this Discworld adventure, Rincewind is back, and Death is on an extended vacation, leaving those whose time is up faltering in limbo. He must bring Death back.
descriptions.dos:6b359ec8388bca54: A drill and practice program for addition and subtraction facts. Choose the operations, the specific facts and the number of seconds allowed to answer each.
descriptions.dos:6b3f65c77f732e60: A text adventure for vintage computers, set on August 27th, 1904, in which you play Emilia Vittorini and type commands to instruct your alter ego.
descriptions.dos:6b56ffa972105751: A storybook authoring program in which children create and publish their own illustrated books, building writing, reading and vocabulary skills. The series was used in over 20,000 US schools.
descriptions.dos:6b6851a2ce2ccf7d: Magic Boy becomes a master wizard by shooting enemies, putting them in a bag and throwing them away. He passes through four areas, Sand Land, Wet World, Plastic Place and Future Zone, collecting power-ups.
descriptions.dos:6b6c8ab3e4cb4d5d: A special edition of SkyRoads with three new Christmas worlds and a training course, though adding them means you can no longer play some of the original worlds.
descriptions.dos:6b6fe99dfe42e278: A logic adventure in which you are taken into Robotropolis, an underground city of robots, and must program your helpers Sparky, Checkers and Scanner to solve puzzles and escape.
descriptions.dos:6b71821e0ae8c9ba: A low-budget 3D fighting game from the small Japan-based developer 47-Tek, with modes for fighting the computer, another player or training against an inactive opponent.
descriptions.dos:6b79149051636f82: A Pac-Man platform adventure in which Pac-Man travels through time in an Indiana Jones-like romp. There is little to eat; the object is collecting points.
descriptions.dos:6b7f07dce7ee3e90: An interactive fiction allegory for thousands of years of cyclical human history embroiled in military warfare and conflict.
descriptions.dos:6b845561ec725ddb: A backgammon game for two human players or one human against three levels of AI, or you can watch two AI players. It follows the original rules and is played with a cursor.
descriptions.dos:6b960a7f3fb4175c: A fan-made port of the Sega Genesis classic using the original sprites. At 50 coins you automatically become Super Sonic.
descriptions.dos:6b979aadff30884b: The second Ford Simulator, an advertisement for Ford's 1990 product line in five sections, including a driving simulator with customizable controls, sound, difficulty and type of driving.
descriptions.dos:6ba0e1f944d24553: The Time Thieves, plunderers of time-changing technology, have stolen the cutting-edge image processing technology of the city of DSPea. Engineering Jones, Senior Time Warden, and his robot buddy CirQuet must set things right.
descriptions.dos:6ba4671dca674f3f: You are a Space Marshall investigating a distress call from the colony Delta 5-5. Your ship crash-lands on the planet, and you put on your Power Armor to explore the planet's surface.
descriptions.dos:6bb5ed9ac74a9efe: Roger Wilco relaxes in his favorite pub somewhere in time and space when soldiers carrying a parting message from his old nemesis Sludge Vohaul come to execute him, in this Space Quest adventure.
descriptions.dos:6bb7a72b83f5226a: The first EA Sports game with Virtual Stadium technology, giving a 3D feel and multiple camera angles. It has the NHL license with real teams and players, a full league and playoffs, and optional fighting and penalties.
descriptions.dos:6bc1dedea7e405f8: An oceanographic simulation in which you begin as an inexperienced oceanographer and build your reputation exploring other lost vessels, then plan a Titanic search with funding, a ship, personnel and equipment.
descriptions.dos:6bc659fe1c05efd1: A first-person shooter in which Nick Hunter must thwart the evil Thorne Devereaux's plan to coat US currency with time-delayed explosive by infiltrating his base and mowing down nameless guards.
descriptions.dos:6bc6f1caa943bd83: A freeware console-style RPG with hand-drawn 2D tile graphics, rendered battle backgrounds and an original score. You play Spear on a quest to discover your true identity.
descriptions.dos:6bc9a2cbc2593450: The sequel to Nicky Boom. Nicky must find out who has been removing ladders and blocking caves in his homeland, in multi-directional maze-like platform levels with some brainwork.
descriptions.dos:6bce12d6084afd36: A translation of the famous mainframe BASIC game, a turn-based, text-based strategy game in a randomly generated galaxy. From the captain's chair of the Enterprise, you must blast a number of Klingon warships.
descriptions.dos:6bd3026fb3900e63: An interactive fiction based on R.A. MacAvoy's fantasy novel. You play a young warlock, Damiano Delstrego, in a fantastical Italian Renaissance, and the angel Raphael gives you lute lessons.
descriptions.dos:6bddc03ba2020c01: Strategic Simulations' baseball game simulating a full major league season. View statistics for every team, and play with one or two players or manage teams while the computer plays.
descriptions.dos:6beb5cefaa216233: A solitaire card game in which cards are laid in a row and you pile them all on top of one another, moving a card or pile one or two spaces left onto a card that matches in suit or value.
descriptions.dos:6c00c6d476705506: In World War II, as the Allies' top agent B.J. Blazkowicz, you go after the Spear of Destiny, taken by the Nazis from Versailles to the impregnable Castle Wolfenstein, in this first-person shooter.
descriptions.dos:6c03717482a8d6c1: A shareware Pac-Man clone with few differences from the original apart from a two-player hot-seat mode.
descriptions.dos:6c0c0d5ce89492bc: A pirate board game with trivia. Choose a captain and play two other human or computer players, rolling dice to sail across the seaways and reach home port with as much booty as possible.
descriptions.dos:6c0f312f464f0277: A football game licensed to Joe Montana but not the NFL, so teams represent cities and the fictional rosters are fully editable. The action is viewed from the side.
descriptions.dos:6c1fdd84f818fb7e: A real-time strategy game set in a future where private security forces have become a corporate world police. You run the mercenary company Granite, researching components to build your own combat units, with a stock market.
descriptions.dos:6c24bf3b917fc065: A snake game in which your elongated hero roams an enclosed playfield for food without doubling back, hitting walls or biting its own tail. Pick up five pieces of food to clear each level.
descriptions.dos:6c2f68c639ebcfa5: A variation on the original Star Trek computer game, in ASCII, from Windmill Software. The Klingon and Romulan empires form a United Front against the Federation and you command the USS Enterprise to counter them.
descriptions.dos:6c3e230c475c30f7: The third game in the MicroLeague Baseball series, using the EGA graphics of MLB2 with many more players, player ratings, stadium factors and enhancements.
descriptions.dos:6c3f6cbc386a23a3: Finish building a high-rise while avoiding falling screws, vandals and the building inspectors.
descriptions.dos:6c422f14f176da20: A shooter in which you are the worst fighter of the Yanchooz, who are trying to destroy and enslave other races. After you botched your last 18 missions, your leader Xyfud Plasfoc wants you dead.
descriptions.dos:6c46d65b92372b54: A little-known arcade flight game set in the American West around World War I. You are an air stuntman in a biplane who later competes against other pilots in survival battles.
descriptions.dos:6c7152275abd9d79: A grand-strategic simulation of World War II in Europe in which you control land, sea and air action and manage limited production and research. Six historical scenarios run from Autumn 1939.
descriptions.dos:6c71ed1c16c017d0: A football management game similar to an early Championship Manager. Play any team in the English Premier League, with commentary and highlights shown by a graphical engine.
descriptions.dos:6c8233121214abdf: A four-player trivia game about The Beatles.
descriptions.dos:6ca1c7b94494225b: A Ghosts 'n Goblins clone with nice graphics, decent gameplay and good level design.
descriptions.dos:6ca219c16750ba52: A side-scrolling space shooter controlled with the mouse. Your sprite is fairly large, which makes it hard to avoid incoming fire.
descriptions.dos:6ca66f4cba26b180: You are Oscar, running and jumping through 7 Hollywood-style levels (Science Fiction, Western, Horror, Cartoons, Dino, Detective and Gameshow) to find Oscar statuettes. Levels can be played in any order.
descriptions.dos:6caf59ccbfa9be2e: Maxis's planet simulation. Take charge of a whole planet over its 10 billion year lifespan, guiding it from single-celled life to inhabitants who reach the stars, against pollution, disease, famine and war.
descriptions.dos:6cafb5d907ffe7e3: An MS-DOS port of a 1982 CoCo adventure, Treasures of the Enrakian Empire, written over nine months by its authors.
descriptions.dos:6cb749f7c19b17c1: An educational game that teaches geography. Bowser has set up headquarters in Antarctica and created portals to 25 famous cities for his Koopas, and has kidnapped Mario.
descriptions.dos:6cc8987837af6c40: A vertically scrolling space shoot 'em up over 16 short levels. Your fighter shoots swirling alien patterns and stationary cannons, collects extras and fights bosses, with a two-player option.
descriptions.dos:6ccae2349bb96727: A shareware platform game in which you control a robot called Heels through rooms, avoiding alien creatures and holes.
descriptions.dos:6cd0408f8816d8e7: A graphical adventure in which you are a private investigator solving a case in a district of the fictitious city of Falcity, exploring streets and buildings in full-screen color tile graphics.
descriptions.dos:6cebba37e096671e: A short text adventure about fixing a broken space station, written to test the author's game engine.
descriptions.dos:6cee04371864c5db: A text-based, turn-based simulation of the battle for the Mediterranean from December 1941 to August 1942. Each turn is three weeks, with strategic and operational decisions.
descriptions.dos:6cee8bf4b0410e4d: Miner Willy discovers a network of caverns of an extinct civilization and sets out to collect all the treasures in 20 caverns before his air runs out, avoiding nasty creatures.
descriptions.dos:6ceec60497d2c435: Control a turret fixed in the middle of the screen, change its angle and shoot down enemy paratroopers as they drop from planes. There are three difficulty levels.
descriptions.dos:6cfbdc416f2a8e68: An anti-terrorist game with strategic planning and real-time action in a third-person over-the-top view like the original X-COM, a precursor to Rainbow Six. You face threats from fanatical cultists to terrorists.
descriptions.dos:6d06a1a5b49275b9: A commercial mod of Quake that needs the registered game but acts as a stand-alone, with its own characters, weapons and environments. You play a mercenary named Damage working for an underground crime boss.
descriptions.dos:6d09eb24fcd81c34: A converted Altair BASIC game in which 2 to 4 players become stock market sharks, buying shares in interstellar shipping companies to amass a fortune.
descriptions.dos:6d0d4e8d153a670a: A shareware crazy golf game for up to 9 players. After each hole it shows shots per hole and the running total; the shareware version has 9 holes of increasing complexity.
descriptions.dos:6d11564bd4189d72: A logic platform game starring a ball named bal. Over 25 static screens, collect all the flags on platforms in a time limit and reach the exit, with bombs to help from the second level.
descriptions.dos:6d1636f5f587969d: A Korean beat 'em up based on a comic series. The story follows three kids, all playable at once by up to three players.
descriptions.dos:6d1ca26847870f7c: Putt-Putt is blasted to the moon by an accident at the Fireworks Factory and meets Rover, a lunar rover. Together they rebuild a rocket and do good deeds for the Moon People.
descriptions.dos:6d34f555ea831f5a: A side-scrolling beat 'em up from Korea.
descriptions.dos:6d398ff2266a2f36: A shareware implementation of Cribbage, the two-player, six-card game, playable by keyboard or mouse in color or monochrome.
descriptions.dos:6d39a5b100a735bf: A little-known RPG with a fairly large world to explore and many NPCs to talk to, in an isometric perspective, plus battles.
descriptions.dos:6d49d2fa6770d426: Colonists have settled in the Astral complex on an asteroid, but raiding ships full of bloodthirsty monsters arrive. You and up to two friends play armed colonists retaking infested colony chambers.
descriptions.dos:6d4d4837b6511067: A linear Final Fight-style beat 'em up where you play Iron Man or X-O Manowar. Each sidescrolling level ends in a comic book boss, starting with Nuclear Plant Siege against Mr. Hyde and the Melter.
descriptions.dos:6d55fb5d53a0d8f6: A two-player game of timed duels in which each player controls a spaceship flying around a star and shooting at the other. Ships keep constant speed and direction until changed.
descriptions.dos:6d565213512c05b1: An educational game and sequel to Operation Wildlife that teaches children about U.S. Presidents plus logic and language skills using five decoder alphabets: English, American Sign Language, Braille, Morse Code and Semaphore.
descriptions.dos:6d580c22b82231bf: The evil sorcerer Blackmagic has taken over the village of Jolimy. Serguei must build up his power with mini quests, then fight him. Type commands such as open door and get star.
descriptions.dos:6d5aaf26d2fab08b: An adventure like Where in the World is Carmen Sandiego, with questions on science, weather and history as well as geography, as each puzzle is a step toward stopping Dr. Data.
descriptions.dos:6d7a722e381c37fe: With the scrolls in hand, the Last Ninja trains a new order of ninja but is mysteriously transported to 20th-century New York, where the Evil Shogun has returned.
descriptions.dos:6d7cb72ce7bff422: A language-skills program for children with animations tied to key nouns and verbs. Typing phrases like The Girl Jumps Over the Flower shows the animation, letting players build short stories.
descriptions.dos:6da5f5187c82b3f4: An open-world, turn-based RPG with no specific backstory and one primary goal, to wander. You may try to kill the evil mage in the citadel; killing him or dying in a duel ends the game.
descriptions.dos:6da95d1d96e71e35: Inspired by the 1986 film, a dogfighting air combat simulation set on the carrier USS Brigham off Libya and the Middle East. Choose the F-14 Tomcat, with a Radar Intercept officer, or another aircraft.
descriptions.dos:6dac1aef3fd1c257: A minesweeper-like game in which you move your man through a field avoiding mines, and the game tells you how many mines are near you.
descriptions.dos:6db48afb94f08f78: A tactical action real-time strategy game often likened to Syndicate. A sequel called Zero Hour followed.
descriptions.dos:6db595a5f2ec3b56: An unofficial Pac-Man. Move through a maze eating dots for a high score while four monsters chase you; eating one of the four stars lets you eat the monsters.
descriptions.dos:6dc4f206d7e88a3c: The third in Dinamic Multimedia's PC Basket series of inexpensive basketball management games, with a 1995 database of Spanish basketball teams and an improved basketball simulator.
descriptions.dos:6dc644d5b4cc07b5: A tennis game endorsed by Jimmy Connors, with tournament and single play on multiple court types. Aim your shots with crosshairs and try for an Ace.
descriptions.dos:6dcea62bedf5cbcd: A Tetris clone in which you clear lines to keep blocks from stacking to the top. Clearing four lines at once earns a NOT, which cuts a notch out of the border on each side.
descriptions.dos:6dd3bc9ed8b6f6ad: An animated 3D graphic adventure in which you play Mel Odius, an up-and-coming young guitarist whose guitar has been stolen, and help him find it.
descriptions.dos:6dd6c570c3687d2e: A Czech action game for one to four players, set in a pub where the patrons build home-made catapults and fire on each other.
descriptions.dos:6dde9adb6d1c9e27: You are trapped in a labyrinth with several Beasts, shown as slim Hs, and your goal is to survive rather than escape, in ASCII graphics.
descriptions.dos:6df7d765bb645a66: A 2D educational adventure about ocean life. Explore the sea in a submarine and learn geology, marine biology, oceanography and ecology through nine mini-games, with hundreds of photos and movies of undersea life.
descriptions.dos:6dfcc4df27a96a6f: A tactical simulation of the South's last major offensive of the American Civil War, using a refined version of SSI's Gettysburg system over 13 turns of two hours each.
descriptions.dos:6e12b83bdf220005: A text-mode puzzle-action game, the third in the original Kroz trilogy, continuing Kingdom of Kroz.
descriptions.dos:6e220c870c32d99e: Freddy the Frog presents six games to help school-starting children build numeracy and literacy skills. In one, Freddie builds a house and can add a log only if you solve a math question.
descriptions.dos:6e263c74ab69f434: The first game based on the Australian Touring Car Championship and Bathurst 1000, and the first racing game to use Full Motion Video. Only the Bathurst track is included.
descriptions.dos:6e305f4a9423af73: A short, unofficial Star Trek text adventure about an evening with Beverly, told by typing commands.
descriptions.dos:6e366d489cda96e0: A 3D World War II tank simulator with three campaigns, Normandy, Ardennes and Desert. Command up to four M4 Shermans, two jeeps and artillery against German tanks and bunkers.
descriptions.dos:6e46976f20fb51f2: A mini-demo of Lemmings 3D with snowy graphics, with the same gameplay and 6 levels not in the full game.
descriptions.dos:6e590d4538fe84eb: An RPG made in 1994 by Paint.NET author Rick Brewster when he was 12, with an odd combination of CGA graphics and Sound Blaster music.
descriptions.dos:6e7005a2941a4d55: A tennis game about the Davis Cup, with 16 qualifying countries and 48 players with different attributes and skills.
descriptions.dos:6e70ea7761ee1f7a: A first-person adventure in which you solve puzzles and fight undead creatures that have overrun Elvira's Castle. It has dozens of different death sequences.
descriptions.dos:6e7107a627e9d397: A non-violent Christmas first-person game from Pie in the Sky Software. As a snowman you rescue Santa from an Ice Wizard using a magic candy cane.
descriptions.dos:6e7555593ad42544: A text adventure in which you work for the C.I.A. and must recover a valuable ruby stolen by a spy ring called Chaos. It was being used in a top-secret laser project.
descriptions.dos:6e779b004f60b47a: A detective simulator in which, as J.B. Harold, you investigate the murder of a wealthy businessman: find clues, gather evidence, interrogate suspects and bring the killer to court.
descriptions.dos:6e7b24a8862edf99: A conversion of Blackjack: bet, then try to reach the highest hand without going over 21. Hit or stand, and for the player double, split or surrender.
descriptions.dos:6e7d0095a0312421: A TRON-inspired light cycle game. Steer the Laser Cycle in an arena, avoiding walls and homing missiles, and turn its trail into an energy barrier for short stretches to block them.
descriptions.dos:6e83bb2b97a4e016: A cross between Wolfenstein 3D and Pac-Man. Navigate a 3D maze, shooting and running from wireframe pyramid enemies; kill them all to exit to the next maze.
descriptions.dos:6e87abfcb29f4fff: A shareware keyboard-controlled shooter like Robotron 2084. Stay alive in the center of the screen while baddies warp in at random positions and shoot them all.
descriptions.dos:6e9b71a16116aae2: A German puzzle game based on Swap. Clear the field of colored blocks by switching their positions; blocks of the same color next to each other disappear.
descriptions.dos:6ea588cf139523b0: A shareware word-building game using domino-like tiles with two pairs of letters. Place a tile next to an existing one to make one or more four-letter words.
descriptions.dos:6ea6e3141d06087a: A 3D snooker simulator. The table and cue can be turned through almost any angle with adjustable strength and spin, a dotted line shows your ball's path, and a trick-shot mode recreates classic shots.
descriptions.dos:6eab361705e4d20d: A shareware text and graphic adventure for newcomers to the genre, set in 1950s Hollywood, where you play the down-on-his-luck private detective Jim Novak in the film noir tradition.
descriptions.dos:6eb54aaa1523cb1f: A game based on the board game about the 1942 fighting around the Russian village of Velikiye Luki. Six scenarios let you play the German or Russian side.
descriptions.dos:6ebe7b7ff47094d3: A shareware archery game for one or two players. Aim with the left and right arrows and fire with Enter, while wind and draft deflect the arrows.
descriptions.dos:6edc528ff38a9cd9: An American Laser Games arcade conversion, a point-and-click shooter where you fight a gang of lawbreakers in a small town.
descriptions.dos:6ef34b0fbec25fde: An extras pack for Descent II that adds 23 missions and some of the original Descent II music as Redbook audio, bundled with the Mission Builder II pack.
descriptions.dos:6ef53cfe8c575391: A sci-fi strategy game converted from the Games Workshop and Milton Bradley board game. You control a commander and four marines sent on missions aboard hostile alien starships.
descriptions.dos:6efc369c131f5476: A real-time puzzle game in which you guide a ricocheting ball into the exit hole by moving a cannon along the perimeter walls and shooting to manipulate the ball and other objects.
descriptions.dos:6f092b427c7ad60a: A shareware historical trading simulation set in 18th-century China. As the young adventurer Atlas Pathfinder, explore sea and land, trade with Chinese cities and build a commercial empire.
descriptions.dos:6f0d0619811eba14: A 3D arcade and strategy game loosely derived from Carrier Command. In the Ultra War, fought between the two dominant races in the New World, you use the Mauler, an Armored Fighting Machine.
descriptions.dos:6f1866ab7e5afeeb: One of the first chess games designed for experts. It can be played from an isometric 3D or a traditional 2D view, with an optional clock and analysis mode.
descriptions.dos:6f2c11c15e5b1b02: One of the earliest shareware games. Fly a prop plane shown in 3D from horizontal and vertical views, fight off vandals and punks before they reach your city, and refuel from your blimp.
descriptions.dos:6f2c9c22ed442017: Captain Klondike's ship has crash-landed on an asteroid, and he must find fuel while collecting coins, gems and power-ups, battling creatures and avoiding traps, up to a final confrontation with G.O.R.G.
descriptions.dos:6f3d3e22eb6455fc: A sci-fi first-person shooter in which you play a Marine named Bitterman in Operation Alien Overlord, a counterattack on the home planet of the cybernetic Strogg to protect Earth.
descriptions.dos:6f3f592f2f0bf64c: You are a little pink guy with a white collar, moving with the arrow keys and thrusting upward with space, passing through doors between rooms and collecting X's.
descriptions.dos:6f45ee47e6e40690: A multiplayer snake game in which you die by being shot by other players instead of running into walls.
descriptions.dos:6f52af412bd89b6c: A Wolfenstein 3D modification inspired by the original Rise of the Triad, which began as an add-on to Wolfenstein 3D and whose roots in its engine are visible.
descriptions.dos:6f577c87bc77bf01: A tennis game with 3D characters named for the French tournament. Choose from 10 men, 7 women or 3 futuristic players and play on five courts, two of which must be unlocked.
descriptions.dos:6f5b31476048f781: You control a trampoline moved horizontally along the bottom of the screen. Bob jumps higher each time he hits it, collecting items at the top.
descriptions.dos:6f6467c132d076d1: An educational arcade shooter from Scetlander. You play Hal, the American cousin of Henrietta, helping her with spelling.
descriptions.dos:6f7313b9a91ce808: A card game, visual puzzle and physical pendulum puzzle in one, with hundreds of puzzles playable individually or in sequence in a Pilgrimage rewarded with zen koans.
descriptions.dos:6f83734babc0f50a: A compilation of four sports games: Archery, Olympic Slalom, Par 4, a text-based golf game with three courses, and Quarterback Crunch, an American football game with nine gambits.
descriptions.dos:6f8fbb425e953bed: A shoot 'em up from Dutch developers with a strangely shaped aircraft and an attempt at realistic flight handling.
descriptions.dos:6f940f6c1d3fce6f: A multiplayer vehicle combat game in CyberCity where you pilot a Cyberpod, collect power-up modules, and compete in four teams of four for control of city squares. Kill or be killed.
descriptions.dos:6fa678f68f4e6a43: A snake game for up to six players, three at a time, originally designed as a BBS door game. Eat dots to grow and avoid other snakes, aiming to be the last one standing or reach a size of 200.
descriptions.dos:6faecae24399f553: The very rare sequel to Last Half of Darkness Part II. You are stranded alone on an island inhabited by living dead and must find the girl you saved in the earlier chapters.
descriptions.dos:6fb3d239b2a79bf6: The first Warlords game, a medieval strategy game of world domination for up to 8 players on one machine. Control 80 cities in the realm of Illuria and wipe out your 7 opponents.
descriptions.dos:6fb8fd680759fbe7: A helicopter simulation in a Hughes 530 MG Defender, with modes including training, rescue and combat missions, and sea rescue.
descriptions.dos:6fcb3bce354e4fee: A top-view arcade racing game. Reach the finish line before time runs out, avoiding other cars, trucks and obstacles and refueling from special trucks along the way.
descriptions.dos:6fcc94dd920a5592: The Atomic Edition of Duke Nukem 3D contains the three original episodes of the main game and the Plutonium Pak expansion, plus Windows themes, screensavers, jigsaw puzzles and an image carousel.
descriptions.dos:6fccbb8d9884ea34: An adventure series in which you play Rolan, a fur-covered person with both human and animal blood, who must stop a terrible evil threatening the land by exploring a maze of trees and bushes.
descriptions.dos:6fda73228fdc5f1b: A shareware Missile Command-style game that teaches math, spelling and touch typing. Missiles drop one at a time; type an answer and press Enter to fire.
descriptions.dos:6fee1dabda05c1b0: A comic adventure in which an ancient prophecy says King Fudd the Bewildered will die peacefully with his daughter beside him, but Princess Lorealle is abducted by her stepmother Morgana.
descriptions.dos:6ff12587ffef7c6e: A three-dimensional football game offering a variation on the FIFA series.
descriptions.dos:6ff520a1421a0d65: A shareware video poker machine simulator. The default game is Jacks or Better, and it can be configured for Second Chance Poker, Joker Wild Poker, Deuces Wild Poker and others.
descriptions.dos:6ffc3d3159879b26: You play Matt Stuvysant, a man of Polish descent and criminal persuasion who arrives in London with only the clothes on his back, planning to become the greatest criminal mind of the century, starting with small shops.
descriptions.dos:700ad2c13cfd68d7: An arcade-style tank war game claiming to simulate real battle tanks, with tanks that move faster than in reality and ammunition recharges to collect in the field.
descriptions.dos:700f364cb97612fd: The third edition of the Wheel of Fortune games, with new puzzle phrases. Up to three contestants spin the wheel and guess hidden letters to solve puzzles.
descriptions.dos:7011272dc804dad0: In the year 2009, you are Nick Vrenna, falsely imprisoned in a high security prison where genetic experiments and a riot have turned guards and inmates into mutants. You must escape.
descriptions.dos:70119e5c77c21011: An adventure in which you decide the fate of the heroes and direct them to their aim. Discover many locations and events, with different stories depending on your directions.
descriptions.dos:7014c342ce4adca3: You are a forklift searching for switches and keys through a warehouse of enemies, lasers and traps. Your fuel keeps dropping, so you must find canisters, and in the end locate a missile and bring it back.
descriptions.dos:70190e051c2e9ba7: A mission-based role-playing game with missions of varying difficulty that you can take in any order or repeat. Each has four or five chapters of dungeon exploring, fighting enemies and grabbing loot.
descriptions.dos:701e9f929e13e3fd: As Mac, rescue hostages in 15 buildings now controlled by the evil Calawarr brothers and their army, finding hostages in each stage and taking them to the exit while avoiding enemies.
descriptions.dos:701ed6742622aac3: An upgraded AV-8B Harrier Assault in SVGA resolution (640x480). You lead a marine expeditionary force trying to occupy West Timor with a full Amphibious Assault Group.
descriptions.dos:701f4c21e92ac126: A turn-based fantasy strategy game. Capture cities, use them to create armies and send them against your opponents. It still has a devoted following on the internet.
descriptions.dos:7022a3998e701ac4: A freeware remake of the 1984 classic with updated graphics and sounds and a classical melody for each room. As Willy, the miner turned millionaire, you wander through his mansion.
descriptions.dos:702639e8a8dbd6da: A collection of three magic-themed text adventures by John Olsen, including Merlin's Magic Forest, where you are transported to ancient England and must search for ingredients to free Merlin from Morgana's spell.
descriptions.dos:702ccaf27aaf0415: Three Vikings, Eric the Swift, Olaf the Stout and Baleog the Fierce, are kidnapped by the alien Tomator. Combine their unique skills to solve puzzles and defeat him and his aliens, robots and giant snails.
descriptions.dos:7034e64dfa2692de: A Tetris sequel with additional features such as two-player cooperative and competitive modes and new block types, including lightning bolts that eliminate an entire row.
descriptions.dos:70499a6de252d243: An educational game in which dinosaurs of the past are brought to the present. Learn to track and identify them with the help of the Dinosaur Encyclopedia and Dexter the talking Dinodroid.
descriptions.dos:706dc0b0d56d9228: A single-player space strategy game that plays like the Star Trek variants without referencing that universe. You command the Argo to end hostilities near the Xanadu base against enemy ships.
descriptions.dos:7076d51586fd978d: An unofficial DOS port of the 2D side-scrolling arcade game like Super Mario Bros. Giana finds herself in a mysterious dreamworld and fights monsters and huge spiders through 32 levels.
descriptions.dos:7082c1cb361ab822: Set in 2017 of an alternate timeline in which the Soviet Union still exists, you are General Sloan McCormick commanding the US Strategic Defense Initiative against a Soviet extremist group of KGB members.
descriptions.dos:708db4c76282415c: A freeware falling block puzzle game for up to four players, played by keyboard, with a soundtrack, high score table and customizable keys. Special blocks can be captured by clearing their row.
descriptions.dos:7094ad406ae0aac8: Based on the arcade sequel, you drive an F-1 racer in a timed qualifying run to win the pole position and then race for the top spot. This game offers four tracks to choose from.
descriptions.dos:709a00e214ea1966: A pure action title, the last DOS-based game of the StarFight series, with short cutscenes and in-game dialogue and better compatibility with new hardware than its predecessors.
descriptions.dos:70b2a68e92b268b4: While Jack drinks a beer, he absorbs Ar'Kritz, a microscopic extraterrestrial police officer. As Ar'Kritz causes mutations with a toxic substance, Jack is about to turn into a powerful monster.
descriptions.dos:70b54236f4a6dd39: A text and graphic adventure adaptation of Rod Serling's television show, built like an episode with its own mystery. Type verb and object commands and move with N, S, W and E.
descriptions.dos:70b7e62ee7a6d7e8: A DOS port of an Amiga platform game with beautiful graphics.
descriptions.dos:70c53c3e1a927dd9: A helicopter simulator and shooter, the sequel to Core's Sega CD game AH-3 Thunderstrike. It has multiple weapons, full freedom of movement and missions, with lots of enemy tanks and helicopters.
descriptions.dos:70c68145cba09def: A simple overhead shooter in the spirit of Raiden and Raptor. In 2047 a terrorist organization travels back to 1943 to sell weapons to the Axis powers, and an elite group of fighters must stop them.
descriptions.dos:70d825751ece919d: A 2D Wing Commander-like space shooter. Pilot a combat ship through 40 linear missions, destroying enemies or protecting friendly shuttles, with the goal of defeating an alien race.
descriptions.dos:70d9dd11f845a180: A computerized version of backgammon: both sides roll dice in turn and move, trying to clear all their checkers from the board before the opponent. This version supports a single human player.
descriptions.dos:70e64a9c94eb7735: A fantasy interactive fiction in which you play the black dwarf Grimbis, who must recover a magical orb stolen by elves by typing verb-noun commands.
descriptions.dos:70f44ef3bfba6c00: A space shooter in which you hunt space-faring business school graduates whose myopic quantitative concepts have ruined Earth's economies and are now spreading the plague to other planets.
descriptions.dos:71013dabdb2e4619: A text adventure in which the Golden Baton in the throne room has suddenly become tarnished and gloom has settled over the kingdom. Find the source of the evil before it is too late.
descriptions.dos:7101df156a29f6af: In an all-out galactic war, the conquering Eclons have invaded the Zuran galaxy. As a Zuran Defender you must cleanse the stellar neighborhood of Eclon forces.
descriptions.dos:7104bf3023407422: In 1996 you are William Tibbs, an American law student in Paris, who must take up the challenge of Wolfram to save your fiancee Juliette, after a final cry for help from the last Knight Templar.
descriptions.dos:710e9b350ab86534: A World War I flight simulation structured around an interactive gallery of pilot biographies that change as events unfold, with 150 missions.
descriptions.dos:711f8b6747cd9543: From the Worlds of ZZT, a game where your goal is to escape the city, with its bureaucracy, smog and desperate weirdos, by mastering 30 game boards.
descriptions.dos:712b081b0af46c86: An arcade game in which you shoot numerous spiders descending from the top of the screen with your laser. Ammo is limited but more appears when you run low.
descriptions.dos:712fbe5c6d99fd16: Hocus Pocus, a young magician's apprentice, wants to join the Council of Wizards in the land of Lattice and marry his sweetheart Popopa. First he must gather magical crystals for the wizard chief Terexin in this platformer.
descriptions.dos:713ad207bd5e76af: A shareware clone of Space Invaders. Control a cannon at the bottom of the screen and destroy waves of advancing alien ships for a high score, with three lives.
descriptions.dos:7140aa5d80aef2fd: A point-and-click adventure sequel to Ringworld, based on Larry Niven's Known Space novels, in which Quinn and Miranda Rees continue after saving the puppeteer race from extermination.
descriptions.dos:7142959ca0ff5669: Manage a team through the 1996 championship and beyond, with full control of engineers, contracts, sponsors, training, drivers, merchandising, design, development, testing and race weekends.
descriptions.dos:71536d99e30602f9: Sonny Bonds, a small-town policeman, fights the rising tide of drugs in his city. Based on real police procedure, he moves from patrol officer to detective and chases the infamous Death Angel.
descriptions.dos:715ae2218c83d3d0: A late, high-quality clone of the arcade game Q*bert. Jump on every step of a pyramid to change its color and move on to the next level while enemies hinder you.
descriptions.dos:7161349d44c16d4b: An all-strategy baseball simulator done entirely in text. Use existing teams, draft from them or create your own, and answer yes/no questions about fielding and baserunning.
descriptions.dos:716164b229037061: A football management sim, successor to the original Championship Manager, released in fall 1995. It became the benchmark of the genre and remains popular.
descriptions.dos:716960a3584a2c99: A cricket game about the Ashes, the tours between England and Australia, in which you play test matches.
descriptions.dos:716a24f052d01235: Four hopeful explorers try to make a fortune on a virgin planet by producing Food, Energy, Smithore and Crystite. Each good has its uses, and shortages cut your turn time or output.
descriptions.dos:7174b21e30721a7a: Rockwart the Troll has cast a spell on Daisy, putting her to sleep for 100 years. Dizzy sets out to fix it in a compact arcade adventure, starting trapped underground.
descriptions.dos:717e22a7d37b3d0d: A pattern-recognition game with 3x3 grid puzzles of abstract shapes with one empty space. Work out the logic and pick the shape that fills the gap; scoring depends on reaction time.
descriptions.dos:718854bc3ae40f41: Roger Wilco, the interstellar janitor, finds himself accused of violating galactic law and stripped of his honors, and travels into the Spinal Frontier to set things straight.
descriptions.dos:718b4b40a24ff4a8: A Polish math program for children that teaches adding, subtracting, dividing and multiplying at three difficulty levels, with two mini-games, a slot machine and a match puzzle.
descriptions.dos:718fb14a6b87ee47: Play Sir Graham, a brave knight sent to retrieve three stolen treasures: a shield that protects against invaders, a mirror that foretells the future and a chest forever filled with gold.
descriptions.dos:71903527bab71ad0: A DOS remake of the BASIC game Wizard's Castle. Explore an 8x8x8 castle by short text commands, killing monsters and grabbing treasures to find a powerful item.
descriptions.dos:7194f53b30c46fa1: A chess game in which the pieces are small realistic figures that walk around the board and, when one takes another, fight in an animated battle that is different for each pairing.
descriptions.dos:71969a7d505bab8c: Help the land of Metavira: hire mercenaries as you explore, capture and hold territory so the natives can harvest trees that yield a revolutionary medicine. More trees mean more money.
descriptions.dos:71a0e8f77470fca8: An arcade-style game based on the UK TV series. Control one of the Mr. Gumbies through multiple screens, throwing fish at flying feet and other surreal enemies, with non-sequitur asides.
descriptions.dos:71a1b3dcb5b2aeaf: A freeware clone of Galaxian. Move your ship from side to side with the cursor keys and fire with Space against enemy ships that swoop around the screen.
descriptions.dos:71a3396db6eadd2e: A Sierra-style adventure for kids based on nursery rhymes like Humpty Dumpty. The rhymes have gotten mixed up and the child must find the missing pieces and give them back.
descriptions.dos:71a73c4fec71ef85: Number 8 in the Scott Adams adventure series. On an Egyptian treasure hunt deep inside a newly discovered pyramid, find all the treasures and escape alive, using a 2-word parser.
descriptions.dos:71a84b6cd302af66: A Bomberman-like game in which players in a maze plant time-bombs to eliminate their opponents by detonating explosives when the enemy is in range.
descriptions.dos:71b216e4d83db673: A jigsaw puzzle game with interesting options such as fractal images.
descriptions.dos:71b82e44e9e6fd14: A science quiz racing game. Quarky and Quaysoo organized Los Turbos to beat rival teams, and you answer questions correctly to earn money to move between checkpoints and win races.
descriptions.dos:71c87215d90cd076: Simulates the annoyance of being pestered by a housefly while reading in your easy chair, as you pull out a flyswat and try to swat it.
descriptions.dos:71d1cdcb13dcffb0: A public domain version of Defender. Fly a spaceship left or right through a tunnel, destroying alien ships and rescuing the people being abducted.
descriptions.dos:71ec693c4c28e476: A puzzle game first published with the Spanish edition of Computer Gaming World in 1997. Eliminate all bricks in each level by grouping them by color range, avoiding leaving any alone.
descriptions.dos:71f5e7fb690e28af: A textmode maze game in which a secret agent, an X, searches a random maze of destructible and indestructible blocks for three randomly assigned espionage objects, gathered in sequence within a limited number of moves.
descriptions.dos:71f78b4be0d60b8b: A demo of a cancelled game, described as a cross between The Sims and Jones in the Fast Lane. It is SimCity-like but aims to keep individual people happy rather than the whole city.
descriptions.dos:71fc6dd20101c148: An arcade flying game with 256 levels, parallax scrolling and procedurally generated terrain packed into just 256 bytes of machine code. Get your starship across an increasingly dangerous environment.
descriptions.dos:7213b6f02cbfd978: A shareware dice game based on Zilch, played with six dice by up to nine people including the computer, with a two-player Mutant Trash variant and a Rotary Club mode.
descriptions.dos:721ad338ada46f87: An American football simulation where you play as head coach. Select home and visiting teams, human or computer controlled, make roster changes and call the plays.
descriptions.dos:7221edbbfcd32784: A commercial Othello simulator with ASCII graphics. Play against the computer or another player and capture more pieces than your opponent.
descriptions.dos:7226782b3409f1b3: A text adventure in which you explore the immediate vicinity of your office and discover that supernatural beings such as dwarves, elves and trolls live in a modern-day environment.
descriptions.dos:7235ded0a07a2c7b: Skunny the squirrel travels back to ancient Rome to stop an evil chef from destroying the invention of the pizza, jumping from platform to platform and onto the heads of Roman legions.
descriptions.dos:7242166a4537bb33: A popular shareware side-scrolling shooter with a variety of weapons and enemies in 4 episodes.
descriptions.dos:72529531a386c761: A real-time, 3D view game mixing Civilization-style play with the Dungeons and Dragons universe. Build a small village into a Stronghold, recruiting and training Fighters, Thieves and other classes.
descriptions.dos:7256cb48b40c31f0: You are a small ant who goes into an anthill to rescue a friend's bag of cookies after the dog lost his balance, in a platform puzzle game.
descriptions.dos:7256eeb56cf5c86f: A turn-based wargame about managing only air forces in combat operations, a forerunner of Air Force Commander and WW2 Air Force Commander from the same developers.
descriptions.dos:726741a29366d59f: A very simple QBasic shooter in which you fire at Bob Saget with sitcom audience moans and demented circus music, targeting specific areas of his body.
descriptions.dos:72793f5bda4cee27: A DOS shareware remake of the Donkey Kong arcade game with two modes, the original Classic mode and an enhanced Champ mode.
descriptions.dos:727e043a4accf25d: A short text adventure built with the Text Adventure Generator Runner, set in the fictional Abyssville, where the energy companies' man-made singularity has had unforeseen side effects.
descriptions.dos:728749aaaeb40e4f: A 2D wrestling simulator from indie developer MDickie. Defeat the opponent while earning a better match rating, hitting him with chairs, throwing him on tables and climbing the cage.
descriptions.dos:7287d7708750f2dc: A futuristic economic real-time strategy game from Australian developers about what could happen to companies scamming people by selling land on the Moon and planets.
descriptions.dos:7290454d5c98d9a8: A real-time text adventure for one or two players, cooperative or competitive, with random treasure placement and character classes. Find the Black Orb to save your home from becoming a barren wasteland.
descriptions.dos:729de9d1b1e07caa: A sci-fi RPG in which you are sent to a fleet of spaceships invaded by escaped aliens. Walk around fighting aliens and collecting keys for doors, handling toxic coolant carefully, with 6 programmable robots.
descriptions.dos:729f943974559b33: The sequel to Dark Sun: Shattered Lands, set on the burning wasteland planet Athas. Characters can be imported, and the party journeys to the liberated city of Tyr.
descriptions.dos:72ae090a5277e09e: A freeware Lemmings clone in which you control a green duck leading orange ducks to a rocket ship. Holding the right mouse button makes the leader move toward the cursor.
descriptions.dos:72b9247933b6a513: The fifth Dragon Slayer game, set in the fantasy land of Pentawa. The king hires a party of adventurers to protect its inhabitants from ferocious creatures, beginning with retrieving a precious sceptre from a dungeon.
descriptions.dos:72b9570543aa8e9b: You play Nick, rescuing your true love Xianna from gangsters. Start in one of five cities, Denver, Atlanta, Detroit, Los Angeles or New York, which differ in the number of turfs to clear.
descriptions.dos:72bcef9877a4ebdd: A hand-drawn side-view platformer set in Zulaland, starring Zulus Twiggy, who was born a little different from his fellow tribesmen.
descriptions.dos:72bf5127d3581e98: Chase Carmen Sandiego and her American gang across the USA. As an ACME detective you travel from town to town on the suspect's trail, using clues and evidence to put the suspect in jail.
descriptions.dos:72cabd5fb3c20844: The villain I.M. Meen hates it when children study, so he creates a magical book that traps them in his evil labyrinth. You are one of two new children trapped in the maze, trying to free the others.
descriptions.dos:72cb69fbfc46508c: A point-and-click adventure in which Floyd is ordered to sneak aboard the Starship Longshot and remove the Prime Minister of Bubba Star Six from the picture.
descriptions.dos:72cd7789cb8d3264: Drive your remote controlled Gemini tank with the arrow keys and shoot with the space bar, battling enemies on remote planets and killing three of their tanks before they destroy yours.
descriptions.dos:72cf5bc359ab6a1f: A shareware educational game about the capitals of the world as they were in 1990. An outline map may show surrounding countries or cities as clues for the target city you must identify.
descriptions.dos:72cfaae74edd04d7: A card game that originated in Hong Kong, played by almost all the oriental population and second only to Mahjong in social entertainment.
descriptions.dos:72d3fec8237e1325: A digging arcade game in the spirit of Digger and Dig Dug, starring Bob the Hamster.
descriptions.dos:72f12598a92ea196: A first-person adventure made of still screens. A mad scientist's elixir has made the protagonist's dreams real, and he must stay alive, leave the forsaken place and return to the real world.
descriptions.dos:72fdf380746eef34: A Breakout clone in Tandy 1000 BASIC. A wall of bricks sits at the top of the screen and you deflect the bouncing ball with a paddle to knock down the wall.
descriptions.dos:72fe29fe97badd30: A one-on-one soccer-like sport played in hovercraft in a future without violence. The goals move, the arena is oddly shaped, and money from goals buys weapons and power-ups.
descriptions.dos:7301617b0832760d: A puzzle game from Soleau Software similar to Boloball, in which you get your 25 colored balloons as high as possible on the board; the higher a balloon goes, the more points.
descriptions.dos:73019f33e5b132b0: A Spanish action arcade game in which you play a Viking wandering various locations and battling opponents, with no particular plot.
descriptions.dos:7304c4552580f94b: A Mortal Kombat-style fighting game with human, alien and robot characters in a futuristic setting, with 3D-rendered SVGA characters and animated backgrounds, and single, two-player and practice modes.
descriptions.dos:730efd1a216dff82: An RPG with an interface like the Bard's Tale series or Dragon Wars. Create a party of six and try to stop a crusade of slaughter against the elvish race, corrupted by an unspeakable evil.
descriptions.dos:7316ecd5f1a33c61: A computer version of the Connect Four party game for one player against the computer or two players.
descriptions.dos:731c5d5d119628b0: A shareware card game for three to eight players, where the computer fills in if fewer than three play. It includes the original game and the Sevens/Parliament, Five or Nine and Pay or Play variants.
descriptions.dos:7325612671081740: A custom launcher for over 200 top Descent levels for Descent 1, 2 and Vertigo, mostly picks from the user Diedel plus entries from level contests, with notes on game types and player counts.
descriptions.dos:732cab2c1924ec65: An expanded Railroad Tycoon with additional scenarios and settings, enhanced graphics and several more types of trains.
descriptions.dos:732dfab3a7047000: Two action helicopter sims in one, Werewolf and Comanche 2.0, similar to the original Comanche. In some missions you can land to refill fuel and ammo.
descriptions.dos:73308b312e90b6fb: A turn-based war game that is easy to learn, with terrain effects, multiple difficulty levels, plenty of units, a scenario editor, full campaigns and multiple zoom levels.
descriptions.dos:73397f68977af5bf: A card game simulation, Volume Sixteen of the Coffee Break series, with four poker varieties, 5 Card Stud, 7 Card Stud, Chicago and Hold 'Em, against three computer opponents.
descriptions.dos:733f716275895542: An educational CD-ROM exploring the Wild West from 1500 to 1900 AD. You play a character and earn points by making choices in 10,000 possible scenarios, with narrated intros for each time period.
descriptions.dos:734009e9ef26c48f: A dungeon crawler with heavy RPG elements, moving about an ASCII map in a minimalist interface.
descriptions.dos:7340335e06f09f2e: A futuristic sports game played in a hall like a basketball court with a basket in the middle. Throw a charged energy ball into the basket; it is charged in energy fields in your opponent's half.
descriptions.dos:7353a100ccfc4f98: An Eamon adventure disk. In the Eamon RPG you are a free-wheeling adventurer who takes dangerous quests against many enemies to earn riches and experience.
descriptions.dos:736622d45abd7ad9: SimCity with multimedia enhancements on CD, such as video clips. Build up your city and provide your citizens with what they need.
descriptions.dos:7381b3339d9cba83: The table football game recreated as a turn-based strategy game. Each player has 30 seconds to move in a 30-minute match, selecting a player and aiming.
descriptions.dos:7389a14203579cc7: The ancient demon Jashiin awakens after two thousand years and destroys the kingdom of Zeliard with a 115-day sand rain, then turns Princess Felicia to stone. You set out to put things right.
descriptions.dos:7394584f34082b75: A German football management simulation and sequel to Bundesliga Manager Professional for up to four players. Lead your favorite team to sporting and financial success, taking loans and investing in real estate.
descriptions.dos:739ade8f2a54211e: A top-down hockey game against Canada or the USA with many options for difficulty, speed and referee behavior, and an editor for new tactics, lineups and abilities.
descriptions.dos:739bd25c9e1b37a3: In the 12th century, Gao Qiu overthrows the Song Dynasty emperor Hui Zhong. As an exiled ruler you must build your stats to challenge and destroy Gao Qiu and restore Hui Zhong to the throne.
descriptions.dos:73acc4f9af404614: A shareware adaptation of the Epyx classic with all the levels from Jumpman and Jumpman Junior, plus original levels and an editor.
descriptions.dos:73ad520f7d745397: A side-scrolling shooter with unintuitive controls and a variation on Defender, in which you fly left or right and try to save your men while dodging enemy fire.
descriptions.dos:73b285367ffbbb86: A tile-based real-time wargame of the Battle of Austerlitz on 2 December 1805. Command either the French or the Russo-Austrian armies.
descriptions.dos:73b49072f998f0cb: The second game by John Como, from the Villa Crespo budget coffee series: a peaceful, family-friendly game of Hearts.
descriptions.dos:73bb434c6489b161: One of the first Space Invaders clones on the PC, with the same concept and different graphics.
descriptions.dos:73c1ee97d7ca1b85: A simple textmode Pac-Man hidden inside the RemorseView application for viewing ASCII artwork, in which a yellow gobbling mouth moves through a maze.
descriptions.dos:73c30e09c425faf9: A word association game for one, two or four players, based on free association word chains like the UK party game Tennis-Elbow-Foot.
descriptions.dos:73c3cc33681c1628: An operational-level wargame of a hypothetical World War III in central Europe in the early 1990s. As the Soviets, sweep aside NATO and capture the Ruhr; as NATO, stop the Russians.
descriptions.dos:73c5db1209425aa1: The fourth Sierra Hoyle game, a collection of eight card games: Bridge, Euchre, Old Maid, Gin Rummy, Hearts, Cribbage, Crazy Eights and Klondike, with rules and an interface tutorial.
descriptions.dos:73cd154341aebfaf: A mystical fantasy RPG that takes you underground to battle bizarre monsters and find riches in and beneath the city of Locklaven, controlling a party of four explorers by keyboard or mouse.
descriptions.dos:73dc485d7ecd8945: A comic space adventure in which Brad Stallion, helped by the computer Sandie, tracks a band of interstellar raiders across two planets, a space station and his ship by solving puzzles.
descriptions.dos:73e088f01302994b: Don Bluth's second laserdisc conversion after Dragon's Lair. You play Dexter, fighting the madman Borf, who has kidnapped Kimberly and threatens the world with the Infanto Ray, which turns adults into children.
descriptions.dos:73e7200db9ddc2f3: A game loosely inspired by Duck Hunt, played with the space bar. An armed ASCII man at the bottom center fires at birds flying above, timing his shot to intercept them.
descriptions.dos:73ecdc0ea871307a: You are a thief breaking into a Spanish bank who needs tools such as a torch and pincers, avoiding policemen, gorillas, kung-fu experts, women sweeping and paper airplanes.
descriptions.dos:73fae3b292eda614: Released after Pinball Illusions, a pinball game with nine tables based on places around the globe, including Africa, Australia, Hollywood, New York and the North Pole.
descriptions.dos:74011fab0a7d5aa1: The widest-scope strategy game of its time. Lead a nation from the Stone Age to the 21st century and become the dominant civilization, by conquest or otherwise.
descriptions.dos:740c694629591ca9: A simulation of the Battle of Midway in June 1942. The computer commands a huge Japanese force trying to invade the island, while you command the badly outnumbered American forces.
descriptions.dos:74111431cc4f0d54: An interactive fiction in which Terry, in rehab for nicotine addiction, stands in a muddy glade in the rain. A head buried in the mud tells him he has pieces to recover.
descriptions.dos:741347b3e3215ce0: A trivia game with a hundred multiple-choice questions on the Star Trek television series, covering the Enterprise crew, aliens and enemies, episode names, technical data and dialogue.
descriptions.dos:7429ddb9eee6a3e2: A medieval strategy game with action and light adventure elements and hand-drawn graphics. You return to find your ancestral castle in ruins and a huge army marching on your land, and must raise an army.
descriptions.dos:742a465a55b6cb48: Realistic armored warfare across numerous tactical theaters, with modern US and Soviet armored vehicles to choose from. It was one of the earliest tank sims with a broad mission editor.
descriptions.dos:743731ae01bc1f4c: A shareware compendium of fifty-seven puzzles in categories such as Anagram Word Find, where the words in a word-find puzzle are anagrammed, and Antograms.
descriptions.dos:74425f410b78bfb6: A shareware dungeon crawl. Two hundred years ago you served the good Lord Trentarus, whose mages built a sarcophagus of pure wizidrium to ensure his reign continued; this is the sequel to The Cyan Sarcophagus.
descriptions.dos:744386e7d9cfee5a: A winter Olympic sports game and successor to SuperSki III. Choose a mode and difficulty and compete in Downhill, Giant Slalom, Slalom, Snowboard, Snowboard Slalom or Ski Jump.
descriptions.dos:74633fad6dbe3440: A two-on-two beach volleyball game from an angled overhead view. Up to four players can share a computer, with computer-controlled teammates filling the other positions.
descriptions.dos:746a319c605780b3: Build factories on land, but people get angry if you keep building. Move with the arrow keys and advance one turn with Q, which increases money and reduces anger.
descriptions.dos:746bb1d8f238949f: Abe, a Mudokon in a race enslaved by the Glukkons, overhears the corporate leaders plan a new meat product and sets out to free his people in this puzzle platformer.
descriptions.dos:746c6f24cce614b8: A 1995 interactive fiction by Andrew Plotkin in which you are caught in a rainstorm in the countryside. It won the Inform category at the inaugural Interactive Fiction Competition.
descriptions.dos:74748db589ec2f3f: As brave knight Sir AddaLot, defeat the dragon Scorch, who terrorizes castles, by eliminating equal results of math expressions while walking from castle to castle.
descriptions.dos:7478d609627ed984: A Centipede-style shoot 'em up. Shoot a giant centipede moving down the field and the mushrooms for extra points, watching out for spiders and the indestructible hungry Pacperson.
descriptions.dos:7482b14b41830260: The sequel to the arcade-style racer Screamer, with an improved SVGA engine, new cars and tracks, trackside details like cows and helicopters, and a Techno CD audio soundtrack.
descriptions.dos:748c18d8a98acdd6: A rally arcade racing game looking like Gaelco's World Rally Championship but with a larger car sprite. Modes are training, single race and championship over 30 circuits.
descriptions.dos:7490ac49a00b251e: When the town of Word-Ville runs out of words, Reader Rabbit and his friend Matt collect them in four activities: Vowel Pond, Word Mine, Word Patch and Alphabet Dance. For ages 6 to 8.
descriptions.dos:74a226e83139ef3a: A shareware adventure in which you are a bar man on an intergalactic cruiser who wakes to find the ship deserted and must explore it to escape alive.
descriptions.dos:74a5a6fbb88cffd1: An Infocom interactive fiction by Brian Moriarty, written to be easier than typical Infocom releases as an introduction for newcomers to text adventures.
descriptions.dos:74a91096f390f7e0: Ride your bike across funky terrain while collecting apples.
descriptions.dos:74ba2c273b36e8e3: A split-screen tennis game with the camera close behind the athlete. Play exhibition singles or doubles, training, the Davis Cup or the four Grand Slam tournaments with one of 32 athletes or your own.
descriptions.dos:74c916fcb6eda4a7: A puzzle game whose object is to eliminate all tiles from a board of black squares by selecting a tile with the cursor and pressing an arrow key.
descriptions.dos:74c9f8e13db4d076: A crude text-based wargame of a sea war between the USA and the USSR. Deep and complex with almost no help available.
descriptions.dos:74d82070409e7df4: The second Micro Machines game, in which you race extremely small cars around a table, a treehouse and other places, in top-down view where the control is sometimes difficult.
descriptions.dos:74dbd2909c6fab88: The third game of the Daemon's Quest series, an interactive fiction.
descriptions.dos:74dc5718786615ea: Gavrila, a charming loader, solves weighing puzzles in a limited time for points. Entering rooms in a multi-storey building, he puts the proper boxes on the weighing machine and labels them.
descriptions.dos:74dcc68d73e1c6da: The first version of MECC's educational application that lets children aged 6 to 12 write their own fairy-tale stories, creating illustrated books of pages.
descriptions.dos:74fc8c0ccd71bad8: A re-release of Hole-In-One Miniature Golf with 3 more courses, 8 in total with 144 holes.
