descriptions.dos:7507b6be36e9ce7a: A top-down football simulation where you pick the strategies. On offense you control the ball carrier, then the quarterback after the snap, then the receiver; on defense you control the middle linebacker.
descriptions.dos:750c04bb8cffac91: A traditional space shooter with 42 rounds of battle against invading aliens, each with different movement and firing patterns. You have an auto-fire cannon and a single-fire targeting laser.
descriptions.dos:7513ac913e67c56e: A Breakout variant by Ken Silverman, the author of the Build engine, in which the paddle can move vertically as well as horizontally. There are no falling bonuses; just clear the screen.
descriptions.dos:751526af39d2ec6a: You are an energy guardian who must stop the enemy from breaching your inner globe. On a grid fifteen nodes wide by eight high, you move a character along the lines.
descriptions.dos:751aee0a65f2e6f4: A strategy game where you reach the far end of a large grid filled with enemies, holes and walls. You can create and fill in holes to block enemies or reach new areas, and the enemies vary in intelligence.
descriptions.dos:752e96c4aa4f6698: An Italian platformer for a younger audience starring an anthropomorphic stack of sweets with arms, legs and expressive eyes.
descriptions.dos:75388fefb840ea4a: A small modern boy finds himself in a magical land ruled by Dr. Malvado, whose name means Evil in Spanish, and must stop him while facing opponents like bears, wasps and spiders.
descriptions.dos:75402b3fca5b9b4d: An Infocom comic science-fiction text adventure: in 1936 the protagonist is abducted by invaders from Phobos and must escape and foil their plan for Earth, collecting items and solving puzzles by typing commands.
descriptions.dos:7540d13667ee33ff: The well-loved card game with many local house rules, some set in a menu. Collect 500 points and avoid -500, playing in teams against two other players.
descriptions.dos:754629685951153e: A simple top-view shooter for 2 or 3 players with DeathMatch and Capture the Flag modes. Choose a map and buy weapons with money earned in battle.
descriptions.dos:75568c188be322bf: A text-based game in the Wizard's Castle family, originating in 1981 on DEC mainframes. Descend into a dungeon in a haunted mansion to find the all-powerful Globe.
descriptions.dos:755c1fd2f89e873a: A 2D naval simulation in which you captain a US Navy Destroyer in World War II, commanding sub-hunter, rescue, blockade running, bombardment, scout and convoy escort missions.
descriptions.dos:75721c8e98bbaf12: A conversion of Capcom's arcade game. Shoot everything in sight as the hero runs back and forth along the bottom of the screen, dodging bullets and grenades, alone or with a second player.
descriptions.dos:757276f7620396a3: A Korean platformer from Object Square Team, a team of only two people, with music by TeMP.
descriptions.dos:757503ccaa12dce0: A street dealer's buying, selling and fighting game based on the New York drug market. Pay off your debt to the loan shark, then make as much money as you can in one month.
descriptions.dos:757569ed29594dd1: A puzzle game in which you collect all the keys, reach the door and don't die.
descriptions.dos:757959b66ecaf32a: A Christian game from Bridgestone in which, with the Sword of the Spirit and the Shield of Faith, you help Captain Bible fight evil in the Dome of Darkness.
descriptions.dos:757d9d948692a27a: A conversion of the arcade game for up to four players, a wizard, warrior, elf and valkyrie, who make their way through mazes, collecting treasures and potions and fending off creatures and ghosts.
descriptions.dos:758ee48f994b9c76: A platformer with a huge nonlinear playfield of several terrains. As Captain Comic, galactic hero, you must recover three treasures stolen from the planet Omsoc and hidden on remote Tambi.
descriptions.dos:759f11ec89d16396: A simple aliens-attack-Earth game in which you must ram all the defenseless alien ships before they land, while avoiding the alien Droids who try to ram you.
descriptions.dos:75a23023e0bd07c1: Based on the Spanish animated series broadcast on Television Espanola in the late eighties, set in the System of the Double Sun with seven planets and twelve moons.
descriptions.dos:75a3c8b11893041b: A Contract Bridge game with adjustable bidding conventions for both partners, such as Cue Bid, Weak Two-Bid, Jacoby Transfer and Gambling NT. Games can be saved and restored.
descriptions.dos:75a5bb79e30a78dd: A simple keyboard-controlled ski jumping simulator, available as shareware with a modest registration that unlocks extra features.
descriptions.dos:75af06a68a92ff48: A Taiwanese first-person shooter borrowing heavily from Doom, Duke Nukem 3D and Shadow Warrior, set in a post-apocalyptic future after a nuclear holocaust started by a self-aware AI defense system.
descriptions.dos:75afb2ba6c2970b8: A basic CGA translation of the Wheel of Fortune game show: guess letters until you can solve the phrase across three rounds and a bonus round, against 2 computer players or friends.
descriptions.dos:75b507a3fadd84f8: Fly an Apache AH-64 helicopter to rescue downed pilots behind enemy lines in a 3D remake of Choplifter.
descriptions.dos:75b64f156f8a89f8: A robot combat simulator driven by AI profiles. Edit and create your own AI profiles, then pick several to battle and see who wins.
descriptions.dos:75bbc39499c635bd: A shareware partnership whist game for four players in two teams, where you sit as North and the computer plays the other three hands. A match is a series of games.
descriptions.dos:75bd069708ea8dac: Rockford the Ant returns with 15 new levels and an easy-to-use editor. Build, save and play your own levels and sequence them on a separate game disk.
descriptions.dos:75ca891050fd0d4e: An isometric puzzle game for four players, any mix of human and computer, similar to Virgin's Spot. Move your pieces next to pieces of another color to take control of the largest area of the board.
descriptions.dos:75cb05a0d3379dcb: Pyl (Dust), a 3D first-person shooter that emphasizes sneaking to save ammunition. The action takes place across a series of maps visited by a character searching for artifacts.
descriptions.dos:75cc0400c9612731: A science-fiction comedy adventure. An alien crash-lands near Atom City in 1958 seeking help for his occupied home world, and you play Barth, gas-station owner Zeke or astronomer's daughter Lydia.
descriptions.dos:75cf5de58a782412: Two editions of the geography detective game Where in the World Is Carmen Sandiego?, the Deluxe Edition and the CD edition from 1995.
descriptions.dos:75cf5de58a782412.1: As a rookie detective, identify the thief behind the theft of some of the world's most priceless treasures, obtain an arrest warrant and track down the crook before time runs out. Your rank rises as you solve cases.
descriptions.dos:75cf5de58a782412.2: The CD-ROM edition of the geography detective game Where in the World Is Carmen Sandiego?, in which you chase thieves around the globe.
descriptions.dos:75d595d3521f21cf: Two text adventures with graphics, Shard of Inovar and Venom.
descriptions.dos:75d595d3521f21cf.1: A text adventure about the Inovar, a magical artifact created by the ancient Elfin race Eharin to defeat the plague Nagroma that swept the land.
descriptions.dos:75d595d3521f21cf.2: A text adventure with graphics. The evil Traklan, condemned underground by Lord Mirosima, has risen again to threaten the land of Armosin, and you play the warrior Rikka.
descriptions.dos:75d5e33143c05969: A strategy shooter in which you control a robot starting in the center of the game area, surrounded by baddies, and must rescue all the humans on the screen. Some baddies attack the humans instead of you.
descriptions.dos:75e15f5416ac5a66: A rail shooter in which humans have left Earth and the journey to the stars outlasted expectations. When the mysterious Scarab-X forces attack, the Scavenger 4 squadron responds.
descriptions.dos:75ea161c2d0ede6a: A DOS shareware remake of Space Invaders with three modes: Classic, Deluxe and the enhanced Champ mode.
descriptions.dos:75fc9dfb83e46cd2: A Pac-Man-like maze game with an overhead view. Help the farmer rid his farm of mice by moving the maze walls to corner them for the cat. A female mouse that reaches cheese will reproduce.
descriptions.dos:75ff273ccc600dea: A historical wargame in which you play either side in four of Napoleon's battles: Auerstadt, Borodino, Quatre Bras and Waterloo, with a scenario construction set for designing your own.
descriptions.dos:7604692b8dc72701: A puzzle game based on Puzzle Bobble. Aim colored faces from the bottom of the screen, off the walls if necessary, to hit matching groups on the grid.
descriptions.dos:7609122ebdfe6e8a: A memory game: watch a pattern of 4 circles and then recreate it. Written in only 55 lines of BASIC.
descriptions.dos:76173e1eb1de64f4: A Tetris clone with interesting piece shapes. Complete lines to keep the wall low and don't let blocks reach the top of the drop tube.
descriptions.dos:7634c2c9b1f431a7: The Dark Army is on the move, led by the sorceress Scotia, who aims to destroy Gladstone Keep and King Richard. Scotia, empowered by the Mask, can shape shift and infiltrate.
descriptions.dos:763997421dbef746: A tenpin bowling game from Leader Board authors Bruce and Roger Carver. Time a succession of clicks to set angle, speed and curve, with three skill levels.
descriptions.dos:7653e9aada355e06: A text adventure set in a single room, your dilapidated apartment, as you prepare to leave for a festival in Death Valley. The nearer you get to leaving, the more problems befall you.
descriptions.dos:76666ec21b5408cc: The trading vessel Princess Blue is ambushed and destroyed by Manchi raiders after finding a derelict ship. As the only surviving crew member, you start a space career in this mix of flight, trading and RPG.
descriptions.dos:766d4510499ac103: A text adventure in which you are the only witness to a kidnapping and must go to the rescue. It has a two-word parser, function key macros and a split-window format.
descriptions.dos:76800b20d44953b7: A turn-based strategy game in which you control a medieval country and conquer all other countries. Raise armies, improve your castle and defenses, conduct diplomacy and grow your economy.
descriptions.dos:7683494514209bf2: A trivia action game. Move your muncher around a grid and eat the words that fit a given clue or category, while incorrect words and critters get in the way.
descriptions.dos:768e4bde924e5faa: An Olympic-style sports game with arcade gameplay. Events include barrel jumping, bull riding, caber toss, cliff diving, log rolling, pole vault, skiing, sumo wrestling and weightlifting.
descriptions.dos:768f71eba6693ca5: A strategy game with light RPG and business simulation elements. You play the former king's son in a medieval kingdom dominated by an evil sorceress called Medusa.
descriptions.dos:7693de1c19e04728: A rugby game released alongside the 1991 Rugby World Cup. Recreate the full 16-team event, play friendlies or an 8-team league, with 10 skill levels and customizable options.
descriptions.dos:76965738286d2268: A text adventure in which you journey between short stories connected solely by color: speeding on the road with a friend, landing on Mars, teaching your daughter astronomy.
descriptions.dos:76a5c4047645bd05: A space adventure developed by the small French studio Legend Software, which took over development in the late 1980s. It was originally intended for the Amiga, then the Atari.
descriptions.dos:76b54b0ab1d176df: A role-playing simulation in which you sit in the cockpit of a B-17 Flying Fortress bomber with the 8th Air Force in World War II. The name refers to the crushed service cap of veterans of 50 missions.
descriptions.dos:76b7e09bb27622ba: A biology quiz in five levels, including Systems, Plants, Animals, where you place animals in the correct phylum and class, and Pioneers, a quiz on the history of biology.
descriptions.dos:76b9b83cecde8fd4: A Flappy Bird clone made for Mini Ludum Dare 71: The Retro Challenge. Make the bird flap through pipes without hitting the ground or pipes.
descriptions.dos:76cc4c635602dcfd: A Missile Command variant. Protect six cities along the east coast from the enemy's 12 missiles by moving a cursor and firing anti-ballistic missiles.
descriptions.dos:76d312cb754d0d68: A DOS shareware remake of Namco's 1980 Galaxian arcade shooter, with the original Classic and enhanced Champ modes.
descriptions.dos:76db4a9481b0e66b: You are the sibling of the sailor who washed ashore in the first game. Your father united twelve warring tribes, but after his retirement they are at war again, and you must unite them.
descriptions.dos:76e53d387d389ea4: An air traffic control simulator. Take charge of a sector, guiding every aircraft to its destination safely on a radar screen where planes appear as green dots.
descriptions.dos:76e5a7df2c0f4d54: A Concentration card game with Bible images, meant to teach players about Bible stories. One to three players take turns turning over cards to find matching pairs.
descriptions.dos:76ec0312bf369c77: Based on the 1980s game show. Play one of three contestants in a quiz round and a shot at the big board, where correct answers earn spins.
descriptions.dos:76f79609d9995fc7: The first in a line of pinball games from 21st Century and Digital Illusions, with four tables: Steel Wheel in the wild west, Ignition in space, Nightmare in a haunted graveyard and Beat Box in pop music.
descriptions.dos:76fdbfd04834d064: A shareware keyboard-controlled Risk-like game in which you play the Olympians and conquer all eight islands against three computer adversaries: the Calydonians, Argonauts and Titans.
descriptions.dos:7709165837803ec4: A hybrid action-strategy game originally released on the 3DO, in an FMV edition for the REEL Magic MPEG card.
descriptions.dos:7709d3f06d465701: A first-person shooter built with the Pie 3D engine. Explore thirty levels, search corridors for equipment, collect weapons and fight through waves of unusual enemies.
descriptions.dos:7717a9ff82a34858: A shoot 'em up with a complex plot. You are Trent Hawkings, the galaxy's ace solo fighter pilot, who fights off MicroSol, a company bent on taking over the galaxy.
descriptions.dos:771eb88d7b9bd706: A side-scrolling space shooter, whose Greek title means Runaway.
descriptions.dos:77200726c63b4c60: Nevada Smith, a lowly research assistant, hopes to make his name by finding a lost tomb, but the professor he assists steals his glory. He sets out to explore the Pharaoh's tomb himself in this platformer.
descriptions.dos:7727bef3292816a5: A text-based game in which you lead three aircraft patrolling terrain to suppress enemy forces in the distant future, with ultra-modern weapons and protection.
descriptions.dos:775031391011377b: A Final Fight-style beat 'em up featuring Batman and Robin, based on the Batman Forever movie, using batarangs and a bat grapple with the film's plot, characters and quotes.
descriptions.dos:775a9a55e1ce8e65: An arcade game of guiding a permanently bouncing ball through a vertically scrolling field of obstacles, controlling its horizontal movement and the speed of vertical movement.
descriptions.dos:77634a4fd949dab9: A shareware keyboard-controlled Rubik's Cube puzzle. Start with a solved cube and randomize it with commands, or let the computer randomize it for you to solve.
descriptions.dos:7764931342601e2d: An isometric action puzzle game with Epsitec's yellow egg-shaped Blupi characters. Guide Blupi safely to the exit, a purple balloon, by manipulating the environment in many ways.
descriptions.dos:776619dfc8095d37: Two games, Flashy Cars and Turbo Flashy Cars, combining picture puzzles with a cartoon car race.
descriptions.dos:776619dfc8095d37.1: A picture puzzle in which you unscramble an image by moving pieces around with a joystick or the keyboard (QZOP).
descriptions.dos:776619dfc8095d37.2: Two games in one: a puzzle in which you assemble an image of a drawn car from pieces, and a top-down cartoon race in a retro-style machine over a difficult route.
descriptions.dos:7767e8b47f9e0ad0: The sequel to Whale's Voyage, set twenty years after the crew of the spaceship Whale won a great battle and abolished a dictatorship. All the money is spent, so the four heroes start trading again.
descriptions.dos:77781fa5eaa1865f: A Tron-inspired light cycle game for 1 or 2 humans, with computer rivals for up to 6 players. Block the others with the trail you leave behind without running into any trail yourself.
descriptions.dos:777a132859f67fd3: An early edition of the Triple Play baseball series, licensed by the MLB and players associations, with a manager mode that allows players to be traded.
descriptions.dos:7781de05841b0163: In 2027 the world is split between two superpowers. A spy reveals the secret Cyberia Complex in Siberia where a mysterious weapon is being developed, and you are sent in.
descriptions.dos:7783a1d0e9b99eba: A conversion of Atari Games' first-person shoot 'em up based on the original film. As Luke Skywalker you must pass swarms of TIE Fighters to attack the weak spot of the Death Star.
descriptions.dos:778ee8dcb0d6e592: A strategy game in which you construct and manage a commercial space station, like Project: Space Station. First get the station running by sending up all the required personnel and modules.
descriptions.dos:779104e498f8b2e3: A side-scrolling shooter with 3D backgrounds, colorful graphics and a storyline. A ship leaves Earth in 2616 with 1,000 settlers, loses contact, and the action moves to 4720 when a city is attacked.
descriptions.dos:77a9de935446b921: A platform game in which, as a Super Solver, you recover hidden treasures of the ancient world in four caverns (Greece & Rome, Egypt, India & China and the Near East) to reach the final cavern.
descriptions.dos:77ab4e403111bf0e: A Columns variant that pokes fun at Microsoft's operating system. Groups of three Windows 3.x icons descend and pile at the bottom instead of colored blocks.
descriptions.dos:77b49dc598c84ff7: Play Wendell, a rookie acrobat who must retrieve the ringmasters' hats and stop the chaos caused by their disappearance, while clowns armed with knives and beach balls get in his way.
descriptions.dos:77b9f15a3f1884ff: A Finnish platformer about Pekka the chicken, who grew tired of living by the laws of nature and decided to civilize an animal society and lead it to democracy.
descriptions.dos:77bcf2168cb05f96: Kirt thinks he is an ordinary human until he learns he is the last of The People, an ancient race able to shapeshift into magical creatures. He takes on a quest in this first-person adventure.
descriptions.dos:77becbbbb55c9db3: Sequel to President is Missing, an adventure without a text parser with an involving story and puzzles solved by logical deduction and attention to detail. You are an official investigator.
descriptions.dos:77c5e4545f7c1a4a: An arcade-puzzle game with a top-down view of a railway network of stations and junctions. Trains are released at random, each with a destination, and you must get a set number there within a time limit.
descriptions.dos:77c960fbc77afe23: Another interactive book for kids in the Once Upon A Time series. A child brought up by the dragon in one of the kingdom's four houses is now a brave boy, left alone one night when his parents go out.
descriptions.dos:77d16bddda96c359: A science-fiction first-person shooter in which you are a crashed space pilot stranded on a derelict vessel. Collect key cards, insert them in terminals and use the codes to open lockers with weapons.
descriptions.dos:77dd2c37c35f0bea: A text-mode action and puzzle game. Reach the exit on each level past obstacles like trees, which can be destroyed, and monsters, using various one-off puzzle objects.
descriptions.dos:77dfa06da8db8b32: Loosely a sequel to MicroProse Soccer, with the ball sticking to your player's foot, but in pure 3D polygons viewed from just behind the ball as you move up the pitch.
descriptions.dos:77e023fb30d0526d: A turn-based action-strategy game in the vein of Jagged Alliance or X-COM though less complex. The Grey Cows and Brown Cows battle each other on one big battleground.
descriptions.dos:77e62d52aba4c8c7: Moraff's World and Moraff's Revenge with a story. Dungeon crawl, slaying evil garbage cans, Lesdidian warriors and toxic waste barrels, trading their worthless dollars for real money.
descriptions.dos:77e7ea26a55070e9: A camera simulation over three photographic scenes. Pan with the mouse, zoom with its buttons and record camera movements for later playback.
descriptions.dos:77f274b8481e638b: An Enchanter saga text adventure. The world of magic guilds is threatened with destruction, and you, who defeated the warlock Krill, are among the young Enchanters called to the task.
descriptions.dos:77f95d0de5bee22c: Based on the film, tiny aliens invade Looney Tunes land and the Tunes' fate is decided by a basketball game against the aliens turned huge Monstars. Two thirds basketball sim and the rest mini-games.
descriptions.dos:77fabfe798ffbfa6: An RPG typing game designed to run on an IBM XT286 with a CGA graphics card, made in QBasic with the source code included.
descriptions.dos:77ffc98fee161446: A logic game combining elements of Boulder Dash, Dyna Blaster and Sokoban. Collect all the keys and reach the exit door of each level without getting killed. There are around fifty levels and a built-in editor.
descriptions.dos:7801bcb934b8a8e9: A shareware space shooter controlled entirely with the mouse: one button fires the thrusters, another the guns, and moving the mouse rotates the ship.
descriptions.dos:780b0dea89df04a4: The sequel to Pee & Gity Special, continuing the brawler gameplay. The protagonists work together punching waves of enemies until the last is eliminated, then advance.
descriptions.dos:7810f2c7fc0d7f79: In the year 15432, a mysterious group called A.V.C. contacts the acquisition squad Red Hunter to perform missions in dangerous environments, in this first-person shooter.
descriptions.dos:781d558c25e03bbb: A side-scrolling arcade shooter in which you pilot a space jet infiltrating the planet Kaeon through six stages, including Orbiting Defence Station, Atmosphere, Alien Forest, Capital City and Underground.
descriptions.dos:781e19f267aa738a: Louie, a martial arts expert, must save his master from a local gang called the Martial Arts Posse. Battle through the city to a final confrontation with the leader.
descriptions.dos:7827cc9895a32355: The same gameplay as the original Incredible Machine: solve each puzzle using only the parts provided. It includes all 87 puzzles of the first game plus 73 new ones, new parts and music.
descriptions.dos:7837eb453d314ca0: A fast-paced puzzle game, somewhat like Tetris, in which you eliminate approaching colored shapes before they reach the top by pointing your own colored piece at them and firing.
descriptions.dos:784efb995a460089: Jerrod Wilson gets a letter from his long-lost brother, who fled Brooklyn after being falsely convicted, asking him to join him in Sacramento, California, in the gold rush.
descriptions.dos:785171ac3434b004: A platformer in which George Jetson must survive an electronics rebellion, with the option to ask Rosie for help.
descriptions.dos:787070f6be985835: A 3D Tetris clone. Rotate blocks in 3D to fit them into the pit, with odd three-dimensional pieces and adjustable pit sizes for advanced players.
descriptions.dos:7876fa2b783037e2: A fantasy text adventure in which you play an ordinary man named Philip, whose home becomes the site of a portal to another dimension through which a cleric steps.
descriptions.dos:7877c2e617771b63: An adaptation of Storybook Weaver for children aged 8 to 14 to write their own stories, based on everyday contemporary situations with illustration objects from real life.
descriptions.dos:787d17d4df7c021b: A Breakout variant with two linked paddles that keep a ball in play while breaking blocks. The ball can escape from any side, and completing a stage reveals a gallery image.
descriptions.dos:787fed6d21dae468: Move with WASD collecting keys and items, avoiding monsters, unlocking doors and finding treasure. The graphics resemble roguelikes, but nothing is random.
descriptions.dos:7888066314645eac: You play Bounty Bob, exploring every inch of an abandoned mine. Walk over each floor section to change its color; when all are changed, you advance to a harder level.
descriptions.dos:788a3585432a80a4: A top-view educational maze game in which you race around collecting scattered letters. Two teleporters warp you to random spots, and each maze has a picture of an object in the middle.
descriptions.dos:78924992d4e46a7c: A simple horizontal adaptation of Pong against the computer or a human. Each player controls a red or blue line paddle at the top or bottom of the screen.
descriptions.dos:789e3d055def568f: A live-action video game in which you watch a lakeside house through security cameras and trigger traps to protect its visitors, following events across rooms and timing your actions.
descriptions.dos:789f9bb4cab48515: A first-person Bible and Christian quiz game. Travel through mazes and obstacles using quotes from the Bible, with hints to help you answer moral and biblical questions.
descriptions.dos:78aa7f4b3eb317a8: Buy a rally car such as a Lancia Delta or Toyota Celica and race against the clock on different locations, collecting money and items. After qualifying, race to win prizes and repair or upgrade your car.
descriptions.dos:78ae3d0c6c28e7f2: Osiris is slain by Set and his body is scattered over the desert. Scour the countryside of Egypt to obtain the pieces and prepare for the final showdown against Set.
descriptions.dos:78c418c44c4eb096: Roger Wilco's escape pod is picked up by an interstellar garbage hauler and he wakes in a pile of trash. He must escape in this Space Quest adventure.
descriptions.dos:78cc4988601b6207: A 90s Pac-Man clone in which a yellow circle eats dots in a maze that changes color and shape each time you advance. Hourglasses and bombs around the maze help you collect the dots.
descriptions.dos:78cd20608e8be932: A Polish adventure set in the city of Wachock, famous for jokes. You play the village head and must find your daughter's missing husband.
descriptions.dos:78cf3fae41dd79e2: Fly a Sopwith biplane, shooting down enemy planes and destroying enemy buildings, alone or in skirmishes against the AI.
descriptions.dos:78d0ded8f0dccea6: The third Zork game. A nameless adventurer is cast into a deep dungeon and hears a mysterious voice saying that all the tests have been passed but one.
descriptions.dos:78db8ddf925ab2a4: A set of four horror-themed puzzle games for two players from InFluid Software, including Crypt Tac Toe, a Tic Tac Toe variation.
descriptions.dos:78e726e61057135f: A compilation of Test Drive II and all its add-ons: the car disks Musclecars and The Supercars and the scenery disks California Challenge and European Challenge.
descriptions.dos:78fe8afa511f859e: An educational game for children. Work out the cheapest way to connect the neighborhood to the water supply, deciding what kind of pipe to buy and where to put it on a limited budget.

descriptions.dos:791c0a97927f24c7: A single-player version of Yahtzee: roll the dice and pick where you want the numbers to go, with primitive voice synthesis.
descriptions.dos:791df843d5de83eb: A 2.5D game with no enemies. Wander a submerged space station finding and turning pumps and valves to stop the level flooding, within a time limit.
descriptions.dos:791f516e11d5a169: A strategy board game on an eight-by-eight board of numbered squares. Collect points while limiting your opponent's options, one player moving horizontally and the other vertically.
descriptions.dos:79209e53e47ad6aa: A classic jigsaw puzzle where you lay down an image, such as a landscape, object, vehicle or the series' bear mascot, from scattered fragments.
descriptions.dos:79243d0958d812a0: An enhanced version of The Civil War with better AI and graphics. Pick a side, then one of eight historical battles or the whole campaign from 1861 to 1864.
descriptions.dos:792b9050e35abe9b: A small but very hard Spanish arcade action game with no apparent plot. You are a knight wading through a dark dungeon full of traps and enemies and, it seems, without any weapons.
descriptions.dos:7933375db42d9a6e: A Tetris variant where you stack words instead of bricks. Choose the correct spelling from options at the bottom of the screen using the left or right cursor.
descriptions.dos:79351d41eaec210f: Five years after Maniac Mansion, Purple Tentacle drinks toxic sludge from Dr. Fred's laboratory, grows flipper-like arms and a vastly increased intelligence, and develops a thirst for global domination.
descriptions.dos:79411b5a14254d56: A mouse-driven version of Sudoku in 320x200 graphics, written as a 16-bit application with 8086-compatible instructions.
descriptions.dos:7943b872b0d4a0b3: A Risk-type game of global conquest with nuclear weapons and real-time action. Click countries and invade to expand your empire, with a Cold War setup or random starting countries.
descriptions.dos:794eab4f06c0e40b: The sequel to Luigi & Spaghetti, an unofficial game that is basically a level modification of its predecessor, this time without Spaghetti's help.
descriptions.dos:7954c6319f3654e9: A text adventure in which you are a spy who has to recover the Secret Formula, with a very fussy parser.
descriptions.dos:795e20fc695e55d2: You are an explorer investigating the burning of the Amazon Rain Forest. Natives tell of menacing ants as large as wolves, and you ask one to lead you to a large ant hill.
descriptions.dos:795f4aebf8776610: A World War I flight simulator with 28 aircraft from both the Allied and German sides in 3D graphics. Start a career as a pilot and rise through the ranks to become the most feared ace.
descriptions.dos:7960d580fe0f4ad1: A billiards game with eighteen selectable settings across the top of the screen: eight for side/English, follow and draw and nine for vector/point selection.
descriptions.dos:79617d7445581f4c: A matching puzzle where you must make chains of three identical pictures. Cards on a 7x7 field are face down, each with several patterns that cycle.
descriptions.dos:796b3ef5f75873a9: A point-and-click adventure based on the Spielberg movies. Fievel Mousekwitz, a young Russian mouse emigrating to America, is tossed overboard in a storm at sea.
descriptions.dos:79771746003bdab1: A classic artillery game taken further with equipment production, repairs and high-resolution graphics.
descriptions.dos:797c5bbb077412be: A pinball game with two tables, Rocket and Graveyard, derived from the Amiga game Pinball Dreams by Digital Illusions. It supports up to 8 players.
descriptions.dos:7983ddac01a2c5c1: The follow-up to The Web, with a single complex table in 3D with 4 viewpoints. The goal is to travel through time by collecting crystals across Roman, Prehistoric, Futuristic and present-day settings.
descriptions.dos:7987d382aab39b01: A puzzle game in which you build streams of light from a laser to a target on a field of cells, using mirrors and other elements.
descriptions.dos:798c9ae03fe1ce8e: A version of Pac-Man created with Sierra's SCI adventure game engine.
descriptions.dos:798d8b85ad96b3cb: A wolf simulator. Take the role of a wolf in a mission, such as surviving for a day, or in a simulation mode, with all aspects of wolf life simulated, from hunting to avoiding hunters.
descriptions.dos:798f710fa97cdbca: An unusual football management game with virtually no statistics. Up to four managers lead their teams through the World Cup, from qualifying to the tournament, where tactics and training matter hugely.
descriptions.dos:79a2e175b1e7474f: A small Lemmings clone with a twist: you must kill the Lamers instead of saving them, to stop them reaching the computer and destroying it. Weapons include a handgun, machine gun and bombs.
descriptions.dos:79a83b2c7ca8d471: Steg the slug must feed his family of T'yungunz by blowing bubbles to catch grubs and guiding them past obstacles to the nest. Get a certain number of T'yungunz fed to complete each level.
descriptions.dos:79ac137f6e491151: An adventure based on the French comic series by Francois Bourgeon. As the French Revolution approaches, Hoel and Isa find themselves in Brittany and face a thousand dangers from European to African shores.
descriptions.dos:79bb016534a6ddb9: In 3045 A.D., as Captain Timebound you use the world's first time machine to see dinosaurs, starting 150 million years B.C., and bring back first-hand information.
descriptions.dos:79bd2c5e3cf55767: Based on the movie, terrorists have taken control of a high rise tower to steal $600 million. Rescue your trapped wife and stop them, searching the building for useful items from a 3D point of view.
descriptions.dos:79c0b33ec6bbca88: A text adventure at an abandoned ski resort, SnoFlake, where you play a lost camper trying to find his way home.
descriptions.dos:79c1881414a562e4: Guide your floppy disk through a maze, avoiding dust and magnets.
descriptions.dos:79c4394f9ee632fe: A 2D versus fighting game with cartoon graphics. Seven characters have standard and special attacks, with a tournament mode, single fights against the AI and a two-player mode.
descriptions.dos:79c9abb59376a242: Koei's fantasy strategy game. Six magicians, each trapped inside a gem, are freed from the crown Gemfire by Princess Robyn, daughter of King Eselred, the tyrannical ruler of Ishmeria.
descriptions.dos:79d2ab184899e67e: A horror graphic adventure with a fully explorable 3D environment, animation and ellipsoid-based graphics, in which you try to free Ecstatica.
descriptions.dos:79de6939519b557e: A wargame of the Battle of Stalingrad. Command the Soviet or German forces; historically the Soviets won at great cost, but you can try to change the outcome.
descriptions.dos:79ded09890f59ba9: Oxyd magnum! Gold contains an extra 20 levels not originally published with Oxyd magnum!
descriptions.dos:79f05b1103fdbe32: A freeware 3D Bomberman. Run through a 3D maze laying time-delayed bombs to blow up the other Bomberman, scoring a point each time.
descriptions.dos:7a0553805070e491: A strategy BBS door game written by Amit Patel in 1990, started as a PC clone of the Atari ST game Space Empire Elite.
descriptions.dos:7a05b92986470ccc: The third of Questprobe's Marvel Comics text adventures with graphics. Play the Thing and the Human Torch, switching between them at any time, to free Alicia Masters from Doctor Doom.
descriptions.dos:7a10962970e86beb: A set of circus games: flying on a trapeze, walking a rope with tricks, controlling a trained tiger through an obstacle marathon, and doing tricks on the back of a frantic horse.
descriptions.dos:7a1d41a62e158369: A complex game in which you create your own ecosystems, animals or plants, then watch them eat, evolve, mate or die. You can even edit their DNA.
descriptions.dos:7a21a5e9b4c5f542: Six small educational games starring Freddy the Frog, with simple controls. In Adding, Freddy faces a network of lily pads, and he must move to various important buildings on screen.
descriptions.dos:7a226c8f0053db24: A first-person 3D shooter in which you escape an underground labyrinth full of monsters while trying to rescue your dog Sparky, similar to Wolfenstein 3D.
descriptions.dos:7a45fccc4293106c: Returning from R&R in Saigon, your helicopter is forced down by Viet Cong guerillas in the Central Highlands, and you must lead the survivors to the nearest US base.

descriptions.dos:7a5d162c774ec572: In the ninth century of the Second Era, Cyrus, a Redguard mercenary and hero, finds that his sister Iszara has disappeared under mysterious circumstances in Hammerfell.
descriptions.dos:7a61bb0c87bc6681: You land your crippled ship at the deserted Atargis mining station and must enter it to find a way off the asteroid, wondering what happened to the 200 personnel in the mines below.
descriptions.dos:7a785ddb9fb613cb: The fourth Might and Magic RPG. Control a party of 6 heroes to save the world from the evil Lord Xeen, with nearly the same interface and graphics as Isles of Terra.
descriptions.dos:7a787490745e84ff: A top-down shooter in which you fly a megadestroyer against heavily armed space platforms, shooting enemies, turrets and command centers. You have three lives.
descriptions.dos:7a79ba7a16ea50d6: Collect all the fast food on screen, meaning food that is moving fast, while avoiding monsters. There are 30 levels of increasing difficulty.
descriptions.dos:7a7c9b3cd2ebb43a: A Korean brawler in which two anthropomorphic animals return to their rural house to find it invaded by enemies. Play Pee, Gity or both in two-player mode.
descriptions.dos:7a7f0f237ed24e19: A platform game based on the arcade game Space Panic. A digger with a shovel kills evil legged apples, walking left and right and climbing ladders, with no jumping.
descriptions.dos:7a89caf385293f38: A pinball game with a dinosaur theme.
descriptions.dos:7a95360e04cd6a98: The third Ishar game, where characters can be imported from Ishar or Ishar 2. Travel through Portals of Time in pursuit of the dragon of Sith to protect the Citadel.
descriptions.dos:7a988513eb6871b7: A two-player chess variant with laser weaponry. The goal is to defeat the opponent's king, and you can move and rotate all the pieces; there are eight types of pieces.
descriptions.dos:7aaf3f3fc2c22bed: A sidescrolling game in which you collect coins or buttons for points, with a multiplayer mode and a level editor.
descriptions.dos:7abb6a24722d3bda: A submarine simulation as part of the US Navy Silent Service after Pearl Harbor. Take a fleet boat on patrols of up to 2 months from Hawaii, Australia or New Zealand.
descriptions.dos:7ac1cf9540293628: A Spanish Pac-Man clone with different levels, ghosts eaten during the bonus placed differently at each rebirth, and a built-in level editor.
descriptions.dos:7ac97c6ce18f1f7c: A text-mode action game: guide a character through seven rooms, collect gold and bring it back to the start. Each room is populated by robots.

descriptions.dos:7ad7f428878541cb: The multimedia version of Battle Chess in which the pieces come to life, each with different animations for capturing and being captured.
descriptions.dos:7adaa397ca87ae90: A package of two card games, Gin and Cribbage, and two board games, Checkers and Backgammon. Gin and Cribbage have personality-based AI advisors and opponents.
descriptions.dos:7adb352f360a59d5: An isometric puzzle game in which you save comrades imprisoned in a dungeon, moving your character through each screen past guards.
descriptions.dos:7adcd654e431fbaf: A five card draw poker game, originally a BBS door game in which players tried to post a high score in money earned.
descriptions.dos:7adec47bd4b79b39: A modern take on Cabal gameplay across five locations: 1896 China, a 1966 air force base, 2006 London streets, 2106 hangar with cyborgs and 2207 spiders and bats.
descriptions.dos:7aee0e30709beed1: All the characters from the first three Mortal Kombat games return, including Kano, Reptile, Mileena, Kung Lao, Shang Tsung, Sindel, Sub-Zero and Scorpion, for the ultimate battle.
descriptions.dos:7aee8586c59b4ac6: A scrolling shooter: kill anything that moves or fires at you and avoid rocks and stationary objects, most of which kill you on impact.
descriptions.dos:7af5cd7f855c4c47: A guess-who board game in which the computer picks a character and you use hints such as hair color, sex and eye color to work out who it is.
descriptions.dos:7af66499744d41a1: A platformer in which Bart Simpson must stop the Space Mutants from invading Springfield. On each of five levels he collects or gets rid of the ingredients they want for their machine.
descriptions.dos:7af6f9e929584b3e: Kill endless waves of aliens by flying around the screen with a rocket pack and shooting them with a machine gun.
descriptions.dos:7b0e849c2c6b9ad4: A shareware Wheel of Fortune game for one to six players based on the TV game, with between three and six rounds plus a bonus round.
descriptions.dos:7b11a6ccd2da0954: Transformable Arcade Zone, a Breakout clone with multiple paddles, 64 levels and a built-in level construction set. Each level has a different paddle layout.
descriptions.dos:7b200f55f89083b2: A World War II submarine simulation set in the South Pacific. Destroy Japanese convoys in practice, campaign and historical modes.
descriptions.dos:7b235e4d2345f0b1: You are a silencer, an elite soldier of the World Economic Consortium sent to hunt down the Resistance, but you slowly realize the WEC is not what it appears to be.
descriptions.dos:7b26d3f76f3f2e05: The sequel to Heretic. Three humans who escaped the slaughter by the Serpent Riders seek vengeance on Korax, the Serpent Rider who remains in their world.
descriptions.dos:7b3171893d3e93d8: A 2D post-apocalyptic RPG set after the Great Apocalypse, several months after the Day Time Stopped. You can't last much longer on your supplies.
descriptions.dos:7b33d2a98f24f56e: Recover the Golden Baton, a priceless artifact that maintains the balance between good and evil, stolen from King Ferrenuil's palace, which has caused drought and pestilence.

descriptions.dos:7b4495509edecc41: An arcade racing game with shooter elements. Choose a Speed Boat or Dune Buggy and race viewed from behind, with a multiplayer mode.
descriptions.dos:7b44aac723568b9b: A shareware Missile Command-style game. Protect the cities along the bottom of the screen with two missile sites against successive waves of incoming warheads.
descriptions.dos:7b4acdc0349674c7: Make your way from chamber to chamber of an ancient pyramid, uncovering treasures, avoiding traps and facing various enemies to escape.
descriptions.dos:7b5563729ce1cf6f: A sports game in which the races of the fantasy world of GHoLD meet for the Grand Monster Slam every five years. You must win 9 matches and negotiate two sub-games.
descriptions.dos:7b5963f180ef3828: An educational title with three separate modules for young children: Colors, Music and Puzzles, featuring the Berenstain Bears.
descriptions.dos:7b667a71b139e075: A graphic adventure with a key-based verb interface. A set of jewels and the curator guarding them have been stolen, with Norman Bates the suspect, and a detective drives out to the Bates Motel.
descriptions.dos:7b6c813d601a65d7: A compilation of F-15 Strike Eagle II and the Operation Desert Storm scenario disk, with campaigns in Libya, the Persian Gulf, the Middle East and Vietnam in which you destroy primary and secondary targets.
descriptions.dos:7b7462075ab1b673: A power boat racing game against four AI opponents. Manage the engines to avoid overheating, adjust trim as you go, and sometimes stop for repairs.
descriptions.dos:7b7f5c5d755778ba: A shareware submarine strategy game with character graphics. Your sub sits in the center of a grid map while a big convoy of ships, submarines and anti-submarine helicopters passes left to right.
descriptions.dos:7b8a1957ec7ab13f: Picking up right after Manhunter: New York, you crash-land your stolen ship in San Francisco after chasing the enigmatic serial killer Phil, take on the identity of a local Manhunter and solve more crimes.
descriptions.dos:7b928a299e4e4a98: A licensed Liverpool FC football game from Arc Developments, with a third-person 3D view similar to Striker.
descriptions.dos:7b982345b6d165bc: The first Blake Stone game, in which a British secret agent faces Dr. Pyrus Goldfire, a madman planning to unleash a mutant army upon Earth using genetic engineering.
descriptions.dos:7b9d2806ffce20a5: The game show for one to three players in which you give answers in the form of a question.
descriptions.dos:7ba30baa635e3739: A shareware strategy game similar to Reversi. Players start with counters on the corners of a 7x7 grid and move pieces to any adjacent square to duplicate them.
descriptions.dos:7ba8787eef6aba38: The sequel to Spellcasting 101. Young Ernie Eaglebeak is a sorcerer's apprentice in what turns out to be a training simulation in his sophomore days at the Sorcerer University.
descriptions.dos:7bbc15d9be7d816f: An educational title about volcanoes: their formation and classification, the geology and physics of eruptions, and their impact on people. Information comes in animated slideshows divided into chapters.
descriptions.dos:7bc8028853f4723b: A Soleau Software word game in which you spell as many words as you can from the letters of a master word, checked against a dictionary of over 80,000 words, with up to 8 personal scorecards.
descriptions.dos:7bcee11f0ae89d98: A standard fighting game based on great martial arts masters.
descriptions.dos:7bd2d7669e2d119b: The DOS version of the arcade classic Bomb Jack, released in 2002 by an unknown author.
descriptions.dos:7bd914bb0954f988: A first-person adventure using live actors and video, with a Myst-like interface. Rotate the viewpoint to find items and talk to characters through a dialog system.
descriptions.dos:7bdfe4c6654c66fa: A tactical wargame set in World War II on the Eastern Front. Play the German or Soviet side, with armored vehicles, various ammunition types, artillery, infantry and engineers.
descriptions.dos:7be3d628f796ed2c: Asteroids in a 3D space viewed from the cockpit, like Wing Commander. Destroy a quota of asteroids on each level before moving on, rotating in 720 directions, thrusting and firing.
descriptions.dos:7beaa0918008ed5f: A pipe-laying style puzzle in which you lay paths that a bomb follows. Gather all the fruit on the field, then make your CPU opponent explode against a wall or barrier.
descriptions.dos:7bf0256aff45ed97: It is 1986 and you play the US President or the Soviet General Secretary, commanding industry, covert forces and military might to make your country the world's most powerful over eight years.
descriptions.dos:7bf2cdbe73e8cba1: A 2000 remake in 256 colors of the Spanish adventure based on Umberto Eco's The Name of the Rose, in which William of Baskerville and his disciple Adso investigate an abbey.
descriptions.dos:7bf44b8a8a9c4cf1: A first-person shooter set in paintball matches.
descriptions.dos:7bfb731c294462fb: Elite soldiers Hank Guts Carter and Stacy Garters Pringle are sent to stop General Wort and his minions. Played like Cabal, you control Guts or Garters by keyboard and mouse across static screens.
descriptions.dos:7c0fa66b5a8b918b: A tactical simulation of World War II land combat with men and weapons from the United States, Germany and Russia. Nine scenarios range from open field firefights to house to house conflict.
descriptions.dos:7c1b0c6a77a3cd62: One of the first realistic cricket games, with test and one-day matches and a choice of 8 teams. You set your field, bowlers and batsmen, with commentary and video options.
descriptions.dos:7c1ba52abdbbb4b5: A German Tetris-like game with gameplay very similar to Xixit and Chain Reaction.
descriptions.dos:7c2d0e329b58ece1: An educational game that teaches children about mammals and logic and language skills with 5 decoder alphabets: English, American Sign Language, Braille, Morse Code and Semaphore. You must locate and decode CYPHERGRAMS.
descriptions.dos:7c36a4bb8312bf3b: Help Rolling Ronny, an errand boy, rollerskate and shoot his way through nine levels of parkland, city streets, office complexes and sewers, collecting cash by running errands.
descriptions.dos:7c421632de3bb156: A quiz game in which the computer asks questions on US capitals and French words.
descriptions.dos:7c4c1d6936e4877b: A German adventure set in an alternative history in which Caesar conquered the world and you live in the 20th-century Roman Empire.
descriptions.dos:7c52fa704829860e: A Japanese platform shooter with many levels and enemies of rising difficulty. You pilot a robot that can switch from a mech into a jet at any time and has an auto-aiming weapon that uses rechargeable energy.
descriptions.dos:7c6719643487db14: The evil sorcerer Suzar and his mutated army have defeated the warriors of the land of Anar. You, the only escapee, are brought to King Darius and set out following ancient legends.
descriptions.dos:7c6b50f4f3b9d6c7: A Mahjong tile-matching game in which tiles are matched by line of sight and proximity, rewarding you with images of Chinese women.
descriptions.dos:7c6f8df459a5620f: A short EGA game that helps children estimate which of two zoo animals is bigger or smaller by pressing 1 or 2, with feedback after each of 10 screens.
descriptions.dos:7c835ed97a62fe58: A simple computer version of the card game Durak.
descriptions.dos:7c852af9ad296bc9: A 2D turn-based strategy game like the Panzer General series that covers all the major battles of the September Campaign against Poland in 1939, with original historical sounds.
descriptions.dos:7c978ff17b26ac39: Based on the original Paratrooper, with new features such as a 2-player mode and new graphics and sounds.
descriptions.dos:7c9b4fcb982fe665: A big adventure in the tradition of Colossal Cave and Zork with several hundred locations and heavy emphasis on treasure-hunting and exploration, set in a more coherent world.
descriptions.dos:7ca28c92df9048ec: A kid's game in which you guide a hamster through a maze, eating enough fruit to advance. Beware giant mice, which you can kick or hit with strawberry bombs.
descriptions.dos:7ca5e80128d87917: A party game similar to Scruples where you digitize thoughts, compare them with others and play out various roles.
descriptions.dos:7cc10500f5099574: Europe suffers the same bio-war as in Roadwar 2000. Terrorists have destroyed one city, and your gang must locate and disarm their bio-bombs and destroy their headquarters.
descriptions.dos:7cc18c77d2df8543: A caravan of adventurers heads toward Accardi-By-The-Sea, each with their own motivation: the magician Frobwit, the lovely Acia, the merchant Gurthark and the scout.
descriptions.dos:7cc43e24619bfe32: The sequel to The Legend of Kyrandia, in which you play the young sorceress Zanthia. Kyrandia is disappearing and the high council's cure is the anchor from the center of the world.
descriptions.dos:7cc7e850b7319295: An early tennis game with quarter-final, semi-final or final matches of 3 or 5 sets, where winning moves you on to the next.
descriptions.dos:7ccab2d3b30742c8: A complete text adventure written by an author learning to program in Borland C, the only game of the RoachCrunch exercise series.
descriptions.dos:7cd8448e8e046212: An SSI sci-fi RPG designed by Phantasie designer Winston Douglas Wood, with a huge universe, detailed character generation, exotic aliens and tactical space and squad-level combat.
descriptions.dos:7cf4e6868cff3a9d: An enhanced remake of Tetris: control the position and rotation of falling blocks and clear lines before the play area floods.
descriptions.dos:7cf57391effba206: After crashing your plane at sea you drift to a small island that was once inhabited. A text adventure in the Infocom mold: why did the people leave, and why is there a fence around the white house?
descriptions.dos:7cfadfb5a0fbbb38: In 2147 the first colony ship is launched toward the asteroid Theta-2, but the second vessel with the colonists meets a terrifying disturbance in space. A first-person shooter and flight game.
descriptions.dos:7d0ac6252a98d858: A boxing game with dozens of boxers rated on attributes like Power, Defence and Punishment. Play a single match or an entire championship, with an announcer introducing each bout.
descriptions.dos:7d0b21aa69a34d63: An arcade game in the tradition of Beetlejuice in which you go around a building shooting gremlins and collecting items, with an alarm system, two weapons and various scenery.
descriptions.dos:7d1553b0ac50ce64: A conversion of Avalon Hill's 1965 board game Blitzkrieg, set in the Battle of the Bulge. A turn-based strategic wargame on a hexagonal map.
descriptions.dos:7d266a45cbefbcdc: An odd Korean bowling game whose name translates to Burst of Laughter, from the developers of the Sango Fighter series, with an unusual cast of playable celebrities.
descriptions.dos:7d2f6ec8f8412047: A Tetris-style puzzle game. Symbols are arranged in columns on screen, and you move them to make columns of identical symbols, which then disappear.
descriptions.dos:7d31a627f8c708fe: The sequel to Hoyle's Book of Games, made up entirely of solitaire games in many different versions.
descriptions.dos:7d34105f110729f2: You are a freedom fighter storming the tower of your country's dictator, defended by robots with genetic parts. A platform shooter across three episodes with EGA graphics: shoot robots, get keys and move on.
descriptions.dos:7d3b2619ae5f005d: An Electric Crayon coloring book with 30 Inspector Gadget illustrations carrying safety education messages, with 16 on-screen colors and a mix option.
descriptions.dos:7d42720e03409b4b: In a medieval fantasy world a strange substance is causing addiction among the population, and it all seems to come from one point controlled by a mysterious stranger. Lead a group of heroes to trace it.
descriptions.dos:7d4cd7caa762d329: An edutainment product for creating 3D models of any structure: homes, office buildings, theaters, shops and schools, from scratch or from provided templates.
descriptions.dos:7d53c7b17376413f: An MSX version of The Goonies with different levels and enemies than the Famicom game. You play Sloth and must rescue seven Goonies per stage.
descriptions.dos:7d53e2add1279890: An educational game in which A.J. invites kids to numerous mini-games, including an Arkanoid clone and a funny face maker where you can change facial features or generate a face at random.
descriptions.dos:7d5df04bb7780eb4: A shareware maze game in which barriers across the play area form the maze, and you navigate your marker to the exit point.
descriptions.dos:7d63878db14f22e8: A side-scrolling shooter for 1 or 2 players. Even on easy mode things get hectic, and levels appear to be procedurally generated.

descriptions.dos:8ddcebb5dd8f5312: A point-and-click adventure developed by Synthetic Dimensions and released by Psygnosis in 1996, based on Arthurian legends, originally titled King Arthur: The Quest of The Fair Unknown.
descriptions.dos:8ddef62db597b4ff: The sequel to Barbarian: the Wizard Drax is back, but this time the princess you saved has taken up a sword to join you. Explore the tunnels of his dungeon and defeat monsters.
descriptions.dos:8df571caaa7c131e: An action-oriented fantasy RPG in which Zeus chooses you to leave the Land of the Gods and become mortal on Earth, configuring lifepoints for intelligence, charisma, strength and other traits.
descriptions.dos:8e161d7ad77f92b7: An educational action game in which you are Daffy Duck, Private Investigator. Letters have escaped from their words, and you must find them and fill in the words.
descriptions.dos:8e183b9d32435a26: The Cybercon III computer was built to look after the world but killed people instead, leaving the world in chaos. As one of the few survivors, you must destroy it.
descriptions.dos:8e1c0698804590fe: In 2005, Mortal Coil is a covert agency of undercover mercenaries funded by governments, sent to investigate sabotage and terrorist attacks on research installations. A team-based first-person shooter.
descriptions.dos:8e3e3c66271a7e0c: A reflex game for one player against the computer or another person. Finish off your opponent by knocking him off the platforms or making a platform disappear, throwing a disc as your weapon.
descriptions.dos:8e48945553b32f89: You are a NASA explorer sent to investigate a newly discovered star system and collect specimens from the new galaxy.
descriptions.dos:8e615ea922ae714e: A shareware Mahjong game playable with keyboard or mouse that plays like the card game Gin, in which you accumulate straights or runs to win.
descriptions.dos:8e643231fe6dca28: Set during the collapse of the Soviet Union, you control a Soviet tank exploring Vilnius and Baku to rescue all Russian citizens while rebel armies attack, in an overhead view.
descriptions.dos:8e68d608cf405c87: A multiplayer 3D tank game paying homage to Battlezone, with a capture-the-flag mode and futuristic graphics. It updates the original Spectre with better graphics and more tank types.
descriptions.dos:8e7d75ed2c76acbc: A parody by Finnish programmers of a day in the life of Bill Gates, in which you start with a pile of cash and decide how to allocate it among big business decisions.
descriptions.dos:8e7e8efb318191bf: A fan-made DOS version of Puzzle Bobble that stays true to the original, with some music tracks copied from famous Disney songs.
descriptions.dos:8e90b010c820bc83: An interactive fiction in which you must unravel the mystery of why you ended up on a lonely beach beside a man who eats only locusts and honey, and find the parchments in a haunted, magical setting.
descriptions.dos:8ea0e282ceb657da: As in the film, the melting of the polar ice caps has flooded the world. As the leader of a group of survivors, complete 22 missions of real-time strategy.
descriptions.dos:8eafbb3894f38bd4: The Need for Speed Special Edition adds new cars and tracks, changeable time of day, 8-player network and modem support and Windows 95 support. Drive 8 cars including the Lamborghini Diablo VT and Ferrari 512TR.
descriptions.dos:8ece82af4788da80: Each character in the Hundred Acre Wood has lost an item of value. Collect the missing items and return them to their owners, one item at a time.
descriptions.dos:8ee1de2854581d7e: A coin-op conversion in which you infiltrate an alien fortress over 6 levels, piloting a remote controlled drone that is a jet fighter in behind view and a helicopter gunship in top-down view.
descriptions.dos:8eeeb5f065e7cec9: The second adventure-puzzle game in the series, with two imps to control instead of three. The prince has been kidnapped and Winkle, a reckless jokester, and Fingus, who is careful, must rescue him.
descriptions.dos:8ef7a7ee11b4f571: A tool for the murder party host. Input data on the guests and it mixes it with the story and generates a murder, motives and clues, printed into personal booklets.
descriptions.dos:8f0a328b45171477: A deserted frontier town hides thirteen treasures in its closed mine and Boot Hill. Use a VERB NOUN parser to uncover secret passages, ride a bucking bronco and crack a safe.
descriptions.dos:8f0e6a3d35476410: You are Emilia Vittorini, daughter of Augusto Vittorini, who founded the Industria Torinese Automobili with his brother Tullio. Your father is abroad raising funds when something goes wrong, and you must find out what happened.
descriptions.dos:8f1193f63e45759f: A platform game with the mistress of the dark in two huge levels, fire and ice. Pick up many weapons and power-ups and kill many different enemies.
descriptions.dos:8f15281d9d1d8aff: The sequel to Ishar: Legend of the Fortress. After Krogh's defeat, Ishar became a cultural center in Kendoria and a city named Zach's Island developed, where a monk named Shandar appears.
descriptions.dos:8f21b7536a260dc6: A multi-genre game combining arcade action with tactical strategy, meant to be one of Bullfrog's three masterpieces of 1997 along with Syndicate 2 and Dungeon Keeper.
descriptions.dos:8f2be2948571164a: Pilot a spaceship through levels of increasing difficulty in a pseudo-3D vertically scrolling field, shooting everything in your path. New weapons become available as you gather points, and the music was a selling point.
descriptions.dos:8f32f8db7bb01498: An action-adventure in a fantasy world with two episodes of eight and eighteen levels. You play the wizard Kairtan, who has just graduated from the Academy of Magic.
descriptions.dos:8f34f4621f6247d5: God Jul! means Merry Christmas in Swedish. Help a janitor clear the snow from the staircase of a small house in three stages, scored on how clean you leave it.
descriptions.dos:8f4481b28bb784a1: The CIA learns that giant mutants are wreaking havoc in Metro City, caused by a scientist calling himself Dr. Mangle. They send top agent Snake Logan to fly over, investigate and report back.
descriptions.dos:8f466539921b5969: A little-known Italian Christmas platformer starring Babbo Natale, with an unusual main menu shown as a bird's-eye view of the area and a snowman's head as the cursor.
descriptions.dos:8f4930252545925e: Colossal Cave Adventure, the text adventure first written by Will Crowther for the PDP-10 in 1976 and expanded with Don Woods, in which you explore a cave for treasure.
descriptions.dos:8f5a5cdaeb4e6b3a: A strategy and educational business game: build a theme park showing off dinosaurs, borrowing money, buying and selling dinosaurs and buying fences, including electric fences, to keep them in.
descriptions.dos:8f5a77fe4b3b210b: A pinball game with three tables.
descriptions.dos:8f5c4be3baed5882: A turn-based game in which you play the Carthaginian warlord Hannibal against the Roman Empire, managing resources from mines and the economy, recruiting armies including elephants and besieging cities.
descriptions.dos:8f6e57ed032d3311: Sets of blocks fall down a shaft and you rotate them before they reach the bottom. Fill a horizontal line and it disappears; if blocks reach the top the game is over.
descriptions.dos:8f6e8eb3c975af13: An animated, interactive horse racing game. Jockey abilities, track conditions, horse abilities and race length combine to make each race unique, and you bet from $2 to $100 in Win, Place, Show, Exacta, Quinella and Daily Double bets.
descriptions.dos:8f6fb92b43c49179: You play a woman driving a moving van across the US to a new job in New York City who runs out of gas in Chewton, Arizona, during the town's 40th annual rock festival, celebrating actual rocks.
descriptions.dos:8f779e1831a005eb: A 2D combination of Rubik's Cube and the harder levels of Q*Bert. Flip tesserae, or tiles, over adjacent squares in a simple symbol-graphic puzzle.
descriptions.dos:8f8060b32813d02d: Construction Bob finds himself in Hell after leaping into a large pit and must escape in this platformer.
descriptions.dos:8f82acbad0c2a085: A WW2 naval combat simulation in which one or two players command German U-boats, US destroyers or Allied merchant ships, operating in small groups with full status screens.
descriptions.dos:8f848370705259e9: A freeware 90s Snake clone whose title means Train in Czech. Control a train that collects items scattered around the area, adding a new wagon for every item, while avoiding crashes.
descriptions.dos:8f859363fabaf881: A graphic action-adventure in which a journalist traveling to the town of Downforth for a story is shot at from a military base used for experimental weapons, and zombies appear.
descriptions.dos:8f92f69e398cbb6a: A text-based simulation in which you create a customized fantasy scenario and explore it through typed commands.
descriptions.dos:8f97629a48e56552: You are locked in a castle by the Erlking of Errors, the Spelling Serpent. Move through the rooms, typing each flashing word before it fades, to find the Key of Gold and escape.
descriptions.dos:8fa2d6964698b947: An American football simulation, the first of MicroProse's short-lived series, with the teams and players of the 1993 NFL season, single game and league modes and team and playbook editors.
descriptions.dos:8fab6ba148f1a990: A fan-made DOS port of Hexen II. The oldest and most powerful of the demon Serpent Riders, Eidolon, is the only one standing between slavery and liberation for the world of Thyrion.
descriptions.dos:8fb53fbc46ecdeb3: An ordinary arcade shooter with a side view in which you control a buggy-like machine with a cannon through five levels of enemies, including one where it must swim.
descriptions.dos:8fc033cb7455f6d7: A simple game in which you pilot a plane, blowing up other planes while carrying out your missions; a combination of Defender and Scramble.
descriptions.dos:8fc1855b36fdf978: A BBS game written in 1992 by Seth Able, author of Legend of the Red Dragon. Conquer all the planets, buying better ships, more fighters and more shield power through economic endeavors.
descriptions.dos:8fd1601d8c94a7dd: You are Ser Lev Arris in this sequel to Privateer, searching to regain your identity and memory in an interactive movie and space combat game with trading, missions and unusual planets.
descriptions.dos:8fda0092ad0cf52e: An old-school horizontal shooter. A space freighter of terrestrial settlers reappears with an alien crew who want to conquer Earth, and you escort a super bomb to the carrier to destroy it.
descriptions.dos:8fe895e7fe278f51: A shareware quiz game for up to four players in a trivia shell where question packs can be swapped, with three levels of difficulty.
descriptions.dos:8ff7d0439b9e49fd: A humorous Olympiad-style game with cartoon characters and graphics and 8 events, such as Swimming, 100 meter sprint, Long jump, Javelin and Archery.
descriptions.dos:9000ef9c874ee837: Play Ryu on a world tour through Japan, the USA, England, China and Thailand, defeating two opponents in each country. Bonus rounds between countries offer extra points.
descriptions.dos:9007f39d4ff48741: An early educational mystery in which young detectives investigate a ghost haunting the Kim family's new home. Players search the town, follow clues and use the SnoopNet computer to solve the case.
descriptions.dos:900800e3785f299c: A Dutch action puzzle game in which the player moves a square around a field where stars appear at random. Enclosing exactly three stars scores points and removes two of them, and the game ends when 170 stars fill the field.
descriptions.dos:901c1daa2b8cb6e2: A text adventure set in a castle, published as one of four type-in programs in the book Creating Adventure Games On Your Computer. It was written in BASIC to teach how interactive fiction is built.
descriptions.dos:901dab35fdec1d9d: A text adventure in which you are stranded on an abandoned planet amid the ruins of a lost civilization, with only vague goals to guide you.
descriptions.dos:9022911b06fd7e52: A free fifth episode for Doom, released by John Romero for the game's 25th anniversary. After the Spiderdemon's defeat, you return to Earth to stop a new hellish invasion.
descriptions.dos:903cce07df91b471: A turn-based strategy game that simulates pitched battles of the ancient world, up to the fall of the Western Roman Empire in 475 A.D. Players can design terrain and units and set up each side's troops before the fight.
descriptions.dos:903e3e838c3641d3: A shareware version of Reversi, also known as Othello, played on an 8x8 board with black and white pieces. Trap your opponent's pieces between yours to flip them and finish with the most pieces.
descriptions.dos:9048ed3c2938798c: A political simulation of the Polish underground movement that led to the Solidarity trade union. Starting from the imposition of martial law in December 1981, you work to win over the public and weaken the government.
descriptions.dos:904a865b7d1bd22e: A shareware puzzle game for one or two players. Balloons hang on shelf-like levels, and players take turns bursting balloons from a single row; whoever pops the last one loses.
descriptions.dos:904db052a72eee61: A crime strategy game for up to four players set in a near-future city. Climb the criminal ranks through burglary, robbery, kidnapping, smuggling and more, each played as its own minigame.
descriptions.dos:904df1f090efe6a4: Fly dogfight missions as a pilot to improve your ranking, or act as strategist and decide how, when and where the fighting is done while tracking events.
descriptions.dos:9068c4797b15843b: A VGA version of the card game Crazy Eights, played against the computer.
descriptions.dos:9078484299d332df: A grid-based Star Trek strategy game of exploring sectors and fighting enemies.
descriptions.dos:907d44eb68064890: A side-scrolling platformer in which Vixen, raised by foxes and the last human on a world ruled by dinosaurs, fights to retake the planet. She moves left to right through timed levels armed with a whip.
descriptions.dos:908509a2af9701b2: A space shooter in the style of the old Star Trek games. A 4x4 grid map shows enemies and star bases, and you fly your ship through each sector, fighting as you go.
descriptions.dos:9086a9e9379cb934: An isometric action game with stealth elements and light strategy. You play an American commando on more than fifty missions in hostile countries such as Afghanistan, Libya and North Korea.
descriptions.dos:908f3b7bac9b3dfd: A horizontal shooter that reuses artwork from the Langrisser role-playing series.
descriptions.dos:909a488ca7f039ca: Lead the defense of four moons against an alien invasion as Admiral Leighton. Each mission begins at a tactical map and moves to the combat, on terrain from lava fields to mountains, forest and underground.
descriptions.dos:90b12d12c8d31937: An athletic competition for alien athletes with four events: piloting a ship through time and space, racing around the rings of Saturn, a fast electronic puzzle and a futuristic obstacle course.
descriptions.dos:90b941e87a0cf3a1: A miniature golf game with four courses, Deluxe, Classic, Traditional and Challenge, each at its own difficulty. Up to four players can play a round or practice any hole.
descriptions.dos:90bc342f365c2351: A graphical space trading and combat game inspired by TradeWars 2002. Explore 1,000 sectors with the mouse, collect cargo, battle enemies and sell goods at space stations to upgrade or buy ships.
descriptions.dos:90c3708e4e16db1f: A licensed platformer based on the Hanna-Barbera cartoon, with eight levels alternating between side-scrolling and driving George's Jetcar. Each member of the Jetson family has a themed level.
descriptions.dos:90c5e6bf2d381ea6: A boxing game with role-playing elements. Create a beginner boxer, choose a manager and trainers with different specialties, and fight your way toward the world championship.
descriptions.dos:90c90f665d439c61: An ASCII-graphics spin-off of Space Invaders for two alternating players. Each controls a small missile launcher against descending aliens, and when one loses a life the other takes over.
descriptions.dos:90d52b52a35c3a34: A 3D maze game in first-person view. The shareware version has 8 mazes and the registered version over 50, with ramps, slopes and multi-level platforms.
descriptions.dos:90e1bf9c9f39a78d: A guessing puzzle in which you hunt for the elusive Grinch hiding in a 10-by-10 field of bean bushes. Each place you examine produces a sound that hints at where he is.
descriptions.dos:90e890112485263b: A BASIC version of tic-tac-toe for two players or against the computer, whose skill level can be set.
descriptions.dos:90ec60432713e9cd: A platformer in which Professor Bob Jumpalot searches caverns for the holy statue of an ancient tribe.
descriptions.dos:90eccf4b7bbcbe68: A text-based mystery in which the US President and other heads of state have been kidnapped. As a special investigator, you sift information and send agents into the field to catch the culprits.
descriptions.dos:90f68d40a14b5197: A platform-action game from Alive Software in which Snow White gathers flowers and fruit for the Evil Queen while forest animals attack her.
descriptions.dos:90f800fd4bb37a38: An action puzzle game in which you control a magical orb, choosing from three with different special powers. You roll left and right across each level collecting human souls.
descriptions.dos:90fcd28bb512a3d3: The second Quest for Glory adventure, set in the land of Shapeir. Elementals threaten the land and the Emir of a neighboring city is missing, and you must meet new friends and set things right.
descriptions.dos:9112624cb8cfa5f4: A three-part text adventure retelling the Arthurian saga, from the founding of the Round Table to the quest for the Holy Grail, with Lancelot as the hero.
descriptions.dos:911fc6e846bdc728: A text adventure based on the Anna Popkess book, set in a post-apocalyptic world where guards struggle to control mutated mobs. It uses the SWAN interactive fiction system.
descriptions.dos:912e5d2d80bd3a47: An educational multimedia title made of several vignettes covering a wide range of scientific concepts.
descriptions.dos:913953dcf5c4cd9e: The Carmen Sandiego series set in American history. Search for clues and trail Carmen's gang of thieves through the nation's past to capture them one by one.
descriptions.dos:913a922795941598: A Spanish-language platformer in which Eco-Kid sets out alone to rescue the Arctic.
descriptions.dos:9140578a7a235f54: A Frogger-style game in which a little green toad crosses a busy city street and then a river by hopping on logs and lily pads.
descriptions.dos:9140cff86d280d3a: A text adventure in which Count Cristo, struck by a Voodoo curse, explores his castle in search of the recipe and words needed to lift it. It begins with the Count standing over his own coffin.
descriptions.dos:9142964563c4d715: A jigsaw puzzle game from Alive Software with screen resolutions up to 800x600, 48-piece puzzles, and support for your own PCX and GIF pictures.
descriptions.dos:91451c4f1a4d9dce: A puzzle game of 120 levels in which you move colored bricks with pusher devices so that same-colored bricks connect and disappear. Each completed level reveals more of a picture.
descriptions.dos:9148a07d729f2335: A fast puzzle game in which water pours into a grid of boxes joined by rotatable pipe pieces. Rearrange the pieces to fill every box before leaks flood the bottom of the screen.
descriptions.dos:914b22844b9488fd: An environmental management simulation by Chris Crawford, successor to Balance of Power. You manage global concerns affecting Earth's ecosystem.
descriptions.dos:915f43006f94311b: A one-on-one fighting game with eight characters, Ryu, Ken, Blanka, E. Honda, Zangief, Chun Li, Guile and Dhalsim. Beat the other seven, then four bosses: M. Bison, Vega, Sagat and Balrog.
descriptions.dos:915fd566b5f5fb2a: A platformer based on the movie, in which Captain Neweyes and the dinosaurs set out to rescue Louie and Cecilia from Professor Screweyes. Unlike the movie, it follows its own storyline.
descriptions.dos:91644d8cc4ce19d0: A fantasy role-playing game in which you recover artifacts held by the Mad Mage Inshanis to save the kingdom of Hamnlin. Recruit adventurers from various professions, explore dungeons, and level up.
descriptions.dos:916e7b5237c33481: A little-known first-person sailing race that aims for realism, with a radar, wind speed and power readouts.
descriptions.dos:917d226bd15a4a8c: A keyboard-controlled Bomberman variant for two to four players, played over one to four matches. Start in opposite corners, plant bombs to blow through bricks, and escape the blast before it reaches you.
descriptions.dos:917db41d70b34f16: Catch every falling object with a paddle that shrinks each time you miss one. Each level drops a different object, and catching a bad one such as a lightning bolt also costs a life.
descriptions.dos:91809682791813a4: A colorful Korean platformer in which a boy named Zis finds a letter in a bottle and travels to the land of Lisnia to save its people from pirates. He fights with a slingshot and collects watermelons for bonuses.
descriptions.dos:9182bd63cb7dbd3c: A side-scrolling space shooter in the vein of R-Type for one or two players. Earth, ruled by a terrorist army, is then visited by an alien race.
descriptions.dos:9191eed350e9d3e1: A tactical wargame and adventure based on the GDW tabletop role-playing game. In war-ravaged Poland you must take on the warlord Baron Czarny, who wants to take over what is left of the country.
descriptions.dos:91923945ba3654e9: A maze game that generates mazes in shapes from triangles to 61-sided polygons. You travel along a grid from the perimeter to the center, and each maze has 2 to 18 levels.
descriptions.dos:91a65c65f568a82a: A Pong clone for two players or against the computer, with a practice mode against the wall and a demo clock mode. Each player controls a paddle drawn as a white line.
descriptions.dos:91ad803c70236df8: A Pac-Man sequel in which Pac eats fruit and prizes instead of dots, many hidden in passages behind gates. Items include apples, bananas, doughnuts, hamburgers and shamrocks.
descriptions.dos:91b111443a2568a1: A keyboard-controlled shareware blackjack game for up to seven players. Empty seats can be filled by computer players that follow strategy guidelines from the book Green Felt Money.
descriptions.dos:91b62f3552b46311: A five-card stud poker game bearing the name of professional gambler Amarillo Slim, and the first release from Villa Crespo Software.
descriptions.dos:91b74922b72f0f3b: The sequel to MicroIllusions' role-playing classic. The three brothers from the first game are teleported to a foreign land and must save its people from spreading evil in a large world with Ultima VIII-style graphics.
descriptions.dos:91c25b5cc4a9e7a5: Run a construction company in a city where property goes to whoever develops it first and any means of sabotaging rivals are allowed. Start with a single plot, a headquarters, a construction team and a repairman.
descriptions.dos:91d9e3e0e72305b1: A text adventure that sends you through seemingly unrelated locations: a jet cockpit, ice caves, rooms of buttons, levers and keypads, and an old theatre.
descriptions.dos:91fb474d0bcbfe26: A medieval platformer in which a well-meaning but silly knight, lost in a labyrinthine castle, makes his way to the throne room armed with a sword.
descriptions.dos:91fc7ebf4095773d: A turn-based chase game in the style of the UNIX game Robots. You move on a grid scattered with killer Daleks, trying to destroy them before they catch you.
descriptions.dos:92009b4886e513aa: A simple Hangman game in which the computer picks a random word from a file and you guess it letter by letter. You can add your own words or vocabulary files; English, French, German, Dutch, Polish and Hungarian are supported.
descriptions.dos:920903551311f6dc: A puzzle platformer remaking a 1994 ZX Spectrum game of the same name. Each single-screen level requires shooting and avoiding enemies, destroying blocks and pushing blocks around.
descriptions.dos:920c023f87eaa0a3: A falling-block puzzle follow-up to Tetris and Welltris in which the pieces are parts of faces. Rotate and arrange them to assemble complete faces, which can be matched to a famous person.
descriptions.dos:9216b6d3a66c8840: A single-screen shooter in which you operate a gun turret with unlimited ammo and a limited firing angle, shooting down helicopters and the paratroopers they drop before they overrun you.
descriptions.dos:92187cddeb2d9146: A turn-based empire-building strategy game set in the ancient Arab world. Seasonal turns have you establish trade, raise armies and run your economy, expanding by conquest or diplomacy.
descriptions.dos:921e4ee451ff9a58: A Soviet-era arcade tennis game for one player against the computer or two players together, with player names taken from real tennis stars.
descriptions.dos:9225ac3dc01819d8: A first-person tank shooter and sequel to Stellar 7 from Dynamix. Captain John Alex takes the experimental Raven II tank to answer a distress call from Nova 9, with the villain Gir Draxon still at large.
descriptions.dos:922659718f433288: A remake of Grand Slam Bridge with VGA graphics, music and animation. It plays Contract Bridge with a choice of bidding conventions for both partners.
descriptions.dos:922fc7426f980b48: A 1991 missile-defense game set during the Gulf War. Operate Patriot batteries to intercept incoming Scud missiles before they hit the buildings below.
