descriptions.dos:9241df22498d3a4e: A shareware text adventure based on the earlier Stoneville Manor. Wealthy Old Mr Tommy has died, leaving his fortune to whoever finds and opens his secret safe, so you explore the manor and gather useful items.
descriptions.dos:924a2926b9c4c50f: A Pac-Man clone in which you are a square block eating 468 pellets in a maze while avoiding ghosts shaped like hearts, clovers, diamonds and petals. A numeric option sets the game speed.
descriptions.dos:924a66e5ea889b69: The Taito brick-breaking game in which a Vaus spaceship serves as the bat. Catch and direct the ball to clear the bricks at the top of the screen.
descriptions.dos:9251de4c6cd3c23d: An educational game for ages two to six. In a narrated storybook, help Barney Bear wake up and get ready for school by clicking on objects in each scene.
descriptions.dos:92540adb20276afe: A keyboard-controlled Pac-Man clone with fourteen levels and random bonus items. Ack! Man eats pills in a maze and chases the ghosts Finky, Stinky, Dinky and Clyde after a power pill.
descriptions.dos:925ba47d92d7cec8: A puzzle game based on Kwirk, in which you guide the green hero through each level to the exit. It has two modes, Going Up and Heading Out, which differ in how the exit and field are laid out.
descriptions.dos:925fb816a1530e7b: A rally game covering the African part of the 12th Paris-Dakar route, starting from Tripoli, Libya. Unlike its predecessor, you drive from a cockpit view.
descriptions.dos:92651e25e6286310: An Infocom text mystery in which you are accused of a murder you could not have committed. You must prove your innocence among the upper crust before you are judged guilty.
descriptions.dos:92679cbe86d4a9c8: Command a naval cruiser to defend the Persian Gulf in three missions: Convoy Escort, Patrol or Dawn of Death.
descriptions.dos:926ec0b4e3d3ea19: A futuristic vertical-scrolling shooter. Fight waves of enemy fighters, ground vehicles and defense installations while dodging attacks and collecting power-ups, with Mini Missiles as one of two weapons.
descriptions.dos:92717d2c39c1d0fb: A drag racing simulation with five types of dragster. Control the throttle and shift through two to four gears to win races against a human or computer opponent.
descriptions.dos:927eaf236b60e5a9: A paddle game in which the goal is to clear the screen. A ball turns the white screen black wherever it travels, and the paddle keeps it in play for three rounds.
descriptions.dos:928363be45089252: Guide the green Super Bubble around the screen, dodging hazards and traps, to reach the yellow doorway on each level.
descriptions.dos:9299577c1c08dba1: The fourth game in 21st Century's pinball series, developed by Spidersoft. Its four tables are Kick Off (soccer), Jail Break (prison), Tarantula (a spider) and Jackpot (gambling).
descriptions.dos:929ba2d811178b67: A shareware Wheel of Fortune game for one to three players. Take turns guessing letters to solve blanked-out phrases, names and things, following the television game show.
descriptions.dos:929fffb5aba8b35e: The deluxe edition of Rise of the Triad, a first-person shooter. It contains the ten single-player and eight multiplayer levels of the shareware version plus six new levels.
descriptions.dos:92a98c93f616fe29: Read the patient's medical chart, then control a robot probe inside the body to treat the problem with aspirin, antiseptic or ultrasonics.
descriptions.dos:92bd437d3177946f: An action platformer with Sonic-like backgrounds.
descriptions.dos:92c193c5351663cb: A text adventure in which you play Dr. Peter Basham, a pediatrician treating victims of a smallpox pandemic in a hospital.
descriptions.dos:92c2aca837d70303: An educational car design game for children. Modify tires, suspension, engine and body, then test the finished car in a wind tunnel and on a test track.
descriptions.dos:92dfbde8b1b10ddb: A single-player Breakout clone. Move a paddle left and right to fire the ball and break bricks laid out differently on each level.
descriptions.dos:92e904ee1b862361: A role-playing game in which Desmond, robbed of his possessions, takes a job that sends him across towns and dungeons. Build the party, gather equipment, and pause the automatic battles to use items, cast spells or change tactics.
descriptions.dos:92f65f3c8e7648de: A freeware two-player Asteroids clone with VGA graphics.
descriptions.dos:92f8c27cb40de26a: You are a treasure hunter at a collapsed mine whose gear, including the dynamite, was stolen by bandits. Get your weapons and dynamite back to open the entrance.
descriptions.dos:92fbbb9f1f460fbc: An educational action game teaching math to children in grades 1 through 6, covering addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, fractions, percents and decimals.
descriptions.dos:93078cf02e996d05: A playable demo of an unreleased sequel to Renegade: Battle for Jacob Star. It plays like an add-on to the original flight combat game, with new missions.
descriptions.dos:9314fd4191abc73f: The second Magic Candle role-playing game, with an enhanced VGA engine. Choose your party and roam the land to uncover the secret of the Four and Forty.
descriptions.dos:93256c7f2f9e5cb9: A strategic war game for up to 25 players set in a future where nuclear destruction has left a barren world. As a baron under a great king, expand your barony across the planet.
descriptions.dos:93281ed571f6bc47: An adventure with action elements such as space combat. As a time-traveling space pilot, you land in South America during the European invasion to find the treasure of the Inca.
descriptions.dos:93326d768ee210e8: An interactive movie based on the IMAX film Speed, tracing humanity's quest to go faster from running on foot through the wheel, chariot and automobile and beyond.
descriptions.dos:933abfb89aed7c81: An action-oriented strategy game set in ancient Egypt, also known as Nil Dieu Vivant. As the exiled heir of a Pharaoh, you return to Cairo to claim the throne by conquering neighboring lands and defending your own.
descriptions.dos:9347e5093d04c463: A fast puzzle game in which you steer a yellow cube around a board to capture grids by traveling all four sides, while red cubes chase you through 50 levels.
descriptions.dos:934b3d64c433c600: A helicopter simulation with an arcade focus. Choose your missions and one of four helicopters, the Apache, Blackhawk, Osprey or LHX, to fight enemy targets in places such as Libya and East Germany.
descriptions.dos:934b51083f3362ec: A stock market simulation in which you watch companies come and go and buy shares in those you think will profit. For the right price you can tamper with how stocks move.
descriptions.dos:934d2130aadb739f: A board game in which you compete against the computer to claim squares and reveal a hidden photograph, with several difficulty levels and a selection of images.
descriptions.dos:934d83534f4dcb4f: A futuristic tennis-like game for two players. Each uses a racket to send the ball past the opponent into their wall, with gravity and momentum affecting the ball and jetpacks for each player.
descriptions.dos:936177718344d470: A real-time adventure set on a train in 1914, just before the First World War. As Robert Cath, you must solve the mystery before the train reaches its next station, or events may unfold without you.
descriptions.dos:936aaed31ab26573: A humorous SimCity-style strategy game in which the afterlife runs on a market economy. You manage heaven and hell together, building zones for the seven sins and the matching virtues as new souls arrive.
descriptions.dos:936bfbd79c8b88e6: A text adventure trilogy in which Aarbron stows away on a ship because he is enamored with Queen Jade of the Amozons, who is returning from a trade mission to the city of Silverton.
descriptions.dos:936db355a5d8468f: A computer coloring book based on the animated film FernGully: The Last Rainforest. Choose from five backgrounds and over 20 characters to create and color your own pictures.
descriptions.dos:9390e240717fd210: A falling-block puzzle game in which you move and rotate blocks to complete horizontal rows. Each cleared row reveals part of an animated panel, and the level ends when the panel is complete.
descriptions.dos:9397b0db8e98e3d4: A text adventure in which you are the lone astronaut on a deep-space probe of the Horse Head Nebula. A giant alien ship destroys your craft and captures you.
descriptions.dos:93996e1f171b3eac: A video poker machine simulation. Start with 20 coins and aim for winning hands, such as a Royal Flush and Four of a Kind, with five skill levels.
descriptions.dos:939983052067b624: An action game with adventure elements, visually much like Another World. A lone hero faces a mysterious demon and his cyborg minions who threaten a megalopolis.
descriptions.dos:93b60721b8e9e556: An EGA tactical wargame based on battles of the American Civil War, evolved from a prize-winning ASCII game. It is easy to play but difficult to master.
descriptions.dos:93b7e23237d64542: An educational game that teaches facts about the solar system. You chase a UFO exploring the solar system from planet to planet, learning more with each stop.
descriptions.dos:93c0ed236762fe56: A detailed wargame of the first year of the Korean War from Strategic Simulations. Three historical scenarios let you command as General MacArthur or lead the North Korean forces, plus a hypothetical 1995 scenario.
descriptions.dos:93c260debf4b7f0d: A vertical arcade shooter in which you fly a green plane seen from above, moved with the numeric keypad, against enemy aircraft that arrive alone or in formations from all directions.
descriptions.dos:93c833c33ddb0ac9: An F/A-18 Hornet air combat simulator with 50 combat missions, 8 training missions and free flight. It includes a mission creator, a flight instructor mode and a flight recorder for replays.
descriptions.dos:93ce54518c23c407: The sequel to Lands of Lore, an action role-playing game in real-time 3D with computer-graphics and live-action video sequences across four CD-ROMs. You play Luther.
descriptions.dos:93ebff9a789318ea: The second Robot game, a German adventure of 85 screens with outdoor locations and riddles. A telegram from an old friend in the South Pacific sends you on a dangerous journey to the port.
descriptions.dos:940d9178b1ec0ecd: A surreal side-scrolling platformer with ZX Spectrum-style graphics. Gather every required item, tell useful pickups from hazards, and shoot the enemies that pursue you.
descriptions.dos:940e9ce6629e8a02: The first game in the Rally Championship series, based on the long-running British RAC rally. Choose from five cars, including the Toyota Celica, Ford Escort and Subaru Impreza.
descriptions.dos:940fcb38f7c59585: A collection of 2D Rayman: the original game, its level editor with 24 new levels, and 40 of the best fan-made levels from the Ubisoft Rayman website.
descriptions.dos:9418f21817f2ba7a: A top-down role-playing game set in Ymros, the land from Shard of Spring, with a world 32 times larger than its predecessor's. Build a party of humans, elves, dwarves or trolls, and choose among 10 classes.
descriptions.dos:941c75dcbcf36cbd: An official add-on for Rise of the Triad with forty-two new levels that are harder than the original's. It also includes user-made level editors, a random level generator and sound files.
descriptions.dos:941faac3abb11e79: A BASIC miniature golf game for 1 to 10 players from SoftSide magazine. Nine holes are viewed top-down, and you aim the putter and choose a swing force from 1 to 9 against each hole's par.
descriptions.dos:9425388003cd3aeb: A Christmas edition of the scrolling shooter Interpose. An evil scientist has built an army of robotic Santas and reindeer, and you fight them through festive backgrounds.
descriptions.dos:942de794e65782be: More Lemmings with new skills and obstacles. Three islands each feature a different tribe to save: Classic, Egyptian or Shadow Lemmings.
descriptions.dos:943c3e2b20a28e1e: A text adventure set in West End Games' dystopian Paranoia universe. You play Troubleshooter Philo-R-DMD and his clones, taking on a holiday-season assignment for the Computer.
descriptions.dos:9447c4fd6ec2d544: A set of eight ASCII-graphics games for the original IBM PC, working even with a monochrome adapter. Most are replicas of early 80s games, such as Pac-Man variants, and a Boss Key is included.
descriptions.dos:9450f954f26fb592: A single-player game in which a gun fires automatically in turn up, left, down and right. It cannot fire while the previous shot is on screen, so each shot has to count.
descriptions.dos:9453a8d09de99213: Eggs roll toward you from one of four locations. Use the keys to move your farmer's bucket to the foot of the right ramp, and you lose a life for each egg you miss.
descriptions.dos:945a9d36738aab53: A fantasy dungeon crawler in which you, a descendant of the royal House of Quilan, descend into the dungeon beneath Karkoth's keep to find the magical sword Ramdahl and defeat the undead witch king.
descriptions.dos:945afadf9764550b: A re-release of Diamond Digger with a better palette.
descriptions.dos:945ef28421a62cdb: The game show Wheel of Fortune with Vanna White. Players take turns spinning the wheel and guessing letters to solve word puzzles, risking bankruptcy on a bad spin.
descriptions.dos:946147add4d22328: A Minesweeper variation by the French demo group Eclipse. An 8x8 grid hides an adjustable number of mines, 10 by default, which you uncover or flag.
descriptions.dos:947d79f9a8c726b8: A detailed wrestling simulation in which you create circuits, hire wrestlers and book cards.
descriptions.dos:948009b30d9aeaf5: A mouse-controlled 3D vector-graphics strategy game set in a violent future TV show. As a contestant, you command a fleet of Skimmers to destroy groups of combat vehicles such as Cycloids, Scouts and Defenders.
descriptions.dos:94909aee0f129514: The sequel to I.M. Meen. Ophelia Chill, wife of I.M. Meen, has torn the pages out of the Book of Ages and is changing them, and you set out to restore them.
descriptions.dos:94b18e852883dae1: A Wild West shooting gallery set in the late 19th-century American frontier.
descriptions.dos:94b35ad5ad4e214c: A single-player game in which you play a good blob against the computer's bad blob. Every square your blob touches becomes another good blob.
descriptions.dos:94bc381f58182675: Accolade's 1996 American football game, shifting toward team management and coaching. Buy teams, make trades, set salary caps, and manage rosters and injuries.
descriptions.dos:94d68848bdeb9ccd: An air hockey-style game in which you face one computer opponent at a time, deflecting the puck around the walled table with your bat to knock it into their goal. Several opponents are available.
descriptions.dos:94febab4edea8bc5: Pilot a submarine through a series of screens, destroying every enemy with your missiles.
descriptions.dos:9507582f23139b5e: A short text adventure from Temple Software in which you explore Granny's house. Most puzzles involve finding objects and handing them to the right character with a small set of typed commands.
descriptions.dos:950a996a36729164: Fly the A-10 Thunderbolt II, the Warthog, hunting enemy tanks and destroying roads and bridges. It has a 30mm cannon, multiple camera angles and automated landing.
descriptions.dos:9519a764c7487737: A simulation of the NBA All-Star three-point shooting contest, played with the mouse by setting each shot's power and angle. It has a tournament mode and a practice mode.
descriptions.dos:9521e7bddd97b771: A Star Trek: The Next Generation adventure from Spectrum HoloByte in which you command Captain Picard and the Enterprise D crew. It mixes point-and-click adventure with space exploration, diplomacy and ship combat.
descriptions.dos:95221abd4c858a4b: An action game in three differently styled parts, starring a muscular warrior who breaks out of a castle prison. Codes earned by completing a level grant extra lives on levels 2 and 3.
descriptions.dos:95246b6864a84547: A shooter in which a worm hole throws your ship into another galaxy where you are the enemy. Alien races attack you, and their shots damage your shields.
descriptions.dos:954fbf397844ecf4: Steer your ship with the mouse and shoot enemy ships. When you finish, you get a time to beat.
descriptions.dos:95597321b4258921: A Joust-style game in which a hungry tropical bird, flapping its wings for lift and momentum, tries to catch a fat fish swimming in the river below.
descriptions.dos:955b6155f7adf31b: Ride your bicycle down the street delivering papers, avoiding dogs, cars and other obstacles, and throwing papers only at the right houses.
descriptions.dos:956200ca838b11db: A typing tutor based on the Wizard of Id comic strip, built to help keyboard novices improve their accuracy and speed. In the first section you play the Wiz and match wits against an Evil Spirit.
descriptions.dos:95632ce6bb657075: An arcade game in which a boy and a large monkey work around the clock producing coconut milk. The boy catches coconuts that fall from palm trees, gives them to the monkey and waters the palms.
descriptions.dos:95637c407d4b3796: A football game licensed around England player Paul Gascoigne that combines arcade action and management. It has a four-division Super League of top European clubs, player transfers and tactical setups, with side-scrolling matches.
descriptions.dos:9578d1d39e6869e0: A three-player Reversi game similar to Tribolo, played on a 12x12 board with random point values scattered across it. Players take turns placing pieces that sandwich the opponents' pieces.
descriptions.dos:9579f108fb39ff6f: A pinball-like maze game in which you steer a train to safety with the keyboard, using bumpers, switches and tunnels while avoiding bombs.
descriptions.dos:957ba6c8c2e5089c: A single-player Defender clone in which you fly a spaceship to stop aliens from abducting people. It has a high score table and joystick support.
descriptions.dos:957cc3a11b5db9ea: A platformer in which Jim, an earthworm, comes into possession of a powerful super suit that the villainous Psy-Crow and Queen Slug-for-a-Butt are after.
descriptions.dos:9580e6a4bd7fc492: A text adventure in which the protagonist falls in with the Breakers, an ancient people awaiting a Messiah, and must convince them that he is the one they have been expecting.
descriptions.dos:958bb1662e09e585: A horizontal shooter in which you choose one of three ships to fly against the Dominators, a ruthless force bent on destroying all life. The screen scrolls slowly as waves of enemies attack.
descriptions.dos:958bfec3b650fe3d: A Spanish arcade game about a man trying to escape from giant slugs and similar creatures.
descriptions.dos:959186b8e45557d3: A World War I flight combat simulator with 20 craft that each handle differently, from simple missions to a full campaign of patrols and encounters with enemy aces. You can also attack balloons and blimps.
descriptions.dos:9592513be0477838: A text adventure in which you search for a Pharaoh's tomb, meeting ghosts and other creatures along the way, and then find your way out through many hazards.
descriptions.dos:959805b985019b31: A basic side-scrolling shooter controlled with F to fire and WASD to move.
descriptions.dos:959b18f17bc6254e: A small Tetris game that stays memory-resident (TSR) in DOS so it can be started at any time. It uses only about 4KB of memory and can be played without suspending the running program.
descriptions.dos:95b484548395744f: An underwater arcade game in which a scuba diver, deployed from a submarine, hunts for Atlantis's treasure through labyrinths, caves, wrecked ships and ruins.
descriptions.dos:95b7c8ebb7df92b2: A top-down dungeon-crawl role-playing game written in BASIC, most similar to the Warriors of Ras series. Create a character from seven standard classes before heading into the dungeons.
descriptions.dos:95c6489b3fc828b0: A primitive CGA pinball game with only five bumpers on the table.
descriptions.dos:95c8263c46eb18c8: A hex-based, turn-based wargame of the Battle of the Little Bighorn, fought on June 25-26, 1876. You can play either Custer's side or the Indians' side, with optional alternate setups.
descriptions.dos:95cba9bac4ccafa6: A beta version of an unreleased 3D first-person shooter that has only a few levels.
descriptions.dos:95cbfbd6f658c6fc: A shareware game in which the player wakes in a room of huge pounding anvils and giant spiders from Mars. Move left and right along the bottom of the screen to avoid the stomping anvils.
descriptions.dos:95d1d87df6656340: A German shareware game in which a hero explores the evil wizard Schulzasar's castle. Visit its 56 rooms, destroy the wizard's robots and solve puzzles to kill him and steal his gold.
descriptions.dos:95dd2214a85472df: Tetris combined with Mahjong, with many different types of pieces.
descriptions.dos:95e735c936731045: Defend a castle by moving left and right along the top of the screen. Enemies along the bottom raise ladders at random points to climb the walls.
descriptions.dos:961060a748763b74: A character simulation in which you converse with Tracy by typing, using voice, text and live-action video. Status panels track the conversation, her mood and the current setting.
descriptions.dos:96169e55b7bb159d: An early two-player split-screen tank game in which both players start underground. You tunnel around to find your opponent and destroy them before they destroy you.
descriptions.dos:961c67088e00ad63: A side-scrolling action platformer across six levels, each with a three-minute limit, through forest, village, mountain and cavern settings. Arthur the knight must rescue his Princess from the Demon King Astaroth.
descriptions.dos:96227c9bdfa4752f: A Lemmings-style puzzle game in which you command five alien miners from one of four clans to dig for treasure. Each excavation area has a money target to reach by selling treasure to the bank.
descriptions.dos:9622dade7d6d6da1: A racing game with licensed cars such as the Subaru Impreza Turbo, Ford Escort RS Cosworth, Renault Maxi Megane and Volkswagen Golf GTI.
descriptions.dos:96232c68e4e2e759: Score points by boxing in objects that pop up on the screen without hitting them. Move a line with the cursor keys or mouse to form a closed rectangle, with bonuses for boxing several objects at once.
descriptions.dos:9627158620ecd0fb: An interactive children's book starring Mickey Mouse.
descriptions.dos:962c3253c7e7ca8b: A Super Solvers educational game about physical science. Morty Maxwell has taken over the Shady Glen Technology Center and challenges you to a race, so you build the fastest vehicle.
descriptions.dos:962c969b6904cf16: You are Vietnam veteran turned adventurer Bret Conrad, who receives an old map to the lost city of Quetzacotl and its gold. Gameplay is similar to Psygnosis' Barbarian.
descriptions.dos:964063a4d916cafe: A survival simulator and low-fantasy roguelike set in Iron Age Finland around 1000 A.D., among pagan tribes who hunt, fish, farm and trade furs. Keeping your character fed and warm is a challenge, especially in winter.
descriptions.dos:9648a9b74f17a05c: A keyboard-controlled game similar to Meteor Mission, in which you swoop up astronauts abandoned on a desolate planetoid and bring them home.
descriptions.dos:964f8d010f06bfbe: You play a god competing against another god, helping your chosen people take over the world and wipe out the rival's worshippers. Each god starts with a single human in the wilderness.
descriptions.dos:96597505ee1607fa: A puzzle game in which you help Larry Lontrose, an ambitious part-time dock loader, climb the corporate ladder by solving 40 puzzle rooms. Use boxes, balloons and TNT to reach each room's door.
descriptions.dos:965a680ea880fa87: A chess-like game in real time with projectiles and three modes: Medieval, Great War and Contemporary. The modes play alike but each has different units, from swordsmen and archers to aircraft.
descriptions.dos:9673188f2903c5c2: A strategy-focused licensed baseball game with real teams and players plus classic teams, and many data disks of additional lineups. Each play is shown with running commentary and a wide range of strategies.
descriptions.dos:96819b937ccc29a3: The sequel to Moebius, combining role-playing with side-view fighting. You and Moebius travel to master the martial arts, fighting thieves, guards and assassins in real time.
descriptions.dos:968219810b402cbc: A first-person shooter in the style of Blake Stone. After Earth's destruction, aliens vow to destroy your space station, and you fight through its levels against aliens and the station's security drones.
descriptions.dos:968e214e36c186d1: A rally game licensed from Toyota Great Britain, racing on gravel, asphalt and ice over series of short stages. After each stage your times are compared with your rivals', and up to four humans can play.
descriptions.dos:9690baff76b969c9: A Breakout clone in which you bounce a ball with a paddle to break all the bricks. Some bricks hide random power-ups, mostly helpful but a few harmful, such as lengthening or shortening the paddle.
descriptions.dos:96947f1348ca0de9: A platformer in which Skunny the squirrel, after his trip to ancient Rome, ends up in the Wild West because his mother altered the time machine. He sets out to return stolen sheep and right old wrongs.
descriptions.dos:96a9ace130c48ae9: A 3D shooter in which an evil alien race is changing the past with special orbs. Collect three orbs per level and eliminate the aliens, using a set of both ordinary and alien weapons.
descriptions.dos:96bf3c031eca6880: A shareware Tetris clone in which a meteor spotted in deep space on November 13, 2005 is headed for Earth. Your mission is to help stop it.
descriptions.dos:96c5fbb558c13faf: An arcade racing game with 16 vehicles, including boats, trucks, spacecraft and helicopters, on 24 circuits across 7 terrains such as dirt, inner city and sci-fi. Multiplayer is split-screen, modem or network.
descriptions.dos:96c8f633ed41570c: The original Russian version of Lines. Each turn three randomly colored balls drop onto a 9x9 board, and you move one ball per turn to form lines of five or more of the same color.
descriptions.dos:96ce0e6f507ee8eb: A licensed 3D drag racing simulation with a first-person view, featuring 22 NHRA events on 19 tracks and real drag racing stars. Choose among vehicles such as nitro dragsters and funny cars.
descriptions.dos:96e152527173db43: A 4X space strategy game like Master of Orion or Ascendancy, with a heavy focus on ship design. Pick engines, shields, scanners and weapons for each hull, and add modules such as colonization or fighter bays.
descriptions.dos:96e8fbe3d43818ed: A fast futuristic racing game based on the arcade game, in which you guide your spaceship between pylons and shoot down enemy racers.
descriptions.dos:96f996476ddab6c5: Solve three cases as Sherlock Holmes by interviewing people and using logic and reasoning. It is arguably the first multimedia CD-ROM PC title, with over 90 minutes of video of Holmes with everyone on Baker Street.
descriptions.dos:96fef8807ddec9f9: The second part of a text adventure in which a map leads to the palace of an evil necromancer who tried to take over the world 150 years ago. The wizard Vandard gives you an important task inside.
descriptions.dos:97041851fad2a3fd: A promotional platformer from Nestle, given away in Nesquik cereal boxes. As Quicky the Nesquik bunny you recover stolen secret recipes from a crazy doctor across fifteen chocolate cereal-filled levels.
descriptions.dos:9705eff282323d5e: An arcade hockey game based on the arcade original, without statistics or team customization. Play two players or against the computer, with single game and tournament modes, and occasional fights.
descriptions.dos:9741ef85c6cb028a: The sequel to Star Trek: 25th Anniversary, with the whole Enterprise crew in 8 new episodes. Strange events in distant space, such as dead planets spawning life, call for navigating space and sending away teams to planets.
descriptions.dos:975429bae86e6c52: A toolkit for creating your own 3D worlds with the Freescape technology of Castle Master and Driller. Use pull-down menus to create and place objects, define animation, and build networks of rooms, with a simple BASIC-style language.
descriptions.dos:9758f7c70b883fe6: A Columns-style falling-block puzzle in which groups of three colored blocks drop into a 6x18 grid and you arrange them into groups of the same color.
descriptions.dos:97610d0d50513050: A trading simulation set in medieval times and the Hanseatic League, for up to four players. Build sea routes among the 16 cities of the North and East Sea, with the goal of becoming governor of your hometown.
descriptions.dos:97624b7a3dd902f4: A platformer in which aliens trying to steal the World Cup crash and break it into pieces across the globe. As Soccer Kid you retrieve the pieces in Britain, Italy, Russia, Japan and the States, using a football.
descriptions.dos:977297c98923c33d: The commercial sequel to Blake Stone: Aliens of Gold, with the same first-person shooter play. The elevator is replaced by a bomb on each map that you carry to a security cube.
descriptions.dos:9783741f0bb7c1d5: An arcade puzzle game in which Zoomer, a Pac-Man lookalike with arms and legs, traces the outline of squares on the board to light them up. You advance when all the squares are lit.
descriptions.dos:97899dd5bde0e849: A Christmas add-on for Ducks with two four-level episodes, Mulled Wine and Figgy Pudding. It adds new items and Christmas backgrounds that also work with the original levels.
descriptions.dos:9790a48f18176552: A short freeware text adventure made with TADS to advertise Unnkulia Zero. You are an Acme salesman working out of the Golden Dragon Inn, next to Dread Unnkulia.
descriptions.dos:97a3f8e43760a5b6: A detailed Formula One simulation in which you drive a Ferrari 187/88C, McLaren MP4/4 or Williams FW12, each with its own traits. Rival drivers have their own styles, and pit stop timing matters.
descriptions.dos:97a6f915f61edec7: A keyboard-controlled tribute to Bomberman from Dodgy Posse, with Adventure and Battle modes and three sizes of play area. In Battle mode you face a computer-controlled bomberman.
descriptions.dos:97a9b68a3ca3cd28: A two-player artillery game with a preset number of battles on randomly generated terrain. Players on opposite sides take turns firing missiles at each other until only one remains.
descriptions.dos:97b23d0b4ff408e1: The first Caesar city-building strategy game, set in the Roman Empire at its peak. Start as ruler of a small province, building housing, roads, policing, water supply and social events, with tougher assignments as you succeed.
descriptions.dos:97b78a3688925095: A vertical shoot-em-up from Webfoot Technologies with Space Invaders-style opponents that maneuver across the whole play area in waves.
descriptions.dos:97be49c9b3916c2f: A no-frills chess program with an adjustable timer, a move record and a log in which the computer shares its thoughts and gives the player recommendations.
descriptions.dos:97befb47efd2efda: A single-player adaptation of Photon, a Lazer Tag rival. Blue Squad and Red Squad, each three strong with a base, fight in a maze-like arena, and you control one Blue Squad member.
descriptions.dos:97c2d0c1084dfa00: An adventure based on the movie. As Bill and Ted, use Rufus's time-traveling phone booth to visit eras, collect items and get historical figures to follow you, some only after a bribe.
descriptions.dos:97ca3f65eb2b5e9a: A horror adventure using the graphical interface of Deja Vu and Shadowgate. After your car crashes on a lonely road at night, you wake to find your brother missing.
descriptions.dos:97cb60020d176e73: An introductory adventure in which you search for a scientist, missing after experimenting with a time-travel device and accused of murdering a colleague. You must travel back in time to find him.
descriptions.dos:97ce41dd55fd8674: An action game set in the seventh millennium on a devastated Earth, where radiation has split humanity into four sub-races. The factions escaped the hostile planet to establish themselves elsewhere.
descriptions.dos:97dda1acdf160aea: A platform puzzle game in which the Boppin brothers rescue the video game villains trapped in picture patterns by good-doers. Match all the pictures and destroy the blocks.
descriptions.dos:97df24c4d0396d2b: You are trapped in Thor's domain and must find three missing items scattered through an ASCII world, controlling a smiley face and shooting the many enemies.
descriptions.dos:97e075fdd02642eb: A Wizardry-like role-playing game in which a band of dungeon crawlers seeks the fabled Dragon Sword to confront the dragon Oijngate. Explore large first-person maps and fight monsters.
descriptions.dos:97e5be0cf100d565: An isometric action game, sequel to the Amiga and C64 platformer Arnie. It is not a licensed title and requires fast reflexes.
descriptions.dos:97e65302c16e390d: A Wall Street trading simulation for up to four players. A knowledge quiz sets your starting money, then you buy and sell shares and funds in response to market news.
descriptions.dos:97ec39fa6589e677: A shareware showcase of what ZZT can do, from Epic MegaGames, a kind of sequel to ZZT and Super ZZT. It builds on the popularity of ZZT's homemade worlds shared over bulletin boards.
descriptions.dos:97ed2debb5cb9906: A fish and aquarium simulator in which you catch, breed, evolve and mutate tropical fish, then release them in an aquarium you design. Fish, plants and backdrops are generated with genetic algorithms.
descriptions.dos:980c939f3ef84860: A 2D fighting game and Capcom's first with licensed Marvel characters. Play as Colossus, Cyclops, Iceman, Psylocke, Storm or Wolverine, or villains Omega Red, Sentinel, Silver Samurai and Spiral.
descriptions.dos:981a06c66f391d17: A versus fighting game whose eight combatants are aliens gathered on a spaceship to fight to the death. Story Mode follows the tournament through one alien, and Free Play lets you pit any against each other.
descriptions.dos:982993d885b3f6ab: Cinemaware's basketball game, with exhibition and league play and a full league season with one player assigned to each of the 28 clubs. Camera positions vary, with top-down views when the ball is close.
descriptions.dos:9829ad3d0332a089: A shooter and strategy game in which, as Nikola ap Io, you lead Strike Force Centauri, an elite team founded to combat pirates, as a Terra Hegemony assault on Alpha Centauri unfolds.
descriptions.dos:982de74f7be41f85: A strategic trading and combat game, similar to Elite, in which the Viking Union controls the railways after the sun's disappearance and an ice age. As a train captain you must overthrow them.
descriptions.dos:9835103fb62a2193: A single-player keyboard blackjack game with four variations: Blackjack, Seven and One-Half, Nine and Pontoon, played with one or two decks.
descriptions.dos:983712832465b10e: The second chapter of Yendorian Tales Book 1. The Orb of Zamora is returned but a new threat rises as powerful wizards invade a mine in the mountains, and your band of adventurers must stop them.
descriptions.dos:983d5b30e90a8c12: A platformer starring small blue-haired Trolls. You roam each level rescuing baby trolls, with a set minimum to collect before leaving through the Pigstop.
descriptions.dos:985b9f2201c1688e: The successor to Legend of the Sword. The evil wizard Suzar has returned and thrown the five heroes into his dungeon, and as one of them you free your comrades, explore the island and stop him for good.
descriptions.dos:986176a8ccc9d871: A puzzle game in which a bouncing ball must clear all the squares matching its color. You steer it only horizontally and use paint pots to change its color.
descriptions.dos:986ab791ced94e11: A role-playing game, known in Europe as Galdregons Domain, set in the land of Mezron. The evil wizard Azazael is seeking five gems that will give him ultimate power, and you must stop him against medusas, cults and undead.
descriptions.dos:986b9482b1ee8c60: A turn-based World War II wargame simulating a what-if battle between General Patton and Field Marshal Rommel for Normandy. The aim is to gather as many points as possible, positive for the Allies and negative for the Axis.
descriptions.dos:987bf740c28b22b3: A Formula One simulation with real teams and cars, 16 Grand Prix courses and a track editor. Drive for one of five teams in a single race or a full season, adjusting car setup for realistic weather.
descriptions.dos:988197c145af567f: An early variation of the classic roguelike Rogue.
descriptions.dos:9896bef5e3a321f5: A Christmas edition of Jazz Jackrabbit with four levels, new graphics and sound, and a rap version of Little Drummer Boy. You keep your favorite weapons, but there are no bosses.
descriptions.dos:98af97bffcf543fd: A simple top-down role-playing game, written by one programmer for a 1995 contest, in which you save a girl from a bully.
descriptions.dos:98b5ceb7c5adafba: A NetHack variant adding new player roles, monsters, items and special levels. Its name stands for SuperLotsoAddedStuffHack, and it draws on earlier variants NetHack Plus and NetHack--.
descriptions.dos:98b7a310d298f6e5: A platformer in which a mother kangaroo is separated from her child. Each level is a three-storey structure you climb by jumping.
descriptions.dos:98bef03448070756: A very simple first-person maze game in which you hunt for treasures dropped in the maze, with no enemies or dangers so you can explore at your own pace.
descriptions.dos:98c44d7ab089e5b9: A strategy game in which you adjust four machines, two tanks, a mixer and a conveyor belt, to produce good boxes quickly. There are four skill levels, and fast work gets you promoted to President.
descriptions.dos:98c8cb8da07ef911: A basic football management game based on the English leagues, in which you take any team from the Conference to the top division. Pick your starting eleven, rated by ability and fitness, and use the transfer market.
descriptions.dos:98c91b391ad42c89: A DOS clone of Sega's Columns falling-block puzzle game.
descriptions.dos:98cb15ff19d76c42: The second game of a series by Mirinae, a vertical-scrolling shooter that followed the MSX release For the Day 2.
descriptions.dos:98d0650170f96f47: A remake of Skool Daze with new graphics and sound but the same 1985 gameplay, plus random weather and other effects. You play Eric, a school student.
descriptions.dos:98d2d47b1b6a06c9: A rally game covering the African part of the 11th Paris-Dakar route in 1988-1989, through Tunisia, Algeria, Niger, Burkina Faso, Mali and Senegal. You drive a car from a behind-the-car view along a marked path in the Sahara.
descriptions.dos:98db713cff4f8c39: A top-down space shooter in a semi-3D environment in which you fire rounds and missiles at enemies. You can enter tunnels to collect ammo, shield or fuel upgrades by climbing the walls.
descriptions.dos:98ddf86a944b84d9: A chess game played against the computer, with a set of historical games by professionals. It is meant for serious players and can be viewed as 2D icons or in 3D.
descriptions.dos:98df53e08dacd8ab: The first Microsoft Flight Simulator, advanced enough in 1982 to meet FAA regulations. It gives full control of the instrument panel, configurable for any experience level, with more than 20 airports.
descriptions.dos:98e13ca5fe84d132: A Bomberman-like game designed only for multiplayer battles on one computer, in which anthropomorphic rabbits play demolition experts trying to kill each other. It started as shareware and became free in 2001.
descriptions.dos:98ed67135b140b4d: A Mario Kart-style racing game with unusual characters, such as Siamese twins, a circus trainer and a mad scientist, racing hot-rods over ten tracks with weapons like lightning bolts, body bags and chickens.
descriptions.dos:98f04dbb7d1de09f: The Aliants have conquered Earth, and as a surviving member of the human forces you fight back in the story of humankind's struggle.
descriptions.dos:98f058c345278ab1: A single-player, mouse- or keyboard-controlled draughts game from the developer of Colossus Draughts, which won championships in the early 1990s.
descriptions.dos:990168f19f28eaf9: Drive Ike and Billy Joe's moonshine-running car across the US, viewed from above and behind in the style of OutRun and Lotus. It plays like a reverse Chase H.Q., fleeing Sheriff Sam's staff.
descriptions.dos:9905cbf2b9759b10: Rescue the Lemmings across 120 puzzle levels. They walk blindly toward the exit past drops, gaps, barriers and rivers, and you control them by assigning skills to individual ones.
descriptions.dos:9914133d20eef7bb: A compilation of Williams arcade classics: Defender, Defender II, Joust, Robotron: 2084 and Sinistar. The PC version also includes video supplements with interviews with the original programmers.
descriptions.dos:991e27d422447b53: A new platformer with an old-school look by Japanese developer Inufuto, who writes his games with his own C compiler for many 8-bit platforms. Clear each level by collecting all the stars while avoiding the baddies.
descriptions.dos:992f321d5f2f306a: An early text adventure about a date at a drive-in cinema. Choose actions to influence how the evening develops.
descriptions.dos:9936c5813e0c1c7c: A comedy adventure in which you work for an intergalactic pizza shop, making deliveries across the universe.
descriptions.dos:9938c2707699a03a: A first-person 3D paddle game that mixes Arkanoid with a shooter. You shoot fireballs against walls to break free by destroying the breakable ones.
descriptions.dos:9942d9404eb04a57: A role-playing game of swords and sorcery meeting steam-age technology. Lead a party of up to six from the standard fantasy races and classes to stop the Darkfall from engulfing the world of Aden.
descriptions.dos:994598814c65a298: A light-cycle style game for multiple players, based on the Amiga game Dune 3. Each player steers a worm continuously across the field, and running into walls or other worms is fatal.
descriptions.dos:994f0f8cc09c1b85: A fan-made vertical-scrolling shooter with ships from the Star Wars universe, with no regard for sides. You are attacked by hordes of TIE Fighters, Millennium Falcons and other ships.
descriptions.dos:99565caa4e42bc0b: An adventure set in 16th-century Rouen, where Geoffroi Le Brun arrives for a new posting at the musketeer headquarters. A dying Comte has had his precious will stolen by bandits.
descriptions.dos:9964acd70d85837d: A shareware platform shooter in the vein of Duke Nukem II and Bio Menace. In a post-apocalyptic world, survivor Rock Tempest emerges to find mutated life forms and fights his way to safety.
descriptions.dos:9965147de696c22b: A television quiz show with a dating-game twist. Learn the other contestants' preferences and earn money to buy items that improve your chances of making a connection.
descriptions.dos:99684d71c74f5188: Play a black ant sneaking into the nest of the white ants to steal their eggs, guarded by the white queen and her soldiers. It uses character graphics like all of Tommy's games.
descriptions.dos:997426e4014e92a8: A shareware single-player card game with several patience variants: Accordion, Klondike, Canfield and Scorpion.
descriptions.dos:998a26a744397465: An alternate version of Corncob 3-D sold directly by the maker. Having driven the aliens off Earth, you pursue them as they take refuge on the other planets of the solar system.
descriptions.dos:9991693699aceb10: A Kaboom!-style game in which a mad bomber throws bombs from a high wall and you catch them in buckets of water before they detonate. It is controlled by mouse or joystick.
descriptions.dos:99979a982a2cc420: An adventure in which Raymond Pardon, jailed for six years for a hold-up he did not commit, has also lost his wife Mylene. You investigate to discover who was involved.
descriptions.dos:9999d2e8e7521472: A fantasy adventure that replaces the usual inventory puzzles with magical four-note melodies called drafts, played on a distaff.
descriptions.dos:999cbb88120d803a: A single-player Pac-Man-like game in which you eat food in a maze while chased by ghosts. The maze is much larger and extends beyond the screen in all directions.
descriptions.dos:999f8cf72e9f513c: A platformer in which Ulysses, washed ashore after a storm, is asked by the people to rescue twelve women imprisoned by the witch Circe for sacrifice, in return for help getting home to Ithaca.
descriptions.dos:99a2df997dc7f51b: A pinball game themed on time. The first table is set in a past of dinosaurs, the second in the present, and the third in a different era.
descriptions.dos:99c5c668983d963d: A shareware Monopoly for two to four players with save game, written by Don Phillip Gibson to teach himself Turbo Pascal. It follows all the official Parker Brothers rules.
descriptions.dos:99c6b108ac90c792: An educational town-building game. Pick buildings to place on a green plot, which the game builds and joins with roads, then drive a little car around the town in two play modes.
descriptions.dos:99c888bf0e62957a: An arcade action game in which you command the Starship Enterprise against NOMAD. Fight through ten levels of multiple rounds with Klingon fighters and other threats.
descriptions.dos:99ca600c7ae18fae: Control the Diamond Grabber and collect all the diamonds scattered through the maze.
descriptions.dos:99cbc36766f121c3: A single-player shareware draw poker game. You start with $500 in chips, bet in $10 increments, and may discard any of your five cards for replacements.
descriptions.dos:99cc564ff5dc25f5: Run an upstart car company from the beginning of the 20th century, designing cars, opening branches across Europe, hiring workers and engineers, and building ever larger factories.
descriptions.dos:99d3b5199ba114db: A fighting game pitting a red ninja against a blue one. Move, jump, duck and swing your sword to kill your opponent.
descriptions.dos:99e4869e0689019a: A Lode Runner clone in which you collect everything on a level and exit through the top using ladders. You can dig holes in the brick floor to trap enemies.
descriptions.dos:99e7d9a443dbf3dc: A simple Bust-A-Move style bubble puzzle game.
descriptions.dos:99f4860007a2ccf4: A four-level platformer starring Michael Jackson. In the first level you dodge fans while finding the pieces of a rabbit costume, then escape on a motorbike to Michaelsville to find orbs that transform it.
descriptions.dos:99fa674a58346165: The sequel to Desert Strike. Ibn Kilbaba, son of the dead Kilbaba, threatens to destroy America, and you fly missions to stop him.
descriptions.dos:9a058fb0c36f74b2: Become a gambler in Donald Trump's Trump Castle casino-hotel. Play blackjack, craps, keno, poker, roulette and slots, with a $10,000 bet limit that can be changed and a high score table.
descriptions.dos:9a08f88a22d52967: An adventure in which P. J. Barrett picks up the wrong TV at a repair shop, turns it on at home and is sucked through a portal into a strange world.
descriptions.dos:9a33ad9e2432fb46: An educational mystery game in which you help Jake and Jennifer Eagle solve over 50 mysteries in London while sightseeing. Collect clues and review them on a handheld computer called T.R.A.V.I.S.
descriptions.dos:9a39b35566563210: A game of combat in the age of fighting sail, seen from a graphical deck view, with a chart view for checking positions in fleet battles. It runs on ten-minute turns or issue-orders-on-interrupt.
descriptions.dos:9a39c97668c9e01f: The sequel to Aces of the Pacific, set in the Western theater of World War II. Fly fighters and fighter-bombers for England, Germany or the United States, escorting bombers, attacking ground troops and controlling the skies.
descriptions.dos:9a40d5e999a2348f: An adventure in which the newly crowned King Callash of Gran Callahach faces the return of the sorcerer Sanwe, who was imprisoned twenty years earlier by the Dragonsphere spell and swore revenge.
descriptions.dos:9a5ff94b70e76e61: A 3D tank game, often called the earliest ancestor of first-person shooters. Earth has been invaded and you drive from a first-person view, targeting and firing at tanks and planes.
descriptions.dos:9a7ad41760a8486d: A humorous animated chess game in which pieces capture with digitized live-action cutscenes. The computer player taunts and distracts you, and will steal a piece if you let it.
descriptions.dos:9a912da34d80aaf9: A Jagged Alliance spin-off in which you lead mercenaries through missions in overhead-view turn-based combat. It adds new mission types, weapons and multiplayer over IPX.
descriptions.dos:9a93e595659997c6: A chess program that won the 1989 British Open Personal Computer Chess Championship. It has a pull-down menu interface.
descriptions.dos:9ab47e3a5a1b1451: A tile-based puzzle game in which Chip must pass an initiation test to join the Bit Busters computer club. Use keys and special shoes to get through 149 increasingly difficult levels.
descriptions.dos:9abac22cad04f072: A Cold War spy text adventure set in the border town of Ostnitz between the fictional Eastern Bloc nation of Frobnia and neutral Litzenburg, as the US ambassador is about to arrive.
descriptions.dos:9aca7968e0340e02: An Italian pinball game with 6 sci-fi tables, with music and voice.
descriptions.dos:9acf04cc6c768596: A futuristic adventure set in 2160. Devlin McCormack arrives at the deep space station Cerberus after his son Danny's death and, finding he was murdered, stays to investigate.
descriptions.dos:9afb1cd352c7e6a3: The full version of a QBasic role-playing game with several characters, including a secret one, plus magic and items.
descriptions.dos:9b034ba01b3e786b: The first StarFight title, a cinematic multi-genre game with one short third-person adventure section and five action levels, whose events are all hard-coded.
descriptions.dos:9b08577f76fdb422: Manage a team in a new European Super League, choosing from over a hundred teams from all over Europe.
descriptions.dos:9b14371c0399261d: The first game from Mirinae Software and the first top-down shooter from South Korea. Before each planet-level you choose from a wide variety of ships and weapons.
descriptions.dos:9b1dbb39d5507f74: A basic Korean-language Sokoban-style puzzle game.
descriptions.dos:9b2374156076fc02: A platformer based on the film. Young Simba is banished after his father Mufasa is killed and his evil uncle Scar takes over the kingdom, and he must grow up and return.
descriptions.dos:9b2383a05c97c496: A two-player strategy board game on a 10x10 board. Players take turns placing tiles of their color, flipping any single opposing tile between two of theirs, and aim for the most tiles.
descriptions.dos:9b2bb5dcddcca3d9: The sequel to Saboteur, in which the ninja hero has been killed and his sister Nina avenges him with kung-fu moves across 700 screens.
descriptions.dos:9b381dccf4b4c97e: A Tetris-style game in which you connect one side of a well to the other with a circuit of blocks. There are ten kinds, including stopper blocks and universal blocks that complete any circuit.
descriptions.dos:9b39434e2010fe73: A first-person shooter set in 2044, when corporations rule a fallen world and rebels fight them. Your hero sacrifices his life to save a stranger and is revived in the stranger's lab.
descriptions.dos:9b3e614409b7d879: You are a green worm eating pizzas, and each one lengthens your tail. Unlike similar games, the worm can turn at many angles rather than just right angles.
descriptions.dos:9b42d7776570de6c: A text adventure set after a nuclear war, in which you are one of the few survivors, mutant gangs roam the land, and you must find a sanctuary.
descriptions.dos:9b4b55386127aade: A fighting game based on the arcade original. A Shaolin tournament held every 50 years has been corrupted by the sorcerer Shang Tsung and his warrior Prince Goro, who aim to win ten in a row for the Outworld.
descriptions.dos:9b5602b0eb977fdd: A puzzle game inspired by the Rubik's Cube. Shift and rotate the lower ring to copy the pattern on the upper ring before time runs out.
descriptions.dos:9b5743d51a51661c: A single-player Tetris-like game, the last version, with added features such as banking the next piece.
descriptions.dos:9b739814386571ee: An educational title for ages seven and up in which Rayman teaches numeracy and literacy. The games match Volume 1 but with more difficult questions.
descriptions.dos:9b7511445ab4615c: A medieval war strategy game and role-playing game covering all of Middle Earth. Play alternates between overhead maps with real-time strategic control and scrolling wilderness screens for combat.
descriptions.dos:9b951e8899505118: Start with a basic Lamborghini and $6000 and rise through the 4 racing divisions across 60 American racetracks. Each division has 20 rivals, with up to 3 in each race.
descriptions.dos:9b961f021af1988d: The game show Family Feud. Two families compete to guess the five most popular survey answers to a question, scoring points for the number of people who gave the same answer.
descriptions.dos:9b96b0f4caa38d73: A first-person shooting gallery game based on a South Korean fantasy-futuristic film of the same name.
descriptions.dos:9b9ef1d46c1a6104: Run a transport company from 1930, in the midst of the Great Depression, building an empire of trains, ships, lorries, planes and helicopters as technology evolves. Play alone or against computer rivals.
descriptions.dos:9baeac8993bcd132: A set of 20 simple games, including cards, shooting, billiards, cups and Tetris. It has arcade, travel, versus and practice modes for up to two players, and supports PC Gun.
descriptions.dos:9bbb5bbf73f93800: A single-player keyboard-controlled variant of Star Trek with nine difficulty levels and an autoplay mode that plays itself until you take over.
descriptions.dos:9bc4d6be29bdd1b3: A baseball game with teams from different eras, such as those with Babe Ruth and Willie Mays, and camera angles and TV-style presentation.
descriptions.dos:9bc64f8e97af80f3: An arcade Formula 1 race with some simulation elements. Run a single race, a series or a championship, with settings such as the number of participants.
descriptions.dos:9bd4d994f2ef44f2: An adventure in which you help the treasure hunter Killian search for the lost dwarven kingdom of Dol Armaeth, overrun by evil after its wise king died. The areas are visited in a linear order.
descriptions.dos:9bdaf955d4384eab: An educational simulation about volcanoes and the Mount Saint Helens eruption, in three parts to be taken in order, including a survival simulation.
descriptions.dos:9bdb38bdfbfc1c0e: A soccer management simulation that emphasizes psychology. As manager you control strategy, half-time pep talks and PR moves to improve public perception.
descriptions.dos:9be8a3857d199035: A text adventure in which you look for the leprechaun's pot of gold at the end of the rainbow, starting in your own bedroom apartment and roaming the streets, woods and caves.
descriptions.dos:9bea6b9d7ea95c45: A World War II simulation of the B-17 bomber group, the 306th Bomb Group. It covers training, the move to Thurleigh, England, and twenty-five missions, starting as a second lieutenant with few flight hours.
descriptions.dos:9bea737581cecc40: A text adventure in which your ship has crash-landed on a hostile alien planet and you must gather parts inside a deserted alien ship to get off.
descriptions.dos:9bf3a5f932c6ea84: An artillery game in the vein of Worms or Scorched Earth, featuring manly squirrels.
descriptions.dos:9bfa4f46027c8e83: The first adventure of Sir Ramic Hobbs, a drunken and dimwitted knight bound to rescue a princess from a gorilla. A disembodied wizard narrates and advises, in a game full of insult jokes.
descriptions.dos:9bfb794d46bdfec0: A shareware single-player game of Nim against the computer. You can change the rule so that the winner is the one who makes the last legal move.
descriptions.dos:9bfe600f9694d06e: A top-down arcade game like Gauntlet in which Storm and a Wizard friend rescue Storm's wife Corrine from the lab of Una Cum. Kill monsters and collect treasure, alone or with a second player.
descriptions.dos:9bff7f4fc1229447: A first-person space shooter in which you operate a turret on a spaceship, defending it from enemy ships and asteroids with limited rockets and a main weapon that shares energy with the shields.
descriptions.dos:9c0759bb4382ac1b: An early collection of talking story books for children.
descriptions.dos:9c09151f5b264f2e: You play a small green creature who must climb eight towers to blow them up, as they are poisoning the water of potential colony planets. You make your way up via walkways around the outside.
descriptions.dos:9c0d7b6b6986c1d8: An epic role-playing game set in medieval Germany. Take a premade party or create characters by choosing career paths from age 10, with more time in a career making them better.
descriptions.dos:9c0dd15c5bbebb95: A cartoony side-scroller in which a Viking child frees friends and family held by the god Loki in Valhalla. Fight through 16 levels, with shops where you can buy items.
descriptions.dos:9c1faf396b89a7fc: A shareware card game for one to seven players, with the computer filling in for missing players. It is a trick-taking game in which you bid how many tricks you will take and score for hitting exactly that number.
descriptions.dos:9c315680fb9c81c8: A real-time strategy game in which humans sent to prepare Planet X3 for colonization find an alien race, the Protoids, has also landed. Help from Earth is at least 13 years away.
descriptions.dos:9c31da52ceb54178: The sequel to Defender. Rescue humanoids before Landers turn them into Mutants, now carrying them to safety through the Stargate, which also warps you to the nearest humanoid in danger.
descriptions.dos:9c379c937e520248: A platformer in which Tiny Goodbite, one of the California Raisins, rescues his captured friends from a cereal factory. Climb and jump through many floors, collecting a key on each level.
descriptions.dos:9c39ed2fcc6d98bf: Two programs in one: Desert Storm, a multimedia database about the Gulf War including the Pentagon's official report, and Coalition Command, a strategy game.
descriptions.dos:9c427dfd014a7c84: Build influence in a fictional city's criminal underworld while pursuing political power. Manage money, recruit helpers, buy property and vehicles, and take part in overhead action sequences against rivals.
descriptions.dos:9c439e98e520d99c: MiraCom's supercomputer has taken over a corporation and threatens to destroy Paris. As the fighter pilot Blue Arrow, you pilot a cybership through eleven levels.
descriptions.dos:9c4555aa2c93d68c: A keyboard-controlled ASCII shooter. Pirates of the mad Emperor Louis the 30th have captured your friend Jean, and you pilot an armed hovercraft through seven islands destroying missile towers to rescue him.
descriptions.dos:9c4792d985922265: An educational game in which the Berenstain Bears teach young children about letters.
descriptions.dos:9c49de65d818cd74: An educational game teaching kids about Australian geography and history and about major diseases. You play a doctor and pilot for the Royal Flying Doctor Service.
descriptions.dos:9c4c6ed27c5631bf: A roguelike role-playing game by Erno Tuomainen, set in the fantasy world of Salmorria, where you are a burly adventurer seeking quests and gold.
descriptions.dos:9c56344491d209c9: Lead your country's space program in a race to the moon against a competing superpower. Develop and make safe your hardware, choose your astronauts, and get them there.
descriptions.dos:9c595d526336e79b: A Danish arcade game sponsored by Unibank. You play a seal swimming through coastal waters, avoiding fishing nets, stones and barrels, and periodically surfacing as an air gauge decreases.
descriptions.dos:9c5efbab3b941630: A platform and puzzle game in which you operate an unconventional machine at a toy company, cranking out action figures from Star Wars, Indiana Jones and LucasArts games to meet a quota each night.
descriptions.dos:9c73b62725f41ec8: Patrol planets in both a jeep and a helicopter, destroying enemy units and obstacles. The jeep has more hit points, and in two-player mode the helicopter can help the jeep.
descriptions.dos:9c79c534290880e6: The second part of a series of rare French puzzle games for very young children from Colorado Technologies, teaching color shades and geometric shapes.
descriptions.dos:9c7ca7b48c37e8ab: A first-person shooter based on the first three Alien films. As Lt. Ripley you play three sections, the LV426 colony, the prison planet and the derelict ship, with about ten missions each.
descriptions.dos:9c7e6e1f49a7e9db: Command a lunar base. Supply oxygen, water, power, heat and shelter for the colony, starting from a bare mineral-rich lunar plain.
descriptions.dos:9c848eccb057fe7e: A text adventure based on Arthur C. Clarke's novel. A giant asteroid approaching Earth proves to be an alien starship, and as commander of the Endeavor you must rendezvous with and explore it.
descriptions.dos:9c90ed0396b748e0: An enhanced Sensible Soccer with virtually every important soccer league, with multiple divisions in many countries, all major international competitions, and a career mode.
descriptions.dos:9c9f0bc39bc736c5: An arcade space shooter set in heavily defended underground caverns with wind tunnels, fire-walls and lakes. Use your tractor beam to recover stolen nuclear pods and carry them to the surface.
descriptions.dos:9cb3086f6e9bd886: The sequel to The 7th Guest, with improved video compression. You play Carl Denning, boyfriend of the reporter Robin Morales, who has mysteriously vanished.
descriptions.dos:9cbbdd7ebed3cee3: A Snake variant in which you guide a snake across a board to eat digits, growing longer. Eat 9 digits for 10 points each to finish a level, and hitting a wall, obstacle or your own tail costs a life.
descriptions.dos:9cbc78483871e215: A city-building strategy game with cartoony graphics and gentle humor. Choose a starting point with flat land and resources, and compete for supremacy with up to 3 others.
descriptions.dos:9cc177a2a3bc4058: A five-level hack-and-slash game with a boss at the end of each level. Fight flying demons, chimeras, valkyries and skeletons with axes, maces and fire weapons to save the land of Lograth.
descriptions.dos:9ccdd6800c47dfb5: A text adventure in which the great wizard Zot has left behind a castle full of monsters, traps and treasures, including the orb of power. You are an adventurer in search of the orb and other treasure.
descriptions.dos:9cd2dbd1710506d2: A racing game licensed from Speed Racer. All the main characters appear, including Racer X, Pops, Trixie, Spritle and Chim-Chim, and you play Speed Racer.
descriptions.dos:9cd8709e30ddaf0b: A detailed golf simulation endorsed by Greg Norman, with two courses and 3D modeling of ball lie and swing style. Ball effects, weather and wind are optional, and match play and stroke play are offered.
descriptions.dos:9cdd07d22ce19168: An action game in which aliens who watched Earth's wars as television drop modern weapons on past eras, and a British scientist who discovers the conspiracy sets out to stop them.
descriptions.dos:9cea702011f86974: A turn-based space conquest game. Start from a single system, harvest metals to build ships, and claim more worlds, with each system also contributing to research.
descriptions.dos:9ceb3c7db1f160d8: A game based on a children's TV game show. Two contestants compete in stunts and trivia, and the winner gathers prizes in a maze.
descriptions.dos:9ced908094ba9027: A squash simulation from Krisalis with accurate rules, an isometric court and legal shot requirements. It offers three ball speeds, variable match lengths and an easy mode.
descriptions.dos:9ceef419de12417c: Pedestrians keep walking toward gaps in a bridge, and you stop them by blocking the gaps instantly with a keypress. Levels up to 6 have three gaps and later ones four.
descriptions.dos:9cf3744ac3276e68: A complex Tetris variant, an expert-level Welltris in which the well is a cylinder, or tube, instead of a cube.
descriptions.dos:9cfe35c86fd6d9a4: Probe the sea floor for treasure through 10 levels, with unlimited spears against sharks, killer clams and baby guppies while watching your air gauge.
descriptions.dos:9cfeab52c1282084: A turn-based strategy game in a fantasy world with steampunk elements. The Shadowlord has conquered most of the world, and you are summoned as one of four heroes to free it.
descriptions.dos:9d01984f77e6d9f8: A game closely modeled on Out of this World. A man walking in the woods is abducted by anthropomorphic biorobots, their ship crashes on another planet, and the survivor explores it avoiding hostile creatures.
descriptions.dos:9d035296321f31f7: A strategic football simulation focused on coaching. Draft from current or classic teams, then build coaching strategies for the computer to run or call plays yourself, with no direct control of the players.
descriptions.dos:9d03b6bd5be5b21b: An adventure in a Victorian mansion once home to the eccentric Uppingham family, where at least seven fabulous jewels are rumored to be hidden.
descriptions.dos:9d1e5399a12fc739: A Snake-type game in which you prospect for diamonds guarded by ghosts that march across the screen in tight horizontal ranks. You must squirm past them and grab the gems.
descriptions.dos:9d1e9523a51f5b7d: An adventure set in 1993 at a performance of The Phantom of the Opera, where a chandelier crashes onto the crowd. You play detective Raoul Montand, asked for help by his friend.
descriptions.dos:9d22fa9f97a8de86: An adventure set in August 1991, days before the USSR collapses. As KGB officer Maksim Rukov in Department P, you investigate corruption and root out double agents, in an engine based on Cryo's Dune.
descriptions.dos:9d4a76f7db9bed9a: A video game take on the tilting-maze toy. Roll a steel ball through the maze while enemy balls chase and explode on contact, avoiding explosive traps, trap doors and electric sensors.
descriptions.dos:9d5445c4bd3d3947: A TRS-80 BASIC text adventure from 1983, the middle of a trilogy between Project Triad and Codename Intrepid. It builds puzzles around math and logic, in one section even requiring a text adventure played inside the adventure.
descriptions.dos:9d5dfcf474c22b11: A puzzle game like The Fool's Errand. Follow the Mallard family to all 50 states, solving puzzles at two tourist traps in each to find souvenirs needed for the final puzzle.
descriptions.dos:9d643bf251c63853: A side-scrolling action game like Earthworm Jim in which you control the duck Crazy Drake through six episodes. Evil Dr. FoulBrain has stolen the Sacred GoldenEgg from his palace in LoonVille.
descriptions.dos:9d707cc1bcd5d0c6: A shareware educational tile-matching game on a grid. Click cells to flip tiles revealing colors, letters or numbers, and match them to reveal all the tiles.
descriptions.dos:9d721d4f5ca0e97c: A puzzle game with 40 multi-screen puzzles, 15 in the shareware version, of up to 200 screens each. Get from a white cone to a green cone, pushing gray cylinders or, in the registered version, sliding gold cylinders.
descriptions.dos:9d75d4d5dfba126c: A shareware Trivial Pursuit-style game. The computer simulates the dice roll, moves the player, announces the category and asks a question.
descriptions.dos:9d7a3387c67ed95d: Steel Panthers World War II, an authorized stand-alone expansion for SSI's Steel Panthers II. It has several hundred scenarios, mostly from World War II and some from the interwar period, plus campaigns.
descriptions.dos:9d980a88efa8445d: A 3D simulation by Alessandro Ghignola, who went on to create Noctis. It uses blue wireframe graphics at 320x200 and was originally in Italian.
descriptions.dos:9d9d2a41bd2b1aa7: A graphic adventure with a point-and-click icon interface, the sequel to Innocent Until Caught. Play either the macho Jack or the tough feminist Ysanne on another adventure to save the galaxy.
descriptions.dos:9da0dc36d6199976: An adventure in which you play American secret agent Jon Daring on January 1, 2000. British Intelligence calls him to London to infiltrate and stop a threat.
descriptions.dos:9da13af41ad1fe70: Move a red circle around the screen with WASD to avoid white circles. You can only see them in your line of sight, and they can lose sight of you too.
descriptions.dos:9db029b644c57802: A mid-90s economic simulation of an airline company. You start owning 100% of a stock corporation with a few million dollars, buy airplanes and define routes, ticket prices and loads on a world map.
descriptions.dos:9db8242770d1ad4d: A Bible-themed Concentration game about God and Jesus, for one to three players. Match pairs of cards, and the player with the most pairs wins.
descriptions.dos:9dc04c13657f7ec4: A pinball game in which you are the ball itself, influencing your roll direction and horizontal orientation with the arrow keys.
descriptions.dos:9ddd81df5521af24: The follow-up to Aftershock for Quake, a compilation of over 500 single-player and deathmatch maps, nearly a quarter of them exclusive, and more than 100 QuakeC patches, with a basic front-end.
descriptions.dos:9de55451c876e13c: A VGA remake with mouse support and digitized sounds of a 1989 educational strategy game about the Norman Conquest of England in the 11th century.
descriptions.dos:9dea93ab6a3812b5: A CD re-release of the point-and-click adventure Daughter of Serpents, with a few new scenes and without character generation. You are a visitor on a business trip to an ancient city, where a murder occurs.
descriptions.dos:9debc24811289544: A text adventure that begins at midnight in the center of a medieval castle full of traps and dangers. You have no possessions and must escape through observation and persistence.
descriptions.dos:9df3427fd8e9a80c: A fighting game in which martial artist Oolong seeks to become Grand Master of Kung-Fu in his father's honor, facing skilled martial artists one on one in side-view battles, with punches and kicks.
descriptions.dos:9df667ec8ec1b464: The sequel to Livingstone Supongo. Dr. Livingstone must be rescued again, through two worlds with savage animals, hostile natives and deadly traps.
descriptions.dos:9dfe9e0a8b425443: A Cold War spy adventure set in Germany. As an American spy, you must recover stolen NATO defense plans, beginning in your apartment with a computer, bugging equipment and an answerphone.
descriptions.dos:9e09ce8f2568a58d: A mouse-driven adventure in which you are transported to the BorderWorld. Click N, E, W or S to move, and each destination displays a text description.
descriptions.dos:9e0c4487e877332a: A Settlers-style strategy game in which you build a local economy with housing, food and power before attacking other nations to rule the world. You can pick environmental settings as in Civilization.
descriptions.dos:9e12e9c546fdec88: A Game Boy-style Tetris in under 3 KB. It has only the classic A-type mode: move, rotate and drop falling pieces, and clear complete lines, with the action speeding up.
descriptions.dos:9e247eab763bf0f0: A combination of the computer game Life with ideas from dogfighting and cockfighting, simulating seven life forms that fight for survival. It has animated 16-color graphics and sound.
descriptions.dos:9e26786779a06c30: A Linux distribution building simulator. Analyze and select software packages, fix bugs, manage volunteers and paid staff, and keep your distro's size reasonable.
descriptions.dos:9e27ab9681d406db: Save the maiden from the dungeon in a text adventure with a two-word parser.
descriptions.dos:9e3a54836651ca28: A tactical starship simulation of the struggle among Star Trek nations. Take command of a fleet or a single ship from the Federation, Romulans, Klingons or Orions against computer opponents.
descriptions.dos:9e3abfe3de9c16b9: A mouse-driven starship command simulation in which you assign ships and captains to task forces while directly controlling a flagship, with an interface like Star Trek: The Next Generation's LCARS.
descriptions.dos:9e400961f543482d: A Pac-Man variant in which Jr. eats all the dots in a much larger scrolling maze while avoiding four ghosts. Bonus items appear from time to time.
descriptions.dos:9e460a8c08388a7a: A fan-made version of the game show Wheel of Fortune.
descriptions.dos:9e4a977bf38b1de0: A miner is caved in and must find the emergency exit that leads to the upper levels. The exit is welded shut, so he has to find a way to open it.
descriptions.dos:9e4d322ac26a1606: A two-player shareware game in which players catapult cows at each other. Catapults can be angled right or left and moved forward, but not backward.
descriptions.dos:9e51d4844c25c325: A conversion of the arcade game Lunar Lander. Land the spacecraft on the pad by adjusting thrust and tilting left or right, and a descent that is too fast crashes the rocket.
descriptions.dos:9e5b66b7a01c6894: An educational game for ages 3 to 6 with a keyboard template of two blue lines dividing the keyboard in four. You press keys above, below, left or right of the lines when asked.
descriptions.dos:9e5d5e9ad8e25430: A BBS door game spun off from Legend of the Red Dragon, with silly fantasy and expanded gameplay options and side-shows in the vein of Usurper.
descriptions.dos:9e63a2430c017686: A fantasy role-playing game by Howard Feldman inspired by Pool of Radiance, Shard of Spring and Bard's Tale, following Dungeons and Dragons rules. It takes at least 60 hours to finish.
descriptions.dos:9e6a99de69a13816: An adventure in which a window cleaner in 1989 finds a secret passage to a time machine and alien documents. He is transported to 1304 to rescue someone.
descriptions.dos:9e6eed708dfe1ad2: A cancelled first-person shooter in development at Mindscape in 1995-96, which would have been among the few shooters set in the Warhammer world.
descriptions.dos:9e7c6d525ffc19c4: A Tetris variant for one or two players with handmade sounds.
descriptions.dos:9e86f7d8014a911f: One of the oldest chess games, developed by David Kittinger in 1979, with a 1984 DOS version. It uses black-and-white CGA graphics and standard chess notation typed on the keyboard.
descriptions.dos:9e8a90fca8b61894: A graphic role-playing game by Martin Richardson in which you search for diamonds, emeralds and magic rings while fighting goblins, ghosts and other fiends.
descriptions.dos:9e8aec942dd7a307: A soccer management simulation, the first in ESP Software's football manager series. Take control of a team from the four English divisions, with cups, stadium improvements, finances, training, sponsorships, contracts and scouts.
descriptions.dos:9e9a53ab49ada662: A mouse-controlled puzzle in which a picture is broken into pieces and you reassemble it by swapping two pieces at a time, with a chime when a piece lands correctly.
descriptions.dos:9e9c5cff9f62ebd9: A real-time strategy game in which you fight for control of sectors, some with factories that produce units. Touch a sector's flag to claim it, and use six robot types with different armaments, armor and speed.
descriptions.dos:9e9ce29078d89fa1: Choose from five character classes, Paladin, Necromancer, Barbarian, Zen-Druid or Shadowy Tracker, and explore the three levels of the dungeon Ebon Titan to face the boss Titan himself.
descriptions.dos:9ea10ed80a7f537f: The sequel to Driller. The Ketars are collecting energy with devices called EGOs to blast the planet Evath with radiation, and you must beam into their base on the moon to stop them.
descriptions.dos:9ea8985bd77cd2c0: A compilation of Jane's AH-64D Longbow and the Flash Point: Korea expansion. Fly the AH-64D attack helicopter with an authentic flight model and detailed simulation of its millimeter wave radar.
descriptions.dos:9eaaaab556a50ed4: A stunt flying and filming simulation with over 50 aircraft, including the space shuttle, and over 1000 props. Fly around the island, make your own films, or fly stunts for money.
descriptions.dos:9eab70c20566d79e: A shareware family board game in which players start at the corners and race to the center. A spinner tells each player which colored cell to move to.
descriptions.dos:9eb154b3019063d0: An arcade conversion in which you are a fighter pilot flying through wave after wave of enemies.
descriptions.dos:9ebca88213fac155: A talking language teacher that helps you learn to speak Spanish.
descriptions.dos:9ebcb6455f126c27: An interactive fiction game with ANSI graphics, a menu front end and RPG elements. As Star Stryker you hunt Shadow, an escaped mad scientist imprisoned for experimenting with genetic mutants, starting on Nimbus III.
descriptions.dos:9ebd794356719e1b: The sequel to Shadow President, in which, as President of the United States, you handle power, government, diplomacy and terrorists who want to nuke another country with your own arsenal.
descriptions.dos:9ecbaf91e716d85c: One of the first golf simulators with DOS graphics, released in 1985, the same year as World Tour Golf.
descriptions.dos:9edc873553c20452: Sierra's 256-color VGA remake of Hero's Quest with a new interface. In the town of Spielburg the governor's daughter is missing, robbers camp nearby, and the witch Baba Yaga is at large; the town needs a hero.
descriptions.dos:9edd315567d52200: A management game set in 1550, when Elizabeth becomes Queen of England. As the owner of a small trading company, you gain wealth and influence through international trade and luxury goods until you win a post as counselor to the Queen.
descriptions.dos:9f03437597fdd2c9: A first-person shooter bundled with Creative Labs 3D Blaster cards, set in the mid-21st century as rebels of the Lunar Defense Force prepare a war of independence. It requires a Rendition Verite 1000 video card.
descriptions.dos:9f04a84c65d6e9a3: A basic Breakout clone in 1.8 KB of machine code. Bounce a ball off a sliding paddle to tear down a wall brick by brick, and win without losing your seven balls.
descriptions.dos:9f0f1fff3af50149: A fighting game set in Zulula, a town in the land of Akistar that holds martial tournaments, whose Evil Lords rule in secret. Can a hero win glory in the tournament and expose them?
descriptions.dos:9f173c432e98f7fc: A tiny Tetris that fits in a half-kilobyte boot sector, so the PC boots straight into the game with no operating system. It manages rudimentary VGA graphics.
descriptions.dos:9f185457340daac5: A science fiction game by Tsunami Media blending role-playing, exploration, space combat and strategy. Command a spaceship in real time from a first-person view, traveling among planets and launching an explorer vessel.
descriptions.dos:9f18a128a9cd67fd: A death tournament between bumper cars. Knock your opponents out of their cars and hit them before they leave the game zone, facing more and tougher enemies on later stages.
descriptions.dos:9f262aa7d75bb0c9: The sequel to Ultima, with separate town and world maps and time gates that let you travel into other eras of Earth. Your single character roams the land fighting monsters and looking for key items.
descriptions.dos:9f35cfac978f5837: A 3D combat submarine simulator. Seek out enemy convoys and sink the supply ships and escorts with torpedoes and missiles, watching your fuel and air supply.
descriptions.dos:9f383af223a8332b: A wargame set from 200 BC to 200 AD, letting you stage battles between Roman armies of varying size and type, barbarian races, or a Roman army against a barbarian horde. It provides over two dozen scenarios.
