descriptions.dos:9f481de3e73dc62a: A complete remake of the action-strategy classic Archon with rewritten code, better graphics and sound, MOD music, a new game board and an extra special weapon for each figure.
descriptions.dos:9f4a2f3e27e511b9: A platformer based on the TV show in which the witch Hexana has kidnapped Hugo's family. Five levels are ported from the show, such as driving a draisine while dodging trains.
descriptions.dos:9f57dae0ffe98f33: A simple adventure for young players in which you play Snoopy, solving puzzles by picking up objects and dropping them in certain places. It works with keyboard or joystick and has just 5 actions.
descriptions.dos:9f5f645f8a8fa62a: A comedy adventure in Al Lowe's series in which Larry, single again, lands on a TV game show called Stallions and wins a weekend at the La Costa Lotta spa resort.
descriptions.dos:9f7cd83d96abfbb8: A shareware side-scrolling shooter in which you fly a helicopter through a fortress's heavy defenses to rescue captured officials, using a machine gun and several types of missiles.
descriptions.dos:9f97e3f46b065baf: An educational game for two with school subjects including alphabet, math, algebra, time, chemistry, world and US history, and US geography.
descriptions.dos:9f9c0e5a556af65c: A simple educational game in which you place sprites around the screen to create stories from their pictures.
descriptions.dos:9fa2b9f4a4b5054f: A wire-frame space combat simulator in which you fly around an alien planet looking for clues to a mysterious event in its past. You can turn off combat or exploration.
descriptions.dos:9fa310b4a4f6ab77: A turn-based strategy game, conceived as a board game and originally developed for the PDP-10. Players use armies from cities to conquer a 60x100 map.
descriptions.dos:9fa9e883c8fd2b11: An educational game for ages 3 to 7 with 26 games to help with reading and math skills, including matching words, recognizing letters and finding letters on the keyboard.
descriptions.dos:9fbe6d9e23d502b0: A dinosaur-themed educational game for elementary school children with four mini-games, AstroDrive, Zug Escape, Ptera-Ptutor and Spell-A-Saur, built around unscrambling and spelling words.
descriptions.dos:9fc167eb940871d2: A two-player Breakout clone with 48 stages, in which both players have paddles at once so one can watch the ball while the other catches bonus blocks. Collect power-ups and letters spelling BONUS.
descriptions.dos:9fd39288e0e32668: The European release of Mario's Early Years: Fun with Numbers, an educational game in which Mario teaches young children numbers and sums.
descriptions.dos:9fe132fe658f14de: The second Space Quest. Janitor Roger Wilco faces the return of Sludge Vohaul, who plans to infest the planet Xenon with thousands of genetically engineered door-to-door life insurance salesmen.
descriptions.dos:9fe5e9ac4c899330: A version of Monopoly for 2 to 8 players, who can all be computer players. It offers a short game with a time limit or a standard game, and several graphic formats.
descriptions.dos:9ff1fbc5ecd85ab0: An adventure with artwork and inspiration from horror designer H. R. Giger. You play Mike Dawson, an ad company manager who buys a solitary mansion in the small town of Woodland Hills to pursue a writing career.
descriptions.dos:9ff22f3ebd48a9bc: A two-player space ship combat game with a choice of ships, gravity strengths and other options.
descriptions.dos:9ffa9537eac4a576: A darts simulation in which you throw by pressing the space bar three times: first to aim horizontally, second for the angle and third for the strength. The aim is to run out of points.
descriptions.dos:9fffffa743c2f226: A Korean side-scrolling beat-em-up from the studio TG Entertainment, released only in South Korea, known there as Eojjeonji...Jeonyeok.
descriptions.dos:a002f801a78454fd: A LucasArts adventure set in the creepy Edison mansion, where a local girl named Sandy has gone missing and rumors of strange experiments circulate.
descriptions.dos:a00a3ef53c943733: A platform adventure in which the archaeologist Malvineous Havershim, studying ruins in Madagascar built by the mysterious Blue Builders, is overcome by gas while translating glyphs and enters a dream world.
descriptions.dos:a00b7176ab92c381: A baseball simulation from Micro Sports with league play, team management, detailed statistics, drafts, trades and accurately modeled stadiums. It bears the Major League Baseball seal and includes 1991 season rosters.
descriptions.dos:a00eed4428d90b11: A stock Tetris in text-mode graphics made for keyboard-driven play over modem as a BBS door game, which can also be played locally. The unregistered version has only three levels.
descriptions.dos:a015109bfd08ef50: A strategic simulation of interplanetary conflict. Manage resources, power stations, farms and laboratories from a military workstation to explore and conquer other worlds.
descriptions.dos:a01de62fdf5e4c00: A non-scrolling top-down shooter in which robot ships attack Earth in waves, with an arrow showing their entry direction. Your ship has a turret to shoot them.
descriptions.dos:a024df16ef2ddd6e: A managerial American football game in which you are the general manager of a struggling NFL team and must win games and turn a profit. You draft players and handle every part of the organization.
descriptions.dos:a02bc09b121561d9: A point-and-click icon-based adventure in which paranormal investigator Jhon Steel arrives in Reality-on-the-Norm to find a horror case. Talk to inhabitants and collect items.
descriptions.dos:a03300c5a6ec78f6: A backgammon game for one or two players with several computer difficulty levels and full mouse support, rolling the dice with the right mouse button. It can also start from non-standard positions.
descriptions.dos:a0340198481fdcf2: The third McGee educational game, entirely wordless so a young child can play alone. McGee goes to a fun fair.
descriptions.dos:a037f03f8f959eb7: An action platformer set in 1776, when settlers of Buenos Aires send an expedition to Tierra del Fuego. The ship is wrecked and the lone survivor, biologist Sebastian de Anchorena, must go on.
descriptions.dos:a043fe44f62bfbc9: A stock market simulation for one to six players. The goal is to earn the most money in ten turns by buying and selling stocks, using price lists and graphs.
descriptions.dos:a0569dcc77b70fac: A shareware, keyboard-controlled game based on QIX. Claim over half of a bordered rectangle by making smaller rectangles, while the meanies inside try to touch you.
descriptions.dos:a05c7b66c5769be6: A strategy game in which you build the strength and knowledge to unite the free worlds and defeat an alien horde. You begin with one ship and a chosen crew, relying on research, exploration and diplomacy.
descriptions.dos:a0661fbae6615ca5: A simple quiz game from Big Blue Disk #20 that helps you learn US state capitals. Five data sets of ten states each have you swap capital names until they match their states.
descriptions.dos:a06c24bc5bb2e2ba: The sixth Wizardry game. The Cosmic Forge is a magic pen that makes whatever is written with it come true, and your party journeys into a castle once ruled by an evil King, Queen and Wizard to find out what became of it.
descriptions.dos:a06d2d82d4fb4993: An adventure based on the Stephen King novel, using an interface reminiscent of LucasArts' SCUMM. You play horror novelist Thad Beaumont, whose evil twin is committing terrible crimes.
descriptions.dos:a06f897737e4ed42: The sequel to Les Manley in Search for the King, now a point-and-click adventure without a text parser. Les searches for his friend Helmut the Human Bean, kidnapped from his mansion in L.A.
descriptions.dos:a08729606270828d: A kung-fu fighting game in which a demonic yellow devil has seized the original manuscript written by Cheng Heung, and the Shaolin fighters must stop him.
descriptions.dos:a08cee09e7a66510: A platformer in which Carlos, a bearded man in bright coveralls accompanied by a parrot, jumps through 5 levels full of clowns, rats, monkeys and golf players, climbing ladders and using passageways.
descriptions.dos:a08dbc3cd8ebf4d2: Manage a UK football team, choosing from one hundred clubs and using a database of 1270 players and hundreds of support staff. Guide a fourth-division team up to the premier league using charts and graphs.
descriptions.dos:a099e8ca833a4fe6: You are a rolling eyeball finding your way through mazes. Each maze has puzzles and objects such as keys to collect, and a time limit.
descriptions.dos:a0a0e2e4768021af: The Settlers II Gold Edition, containing Veni, Vidi, Vici, the Mission CD, a world atlas and 130 fan-made maps. You start a settlement with one building and must find sources of stone and wood.
descriptions.dos:a0b55b9d8b24d1ca: A volleyball game with full six-player teams and the original rules, played as a single match against the AI or another player. A tactics menu sets defense and offense strategy.
descriptions.dos:a0bdcce43fd1586f: A live-video shooting gallery game in which you blast through a gang's hideouts and bank robberies to rescue the Mayor and his daughter from Mad Dog McCree.
descriptions.dos:a0bf89338ccb6992: A puzzle game on a star-shaped web where you move, arrange and combine colored photons to produce a specific pattern. It is postcard-ware, freeware that asks for a postcard.
descriptions.dos:a0e1d7ad543f225e: A game based on the movie, made of action sequences that recreate scenes such as the dungeon escape and the ice caves. Play them in order or read the story as a manuscript and jump to scenes.
descriptions.dos:a10c4f0f4f0da84a: A pinball game built with Pinball Construction Set, centered on a star-shaped object ringed by 5 bumpers. Up to 4 players, with 9 background colors.
descriptions.dos:a111bd2882c711ca: A freeware fan-made sequel to Spear of Destiny with new sprites, weapons and exploding barrels, and 23 levels asking what happened to Hitler after the war and who got the Spear.
descriptions.dos:a1147284cc3a4e39: Odysseus Kent, an odd fellow, sets off with a shovel and a map from a shadowy man at a bus stop to find the Lost Treasure of Randolph McBoing, supposedly in a cemetery.
descriptions.dos:a118490261d07903: A shareware space combat flight simulation from Virtual Adventures with varied missions, including pure shooting, tactical missions and space racing.
descriptions.dos:a122ce653cc1dac7: An unofficial English remaster of the 1992 economy sim in which the giant company Dynatech secures resources for a depleted Earth by discovering and developing new ones.
descriptions.dos:a127b64d74cfef0a: A much improved version of SubLOGIC's Jet with better speed, flight characteristics and precision, smooth zooming, a game menu, mouse control and landing gear. It loads scenery files rather than only scenery disks.
descriptions.dos:a12bd7cc724ea8c6: A shareware puzzle game in which you line up blocks with colored arrows so that blocks of the same color touch and disappear. Clear them all to finish the level.
descriptions.dos:a137ce54d8cae071: A turn-based strategy game with role-playing elements, like Fire Emblem. It is set in a cyberpunk future in which mega-corporations rule and social inequality has caused an economic depression.
descriptions.dos:a13e4f29fda7d5bd: A semi-realistic kart racing game with a low sense of speed and plenty of sliding. It has simulation and arcade modes, race AI, and two-player split screen.
descriptions.dos:a13f1db47747e997: A real-time strategy game in which you lead one of five races, tens of thousands of years after a catastrophe shut down Earth's ecology. A resource called Mana is found to be regenerating.
descriptions.dos:a145b31393c49985: A chess game in SVGA on CD-ROM with multiple skill levels, various boards and pieces, pull-down menus, an analysis mode and a VCR-like replay option. It can give the player a chess rating.
descriptions.dos:a15dfcba369962ac: A Spanish arcade racing game from Ediciones Mago that calls itself a simulator.
descriptions.dos:a15e86955d8c7275: A third-person point-and-click adventure of exploration and puzzles. Out for a night walk in New York, Jeremy hears a story from an old man about a cursed kingdom and is transported there.
descriptions.dos:a15ef068e9116def: A role-playing game based on Steve Jackson Games' Car Wars. Starting as an average person in New York, build money and prestige through story missions, paid side quests and arena battles.
descriptions.dos:a1616b5263e79d83: A Tetris variant in which a man who fell asleep in front of a monitor walks at the bottom of the well. You fill it with pipes, clocks and other urban shapes, forming steps for him to climb out.
descriptions.dos:a17345cc7ebd80e7: The 1989 Carmen Sandiego game in which you travel through time to collect clues and the warrant needed to arrest Carmen's henchmen and finally Carmen herself.
descriptions.dos:a19337d496d75044: A two-player game of exploitation and conquest on an interstellar scale. Two factions, The League and The People's Holy Republic, compete over decades for control of a rich star cluster.
descriptions.dos:a19694f32aa5091c: A college basketball simulation for replaying individual games or whole seasons from the past or present, with a built-in Stat Compiler that keeps permanent team records.
descriptions.dos:a1a02bc770618220: An advertisement game in which you control a free climber and climb Mt. Guano by clicking one of his four limbs and dragging it to a suitable crack in the rock wall.
descriptions.dos:a1a3fa7318afe6db: A shareware keyboard-controlled Frogger clone from Germany. Take Karl across a five-lane motorway and a river, avoiding crocodiles, otters and cars, as he is a young frog who drowns in water.
descriptions.dos:a1aa31cf9b5de58c: A shooter in which you move your ship up and down while firing at two erratic enemy orbs on the right. Ships freeze while a laser crosses the screen, so you can't dodge once it's fired.
descriptions.dos:a1d9d335c19affbe: A freeware Monopoly for up to six players with save and load, but no computer opponent.
descriptions.dos:a1edb9ae31699392: A Euchre card game with a 24-card deck and five cards dealt to each player. The top card is turned up as a trump offering, and players decide whether to order it up or pass.
descriptions.dos:a1f93ffe165a2be6: A military precision approach air traffic control simulator, also known as Ground Control Approach, released alongside TRACON 1.5 by the same producer. It was the only PC simulator of this approach type.
descriptions.dos:a1fa2bb613e5e80d: A tactical battle simulator in which you command a starship or a small group of ships. It has mouse support, a graphical interface, sound, music, animations and real-time scenarios.
descriptions.dos:a215f951e203d57a: A text adventure in which strange events are unfolding at your hospital, which is now called an Institute, and even your daughter is acting oddly. You may be the one to solve the mystery.
descriptions.dos:a21b830e63bd9f99: A first-person flight simulation like Ace of Aces in which you shoot down Japanese fighters and bombers over the ocean. A cockpit window and instrument panel show engine power, altitude, fuel and ammunition.
descriptions.dos:a22b72612eb4eaa2: A DOS conversion of the Amiga shooter in which Plexu walks, jumps and fires a single, double or super shot gun. Instead of side-scrolling, the action is split into single screens with a boss at the end of each level.
descriptions.dos:a22fc15bb8443008: An adaptation of the TV game show in which you are given the answer and must supply the question.
descriptions.dos:a232032d47fd4e6a: An Ocean golf game with many forms of play, including skins, foursomes, matchplay, strokeplay, practice and fourball, across varied terrain and locations with several difficulty levels.
descriptions.dos:a23579668341ba8e: A schoolboy punished for wanting to play a video game is transported to a fantasy world of anthropomorphic animals, where as the warrior Zakato he must save it from an evil goddess.
descriptions.dos:a235e9337d39ede8: A puzzle game in several sections, beginning with a cipher, that challenges you in different ways.
descriptions.dos:a239dbefa402bf79: Set in 2020, when road rage rules the highways, you are an Eastern European factory worker with the world's last Lada. Your mission is to reach the abandoned Lada factory and reactivate it.
descriptions.dos:a239f4ace55b9a45: An early Westwood turn-based role-playing game in which a stranded space jockey on Saturn's moon Titan assembles a team to find a lost city. Characters have attributes and 21 skills that can be raised.
descriptions.dos:a250198343c7e346: Play one of three evil wizards competing for a magical talisman. Hatch, raise and breed dragons and use them and spells to conquer or aid villages and cities while fighting the other wizards.
descriptions.dos:a258d4721a65e73f: A rare Arkanoid-style game, the first independent work of British programmer Richard Wright, later known for the Galactix games.
descriptions.dos:a25bceb71c7f4eda: A soccer championship among 128 teams of robot players. Each team has four players with different strengths who can be sold and replaced on the player market, for example with spider or worm robots.
descriptions.dos:a26a79d7b94b3544: A cute fan-made platformer like Prince of Persia stripped down to its bare minimum.
descriptions.dos:a26b6120427bb6b0: A flight simulation based on Dale Brown's Flight of the Old Dog. You command the crew of an experimental, heavily modified B-52 bomber outfitted with the latest weapons and stealth technology.
descriptions.dos:a26b7d82a0edaaa3: A tool for children to write illustrated fairy tales based on the stories of Robin Hood and Peter Pan, with a scene editor for ready-made backgrounds and characters and a text editor.
descriptions.dos:a270690e801ddf34: A Boulder Dash variant in which humanity tries to exterminate all rabbits by storing cabbages underground. You control the rabbit Myra, digging through dirt in each of 120 levels.
descriptions.dos:a291cf02d0bdae5c: A Spanish top-down shooter in English, apparently designed for two players. You play a muscular long-haired girl with a huge cannon fighting monsters in a techno-fantasy world.
descriptions.dos:a2b1a50635f26446: A fan-made Dune game that reuses graphics from Westwood's Dune II but is a turn-based tactics game rather than real-time. Its plot loosely draws on earlier and later books.
descriptions.dos:a2b2754969c4503f: The second Adventures with Edison game, sponsored by the Smithsonian Institution. With the happy little Edison, visit museums to find missing treasures for a detective agency.
descriptions.dos:a2b2f83c17684b90: A platformer based on the Tintin comic Prisoners of the Sun. As Tintin you rescue the kidnapped Professor Calculus, in many more locations than the comic's Peru.
descriptions.dos:a2b40ba31849b93b: A text adventure in which the only survivor of the dangerous planet Doomawangara returns on a rescue mission to save an ambassador kidnapped by renegade robots.
descriptions.dos:a2c7431128ee1702: A real-time game in which you control either the US or Soviet nuclear arsenal during an escalating exchange. It has a basic four-screen interface and dozens of weapon systems.
descriptions.dos:a2d9bada673200c6: A low-resolution early PC platformer that shares an engine with Apogee's Arctic Adventure and Pharaoh's Tomb. It has four episodes of twenty puzzle-filled, one-screen levels each, the first shareware.
descriptions.dos:a2da9f6fdce2e06e: A close relative of Kroz in which you search for the Heart of Courage in the Ezam dungeons, evading lost souls and using pick axes and teleport scrolls in a largely invisible maze.
descriptions.dos:a2db58cddc3a162e: A simple computerized backgammon game with aggressive or defensive computer play styles, three game speeds and a save/load option.
descriptions.dos:a2eeb3eac6de651f: A role-playing game in which you play a knight who must restore order to a kingdom left a chaotic wasteland, plagued by thieves and monsters, by finding the Rainbow Egg.
descriptions.dos:a2f4debc51966560: A fantasy role-playing game in which you and four characters collect weapons, armor, spells and keys and fight through the maze of ShardMoure Keep to retrieve the Infernal Tome, a manuscript that can stop time.
descriptions.dos:a2f9ed8d77f2d5a0: An improved version of Jack Nicklaus Unlimited Golf and Course Design with better graphics and sound. It also plays courses created for the earlier game.
descriptions.dos:a30320e715ed7ac7: The Infocom text adventure in which you are Arthur Dent, whose house and then planet have been destroyed. Your friend Ford Prefect, not really an out-of-work actor, has rescued you.
descriptions.dos:a30e53fe179bfd0f: The last of the lunar colony strategy trilogy after Moonbase and Lunar Command, an almost exact copy of Lunar Command with improved graphics and some added complexity.
descriptions.dos:a310b836b3e6c0bb: Play a US Navy SEAL in 3 independent missions involving terrorists and hostages. Each mission has several portions with different mechanics, including swimming and submarining.
descriptions.dos:a31886a4fdc78bc1: A top-down tank game in which two tanks battle to blast into each other's fortresses with guns and helicopters. It is built for head-to-head play via split screen or modem.
descriptions.dos:a32714ca4b92b821: A beat-em-up based on Jet Li's movie in which Jet Li's hero fights through hordes of opponents, with punches and a powerful horizontal sweep with frequent kicks.
descriptions.dos:a32cca6994fd8067: An SCI demo game made by Brian Provinciano to showcase his SCI Studio on the old TechTV show Call for Help with Chris Pirillo.
descriptions.dos:a333dece12121685: A 3D tennis game with 3Dfx support, also known as Tie Break Tenis 98. Choose your player and court surface, men's or women's tennis, and a single match or world championship.
descriptions.dos:a33401d3ff952384: A game designed for stereo 3D LCD shutter glasses, but playable in a normal DOS window. It combines real-time fluid dynamics airflow simulation, physics-based interaction, and flying and driving simulation.
descriptions.dos:a33471fd6ad024d2: An educational game teaching logic and problem solving. Four tram cars each hold one of ten animals, and you work out which is where by placing four animals each turn.
descriptions.dos:a33573f5511a81da: A quiz of 100 fill-in-the-blank questions on literary and historical facts, decoding and wordplay, with a few characters of the correct answer given as hints.
descriptions.dos:a337fce31305e229: An action adventure in which you wake with your identity stripped away and take control of your destiny, making your way through indoor and outdoor areas of an insane reality.
descriptions.dos:a341d558453349f8: A sports game with eight Winter Olympic events. You play the events in a row, deselectable, and the player with the most points wins, with two players at a time on split screen.
descriptions.dos:a346fba1bc667cad: A role-playing game in which Wil Mason is transported to the fantasy world of Middlemere, ruled by four rival brothers. It mixes arcade elements with a first-person view like Eye of the Beholder.
descriptions.dos:a359cda799c78234: A single-player shareware platform puzzle game. On each screen of multilevel platforms with vines, collect all the treasure chests while avoiding obstacles such as water hazards.
descriptions.dos:a3604dd75f67f572: A shareware educational title that teaches children to recognize US and Canadian coins, controlled by keyboard or mouse, with three games including matching coin pictures to denominations.
descriptions.dos:a368195624fdbeea: FIFA Soccer 97, with commentary by John Motson and Andy Gray, player moves from David Ginola using MotionBlending, and interactive replays. Play a league or cup tournament, or practice.
descriptions.dos:a3885a07642c6af3: A dungeon crawl that uses filled polygons for a 3D dungeon, where you fight dragons and other enemies with venomous, magical and breath effects in 16 colors.
descriptions.dos:a397a7596734608f: A World War II air combat simulation in which you fly as an American or German pilot in 1943-1945, with experimental German aircraft such as the Me 262, Me 163 Komet and Gotha flying wing, and the standard Me 109.
descriptions.dos:a39b695def0c042f: Krisalis's second football game, a sequel to Manchester United - The Official. Lead your team through the European championships, either letting the computer play matches or taking control of the players.
descriptions.dos:a39d07e58fe40947: The sequel to Star Control. The Alliance has lost and the Ur-Quan armada imprisons the Alliance races on their homeworlds, including Earth, but a lost research vessel has found something at a distant star system.
descriptions.dos:a3a03ac915c381bc: A single-player game against the computer in which a discus bounces across the screen and you control a vertical paddle. Hitting targets scores points, with white gorillas worth ten points.
descriptions.dos:a3a6cf251ee0b909: Joe Blade must rescue six leaders kidnapped by Crax Bloodfinger in different parts of his base. He finds six bombs to deactivate with only 20 minutes to rescue everyone, in a side-on flick-screen game.
descriptions.dos:a3c1f830677ef062: A platformer with puzzle elements in which you guide Jacek, the Electroman, through 8 levels using teleporters, shooting enemies and collecting weapon power-ups, as your weapon gradually weakens.
descriptions.dos:a3c2c2f7c0e0a389: A Pang-style game of 50 levels for one or two players on the same screen. Shoot hooks upward to burst the balloons bouncing around the playfield.
descriptions.dos:a3c95ab115a3a319: The sequel to Eye of the Beholder. The Archmage Khelben sends the Heroes of Waterdeep to investigate the Temple Darkmoon, near where people have disappeared and shallow graves have been found.
descriptions.dos:a3d6ec51a5ed5b8d: An interactive cartoon in which a brave English soldier must stop the Fascist Von Max from building a Doomsday Machine with special crystals. Each level has a different task, such as shooting, fights and chases.
descriptions.dos:a3df7512be989aea: A post-apocalyptic strategy game in which you lead a gang of warriors across the land, battling mutants and other gangs and looting towns.
descriptions.dos:a3e2e8ea585f5ae2: A single-player space shooter in which you fly over an alien landscape shooting enemy ships. Fuel runs out quickly, so you swoop low to refuel from gas pumps.
descriptions.dos:a3e5f8de4db6c895: An unofficial sequel to Wasteland from Electronic Arts, using a modified Wasteland engine. Decades after a nuclear bombardment, Florida has broken off from the mainland as an island community.
descriptions.dos:a3e75e0c445ceec4: An educational game in which you explore the human brain, collecting treasures, mainly cell types. You travel using anatomical directions and are quizzed on neuroanatomy.
descriptions.dos:a3f1eb1e63b4851f: A remake of the Atari ST game Bolo, a Breakout variant in which your paddle can move all around the screen. Across 50 levels, destroy all the blocks with gimmicks such as no gravity and slippery ice.
descriptions.dos:a3f2c9b77ec2e427: A first-person shooter by Jesse Petrilla about the hunt for Osama bin Laden, one of his games based on real-world conflicts and built from artwork borrowed from other shooters of the time.
descriptions.dos:a3fb748c6be5bb61: An isometric 3D arcade adventure in which the thief Karadoc raids the five stories of Castle Wulf, rumored to hold treasure but also full of deadly traps, riddles and monsters.
descriptions.dos:a3fdfd6dff815fa6: A World War II strategy game, a follow-up to Air Force Commander, focused entirely on air combat between the Allies and the Axis. Pick a scenario and manage resources and bases.
descriptions.dos:a3ff3a7c53ede0ec: A Sierra-style adventure in which Hugo must save his girlfriend, who went to babysit in a haunted house. It was re-released commercially in 1995 as part of the Hugo Trilogy.
descriptions.dos:a407aefaa2bdf86b: A lighthearted adventure made with Adventure Game Studio, set on a distant snow-filled planet.
descriptions.dos:a409c84ccc7cc290: A turn-based hex wargame with three epic Napoleonic battles and a construction kit for recreating any land battle of the period. It has four programs, including a Battle program and a Mapmaker.
descriptions.dos:a40ea4db94c6d9bd: A vertical shooter in which your airplane, which can also move backward, flies up from the bottom of the screen to destroy similar aircraft.
descriptions.dos:a410a089666989b7: The continuation of the Shaw's Nightmare series, with 30 levels plus 2 secret levels, and new monsters, music, sound effects and graphics.
descriptions.dos:a411ca3eb1272830: One of the first roguelikes with a wilderness and more than one dungeon. You search the Caverns of Larn for a cure for your daughter's strange disease.
descriptions.dos:a42a92b3b9be725d: A side-view volleyball game with matches of 1, 3 or 5 sets, each won by the first to 15 points. Teams include the Rollers, CoCo, the Beach Boys and the Geniases.
descriptions.dos:a4369e91c63d9d19: A classic-style racing arcade game like OutRun in which you drive a set distance in a short time to earn extra time. A two-lane public road has slow traffic going your way and oncoming traffic.
descriptions.dos:a43d18f33e705500: A Boulder Dash-style game in which you dig through underground caves to collect diamonds and reach the exit before time runs out. Some caves lack enough diamonds, but there are ways to generate more.
descriptions.dos:a443fbf2444a6bbe: A side-scrolling platformer in which Baby Jo tries to get home through four levels, avoiding bad-tempered animals and machines. Jo can throw rattles at enemies such as bees, lawnmowers and spiders.
descriptions.dos:a446b20bb0e87a39: A football manager game based on the four top English leagues. Its icon-driven interface shows each screen as an office, such as the manager's, president's or bank's, and you click items to reach them.
descriptions.dos:a44cf72365cd2794: A casino game in which Madame Zuinga's Hotel and Casino is cursed with spirits after a ruined gambler left behind a necklace and called on dark forces for revenge.
descriptions.dos:a451454b312e336e: An isometric hockey game licensed from Brett Hull with motion-captured graphics, full running commentary by Al Michaels, realistic fouls, and a mode where Brett helps you improve your game.
descriptions.dos:a46aad4087614a0a: The original extreme games compilation, set in sunny California. Compete in skateboarding, footbag, surfing, roller skating, flying disc and BMX, with the surfing event scored by judges.
descriptions.dos:a488c950808e9e31: A Snake clone, much like Vlak. You control a green serpent on a black field with food, drinks and inedible items such as skulls and poison pots, while blue stones give extra lives.
descriptions.dos:a49c9fd16f783bec: A children's educational game with arcade elements.
descriptions.dos:a4a1e8f76ca45467: An obscure high-resolution Breakout clone with a story, adjustable bounce angle by angling the paddle, and blocks that are small squares.
descriptions.dos:a4a21cc4706af2ec: General Tegel leads an offensive against the alien K'kistik and hires soldiers of any race, shipping them across the galaxy for missions. You pick your mercenaries for each job.
descriptions.dos:a4a4c6b0fcee960c: A Korean side-scrolling platformer with cartoon-like graphics. You play the young warrior Tipi, who sets out to kill the red dragon that has taken his future wife.
descriptions.dos:a4a5cfe7429a5cd6: A text-mode maze game in which a yellow happy face is stranded in a large multi-segmented labyrinth, each segment about the size of a screen.
descriptions.dos:a4a79b5175e25367: A multi-genre military action game in which you rise from Cadet to tactical genius commanding mechanized forces. It has three kinds of combat simulations, including the main battle tank.
descriptions.dos:a4ae6a1e3c0fe188: A shareware color matching puzzle game. Colored balls travel through overlapping transparent tubes and you catch the falling spheres with a test tube.
descriptions.dos:a4b6c981068f1133: A Battleship game in which you place your fleet on a grid and play against another person or one of three computer opponents of different strengths. The toughest is not in the shareware version.
descriptions.dos:a4b72c0ef30cb7ee: A Japanese-style role-playing game in which the hero pursues Gorgus after his father's death. Travel through towns and dungeons, collect items, gain experience and fight turn-based battles.
descriptions.dos:a4b73d0554406a57: A mouse-controlled game like Missile Command in which you defend your central space station from aliens by firing torpedoes at the cursor.
descriptions.dos:a4be9b122574d8ea: A shareware strategy game for up to 5 empires, player or computer controlled. Produce starships and missiles and deploy fleets on a star map to conquer systems; battles resolve automatically with animation.
descriptions.dos:a4c596ceb628ddc2: The real-time strategy classic, including the Covert Operations add-on, that built on Westwood's Dune II. Select units with the mouse and direct them while opponents move without waiting for turns.
descriptions.dos:a4c5affc6fe608e0: A government simulation about political decisions and their consequences, in which you are the newly chosen president of the fictitious Latin American country of Chimerica.
descriptions.dos:a4cf892d1345d08e: A 2D scrolling platformer for the original IBM PC with a CGA card, using a tweaked text mode for 80x50 resolution in 16 colors. A little duck jumps and shoots fireballs to find out who attacked her family castle.
descriptions.dos:a4d3a311b131082d: A 1927 murder mystery in which Inspector Raoul Dusentier is invited on a sailing ship cruise by wealthy Niklos Karaboudjan, who is murdered on the second day, and sets out to find the killer.
descriptions.dos:a4fce3fc0d723642: A pinball game with four tables: Dooke (underworld devils), Enlightment (space travel), Air Crash (modern air combat) and Shark Attack (sunken treasure guarded by sharks). The tables are not the usual rectangle.
descriptions.dos:a505ea648a6235ed: A hospital management simulation in which you build a hospital from an empty building, with rooms for diagnosis and treatment of bizarre diseases such as Bloaty Head, Slack Tongue and Alien DNA.
descriptions.dos:a514207de1839f4e: The first Advanced Dungeons & Dragons role-playing game to go online, hosted by America Online. It is set in the city of Neverwinter and more than 20 surrounding areas.
descriptions.dos:a51bd2296ff4436c: A futuristic motor boat racing game with a Wipeout-like touch to hinder rivals. In the third millennium the boats can dive in lava, acid and other dangerous substances.
descriptions.dos:a51f50cda40a9c40: As a covered wagon party of pioneers, head west from Independence, Missouri to Oregon's Willamette Valley. Stock up on provisions, then decide when to rest, how much to eat and more along the way.
descriptions.dos:a51f8fb6f42c6c80: A shooter inspired by the Soviet spacecraft Buran, which went into space in 1988 as a response to the American Shuttle.
descriptions.dos:a51f96215916c1cd: A Klondike solitaire game played with one 52-card deck, laid out in the standard seven-column layout.
descriptions.dos:a52496bcb8befee8: A business simulation in which you run a company that builds bridges, coordinating supplies and labor and leaving money for research and development.
descriptions.dos:a541913a496bb450: A division and brigade level wargame of the battles between Germany and Russia in WWII on a 36 by 36 hex map from Smolensk to Moscow. It includes PBEM, computer opponents and a scenario editor.
descriptions.dos:a542b2cafceac4f5: A Space Invaders clone in which you fight waves of descending attackers.
descriptions.dos:a54ee0d6d549825f: The first-person shooter in which experiments with teleportation on the moons of Mars go wrong and open a gateway to Hell. A marine squad sent to Phobos is overrun by demons.
descriptions.dos:a5557bdea992e72c: A collection of eight small medieval-themed games, including crossbow and archery shooting events with rotating and moving targets.
descriptions.dos:a555bfe95bd33c90: A straightforward platformer by Stephan Vogler in which you play Kid, collecting fruit and avoiding snakes and pitfalls. Plan your path well, since the blocks you bust with your head may lead to a safer route.
descriptions.dos:a567309b95eedda3: One of the first chess programs for personal computers, with large graphics filling nearly the whole screen. It has seven skill levels plus postal chess, and you can play either side.
descriptions.dos:a56cc3110382d892: A castle-building strategy sequel with a new interface and video cutscenes on the CD versions. Choose one of five feuding lords vying for the Crown, keeping the Pope and your people happy.
descriptions.dos:a5783eb134fa1e28: SSI's action-strategy game like Archon. Pit your forces against a computer or human foe on a game board, and when two pieces collide they fight for survival on another board.
descriptions.dos:a585c7d1f861d639: A Pac-Man variation that advertises Intel's Above Board memory expansion card, based on the fact that 640 KB of RAM is not enough for everyone.
descriptions.dos:a58ab50debe508ba: A math puzzle in which you fill in a four by four lattice of equations with the missing symbols and numbers so that every equation across and down is correct.
descriptions.dos:a5909916588db2a7: A simulation of the World War II B-17 heavy bomber. Customize your bomber with a name and nose art, then fly randomly assigned missions into Germany while managing a crew of 10.
descriptions.dos:a59b54906a312f65: Fly the RAH-66 Comanche attack helicopter with the Griffin squadron through over 30 missions. It has realistic physics, stealth, easy and advanced flight models and a full tutorial.
descriptions.dos:a59faa13e700d7bd: An Iranian shooting gallery game set during the Iran-Iraq war, in which you play a militiaman with a hand-held anti-tank launcher attacking Iraqi tanks that cross the screen.
descriptions.dos:a5a24998d4f40b7d: An interactive full-motion video adventure set in New York in 2040. Brutal killings reminiscent of Jack the Ripper become personal for crime reporter Jack Quinlan, who must solve the mystery.
descriptions.dos:a5b4c573882df8e9: You are on safari to photograph animals as they enter and leave the screen, to save them from extinction, while shooting poachers who will kill you if you are slow.
descriptions.dos:a5b6e8de5425a607: A small, primitive text adventure that works as an interactive political cartoon, with a two-word parser. It has nothing to do with elands.
descriptions.dos:a5bff2d5e5404ce6: A vocabulary game with 5 subgames at four difficulty levels from age 10 to adult, including platformers, crosswords, word searches, scrambles and sentence completion. It supports English, Spanish, French and German.
descriptions.dos:a5c0b1ae6f8e51cf: A shareware two-player strategy game with Tetris-like pieces that appear on either side of the play area. Players place pieces to build a vertical wall across the screen.
descriptions.dos:a5ca43f383f3b91d: A three-part text adventure that won the 1994 AGT programming contest, in which you leave on a two-week vacation from ICON Inc. It is influenced by Infocom's Bureaucracy.
descriptions.dos:a5ce7c3dff96e100: A point-and-click adventure of the film in which Peter Banning, an ordinary dad who was once Peter Pan, returns to Neverland to rescue his children from Captain Hook.
descriptions.dos:a5d225eefffc7282: A humorous Spanish point-and-click adventure in which John Hacker, sent to talk to Count Drascula about some land, sets out to rescue a girl kidnapped by the Count.
descriptions.dos:a5d3d40df34ff9a9: A scrolling shooter set in a maximum-security prison where secret experiments are rumored and inmates have super powers. Steve Kane is taken there after being wrongly convicted of highway homicide.
descriptions.dos:a5d96d1563ad2e21: A licensed Formula 1 game from Gremlin, between a full simulation like F1 GP and action games like Continental Circus. Races have 12 cars and last 3 to 20 laps.
descriptions.dos:a5fafb6d209754e3: A word puzzle game with 25 random letters on a 5x5 grid. Spell as many words as possible from adjacent letters, checked against an 80,000-word dictionary.
descriptions.dos:a5fc64ebaac5ee8c: A DOS port of Madden '96 using the extra space of a CD for improved graphics and animation, with 3D rendered graphics, 640x480 resolution and John Madden announcing. It has over 500 players and 240 plays.
descriptions.dos:a6031846f31d56d5: A straightforward action game in which spiders descend from above at different speeds and you fight them off with a boxing glove.
descriptions.dos:a60409b246265ac4: In 2119, Earth sends seedships as arks across the stars. You lead the UNS Calypso to the Beta Caeli star system, the farthest, in a mix of adventure, colony management and 4X strategy.
descriptions.dos:a61fec5ee1f699f9: A Columns-inspired action puzzler by demosceners. Groups of three blocks fall into a pit, and you form horizontal, vertical or diagonal groups of three or more to clear them. The registered version adds two-player mode.
descriptions.dos:a6212a4cb4b80aff: An interactive movie in which, after the death of Dr. Everett Cussler, colleagues gather at Dr. Elizabeth Duran's isolated cabin for the reading of the will, within range of your camera and microphone.
descriptions.dos:a62290ed310fc445: A stand-alone updated Championship Manager 2 for the 96/97 season with two playable leagues, Italian Serie A and Serie B, and a database of over 4000 real players.
descriptions.dos:a62d88415c6660d8: The 1997 edition of the Madden NFL football series with modem and network support.
descriptions.dos:a640dd7ed51b05f6: A tactical wargame of the British hunt for the German battleship Bismarck in World War II.
descriptions.dos:a643a15cee338f2c: A first-person shooting gallery from the Spanish company Ediciones Manali, set in an ancient castle where you destroy ghosts and monsters moving at various speeds.
descriptions.dos:a64f272087aa8906: An action-oriented baseball simulation and update to HardBall 4, with adjustable difficulty, sharper graphics, more comments by Al Michaels, and improved league play with 1994 major leaguers and a legends league.
descriptions.dos:a6530391d2c5877e: Kill as many zombies as you can before they tear you apart. Aim with the mouse and fire with the mouse buttons, with a pistol, shotgun and machine gun.
descriptions.dos:a66364dbe0ee8134: An educational game in which you capture aliens wandering a grid by drawing the specified polygons around them. A Super Zoid escapes unless you answer a geometry question.
descriptions.dos:a6649e8dedaba864: A simple mouse-driven shooter in which you protect a man hanging out under beehives. Bees attack in groups of four, and you pick them off in the air.
descriptions.dos:a68cced3c5f2fdfc: A CD of 150 more Doom levels and mods from the net, packaged by WizardWorks with version 1.3 of its D! front end.
descriptions.dos:a68fb2f4ce164887: An adventure based on the graphic novel. You have nine days to explore a world of wizards and spells with Roxanna, daughter of Mara the witch, and the retired knight Bragon.
descriptions.dos:a6a5fd8cd1676693: A Grand Prix motorcycle racing simulation with 4 bikes and 12 tracks, including Brno, Suzuka and Spa. Play a full season with qualifying, a single race or practice, with one or two players on a split screen.
descriptions.dos:a6ace90072f58543: An educational game in which you start as a medical trainee and work your way up with each successful surgery, each case coming with a debriefing on the patient's history.
descriptions.dos:a6b8a2d1a18b40bc: A space miniature golf game with 18 holes in zany scenarios, played by giving simple directions to the ball with the mouse. In space there is no air.
descriptions.dos:a6d5e2c70e5dea2c: A soccer game in which you pick one of twenty-four countries for a World Championship identical to the real 1990 World Cup. You also choose which players take the field.
descriptions.dos:a6d771a67a2abe7b: A limited Robotron clone in which a stickman runs around a forest firing a machine gun only in the direction he moves, trying to mow down criminal stickmen using the least ammunition.
descriptions.dos:a6db39cecbb9777b: Perform heroic deeds to change the public's view of you from villain to hero and retake your castle. Gather your band of merry men and take down the Sheriff and his guards.
descriptions.dos:a6df8924e513e473: A game of galactic conquest like Master of Orion or Stars!, with depth, good AI and an interface mostly of written statistics.
descriptions.dos:a6e1379ec7b281ba: A clone of Deflektor in which you turn mirrors with the mouse to guide a laser and pop all the balloons on a level.
descriptions.dos:a6e2c96d156d8e00: A flippant side-scrolling platformer with an anti-remake philosophy, in which you play Wolverine across a pastoral landscape fighting an army of cloned game icons such as Mario, Sonic and Alex Kidd.

descriptions.dos:ac03204a21e5ad8d: A race against the computer, shown as a smiling face, on a figure-8 track in 40-column ASCII graphics, for a single lap.

descriptions.dos:ac07d1cd7fd535f5: A platform puzzle game in which you are Mimi, avoiding or shooting mites and finding your way out of a maze.

descriptions.dos:acb424a24d621833: A draw poker game much like the casino version, in which you bet that you can win the hand with one of nine combinations of cards.
descriptions.dos:acb80c0afc2c718e: A role-playing game with a three-quarters overhead perspective like certain Ultima games and standard RPG gameplay.

descriptions.dos:acd8a0554d5f1be9: A turn-based game in which you try to escape a maze while avoiding robots.

descriptions.dos:b017ba052dd68875: A simplified roguelike with randomly generated levels containing treasure to collect and monsters to fight, in ASCII graphics.

descriptions.dos:b0f42a8c31f95e63: An unfinished one-level demo of a top-down scrolling shoot-em-up in which enemy ships take many hits to die and move very fast.

descriptions.dos:b185ae5b5c2fdd08: A creativity program published by Turner Interactive with Cartoon Network in 1995, hosted by Moxy, for making music videos from cartoon clips. It came with a bonus VHS tape.
descriptions.dos:b191f16d12313621: A simple Arkanoid-style paddle game in which the ball cannot fall out of the screen.
descriptions.dos:b19cc46b067e33dc: A remake of the 1986 isometric action adventure Batman with color graphics and sounds, renamed Watman. Assemble the hovercraft and rescue Robin in a batcave full of bizarre creatures and surreal rooms.
descriptions.dos:b1c1a0c95a06d253: An arcade action game of six levels in which you evolve from an amoeba to a human. In the amoeba stage, eat all the DNA while avoiding spores, microbes and antibodies.
descriptions.dos:b1cc52a2afefb358: Don Bluth's second Laserdisc conversion after Dragon's Lair. As Dexter, fight the madman Borf, who has kidnapped your girlfriend Kimberly and threatens the world with the Infanto Ray, which turns adults into children.
descriptions.dos:b1cdc5bde118d85e: A puzzle game in which you control a black orb in a labyrinth of 200 landscapes. The main task is to open oxyd stones by bumping them to uncover matching colored symbols, like a memory game.
descriptions.dos:b1e4386efcc0fe06: A turn-based, command-driven strategy game in the mold of Star Trek. Command the star cruiser Illiad of the Consortium of Planets, protecting an 8x8 galaxy from the Kaons and Omegans.
descriptions.dos:b1e78d6bb0427366: As a noble ninja, prove the honor of the shogun Yuichiro by recovering a stolen sword from the evil Toranaga, walking from a village to a castle and fighting enemies and traps with martial arts.
descriptions.dos:b1f1924aaf684578: A round-based simulation of the Korean War, June 1950 to April 1951. Play Douglas MacArthur, commander of United Nations forces, or the Chinese general staff, managing the conflict at a limited level or escalating it.
descriptions.dos:b1fd97b598347a21: A remake of an obscure 1983 game with new graphics, sound and music. Move a blue X called Zippy through a labyrinth of dangerous obstacles and dead ends in a maze that moves independently of you.
descriptions.dos:b2025c0020b1df29: An educational anatomy game set at the end of the 21st century, when infections resistant to conventional medicine plague humanity and you take missions inside the body.
descriptions.dos:b2129d70888d2d68: A versus fighting game set in China's Three Kingdoms era with sixteen heroes and three modes: Conquer China, Warriors Battle and Two-Player Match Ups.
descriptions.dos:b224038150604240: The follow-up to Legend for the Amiga, an isometric 3D role-playing game in an Eastern setting. You control four characters, a Barbarian, Runemaster, Assassin and Troubadour, solving puzzles and conquering dungeons.
descriptions.dos:b235202b3e8e9661: A 3D racing game in which the Pod-People, an alien race stranded in an abandoned toy shop on Earth after their planet is destroyed, race.
descriptions.dos:b237289faa1b6843: Create a fighter and take him to the top of the Heavyweight, Middleweight or Welterweight division. Before each fight you train for a set number of weeks, and the fights are viewed from the side.
descriptions.dos:b237875c96be42ea: A short photographic point-and-click story about meeting Vida. Try different actions to advance the encounter, and an unsuccessful choice generally lets you try again.
descriptions.dos:b239e2ea1f9437fa: A platformer made for a marketing campaign for the Israeli snack Bamba, in which you play the snack's baby mascot collecting Bamba scattered around the Jungle and delivering it to animals, with a single course.
descriptions.dos:b242098b63d39511: An empty house with nothing to manipulate, meant as sample code for Mr. Kenner's Adventure Game and Interactive Fiction Generator. It uses one-letter commands.
descriptions.dos:b2422dff258b9d54: An educational game teaching logic and reasoning. In a mysterious castle, Mr. Winn says a treasure awaits at the top of a tower, but you must solve puzzles and riddles to climb its floors.
descriptions.dos:b246599e76f978e1: A good-looking four-player take on Arkanoid, in which AI can control any of the paddles.
descriptions.dos:b2508275e04ba9af: A side-scrolling platformer loosely based on King Arthur's myth. You play Artura, son of the Pendragon, rescuing Nimue from your half-sister Morgause, fighting spiders and bats with an axe.
descriptions.dos:b2524de7cadbd5b3: A strategic-level wargame of World War II in Europe, based on the Avalon Hill board game of the same name.
descriptions.dos:b25fc36967e12d79: A small, witty text adventure with clever puzzles. You visit your friend John Baker, who is missing, and a blizzard rolls in while you wait.
descriptions.dos:b2699832c4681167: An educational game in which kids learn physics by steering a ball with four settings: gravity, friction, ball material and initial force. It looks like Marble Madness but is easier, with 5 levels of several rooms each.
descriptions.dos:b2701107fb53ae6d: A puzzle board game in which you swap tiles to line up same-colored sequences and eliminate them. Tile shapes vary from squares to triangles and hexagons, and a limited pocket supplies tiles.
descriptions.dos:b27c84da77bb6781: A single-player shareware mix of chess and wargaming played on a 20x50 board with three hundred pieces on each side, as the alien Tommy plays.
descriptions.dos:b297fc24dc105322: A platformer in which Spider-Man rescues Mary Jane from the villain Mysterio on a film set studio. Fight enemies and stun them with web.
descriptions.dos:b2ab39a7600d58f4: A squad-based tactical strategy game like the later X-COM, and sequel to Tegel's Mercenaries. Insect aliens called K'Kistiks are draining the Consortium's planets, and one last planet, Berok, remains.
descriptions.dos:b2af3749006c101f: The third Magic Candle top-down role-playing game, similar to the early Ultima games, with a more complex party management system that lets you divide your party and give each group tasks.
descriptions.dos:b2bcf01d822f8339: A Pac-Man clone that encourages seeking a college degree: you collect A's instead of dots while avoiding monsters like Goofoff, Chicky, Boozer and Junky.
descriptions.dos:b2cc9a06a5801050: A versus fighting game set in 80,000 AD, when humanity has reached the peak of its evolution and faces de-evolution after mutations are introduced into the gene pool.
descriptions.dos:b2cd8a7c556db5a2: A Gauntlet-style arcade game with text adventure elements, in which your bandit visits 16 worlds throughout time to grab as much loot as possible.
descriptions.dos:b2d8d2941c59c98d: A children's story-builder that lets kids create magical stories with a click, with no computer knowledge needed. After selecting a word, the scene comes to life.
descriptions.dos:b2de798bcb088cca: A side-scrolling shooter in which you defend your colonies from waves of attacking aliens, with layered scrolling screens and new background artwork and enemies for each of 7 levels.
descriptions.dos:b2f5fd2442dc5b54: Drive a one-man tank through arctic, desert and urban environments, blowing up trees, buildings and walls. Enemies attack in tanks, planes, helicopters and on foot, and each weapon works best on a specific enemy.
descriptions.dos:b31b0d72755d7800: An adventure in which you play Jim, who must write his thesis.
descriptions.dos:b31d51f4f4ec16c5: A role-playing game with adventure and action elements. Your team of four spies, Kat, Tia, Roco and Mad Dog, must recover stolen documents from a fortified secret laboratory and escape alive.
descriptions.dos:b32ba20caedb9c0c: The second Leisure Suit Larry game. Larry Laffer, thrown out by his great love, is left with nothing and sets off looking for love again in several wrong places.
descriptions.dos:b332f81ddba9a511: The caveman-era platformer sequel to Prehistorik. Use your club on animal enemies that drop bonus items, with no required food target this time.
descriptions.dos:b335774d5ab4bca5: A Doom clone made with the Pie 3D Game Creation System. Escape a prison against grey-dressed guards, using guns, machine guns, bombs and lasers, and find keys to open doors or bomb them.
descriptions.dos:b341fc4cd1858764: A puzzle game in which you fill all squares of an 8x8 board with rectangular pieces having yellow or red sides, scoring as many points as possible.
descriptions.dos:b347ba5bb8555674: The sequel to Wizball. The screen doesn't scroll and you have full control of Wizkid, bashing him into bricks of different shapes and sizes.
descriptions.dos:b348a6b0f0a10dcc: A Breakout-style game in which you clear levels by bouncing the ball back up against the blocks.
descriptions.dos:b34b12bb0d234e1e: Pinball Dreams Deluxe, a compilation of 8 tables from Pinball Dreams and Pinball Dreams II, with a Hi-Res graphic mode that shows almost two thirds of a table on screen.
descriptions.dos:b359209964d562bf: An ASCII text-based air traffic control simulation in which each plane is shown as a letter and arrow, and a side list shows planes in your airspace. Guide airplanes safely to their destinations.
descriptions.dos:b35935e7aa365da7: Pilot a starfighter on missions from locating lost artifacts to destroying the enemy in an early first-person space shooter.
descriptions.dos:b35f1ac37d9cc418: An early Compaq-DOS demo suite, including Time to Play, a collection of games, along with a Biorhythms program.
descriptions.dos:b36440cc1274a818: An Infocom text adventure in which you are a backwater island's top diver and shipwreck expert, hired by shady characters to locate and salvage sunken treasure.
descriptions.dos:b364a95c8817fd5c: An arcade-oriented baseball game, called TV Sports: Baseball in Europe, in which you pick from 26 teams and play as batter and pitcher. It includes a managerial element for full seasons.
descriptions.dos:b36653d015b1268b: The second in a little-known series of soccer management simulators. Pick one of eighty English teams to bring to League, FA Cup and European glory, and choose a coaching role of five.
descriptions.dos:b367de09906b3fc1: George, Lizzy and Ralph, turned into a gorilla, lizard and werewolf by an experiment, destroy buildings by smashing at them until they collapse, with up to 3 players. The police and army try to stop them.
descriptions.dos:b36aedfb0442085f: A role-playing game in which monsters plague the island nation of Yendor and nobles are near war, and the Society of Wizards aids a brave adventurer who must also recover the wizards' stolen orb.
descriptions.dos:b36edd51f7d4c3ca: A chess game from the Sargon series with variable move times from 5 seconds to infinity, move undo, side swapping and a search feature that displays its calculations.
descriptions.dos:b36ff04461eead93: A 2003 DOS port of the 1988 Irem arcade beat-em-up Vigilante.
descriptions.dos:b37814628f6c15eb: A short piece of interactive fiction in which the phone rings at 9:05 AM after a rough night and you must get up and get moving.
descriptions.dos:b3868da8559364a6: Automotive advertisement software containing a nine-hole golf game based on the Buick Classic at Westchester Country Club. Aim with the arrow keys, change clubs, and use a two-touch power bar.
descriptions.dos:b3872e594821b281: A wargame of Operation Barbarossa and the 48th Panzer Korps, the Fire Brigade. It recreates three dates in the attack, and you can play any of them from either side.
descriptions.dos:b3a1a9eab101e097: A strategy role-playing game based on TSR's Birthright world of Anuire. It combines first-person dungeon and castle quests, tactical real-time battles, and economic and diplomatic strategy.
descriptions.dos:b3a805e2a86ae0b4: A demonstration in which your PC solves the classic problem of placing eight queens on a chessboard so no two attack each other, including the algorithm in Turbo Pascal code.
descriptions.dos:b3b84a73a0e8d0c7: The Skweeks' pink land has been drained of color by Pitark, and you travel through 99 continents cleaning each one in sequence, moving Skweek in four directions.
descriptions.dos:b3b8b7bb0d778ece: The first Wizardry, one of the original dungeon crawlers. Create a party of up to six adventurers and send them into a 3D vector dungeon to fight monsters and find treasure in the domain of Trebor.
descriptions.dos:b3bb6193e425eb88: A simulation of the TV game show Now You See It. Players find answers hidden in a letter grid, and the first to 1000 points goes to the Championship Round.
descriptions.dos:b3c4206a8fed0409: A horizontally scrolling sci-fi shoot-em-up, the fourth installment of a Korean series. Choose between two pilots or have two players defend Earth against mechanical aliens.
descriptions.dos:b3d251908e62c110: A solitaire board game played with tiles, like Shanghai. Place all the tiles on the board following specific rules to obtain the highest score.
descriptions.dos:b3e4c90bbf17cbe7: An interactive children's story following the fairy tale, in which you click around each scene of characters and animals, starting by meeting the miller's daughter, her father and the king.
descriptions.dos:b3e645140a74deeb: An arcade horizontal shoot-em-up in which you control Lieutenant Henry, with a second player as Sergeant Sanders in some versions, to save Earth from the mercenary invaders of Bozon.
descriptions.dos:b3eeb4dbb77b1e9e: A falling-ball puzzle game in which you rotate clusters of colored balls and line up matching colors in horizontal or vertical lines. Finishing a stage unlocks a gallery image.
descriptions.dos:b4024074b9bc3e71: A slot machine simulation. Start with 100 coins and bet 1 to 3 coins, then click the handle to pull it down. If you run out of coins you can start a new game.
descriptions.dos:b40bc32136500674: A rare total conversion of Wolfenstein 3D with 3 new episodes, 2 new modes and modified weapons.
descriptions.dos:b42fa30acf2e4192: The first Fire and Forget game from Titus, a racing game in which you complete courses around the globe by blowing up enemies and avoiding obstacles, with six courses in each level.
descriptions.dos:b431402fe1978f12: An action game in which one or two players choose among four characters, such as Thor the Warrior, and fight through 100 levels of hordes of enemies.
descriptions.dos:b4366f15e07e45dc: An evil scientist has created rampaging monsters through genetic engineering, and you take back a chain of islands by breeding your own faster, smarter, more aggressive creatures in a lab.
descriptions.dos:b4419e7c106a9843: The second expansion module for Temple of Apshai, which is required to play it. Set in ancient Egypt, the quest is to recover four treasures from four great constructs.
descriptions.dos:b4504a2b7308fda7: A rare Spanish arcade game in which you play a chef with big eyes and a cap, first preparing and then defending your culinary masterpiece over four levels.
descriptions.dos:b455dfe1f9fc44ab: The first game based on the Spanish comic El Capitan Trueno, hero of the 12th century. It was released for the ZX Spectrum, Amstrad CPC, MSX and MS-DOS.
descriptions.dos:b45634283cf4b6b1: A single-player shareware version of the children's card game Old Maid, played against the computer with a 52-card deck from which one queen has been removed.
descriptions.dos:b45c02e4431e03cc: A maze game in which you navigate fifty stages, collect bonuses and use attacks to clear obstacles or stun enemies. It also offers competitive play for up to four players.
descriptions.dos:b464b05c8a63ad72: A Korean educational game like Where in Time Is Carmen Sandiego?, in which a detective for a futuristic agency in 2010 pursues a criminal who escaped with a time machine through various time periods.
descriptions.dos:b46d4555e56fdb27: A Breakout variant with special abilities such as releasing several balls or a ball that cuts through solid blocks, levels with teleporters and bumpers, and a training mode.
descriptions.dos:b477a71cf7bcaf7e: A question-and-answer guessing game based on the TV show, played against the computer or another person. Questions come from a poll of 100 people, and you guess how many answered Yes or No.
descriptions.dos:b47d9c150cefc8b8: The fourth Dizzy game. The land has been corrupted by an evil wizard, and Dizzy, the egg, walks, jumps and flips through many screens, picking up and using items and talking to people.
descriptions.dos:b47ecda979c5a271: A fast-paced platformer starring Zool, a gremlin-like creature from another dimension who travels through six worlds of three stages each to earn the rank of Ninja.
descriptions.dos:b499d2d005cc111a: A TV and movie trivia game for up to 14 individuals or teams.
descriptions.dos:b49e9e60b3b2140f: In the age of King Arthur, a new knight proves himself by searching the kingdom for Excalibur and the Black Knight whose Dwarf minions stole it, in a platformer with hidden treasure troves.
descriptions.dos:b4ba1b70ab05aaf7: A side-view arcade game without scrolling, inspired by Underwurlde and Starquake. You control a tank-like robot that can split in two, with its head flying off on its own.
descriptions.dos:b4bb07000ec71e50: An unofficial English fan translation of a Polish adventure in which the friends Kajko and Kokosz face the Rogueknights and their plot to conquer the village of Mirmilowo, in a setting that resembles Asterix.
descriptions.dos:b4c5cc9945b2bb4f: The war against the Kilrathi is going badly. As war hero Colonel Christopher Blair aboard the old carrier Victory, you lead the Confederation's last-ditch attempt to destroy the Kilrathi.
descriptions.dos:b4c6e1eb33e828ac: An arcade-action math adventure in which you flip, jump, duck and shoot your way to defeat Apathy and return to Mt. Olympus, learning the Numbers of Light.
descriptions.dos:b4c85791898b64cb: A text adventure sequel in which you use the components from part 1 to make a magical arrow to destroy Zerdon, the accomplice of the Wizard Akyrz.
descriptions.dos:b4d452da0401b18f: A strategy game set in 16th-century Japan in which you conquer your opponent's cities on Honshu. Occupy all ten cities to win by forming armies to defend your five and attack theirs.
descriptions.dos:b4d9225df9707ccd: A seven card stud poker game from The WorkWare Co. in which you start with $500 and play against up to seven other players. Registering one game in the series gets you discs with all three.
descriptions.dos:b511ec3828f86bd0: A sci-fi role-playing game in which you lead a team of high-tech mercenaries on dozens of missions in four star systems, with three real-time combat systems: deep space, atmospheric air combat and ground battles.
descriptions.dos:b518c07fe209286c: A 2D action game set in 2040, in which a maintenance engineer sent by mistake to a desolate planet at the edge of the universe tries to earn his way home as humanity turns planets into hydroponic greenhouses.
descriptions.dos:b535561fa43007f4: A real-time strategy game focused on combat without base building. In 2045 terrorists seize an island in the Pacific, and a mercenary group called the Panic Soldiers is sent to drive them away.
descriptions.dos:b5399fa7c86554b1: An abstract puzzle game in which you set up a network of pipes so that a substance called flooz flows through as many as possible. Pieces are offered in random order in seven types.
descriptions.dos:b5438ed532761726: A one-on-one fighting game in which the Dalai Llama organizes a martial arts contest for animals of all species. You take on furry creatures, and finally the Dalai Llama himself, across mostly outdoor levels.
descriptions.dos:b54463c256c0d322: A random level generator for Doom and Doom II that usually creates levels of killing monsters and picking up health, weapons and ammunition before reaching the exit.
descriptions.dos:b5460721babfbcf8: A product tie-in with Unilever's Peperami salami. In the town of Snackopolis, tension between cookies, vegetables and other snack creatures is rising before the mayoral election.
descriptions.dos:b54edb0796ec57ab: A straightforward jet simulation with an open-ended mission, in which the primary role is Combat Air Patrol, and ground attacks are possible once enemy air cover is reduced. You can use wingmen.
descriptions.dos:b55fd7c654f29113: A fantasy adventure spoof with British humor. Choose between two protagonists, explore a nonlinear world, trade barbed dialogue with wandering characters and solve puzzles across several quests.
descriptions.dos:b56d13f7d711b69c: You and several unarmed friends cross treacherous landscapes to retrieve treasures stolen by the Evil Master. You carry a crossbow and shoot obstacles and enemies in your friends' way.
descriptions.dos:b571b4afed4adac5: The sequel to Rebel Assault. Starfighter pilot Rookie One answers a distress call from a freighter while scouting the Dreighton Nebula, where ships are known to disappear.
descriptions.dos:b5722c4c1bd30632: A shareware game controlled by keyboard, mouse or joystick in which you spin a web and catch all the flies before they breed out of control. You can erase flies with the spider.
descriptions.dos:b57e2375563908f5: Get rich betting at the dog racing track. You start with $1000 plus half that in the bank, with three greyhounds in each race, betting on the winner only for a fixed 150% return.
descriptions.dos:b58411fa1109bddb: An arcade game set in ImpArea, which is full of imps transporting the souls of sinners. You have a limited time to free as many lost souls as possible with your magic glass on a static screen.
descriptions.dos:b58ae9b5a2d3ff8f: Ride an off-road bike through all the stages of the African trail. Choose three items of equipment before each stage, meet other riders who try to knock you off, and gauge your speed.
descriptions.dos:b59909c31ebfc0f5: A Worms-like game in real time instead of turn-based. Each player picks 5 weapons out of 40, from pistols and shotguns to bazookas and cluster bombs, and can dig through mud and jump.
descriptions.dos:b5a095fcb0f180c1: A single-player shareware backgammon game against the computer with three skill levels, a tournament mode, modem play and a score table, playable by keyboard or mouse.
descriptions.dos:b5a37c66ceccc634: A severely ill man on the operating table is trapped in his own subconscious by a daemon named Emily. To escape he must find four orbs in Dali-influenced mini-games, in a game with action and puzzle elements.
descriptions.dos:b5a5de695dae1e2c: A Space Invaders clone in which you control a small space fighter to destroy lines of alien ships before they reach the bottom of the screen.
descriptions.dos:b5ac8e3b9f4c340e: Command the USS Columbia to stop warships from attacking Federation Headquarters in an ASCII space battle game where you must destroy all the warships.
descriptions.dos:b5b800e733f3673d: A Korean beat-em-up in which the peoples of the world have formed a peaceful Great Nation, but evil returns, so the president creates an elite police force of the world's strongest, most courageous fighters.
descriptions.dos:b5c482f19968155c: A text adventure in which a wealthy eccentric relative has died and his $7.4 million inheritance goes to whoever first finds his secret invention, with a cousin also searching for it.
descriptions.dos:b5c5f526cf5e1463: A text-graphics remake of Pac-Man in which you eat dots in a maze while avoiding ghosts. Four flashing dots make the ghosts edible for shorter times on later levels.
descriptions.dos:b5d05df38307f140: An early adaptation of the TV game show in which you climb the pyramid by winning rounds. In each round you choose a category and give clues for words that share a common thread.
descriptions.dos:b5e2a3eff5ebeba2: A fixed-screen shooter with vector and bitmapped graphics.
descriptions.dos:b5ec67ad3f33888e: A text adventure set in a collapsed world as the Federated Nations fall apart and rioters storm the Washington Monument. Only Doctor Virgil can save the world.
descriptions.dos:b5f5f0050d0557da: A simple head-to-head deathmatch between two spaceships. Choose two powerups such as missiles, shields and cloaking, then fight the computer or a human at difficulties from sitting duck to very dangerous.
descriptions.dos:b5f68573e70545d9: A puzzle game in which, as a hero, you collect all the hearts in each of 25 levels by solving puzzles such as turning blue hearts red and crossing water with limited blocks.
descriptions.dos:b5fa58496783fe23: A role-playing game from MicroProse released the year of Darklands, with a 256-color VGA top-down view. As Prince of Alonia you control a party in the world of Nhagardia.
descriptions.dos:b60c30821a275ca0: A virtual comic like They Call Me... The Skul. Five living suits of armor have invaded Earth, four set on destroying it and the fifth out to stop them, but it must first bond with a host.
descriptions.dos:b616d921a691d9e2: A role-playing game in which you are a Battlemage with the skills of a fighter, wizard and cleric, hired as a mercenary to repel an inhuman horde from the South on the islands of Argentan.
descriptions.dos:b6257fefb84144ba: A vertically scrolling action game in which you fly a jet up a river to destroy the enemy's bridges, while balloons, ships, choppers and aircraft try to stop you. Fly over fuel stations to refuel.
descriptions.dos:b63af55333a6eea6: Four indoor sports in DesignStar's SportTime line: ten-pin bowling, air hockey, darts and ping pong. Each has computer opponents at multiple skill levels plus human-versus-human and demo modes.
descriptions.dos:b63fa6435c4e20ca: A Build Engine first-person shooter demo whose full game was never finished. You begin on Pymandros, captured by the Lesyrgian Troops who have come to regain the All-Father.
descriptions.dos:b6418d02257ebeb0: A Columns clone from Uzbekistan, apparently made at the Tashkent State Technical University, in which you line up blocks of falling figures in three or more of one color.
descriptions.dos:b6424eb87e1e1a28: A freeware game in which you control a one-ton weight and crush as many of the people walking across the screen as possible by hitting them.
descriptions.dos:b64e80eb90fb68c9: A computerized checkers game in which you eat all the enemy pieces before your opponent does. You can choose your piece color, one of nine enemy levels, and a defensive or offensive strategy.
descriptions.dos:b665ecc4d117dac3: Use the keyboard to match the space and color of objects on the screen.
descriptions.dos:b67523c7e1233f98: An adventure in which you make choices for the unlucky Beasley through his evening, where the right choice moves you on and the wrong choice is instant death.
descriptions.dos:b6757f2063a32199: A poker game with a short guide to the basics, and the ability to play a single game or take part in a tournament.
descriptions.dos:b67857a0555d4e43: A Color Lines-type puzzle game on a hexagonal cell board. Build straight lines of at least five identical fruits, which disappear from the board, as three new fruits appear each turn.
descriptions.dos:b67cad912ef16a09: Six clans are at war in the land of Sorinor, each hiring mercenaries to kill opposing VIPs and protect their own. You are a mercenary commander winning battles as offense or defense, in a campaign or single missions.
descriptions.dos:b67d1db310c720e6: The third game in the Star Fleet universe, narrower in focus. You manage the planetary invasion forces of the Krellan Empire against the United Galactic Alliance, a bit like playing Empire in a sci-fi setting.
descriptions.dos:b67f861eb52f1867: A simple fantasy first-person shooter in which a mage descends into the dungeons of Grelminar the Lich to kill him and save a man named Nemesis, with a chargeable fireball spell as his only weapon.
descriptions.dos:b6818af6e42d7b83: A shooter in which chickens run onto the screen and you throw an unlimited number of bombs at them.
descriptions.dos:b685968509773779: The sequel to Clonk, adding a strategy part to the melee rounds. Two to four players each lead troops of Clonks to conquer towns and castles on a hexagon map.
descriptions.dos:b68aa99540a78dd2: As Rick Dangerous, stop the Fat Guy and his plan to help an alien race take over the world, through Hyde Park, Ice Caverns, Forest and Atomic Mines, solving puzzles and memorizing traps.
descriptions.dos:b69326c872458e60: A flight simulation in which you fly mail runs from airports in one of 5 American states. It features VOR tower readings, DME and ILS.
descriptions.dos:b69d5519ba066be9: A German platformer with English support and no specific plot, in which you play a strange creature shaped like a purple ball on two thin legs.
descriptions.dos:b6a1f30f8b8114a7: Control a small frog jumping across lily pads toward his goal. The pads shrink and sink, new ones appear, and enemy bugs chase you; touching bad bugs or water means death.
descriptions.dos:b6a775d036d76709: A Breakout variant with several different types of power-ups.
descriptions.dos:b6a7b44994061c10: A Concentration game about Moses and the Bible for one to three players, who match pairs of facedown cards. The player with the most pairs wins.
descriptions.dos:b6b2ad8bafbd980f: An Eamon adventure in which a free-wheeling fantasy adventurer from the Guild of Free Adventurers undertakes dangerous quests on the world of Eamon to earn riches and experience.
descriptions.dos:b6b3142d39e280cc: The New Second Edition of the Wheel of Fortune game by ShareData, with more than a thousand new phrases to guess.
descriptions.dos:b6b4257a3b3563cc: A post-apocalyptic adventure in which you play Raven, a psionic mutant Tuner working for the Tuner Netwerk, who witnesses the massacre of a village by Protozorqs and disobeys his orders.
descriptions.dos:b6b8983fe8254bb4: A real-time strategy game set in 16th-century Korea, where rival armies fight for supremacy. Food, wood and metal build structures and troops, and spare resources can be sold for money.
descriptions.dos:b6c8b0a375715834: A five-set tennis game against the computer or another player, with an isometric court, five skill levels and scoring that follows real tennis.
