descriptions.dos:bc305d566745f00f: Extend an oil-mining robotic arm deep below the earth's crust to mine oil while avoiding monstrous bugs, which cost you a life if they touch the arm.
descriptions.dos:bc35b08f0b1a8488: Set in 1800, command one of five factions vying for control of India. Territories generate taxes you spend on hiring troops and improving the military, industry or law and order.
descriptions.dos:bc36dad82af40939: Command a five-person treasure hunting team searching underwater sites for sunken treasure and artifacts, training your crew for roles such as divers who avoid sharks and scientists.
descriptions.dos:bc3afa1cc3b3552d: A single-player escape-the-maze game in which you are a hero taken prisoner by the nation of Markana and left alone in their trap and puzzle-laden maze, which they believe is impenetrable.
descriptions.dos:bc3b4bde3751bab7: An X-Men game set in the Murderworld amusement arcade. Magneto and Arcade have kidnapped Professor X, and the X-Men must rescue him, combining action and adventuring skills.
descriptions.dos:bc5737bf66f0f601: A game developed for an interactive TV game show similar to the Danish Hugo show, in which candidates at home controlled the hero Coba by phone in several minigames.
descriptions.dos:bc687e0393d7d478: Man an advanced helicopter and shoot at humanity's problems across five unrelated levels of two stages each, such as destroying drug plants in South America or dealing with terrorists at sea.
descriptions.dos:bc6bd9a4b49def9f: A Mahjongg variant in which you remove tiles with the same marks until the board is empty. Tiles can be eliminated when they are projected on the same line with no tiles between them.
descriptions.dos:bc70292782fb62c4: A simple two-player tactical combat simulation on a hex grid set in the Cold War, with six Soviet units attacking three cities defended by four US units.
descriptions.dos:bc720caca94d6a3e: The sequel to the arcade driving simulator Hard Drivin'. Complete laps of three courses, including the Hard Drivin' track, before a timer expires, with checkpoints adding time.
descriptions.dos:bc84edda4e14e428: You control a battle tank, the Rotor, hovering in a 2D labyrinth with heavy gravity. Any contact with walls or enemies is deadly, so you rotate it freely and use an afterburner to maneuver.
descriptions.dos:bc966842d9a1fa8b: A single-player shareware adventure based on the 1992 Los Angeles riots, set in a DOS window. You start at a motorway junction outside the city and pick an attitude with which to approach the situation.
descriptions.dos:bc9923e2fcb3cbcd: A real-time strategy game in which you start with a few Baldies and build structures, increase your population and create weapons. There are four classes: builders, scientists, soldiers and workers.
descriptions.dos:bc9a16695611f019: A collection of mini-games starring ALF, the wise-talking alien who crash-landed on Earth, in a party theme.
descriptions.dos:bca843a26546a5ba: A pinball simulation on a table called The Web. With three flippers, send the ball into openings, trapdoors and ramps for bonuses such as multiball, and some targets activate special missions.
descriptions.dos:bcb0ee3b662d622a: The sequel to Infiltrator, in which you infiltrate an enemy compound on foot or fly missions in an attack helicopter. Enter huts to retrieve weapons and information.
descriptions.dos:bcb45e3f8e9cd60a: A simple Rogue-like role-playing game in which you enter a multi-level dungeon and return with a valuable treasure, fighting, bribing or evading enemies along the way.
descriptions.dos:bcbb5e2bb732f8b8: Extinguish all the flames in a building by forming groups of five or more connected water droplets of the same color as the flames.
descriptions.dos:bccb8a6b4ee2021c: A wargame simulating the Battle of Gettysburg, July 1-3, 1863. Command Union or Confederate forces, play two-player, or watch the computer play both sides.
descriptions.dos:bcd3f9ba70462dec: A spelling game for children in which you control Muscle Pete, walking across the floor to touch the letters that spell objects shown on screen.
descriptions.dos:bcfb926b365c6c68: A remake of Lode Runner in which other men try to steal your gold. Collect all the gold bricks and climb the stairs to the top to win.
descriptions.dos:bd06f1ed18b24c18: Build a great galactic empire protected by a huge frontier shield by completing missions, trading with starbases and fighting off invading aliens. The ship is flown top-down with gauges for energy, temperature and radiation.
descriptions.dos:bd260dcd201232ca: A real-time adventure in which you are a prisoner in a jail guarded by droids on day and night patrol, and must find your way out of a labyrinth, bashing doors, as your health decreases.
descriptions.dos:bd2f6cfc4ffaf3f1: An artillery game inspired by Gorillas with warring rats, who lob fiery death at each other in a dispute over a warehouse full of restaurant supplies.
descriptions.dos:bd332d4edd6b4523: A collection of simple children's games, including Rock Paper Scissors, 23 Matches, where whoever takes the last match loses, and a Connect Four variant.
descriptions.dos:bd3757a9ba52dd3c: After crash-landing a UFO, Leonard and Bubba fight their way back to Hickston. This standalone sequel adds vehicles, weapons and enemies across fourteen first-person shooter levels.
descriptions.dos:bd57a536d964ca85: A 3D dungeon crawler tribute remake of Mazzembly, starring the aspiring demoscener Demulamu touring a virtual reality demo party to gain fame, with randomly generated levels.
descriptions.dos:bd616f73a72e02df: An amateur clone of the Amiga game Alien Breed by one-person Crowfoot Software, released in 1997.
descriptions.dos:bd6a9f27e0fb1f1f: subLOGIC's simple flight simulator offering free flight and over 200 flight assignments for beginner pilots, with five small aircraft including the Cessna CitationJet.
descriptions.dos:bd6cc8863c1dad08: An updated Battlezone in which you compete in the T-Mek tournament of the future, controlling a hovercraft in an arena and blowing up everyone else, with an overall view of your opponents.
descriptions.dos:bd7c1dfd012b62b0: A fan-made sequel to Chex Quest 2 whose content was found to have been taken from various other WADs.
descriptions.dos:bd9ac776743d509c: A strategy game that recreates the world as the Vikings experienced it, where the gods matter in every decision and a glorious death is a high goal. You compete against other players for the gods' favor.
descriptions.dos:bda16d7cc84da8cf: An arcade side-scrolling shooter in which you pilot a submarine through treacherous underwater caves to destroy a heavily guarded reactor, armed with missiles, torpedoes and a Big Kill weapon.
descriptions.dos:bdafa10dbebfb258: Ocean's game of the 1992 Olympics in Barcelona, with a variety of disciplines divided into sections including track and field events such as running, relay, hurdles, discus, shot put and jumps.
descriptions.dos:bdb53722f9e821b8: An unconventional boxing game in which low blows and other normally forbidden moves are allowed. Enter a tournament against the computer or challenge a friend.
descriptions.dos:bdb9ac121b132979: A role-playing game set in 2400 A.D. in which you are about to join the Underground resistance. Characters and robots move in real time and are seen from a top-down perspective.
descriptions.dos:bdc9c98a4c0dcc49: An unusual arcade space simulator from Spanish developers, made in English by a very small team of amateurs and published on physical media.
descriptions.dos:bdd84f1c9783410f: A shareware educational trilogy for ages three to seven covering maths, the alphabet and reading in sea-themed mini-games. Each volume has five mini games, the first being the Maths Wave.
descriptions.dos:bde3d4b4a707be9f: A word challenge game that measures your English. Pick the right synonym or definition for the highlighted word from four choices, with a hundred words per volume across four volumes.
descriptions.dos:bde616c738d77b44: A short Korean shoot-em-up that can be very simple or very difficult depending on settings, with a short story told in Korean before it begins.
descriptions.dos:bde6b24b9e4ea7b7: An educational maths game in which all twelve activities and puzzles are based on setting up and managing a circus, building skills like spatial reasoning and pattern recognition.
descriptions.dos:bdea4df48bd2feb5: A comic adventure about nine-year-old Willy Beamish getting into trouble with his sister, his teacher Ms. Glass and his parents.
descriptions.dos:bdeb3ea6ef36c61f: A stand-alone expansion for Dawn Patrol with SVGA graphics, head-to-head play via modem, improved AI, several camera views, 13 planes and over 150 levels.
descriptions.dos:bded958e520135ea: A fan game based on Ron Gilbert's Monkey Island series.
descriptions.dos:bdf8e63bf0c6fd92: The sequel to Impossible Mission. You have 8 hours to stop the psychotic genius Elvin from destroying the world, entering his tower fortress, avoiding robots, assembling security combinations and recovering musical sequences.
descriptions.dos:bdfdd1779b046d6b: A Danish platformer based on a Danish television series.
descriptions.dos:be034aab4d08e84d: A sequel to the original Soccer Management text simulator.
descriptions.dos:be06b7e33d46ea14: A port of the Windows game Minesweeper back to MS-DOS, with a grid of concealed cells, some containing mines and others showing the number of adjacent mines.
descriptions.dos:be1260697cb6bed2: A single-player shareware Snake variant with keyboard control, adjustable speed and sound toggling.
descriptions.dos:be2ad27e7cc6380b: A puzzle game starring aliens from the planet Phrohmaj, in which you place all the colored tiles into the correct spaces on the board, with always one more tile than spaces.
descriptions.dos:be2f4b08eba194c9: A basketball game with a black-basketball theme, many game options including one on one and group, and a betting option.
descriptions.dos:be35fdb1cb9951a9: A freeware billiards game for two players on a pocketless table seen from above, with sliders to set shot power and table temperature, and close-up windows for cue aim.
descriptions.dos:be37fd0ffcd5d5b5: A turn-based strategy game in which you play a warlock, sorceress, barbarian or knight, building a castle to earn units such as dragons and cyclopes that strengthen your hero's army.
descriptions.dos:be3b447b9d1ee07e: A platformer in which Drake, who came to Africa for treasure, crashes his plane in the jungle and explores 13 levels of cave complex to find the exit, avoiding or killing enemies.
descriptions.dos:be4d7ceb6942343b: Bloodlust Software's parody of Pong in which the paddles have attitude and special moves and the ball, now a severed head, complains when you hit it.
descriptions.dos:be52a81da6e4b402: A space shooter reminiscent of Computer Space. Fly a starship on a wrap-around field with inertial thrust in any direction, pursued by enemy formations, firing only left or right.
descriptions.dos:be5dd19ab2edf837: A remake of the Amiga/Atari ST game with a Thrust-like feel. Make your way through levels collecting all cargo containers and returning them to your base, past enemies patrolling the caves.
descriptions.dos:be5e933a4e44284d: Play five-card draw poker against Donna or Sam in Anco's continuation of the series, exchanging cards, raising bets and managing a starting bankroll of one hundred dollars.
descriptions.dos:be6bf9159c421bf2: Take the role of a Marine Corps commander responsible for several divisions, who has to wait for his men to call in with information, in a battle history of the United States Marine Corps.
descriptions.dos:be6f34a73cdc44ad: A game based on Atari's arcade game in which you play the Road Runner, running along the road, avoiding trucks, landmines and falling rocks, eating birdseed, and not getting caught by Wile E. Coyote.
descriptions.dos:be7188498b099545: You play the mighty Thor, using your hammer to solve problems and deal with beasts, in an action puzzle game with a slightly noticeable story.
descriptions.dos:be760fb4d8389def: A homage to 1950s horror films in which you play Count Frederick Valdemar entering a gothic mansion with six levels full of vampires, zombies, ghouls and other creatures.
descriptions.dos:be7ca3cb22c67362: A SimCity-like game with a military element, set in the distant future, in which you are Colony Administrator of a new settlement on a far-flung planet, aiming for the highest Quality of Life for the colonists.
descriptions.dos:be7cfd7785e6de5e: A strategy game in which you are an aspiring pizza chef who wants to start the best pizza chain in the world. Choose a character with varying starting money and a city in the USA or Europe.
descriptions.dos:be82cf548b03fe4d: A text adventure at the English Language Institute of the University of Delaware, in which you play an international student arriving at the institute in a simplified simulation of student life.
descriptions.dos:be8745172c924a1e: A Concentration game about David from the Bible for 1 to 3 players, who match pairs of facedown cards related to stories of David.
descriptions.dos:be8965ac84047bb9: The sequel to Cyberdogs with improved gameplay. Take your character on missions shooting everything around with weapons bought before missions, with an editor for making your own.
descriptions.dos:be8abd544cfdc3ab: A German turn-based racing game in which you choose up to four opponents and one of twenty-five tracks.
descriptions.dos:be8b7dab992e3394: A PC conversion of the stock market board game. Invest in stocks when prices are low and sell when they rise, starting with $5000 in cash and 10 different securities.
descriptions.dos:be8ed2946b6c9cf2: A stand-alone add-on to Lemmings with 100 new levels and all new graphics and music.
descriptions.dos:beaa286c7f543a20: Control a multi-segmented snake in a maze, surviving and earning points. Three enemy snakes enter each level, and you complete it by eating them all, though you can only eat segments of one that outnumbers yours.
descriptions.dos:beae27220d457612: A shareware first-person action game with a Tron-like plot. The evil Dr. Devaro lures users into The Grid to play malicious games, and you ride a hypercycle against his legions of riders.
descriptions.dos:bec1cf0f4ba763fa: A classic space shooter in pure text mode, made for a DOS game creation competition at high-voltage.cz, with source code included.
descriptions.dos:bed0a1061986390c: A DOS falling-block puzzle game with three difficulty levels, high scores and joypad support. An optional challenge mode deliberately withholds useful pieces, and a monochrome mode suits older displays.
descriptions.dos:bed54ddb9ea115ce: An adventure in which Hitler escaped by plane to Thunder Bay after the war, and after he kills your friend Mike Lam, you go on a quest to thwart him.
descriptions.dos:bed927d2d0281533: A freeware shooting range in which you shoot Barney before he escapes from the screen.
descriptions.dos:bedeb5e695cf4052: The second Elder Scrolls RPG, sequel to Arena. Daggerfall thrusts you into a non-linear world full of plots, conspiracy and political intrigue, to be faced with your wits, blade and magic.
descriptions.dos:bee39cd5d510d2dc: A PC remake of the classic by Dan and Bill Bunten. As an explorer commissioned by the King and Queen of Spain, voyage to a new world, claim land, negotiate with or conquer the natives, and gain fame and fortune.
descriptions.dos:bee53311d6b26163: A text-mode 747 flight simulator, possibly the first for PC, with code in BASIC published in BYTE in November 1982. Except at takeoff and landing, you see only the panels and controls, operated by keyboard.
descriptions.dos:bee57f228094ac7e: A wargame based on the board game, covering the Persian Gulf region with complete air, land and sea orders of battle for more than a dozen nations. It ends after 25 turns or on other victory conditions.
descriptions.dos:bee6e79f34fb4549: A shareware educational game teaching fractions, decimals, ratios, proportions and percentages to grades 4 to 9. In 2135 a super hero answers a message from the evil super genius Dr. Ronan.
descriptions.dos:beea094a03cd63d4: The first Duke Nukum episode, Shrapnel City, based on the Crystal Caves engine. In 1997 the mad Dr. Proton plans to conquer the world with an army of Techbots, and Duke Nukum is the only hero who can stop him.
descriptions.dos:beec3cfdb2213c28: A shareware card game played with a 52-card deck. After the deal there is an auction in which players bid on who can win the most points in the trick-playing phase.
descriptions.dos:bef08fd6fcd30cbd: The third Wayne Gretzky Hockey game, adding VGA graphics, voice-overs, more player stats and longer league play, covering both coaching and playing.
descriptions.dos:bf03e786a9c24014: A golf game combining a 3-click swing meter with a 3D engine that brings the Australian countryside to life. It has 5 game modes, 3 skill levels and randomized flag placement each round.
descriptions.dos:bf10245af59ec4e3: The second Despair game, a first-person shooter in which the aliens from the first game are back and after you, using the same 3D engine as Castaway.
descriptions.dos:bf1216cb05f825ba: A shareware Tetris clone that shows reflections of each falling block at the bottom of the playground.
descriptions.dos:bf12a47e84915a6c: Basically European Racers with a different scenario. Four muscle cars, including a '67 Chevelle and a '71 Hemi 'Cuda, and their parts can be viewed and disassembled in a CAD-like program.
descriptions.dos:bf13374669f7eb8b: A strange isometric action game from East Asia in which you play a panda, choosing from several pandas including a female one, and find your way home screen by screen.
descriptions.dos:bf1b169ab102a0cd: A Paul Panks text adventure in which you direct Camphora, a phantom beetle, through the environs of Atsuta Jingu, plotting revenge against Sugawara no Michizane.
descriptions.dos:bf1e965112ebce1e: A BASIC game simulating the running of a large multi-user mainframe. As operator you configure memory, disk and tape drives, concurrent users and game speed, then cope with the workload.
descriptions.dos:bf23baa94cf48984: In the remote land of Eoliae, where winds move armies, the Great master has been murdered and the evil Sharkaan threatens the land. You must learn the power of the winds.
descriptions.dos:bf35734bf11da54e: A naval wargame by Peter Turkan, a programmer and military history lover who made all his games independently, released in 1994 on floppy disks and CD.
descriptions.dos:bf37b074c607ccd6: A video adventure technologically almost identical to Goody but with a more complex map, in which you alternate among three weapons and a pole while searching for David Livingstone.
descriptions.dos:bf3ab6f80637b8c9: The first Questprobe Marvel Comics game, an illustrated interactive fiction game. As Bruce Banner and the Hulk, free yourself from ropes in a desert bunker and collect all the gems to escape.
descriptions.dos:bf3d3498d21eb5e0: A single-player shareware Mahjong game with twenty tile layouts and several tile sets including traditional, monster, letters, words and colors. It is played entirely with the mouse.
descriptions.dos:bf429c5c694ad3a4: A conquest strategy game for one to four players building galactic empires by establishing and defending space colonies, managing resources and battling for star systems.
descriptions.dos:bf43c7703078b147: A tennis game for up to four players on three courts, grass, clay and asphalt, with singles for men or women or mixed doubles.
descriptions.dos:bf6519acfa5e01d8: A remake of Scott Adams's Pirate Adventure made with the Adventure Game Toolkit by David Malmberg, packed with AGT as a demo of what it could do.
descriptions.dos:bf6d289a7266bac8: An action-oriented, real-time football game officially licensed by the NFL with about 30 teams, relatively many coaching options, preseason, practice and full season modes.
descriptions.dos:bf7beacef50d96e1: The first episode of a shareware series, a platformer in which Jill, an amazon warrior, fights monsters. Her most distinguishing ability is morphing into creatures such as a bird and a fish.
descriptions.dos:bf7c88e5c2d6817e: A football strategy game that replays all the Super Bowls up to 1983 and lets you mix and match teams. You choose formations and runners and receivers and the action plays out automatically.
descriptions.dos:bf84246a0874fa31: A text adventure included in Keypunch's Swords and Sorcery package, in which you must survive in New York City.
descriptions.dos:bf851a80175cc384: A Snake take in which you commandeer a smiley-faced worm whose tail grows as you eat numbers, which add to your score. Occasionally a spider appears.
descriptions.dos:bf8b62a2f091064c: A mech action game seen from above on a rotating playing field. Complete missions by destroying targets with limited resources, fighting tanks and mechs with evasive maneuvers and cover.
descriptions.dos:bf8c634327489203: You play Arnie, an average guy who sees a woman on television that he must meet. At the station he is hired by the boss of Mad TV to run the network.
descriptions.dos:bf9de7f70f3c8218: An educational game that rewards children with animated graphics and interactive toys.
descriptions.dos:bfadcba8e3bf9b5d: You command the starship Trekboer on a mission to search the galaxy for a cure to a deadly virus that has struck Earth, in a graphical interactive fiction game.
descriptions.dos:bfae1328bc9d142f: A world conquest wargame in which you start with a city that produces armies to conquer more cities, with eight unit types including ships, fighter planes, ground units and a submarine.
descriptions.dos:bfaffa522367bbc5: A murder mystery in which you guide Nick, great-nephew of the late Randolph Steere, through the haunted Steere mansion to find out where the will is and how his uncle really died. Time for gathering clues is limited.
descriptions.dos:bfc6c3a327e5ecef: A very obscure shareware graphical text adventure sold by mail order in 1989, with graphics in the top three quarters of the screen and a plot that is a variant of The Wizard of Oz.
descriptions.dos:bfd82ec83859e703: A shareware shooter with vertical and horizontal scrolling. As a member of the Federation's elite fighter squadron Starcom, you fight a hostile force taking over small planets in the Orion galaxy.
descriptions.dos:bfd84dc2753805fb: Attend a social event and try to build a romantic connection through conversation, in a text adventure that focuses on how your approaches affect the people you meet.
descriptions.dos:bfda82c9e3d6be15: A Mahjong game against three computer players that plays like Gin rather than tile matching, in which you accumulate runs and sets to win.
descriptions.dos:bfdf26de8597701f: A crime wave hits the town of Huxley, and as mystery master you help police solve 12 crimes by interrogating suspects, searching for clues and using police station resources, within a time limit.
descriptions.dos:bffcef8c654d2389: A Bomberman clone with exactly the same gameplay and a very similar graphic style.
descriptions.dos:bffd2abe6feb3e45: The second Trump Castle game, a casino-resort where you play six games, roulette, blackjack, baccarat, slots, poker and craps, and can explore the apartments and converse with its inhabitants.
descriptions.dos:c02698e1644e4e9a: A collection of independent single-player and multiplayer levels for Quake, shipped with both DOS and Windows installers.
descriptions.dos:c033b3a44e08db44: A full-motion-video basketball game starring Scottie Pippen, played with little more than the arrow keys. Its video technique switches between scenes without lag, making play unlike other basketball simulations.
descriptions.dos:c0437153f94bf6c5: A text-based Rogue-like and precursor to NetHack. Choose a character class, descend into the dungeon, fight monsters and gather treasure.
descriptions.dos:c0443f3875735819: Aliens have invaded the museum and may have woken the dinosaurs. A teenage boy grabs his satchel and sets out to save the museum from monsters that are really computer viruses.
descriptions.dos:c04619f425b2cf1e: A fantasy role-playing game based on the first book of Tolkien's trilogy, with added elements of its own. The quest is to carry the One Ring toward Mount Doom.
descriptions.dos:c0558b4d589817de: A Taiwanese racing game. Drive one of four vehicles through Taiwanese cities, collecting race flags and fruit while dodging furious rival drivers.
descriptions.dos:c05d823460b730b4: A Mastertronic platform adventure based on James Clavell's Shogun, a different game from the Infocom one. Wander as one of several characters, building rapport.
descriptions.dos:c068df488bddd243: A stock market simulation for one to four players. Each starts with $5,000 and trades ten securities, aiming to get rich. Originally written for the DEC PDP-10 and published in Byte in 1977.
descriptions.dos:c06a0ba14d4bddb2: A freeware ASCII-style word game with play similar to Hangman and Wheel of Fortune. Choose a numbered puzzle or play a random one.
descriptions.dos:c0787c4d52546c08: A fishing simulator. Start in a rented boat with basic tackle and work up to tournament level, buying better tackle and gear such as depth finders and bass boats.
descriptions.dos:c086aaf43dac81fa: A shareware Tron game for one to four players. Each player leaves a solid trail behind as they drive, trying to make the others crash into one.
descriptions.dos:c09679b7654b5131: A baseball management game. As an all-powerful coach, you run your team and can trade, delete and create players at will.
descriptions.dos:c0a94769dca204ae: The vampire lord Kairn has murdered his family, sealed off the valley and tortures its villagers. Explore and fight through this action role-playing adventure to end his reign.
descriptions.dos:c0b11638ac5b43a0: A computer coloring book from the Electric Crayon series with about 30 pictures built around letters. Each shows a letter in upper and lower case along with objects that start with or contain it.
descriptions.dos:c0c019981f101a4a: A multiplayer cave shooter in the tradition of the Finnish freeware scene. Two to eight players pilot a choice of ships and weapons in a closed space.
descriptions.dos:c0c26b29ceaf4159: An educational game in which Scooter owns a magic castle full of chambers, secrets, puzzles and activities to explore.
descriptions.dos:c0c484cda5d5c367: Ride a Harley across open country to reach the Sturgis bike rally in ten days. Dodge fallen rocks and cars, outrun the police and rescue stranded riders along the way.
descriptions.dos:c0d45f579f7cc6ac: A text adventure set on Halloween night. Lost in an endless alley, you must pass through the old Mordred Manor and deal with an insane maestro, a sleepy skeleton and more.
descriptions.dos:c0d50603619cdee9: A pool simulator set in a pub. Aim the cue with a cross cursor and choose where the cue strikes the ball to apply spin.
descriptions.dos:c0d8dc7e3307a82f: The third Ultima and the first in the series with a party of adventurers rather than one hero. It features large towns full of people to talk to and a separate combat system.
descriptions.dos:c0ddfb97d5080abb: A port of the classic ADVENT cave exploration text adventure, endorsed as the official version by Crowther and Woods.
descriptions.dos:c0e0ae385eb213a3: A physicist on a remote orbital station must survive when hostile aliens attack and kill the rest of the crew.
descriptions.dos:c0e681c6babc3b6c: A Centipede variant for one or two players. Clear the mushroom patch of fleas, spiders, scorpions and the centipede, with difficulty levels and a high score table.
descriptions.dos:c0ebb37c8f0650bd: A text adventure in which you are a freshman on your first day at Tumbulgum University, with three seemingly simple tasks to complete before the day ends.
descriptions.dos:c0f0301492e3045b: A merchant and trading strategy game. Buy a ship from an animated dealer, then trade your way to success, in a visually impressive presentation.
descriptions.dos:c10346c97486b756: A shareware 8-ball pool game against the computer, with wireframe graphics and keyboard-only controls.
descriptions.dos:c10ae8ac0b565e59: Daredevil Biker Dave jumps his motorcycle over a growing row of cars. After each successful leap the ramps move farther apart and another car is added, with a hoop jump midway.
descriptions.dos:c10b83b66a3e93aa: The fifth Commander Keen platformer. Billy Blaze learns of the alien Shikadi's plan and sets out to stop their Armageddon Machine.
descriptions.dos:c1141530501c9888: A shareware puzzle-action game. Sir Merdimek descends into the dragon's dungeon beneath the town to free the captured souls of Grimlor's children.
descriptions.dos:c12e714d7b2c3a80: An arcade rally racing game with loose steering, handbrake turns and powerslides. It offers time trials, head-to-head races against the computer and other stages.
descriptions.dos:c1414135a1b10e54: An unlicensed BASIC clone of Pac-Man. Eat dots through a series of mazes while four ghosts patrol and chase you.
descriptions.dos:c142573a25179c10: A comedy sci-fi adventure in which Captain Spleen, in debt, hops between planets. Actions are chosen from option menus rather than typed, with PC speaker sound.
descriptions.dos:c1458d095d957919: Infiltrate Nazi headquarters in disguise, find the hidden bomb and plant it outside Hitler's bunker door. Shooting everything in sight raises the alarm.
descriptions.dos:c1469c809d1a06c6: A third-person shooter with vehicles and turrets to use. Pick an affordable mission, destroy everything in it, earn money and move on to the next.
descriptions.dos:c150bef52d5323bf: A role-playing game set in Lyramion, where the imprisoned Lord Tarbos is being freed by Marmion. Find the 13 pieces of the Amberstar to stop him.
descriptions.dos:c155791042f7b307: A text adventure. You wake in a Manhattan hotel room with no clothes, money or memory, hunted by a man and wanted for murder in Texas, and must find out what is going on.
descriptions.dos:c160dd0f16728dff: A set of computerized patterns for building 20 mechanical models. Print the pieces with the software and assemble them following the included instructions.
descriptions.dos:c16c4b89c172205a: A real-time multiplayer game in which up to four cute bunnies jump on one another's heads. Play on one keyboard or over a network.
